t: install_electron.cjs pins and verifies the CI Electron install: validatePins checks locked 44.9.2 files and checksums, then install runs electron install.js and xvfb-run --version. Misbehavior blocks packaging.
laws_range.py selects the CI diff revision base..tip for pull_request and push, using merge-base with origin/main for new branches. It fails closed on missing or ZERO revisions.
offline.sh runs a command with no network interfaces via unshare --net with only loopback up, exporting offline tool flags. Missing namespace support never executes the command.
test_laws_range.py unit-tests select_range: new-branch merge-base, PR and push ranges, manual None, and fail-closed plus mutation-killing negative controls.
Entry install(ui, exec=execFileSync); direct run calls install(path ui directory). Caller supplies ui root; exec injectable for tests. Exports install and validatePins.
Entry select_range(event, before, head, pr_base, pr_head) plus __main__ reading EVENT_NAME, BEFORE, HEAD, PR_BASE, PR_HEAD from environment and printing revision or empty string.
Entry bash offline.sh <command> [args...]; requires at least one arg and non-root caller (id -u != 0). Exec replaces shell with unshare plus inner bash.

validatePins reads ui/package.json dependencies.electron, ui/package-lock.json packages node_modules/electron version and integrity, installed package.json version, and checksums.json archive entry electron-v44.9.2-linux-arch.zip.

install scrubs electron_ and npm_config_electron/platform/arch env keys, runs node install.js with clean env, then xvfb-run electron --version; select_range maps event inputs to base and tip strings joined as base..tip.

PIN is 44.9.2. package.json dep, lock version, and installed version must equal it; lock integrity must exist; checksums[archive] must match 64 lowercase hex; version output must deep-equal exactly [v44.9.2].

ZERO is 40 zeros. push with empty or ZERO before resolves base via git merge-base origin/main tip. pull_request uses pr_base/pr_head. Other events return None. Empty or ZERO endpoints raise ValueError.
If any pin assert fails (version drift, missing integrity, absent checksum), assert throws and install aborts before exec. Caller sees AssertionError naming the mismatched field.

If binary ui/node_modules/electron/dist/electron is not executable, accessSync throws. If version lines differ, deepEqual throws installed Electron version differs. Install exec timeouts are 240s and 30s.
With no args prints offline: command required exit 2; if run as root prints offline: non-root caller required exit 2; if unshare or ip link set lo up fails, the wrapped command never executes.
Missing main causes merge-base CalledProcessError to propagate, so CI does not scan all history. __main__ catches ValueError and CalledProcessError, prints laws range: <exc> on stderr, exits 1.

Empty base or tip raises ValueError instead of returning ..tip or base... Test also executes an in-memory mutated copy weakening the guard and asserts it returns degenerate ranges, proving the guard is load-bearing.
Tester sees CI fail at Prime verified Electron with AssertionError: pinned archive checksum absent or installed Electron version differs, so no package artifact is built.
User sees offline: command required, offline: non-root caller required, or namespace setup error and the build/test command does not run at all.
States: pull_request -> base=pr_base tip=pr_head; push with before set -> before..head; push with ZERO/empty before -> merge-base origin/main tip..head; manual workflow_dispatch -> None.
Remote checksum or dist overrides must not bypass locked checksums: all env keys matching electron_ or npm_config_electron/platform/arch are deleted before install and version check.
Manual dispatch invariant: select_range returns None for workflow_dispatch, and __main__ prints empty line with exit 0.

Limits: install.js exec timeout 240000ms stdio inherit; xvfb-run --version timeout 30000ms with piped stdout. Version parse admits exactly one full line matching ^v\d+\.\d+\.\d+$ to tolerate D-Bus noise.

Resources: exports CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly and npm offline/audit/fund flags; preserves caller UID/GID via --map-current-user and keeps caps for ip.
Requires unshare with --user --map-current-user --keep-caps --net, ip to bring lo up, and xvfb-run plus electron binary downstream. No external interface is attached.
Depends on node_modules/electron install.js, checksums.json, xvfb-run, and git merge-base origin/main. PyYAML or network install is not involved here.
Chromium may emit D-Bus diagnostics on stdout as well as stderr; code filters to exact version lines because substring matching would admit noisy or conflicting pins.
Regression suite guarding hosted admission (ARG-s_ci-1) and token sanitizers (ARG-s_ci-8): it asserts package.yml gate shape, ci.yml local handoff, receipt outcomes, and log redaction.
Admission contract: workflow_pins.pin_errors empty; linux-package matrix exactly x64 on ubuntu-24.04 plus arm64 on ubuntu-24.04-arm; >=11 steps; no if on prerequisites; gate last with if always().

Header contract: job condition excludes fork PRs, fail-fast false, runs-on matrix.runner, timeout 25, pinned go file, rustup 1.97.0, cargo fetch --locked, npm ci, offline.sh npm ci, install_electron.cjs, and fixed env vars.

Gate order contract: PLATFORM must be arm64 or x64; offline bootstrap, then --verify-install MetaViewer-linux-$PLATFORM, then --smoke .tar, with METAVIEWER_MAIN_SMOKE_OK present and build<verify<smoke ordering.

Local handoff contract: ci.yml package and ci-required jobs carry matrix runner/platform, go file, cargo fetch, CARGO_TARGET_DIR, CAPSULE_UI_KIT_REPO, install_electron, and test_package_identity.py --build; no upload/download-artifact.

Receipt handoff: package writes receipt_<arch> via output.write receipt_ + PLATFORM, required consumes needs.package.outputs.receipt_<arch>; ci-required orders --build before --distribution and checks job.status.

Each mutant (gated always, conditional prime step, fork check true, single runner, dropped CARGO_TARGET_DIR, go-version literal, removed fetch, true build, arm64-only verify, true smoke) must raise AssertionError.
Handoff mutants (single runner, true instead of identity --build, needs.package.result, duplicate receipt key, single arch, hardcoded check success) must raise AssertionError.

Gate stub replaces build block with exit rc; for each arch and rc 0/7 it asserts process rc equals stub rc and receipt schema gate_receipt/v1, argv bootstrap/package/verification, rc, PASS/FAIL, scope.platform.
Shim replaces offline.sh and records calls; valid run must call bootstrap, --verify-install, --smoke in order with rc 0 and PASS. Five bad modes must exit nonzero with FAIL or BLOCKED.
Unsupported arch yields BLOCKED, rc None, counts.source unexecuted; missing or relative CARGO_TARGET_DIR skips calls entirely; failed setup and missing smoke marker yield FAIL.
sanitize extracts sanitize() shell function via regex, writes payload to temp raw file, runs bash sanitize raw sane in ROOT, and returns sane bytes; returncode must be 0.
Sanitizer contract: every sanitize() in ci.yml maps ghp/ghs/gho/ghu/ghr/github_pat plus _, %5F, %5f spellings to [REDACTED], while ghosts_of_tokens prose with short fragments stays unchanged.

For package.yml and build-other.yml, families ghp/ghs/gho/ghu/ghr/github_pat/AKIA/xoxb- in raw, upper, %5F, %5f spellings sanitize to [REDACTED]; benign log with ghosts_of_tokens stays byte-identical.
Tester sees unittest AssertionError naming the dropped prerequisite, conditional gate, wrong runner, or missing env var when a workflow edit weakens admission or handoff.
If redaction regresses, test shows raw token bytes instead of [REDACTED]; if over-redaction occurs, benign log diff shows ghosts_of_tokens prose altered.
Gate states PASS on rc 0 with smoke marker, FAIL on build/smoke/setup/target errors, BLOCKED on unsupported arch with source unexecuted. Receipt scope.platform records arm64 or x64.
No matrix member may skip prerequisites or gate: every step except last has no if, gate has exactly always(), verified both via parsed YAML and raw-text regex splits.
Ordering: Prime locked dependencies, Prepare verified Electron, Prime native toolchains all precede Execute gate; inside gate bootstrap precedes verify-install precedes smoke.
Each sanitize and gate run uses TemporaryDirectory with RUNNER_TEMP, GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY, GITHUB_SHA/RUN_ID fixtures; receipts found via rglob *.receipt.json; no network or installs.
Depends on workflow_pins.pin_errors, yaml.safe_load, package.yml/ci.yml/build-other.yml text, bash for gate/sanitize, and ROOT-based cwd. PyYAML is a runner prerequisite.
Hazard: naive substring redaction would corrupt benign words like ghosts_of_tokens; suite pins byte-identical benign output to force exact token-shape matching including encoded underscores.
workflow_pins.py enforces fail-closed workflow reference policy: every uses must be a 40-hex pinned owner/repo ref or a safe local action; violations return error strings.
Package init keeps import inert and exposes only build_parser, run, main by lazily importing mvctl on first attribute access.
Entry pin_errors(text, root) composes YAML with SafeLoader and walks nodes; __main__ reads stdin text plus argv root and prints JSON error list.
Entry __getattr__(name): if name in __all__ imports .mvctl and returns that attribute, else raises AttributeError with module has no attribute message.
Input workflow text plus repo root path; output list of strings. Local ./ refs resolve against root and recurse into action.yml/yaml; remote refs checked against PIN regex and path-part rules.
Control flows caller -> __init__.__getattr__ -> agents.metaviewer_agents.mvctl attribute; no state is cached in __init__ itself.
PIN regex owner/repo@40-hex; ref path before @ split by / must contain no empty, . or .. parts. Fullmatch required; uppercase hex and short SHAs are rejected.
YAML rules: empty workflow errors; non-string keys error except boolean on resolving to on; duplicate keys error; merge key << not admitted; uses value must be a plain string.

Local action contract: target must stay under root, exactly one of action.yml/yaml must exist, resolved metadata must be a file under root, cycles report local action cycle, invalid content reports invalid metadata.
Only build_parser, run, main resolve; any other name raises AttributeError. Importing the package alone must not import mvctl until an allowed name is requested.

Visitor states per node: MappingNode checks keys then recurses values; SequenceNode recurses items; seen set by id(node) visits each aliased or cyclic node once; active_actions tracks recursion stack, checked_actions memoizes.
Aliases sharing nodes or forming cycles are inspected once via seen dict; local-action recursion uses active/checked sets so repeats are not re-parsed and cycles terminate.
On YAML parse error returns [invalid YAML: ...]; on None document returns [empty workflow]. Callers treat nonempty list as fail-closed admission failure.
Bad refs append unpinned action, missing/ambiguous/unsafe/cyclic/invalid local action metadata, non-string key, duplicate key, merge-key, or uses-must-be-string errors; walk continues to collect all.
Unknown attribute raises AttributeError; if mvctl lacks the name, its own AttributeError propagates. No fallback import or network install is attempted.
User sees workflow admission fail with messages like unpinned action: ..., duplicate key: ..., or missing local action metadata, blocking the run instead of executing an unpinned step.
User sees AttributeError: module metaviewer_agents has no attribute ... when misspelling an API name; valid names lazily load mvctl.
Single-threaded recursive walk; no locks, retries, or timers. seen/active/checked sets are per-call local state, so concurrent pin_errors calls do not share mutation.
Reads local action metadata files as UTF-8 within root; OSError/UnicodeError/YAMLError during read become invalid metadata errors. No network installation or permissive parser fallback allowed.
PyYAML is a runner prerequisite resolved before setup-python PATH changes; root argument must be the repo root so is_relative_to checks and symlink resolution are meaningful.

Hazards: YAML aliases/cycles could cause infinite recursion without seen guard; merge keys could smuggle unpinned refs; symlinked metadata escaping root could bypass review, hence resolve plus is_relative_to checks.
Provides embedded v0.2 contract schemas mirrored from contracts/v0.2 as Python dict FILES keyed by filename, so agents can validate messages without reading schema files from disk.

Entry is import of FILES and lookup FILES[name] for one of action_proposal, action_receipt, action_verdict, capsule_meta, catalog_entry, envelope, frame_ref, hello, mv_tool_call, mv_tool_result schemas.

action_proposal carries proposal_id, surface_id, based_on_frame sha256+generation, one action variant, one expectation variant, budget; verdict returns admitted/refused with core_seq; receipt returns after_frame plus verified and verification.

envelope wraps any body via oneOf $ref to surface, frame_ref, observation, action_proposal, action_verdict, action_receipt, hello, capsule_meta, ui_intent, catalog_entry, terminal_session, record_request, record_event, settings, mv_tool_call, mv_tool_result, session_record with from/to, session_id, seq, nonce.

mv_tool_call supports observe by surface_id, list by cursor/limit, propose by embedded action_proposal, wait_verify by proposal_id/timeout_ms; mv_tool_result returns observe with observation, list with surfaces/next_cursor, propose admitted with verdict, refused with reason_code/detail, wait_verify pending/verified.

action variants are click with x,y,button left/middle/right; key with keys array 1..4096; type with text; scroll with dx,dy; wait with ms 1..3600000; lane_submit with verb and payload nonce/seq/command/args.
expectation is one of changed_region with bbox x,y,w 1..16384,h 1..16384; element_state with role/name/state; state_sha256_change with before hash and min/max_tick; text_present with text.
action_verdict is refused with reason_code STALE_FRAME, SURFACE_NOT_AGENT_CONTROLLED, LOCKED_BY_OTHER, BUDGET_EXCEEDED, OUT_OF_BOUNDS, POLICY plus core_seq, or admitted with proposal_id and core_seq.

frame_ref requires surface_id, generation >=1, tick, ts_ns, width/height 1..16384, format const rgb24, ramws_path under /dev/shm, sha256 64 lowercase hex, capture_us; capsule_meta adds fb_path, display, lane_socket, ready_line, windows array 1..16.
hello requires contract_version v0.2, component core/ui/daemon/agent/vision/wender, 40-hex component_commit, component_version, dependencies array 0..16 with name/version/40-hex commit.
Every object sets additionalProperties False and maxProperties 256; every id/string has minLength/maxLength bounds and id patterns ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]*$; hashes must match ^[0-9a-f]{64}$.
Integers are bounded by 9007199254740991; generation/seq/core_seq start at 1 while tick/ts_ns/executed_at_ns start at 0; bbox and geometry widths limited to 16384 and window positions to 16383.

Action lifecycle is proposal based_on_frame generation -> verdict admitted/refused with core_seq -> receipt with executed_at_ns, after_frame, verified boolean, verification method pixel/element/state_sha256 -> wait_verify pending with retry_after_ms or verified with receipt.
Ordering uses envelope seq >=1 plus nonce per message, proposal based_on_frame generation and frame tick, verdict core_seq, and wait_verify timeout_ms 1..60000 with pending retry_after_ms 1..60000.

catalog_entry limits caps memory_bytes 1..1073741824 and cpu_milli 1..20000, nested_depth 0..1, network none/proxy; list caps surfaces 0..256 and limit 1..256; vision caps changed_regions and elements at 256 each.
Frame pixels live outside JSON at ramws_path and capsule fb at fb_path, both constrained to /dev/shm with 1..8 path segments; observation text capped at 4096 and detail at 4096 in refused results.
Budgets are inline: proposal budget max_ms 1..3600000 and max_retries 0..10; wait_verify timeout_ms 1..60000; tool list limit 1..256; capsule windows and geometry fix pixel sizes up to 16384.

Schema mismatch rejects before execution: wrong sha256 shape, surface_id pattern, ramws_path outside /dev/shm, unknown action type, or extra property yields validation error and no verdict core_seq is issued.

Admitted proposal can still return refused mv_tool_result with reason_code STALE_FRAME, SURFACE_NOT_AGENT_CONTROLLED, LOCKED_BY_OTHER, BUDGET_EXCEEDED, OUT_OF_BOUNDS, or POLICY plus human-readable detail.

Tester sees clicks or keys do nothing and tool returns refused with reason such as STALE_FRAME or LOCKED_BY_OTHER; stale based_on_frame generation or a surface not under agent control is the usual cause here.

Schemas reference each other by $ref filename such as frame_ref.schema.json and action_proposal.schema.json, and the module docstring declares them a mirror of contracts/v0.2, so drift between the two copies breaks validation.

This file is the single frozen source of the metaviewer v0.2 wire contracts: a dict of JSON-schema documents keyed '<name>.schema.json' covering mv_tool_result, observation, record_event, record_request, session_record, settings, surface, surface_event, surface_request and terminal_session. Every object in it is closed: additionalProperties false with maxProperties 256.

A tester adding a harmless extra field to any request, param, payload, bbox or geometry object sees the whole message rejected with nothing applied: closed objects mean unknown keys fail validation. The rejection surfaces as the mv_tool_result error arm: status error with code PROTOCOL, UNAVAILABLE, NOT_FOUND or VERIFICATION_FAILED plus detail up to 4096 chars.

An agent that calls wait_verify and hits the deadline gets back only schema, request_id, op wait_verify, status timeout, proposal_id and verified false. There is no receipt, no frame hash and no error text, so the caller knows nothing was verified but cannot tell what, if anything, executed.

A recording that drops frames under ring pressure shows dropped events carrying dropped_frames (at least 1) and policy ram_ring_oldest. The final stopped totals for frame_count and byte_count then fall short of the frames the tester saw captured, with the gap explained only by those dropped events.

A capture or record action that visibly does nothing is reported as a refused record_event: reason_code one of STALE_FRAME, SURFACE_NOT_AGENT_CONTROLLED, LOCKED_BY_OTHER, BUDGET_EXCEEDED, OUT_OF_BOUNDS or POLICY plus free-text detail. The user sees no frame and no file; the reason_code is the only diagnosis.

A request naming an op outside the listed const set matches no oneOf arm and is rejected before anything runs. surface_request accepts exactly create, list, destroy, frame_subscribe, frame_unsubscribe, input, record_start, record_stop, take_control, release_control. record_request accepts ram_start, ram_stop, disk_start, disk_stop, screenshot.

A success claim missing proof fails validation: the verified-result arm requires the receipt object, focus_verified true, input_mono_ns and frame_sha256 of exactly 64 lowercase hex chars, and the receipt error field must be the empty string. Anything less falls through to the timeout or error arms.

Consumers that treat every surface_event as carrying a surface object break on the error arm, which carries only surface_id, a code string and a non-empty detail string. The event const (created, state_changed, frame_ready, input_applied, error) must be checked before reading data.

All control and data enter as schema-tagged dicts: each message carries a schema const such as surface_request/v0.2 or record_event/v0.2 plus a request_id of 1..128 chars matching ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]*$. request_id is the correlation key joining a request to its events and its tool result.

Surface control flows from surface_request ops into surface_event notifications: create, destroy and state changes yield created and state_changed embedding a full surface object, frame subscriptions yield frame_ready with a frame_ref, and applied inputs yield input_applied. Errors arrive on the same channel as the error arm, not as exceptions.

Recording flows from record_request ops into record_event notifications keyed by the same surface_id, recording_id and mono_ns: started names the mode (ram, disk or screenshot), frame_captured names a /dev/shm ram_path plus sha256 and byte_count, and stopped and exported close the session with totals or a destination.

Vision flows out as observation objects carrying a frame_ref plus optional vision (summary, changed_regions, elements) and optional ground_truth pinned to source holdings_lane with a state hash and tick, so a tester can join what the agent saw to the exact holdings-lane state.

A surface lives in state active, standby, ceded, destroyed or lost, with visibility folded, unfolded or pinned and control agent, human or shared. take_control and release_control move control between agent, human and shared; input attempted without agent control is refused rather than queued.

Each recording_id moves from ram_start or disk_start through started, then zero or more frame_captured and dropped events, to ram_stop or disk_stop and a final stopped event with frame_count and byte_count. screenshot is a one-shot keyed by capture_id instead of a ring.

The session log is an append-only hash chain: core_seq starts at 1 and each entry records kind received, admitted, refused, executed, verified or surface_changed with msg_id and the previous entry sha256. A missing or out-of-order core_seq breaks the chain and marks tampering or loss.

Closed-world validation: additionalProperties false and maxProperties 256 on every object, including nested params, payloads, bboxes, geometry and vision items. No arm tolerates an extra key, so schema and code must change together; old validators reject messages carrying new fields.

Identity shape is uniform: request, surface, recording, proposal, provider and session ids are 1..128 chars starting with an ASCII letter or digit followed by letters, digits, dot, underscore, colon or hyphen. Anything else, including an empty id, fails every arm that carries it.

Clocks and coordinates share one bound: mono_ns, input_mono_ns, tick, x, y, core_seq and seq lie in 0..9007199254740991 (core_seq and seq start at 1); scroll deltas allow the same magnitude negative. Geometry w and h are 1..16384; create nested_depth is 0 or 1.

Frame and state hashes are exactly 64 lowercase hex chars: frame_sha256 and the receipt error const (empty string on success) sit in the verified-result arm. Record sha256, ground_truth state_sha256 and session prev_sha256 carry the same 64-hex pattern.

mv_tool_result/v0.2 is exactly three arms split by status: a verified-result arm (receipt plus focus_verified true, input_mono_ns, frame_sha256), a wait_verify/timeout arm (proposal_id, verified false) and an error arm for ops observe, list, propose, wait_verify (code plus detail). Status has no other legal value.

observation/v0.2 requires only schema and frame_ref; vision and ground_truth are optional. When present, vision needs summary, changed_regions and elements; each element needs bbox, role (1..128 chars), name and confidence 0..1; region and element lists cap at 4096 items each.

Terminal output chunks obey paired caps: b64 holds 0..65536 chars of strict base64, byte_count holds 0..49152, gap and truncated are const false, and session_id, terminal_generation and seq are required. 49152 bytes encode to exactly 65536 base64 chars, so the two caps agree.

Terminal sessions open with spawn carrying surface_id, provider_id and cols/rows of 1..1000; started answers with session_id and terminal_generation from 1; resize repeats session_id, generation, cols, rows. Every terminal message also carries schema terminal_session/v0.2 and request_id.

Order and dedupe keys, not arrival order: mono_ns stamps every record_event, input_mono_ns stamps verified results, tick stamps ground truth, and core_seq stamps the session log. seq stamps lane_submit payloads from 1 and terminal data chunks.

terminal_generation starts at 1 and rides on started, resize, data and write beside session_id, so readers can tell a respawned session from a stale one. A resize supersedes earlier geometry; data or write chunks from an older generation must not be interleaved with the current one.

Hard ceilings: ring_bytes, byte_count and memory_bytes cap at 1073741824; max_fps caps at 120 in ram_start and disk_start and in settings limits. Terminal cols/rows cap at 1000, providers at 32 entries, regions/elements/keys/args at 4096 items, error detail at 4096 chars.

settings/v0.2 is all required: theme metaviewer-light or metaviewer-dark, a providers array of id/label/enabled/model objects, a recording_destination of capability_id plus path (or null for no disk target), and limits with memory_bytes, max_fps and ring_bytes. There are no optional settings keys.

Two arms dereference sibling schema files: observation frame_ref points at frame_ref.schema.json, and surface_event frame_ready points at frame_ref.schema.json while created and state_changed embed surface.schema.json. If those files are missing or drift, those arms fail while the rest still passes.
Defines frozen terminal_session/v0.2 and ui_intent/v0.2 message shapes mirrored by envelope validation; terminal ops move bytes/acks, ui ops move layout and control intents.
Every frame requires schema, request_id, op, params with additionalProperties false, maxProperties 256, request_id/session_id pattern ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]*$ length 1-128.
Write/data params require session_id, terminal_generation >=1, input_seq integer, b64 string, byte_count integer; all five required together.
ack/attach params require session_id, terminal_generation, ack_seq and ack_bytes >=0; resync requires from_seq >=1; close requires session_id plus generation only.
exit params add exit_code 0-255 and signal string-or-null; error params use session_id-or-null plus code enum and detail 0-4096 chars.
error code closed set: UNKNOWN_PROVIDER, UNKNOWN_SESSION, STALE_GENERATION, READ_ONLY, RESYNC_UNAVAILABLE, BACKPRESSURE, POLICY.
ui_intent ops fold/unfold/hide/show need slot_id; pin adds boolean pinned; move/tab need group_id, slot_id, index 0-255; float needs slot_id plus x_px,y_px,width_px,height_px bounds.
layout_save/load need layout_id; take_control/release_control need surface_id; all ids share the same 1-128 safe-token pattern.
terminal_generation is always >=1 and monotonic per session; ack_seq/ack_bytes never negative; all integers capped at 9007199254740991 for safe JSON.
Control and data enter as op+params with request_id correlation and leave as validated envelope bodies; file carries data only, no transport or I/O code.
Consumers import FILES and select terminal_session or ui_intent branch by op const before validating params; no function entry point in this range.
Missing required param, extra property, bad id pattern, or out-of-range integer fails schema validation; caller gets bad_shape/schema refusal, no frame emitted.
User sees terminal write stall, resync loop, or layout button doing nothing when sender omits generation/seq or uses illegal id; logs show schema validation refusal.
Depends on envelope/v0.2 outer wrapper and base64 byte accounting; ui_intent branch is independent of terminal_session branch.
Byte-count vs b64 length mismatch or stale generation accepted by a loose checker would desync terminal stream; strict required-field checks here prevent that.
CoreClient is a synchronous bounded mailbox over an owner-only Unix socket; ToolClient adds hello handshake, sequence-file reservation, and correlated tool request handling.
Entry via CoreClient.connect for transport-only use or handshake/hello exchange; ToolClient.__enter__ does endpoint check, sequence-file lock, connect, reserve, then hello call.
Outbound dicts pass validate_envelope then dumps_envelope with max_line_bytes; inbound bytes accumulate in _rx until LF, then loads_envelope with max_reply_bytes; call is send followed by recv.

request builds envelope via make_envelope with next_seq, reserves sequence, sends, then loops on recv filtering async action_receipt/v0.2 into bounded _receipts until correlated record_event or mv_tool_result arrives.
States: fresh, connected socket, hello_complete, terminal. Any transport, validation, timeout, or peer failure calls _terminate and locks terminal; close is idempotent and stays terminal.
ToolClient._ready only true after hello reply matches expected from/to/session_id/body; any exception in __enter__ or request calls close and clears _ready.
Envelope seq must equal next_seq, incremented only after successful sendall; sender identity tuple is pinned on first send and any change raises schema error.
handshake requires fresh client with next_seq 1 and no hello_complete; local hello schema/component/dependencies and peer hello component must match caller-supplied registrations.
Constructor requires positive int byte caps and finite timeout 0 < t <= 10000000.0; bool timeout rejected; violations raise ClientError length or timeout.
request needs _ready true, timeout_ms int 1-60000, body dict with non-empty request_id; expect is record_event/v0.2 or mv_tool_result/v0.2 with strict request_id/op/surface/recording correlation.
Outbound validate/dumps failure maps unknown_version, length, bad_shape, schema without consuming sequence; socket stays usable for validation failures only.
Oversized line, decode failure, EOF with partial bytes, peer close, or monotonic deadline expiry terminates client with length, schema, socket, or timeout codes.
Non-700 owner dir, symlink, non-socket node, wrong mode/uid, missing SO_PEERCRED, or foreign uid raises socket error before connect or first write; fails closed.

Sequence file must be owner-only 0600 regular file nlink 1 with content matching [1-9][0-9]{0,15}; reservation uses tmp write plus fsync plus flock plus replace; any deviation raises socket or schema error.
User sees tool call hang then timeout or immediate connection failed, socket not owner-only, foreign peer, sequence invalid, or uncorrelated tool result; ClientError code names the class.
Single-thread ownership only; ToolClient serializes connections with exclusive non-blocking flock on sequence file and persists next_seq+1 before each send including failed sends.
Socket closed silently on terminate/close; _rx buffer cleared; ToolClient caps retained receipts at 128 entries and closes old sequence fd after rotation.
Timeout, max_line_bytes, max_reply_bytes bound every send/recv; request further clamps per-call deadline to min(channel timeout, timeout_ms/1000) without extending on received bytes.
Depends on envelope make/validate/loads/dumps, tools ToolValidationError, trusted local/core registrations and dependency pins; record correlation uses _RECORD_OP_EVENTS allowlist per op.
receipt returns copied async evidence only and never proves tool verification; treating a retained action_receipt as focus proof would be false success.
Closed transport-only validation and bounded NDJSON codec for envelope/v0.2 plus legacy v0.1 frames; every inbound/outbound frame is runtime-checked before any effect.
Entry via validate_envelope for dicts, make_envelope to build, dumps_envelope to encode one LF line, loads_envelope to decode one LF/CRLF line.

Outbound: validate then json.dumps compact UTF-8 plus LF, single-line check, byte-cap check. Inbound: byte-cap, terminator, blank/multiline, UTF-8, nesting scan, duplicate-key and non-finite rejection, then validate.
Session clock starts at first make_envelope with omitted ts_ns; origin resets if monotonic_ns function identity changes; ts_ns is now minus origin and must fit safe integer.
Outer keys exactly schema,msg_id,ts_ns,from,to,session_id,seq,nonce,body; endpoints limited to core,ui,daemon,agent,vision,wender with 1-128 instance; seq>=1, ts_ns>=0.
Both versions require safe integers within 2^53-1, finite floats, no surrogate code points, UTF-8 string bytes <=65536; container depth capped at 32 via iterative walk.
Schema walk caps recursion at 100, enforces closed objects, maxProperties/maxItems/minItems, string length and byte limits, numeric bounds, const/enum/oneOf exactly-one semantics.
v0.1 and v0.2 isolated by discriminator: legacy bodies must end /v0.1, v0.2 family must be known with version v0.2; unknown contract version yields unknown_version, other deviations bad_shape.
terminal_session/v0.2 data/write params require b64 string plus int byte_count matching decoded length len//4*3 minus padding; mismatch raises terminal byte_count mismatch.
Embedded schemas audited at import: only known keywords/types, closed objects, declared required keys, valid patterns and refs; v0.2 refs rewritten to v0.2/ prefix.
dumps/loads require max_bytes positive int; cap covers full frame including terminator and gates before encode, decode, or parse.
Failures raise EnvelopeError with unknown_version for well-formed unknown contract, length for cap breach, bad_shape otherwise; validate never mutates input.
Duplicate object keys, Infinity/NaN literals, trailing values, blank or multiline frames, bad UTF-8, unmatched containers, or nesting over 32 refused as bad_shape.
User sees message dropped or send rejected with frame exceeds cap, blank/multiline, invalid JSON/UTF-8, or body violates contract; no partial effect occurs.
Nonce defaults to 32 hex chars via secrets.token_hex; no locks needed as module state is only session-clock origin and compiled pattern cache.
Limits: schema depth 100, transport JSON nesting 32, string UTF-8 65536, name length 128; make validates before deepcopy so hostile nesting fails without recursion overflow.
No external config; allowed components, geometry/bbox minima, ramws_path ^/dev/shm pattern, sha256 hex, and action variants are frozen in code.
Depends on _contracts_v02.FILES deep copy for v0.2 bodies; repository contract checker remains independent oracle for parity tests.
Bool never equals number in const checks and integer check requires exact int type, blocking true==1 confusion; pattern ^/ paths also reject embedded CR/LF.
Execution facts only for an already-admitted action; admission and final verification belong to core, supervisor supplies verdict and frozen proposal.
Construct with callable transport, then dispatch admitted proposal plus verdict; check_target is static custody and geometry gate for click targets.
Proposal deep-copied and checked, verdict checked admitted, ids bound, then transport(proposal) called; only focus_verified true plus input_mono_ns returned.
Requires agent-supplied verdict never used; caller must use core dispatch lease; verdict proposal_id must equal proposal proposal_id else POLICY binding refusal.
Target and latest list required; exactly one row with same id and same fields except value must match; box must be four ints [x,y,w,h].
Target stability compares rows minus value key; generation-control names matching ^Stop/Detener refused even when geometry is valid.
Transport result must be dict with focus_verified exactly True and input_mono_ns int >=0; extra fields never confer verification authority.
Unverified focus raises SurfaceRefused refused_focus; bad timestamp raises SurfaceError malformed_capture; both carry action type as kind.
Custody mismatch raises ValueError target custody; Stop/Detener click raises SurfaceRefused generation_control; out-of-bounds or malformed box raises SurfaceError alignment.
Non-callable transport raises TypeError at construction; proposal or verdict check failures propagate before any transport call, so no side effect.
User sees click not performed with refused_focus, generation_control, or POLICY binding message; bad click rectangle shows alignment or custody error.
No locks or retries here; budget and retry policy live in proposal and verdict handled by core; executor performs single synchronous transport call.
Deep copies proposal before validation so caller mutation cannot alter the executed action; return strips transport extras to two fields.
Depends on tools._check_proposal and tools._check_verdict_admitted for shape and admitted status; transport injected by supervisor.
Click bounds checked against frame width/height with x+w and y+h overflow; stale frame or human-controlled surface must already be refused upstream.

export.py builds and validates closed mw.run_bundle.v1 export from verified MetaViewer journal, receipts, observations, proposals, verdicts and Wender STATE, stripping paths, cookies, credentials and PII and failing closed on violations.

Main entry build_export_bundle takes site/run/demo/task metadata plus journal, observations, proposals, verdicts, receipts, steps, states and returns validated bundle dict; it verifies journal, indexes verdicts/receipts by proposal_id, projects steps, vision, states, refusals, then validates.

validate_export_bundle accepts bytes or dict, parses/canonicalizes, scans forbidden content, checks JSON schema and semantic gates, returns deep copy; dumps_export_bundle validates then returns canonical UTF-8 bytes capped at MAX_BUNDLE_BYTES.

verify_journal accepts JSONL text/bytes or sequence of lines/objects, validates metaviewer.journal/v1 header plus session_record/v0.2 chain, returns (header, records, head_sha256); None input yields (None,[],None).

Projection entries convert raw triads to bundle parts: project_step handles proposal/verdict/receipt or prebuilt step; project_vision_elements handles 3 input shapes; project_state_ref handles Wender state or ref; project_refusal handles refused verdicts.

Journal flow starts from GENESIS_PREV_SHA256 (64 zeros), each session_record links prev_sha256 to prior canonical hash; verifier recomputes canonical_sha256 per record and outputs tail as journal_head_sha256.

Step flow joins proposals to verdicts and verified receipts by proposal_id; admitted steps require verified receipt and use its after_frame.sha256 and verification.method; refused steps reuse before hash or receipt after hash with null verify method.

Sanitization flow: scrub_metadata drops path/cookie/cred/PII keys and recurses, scrub_text redacts cookie/cred/email/PII/host-path patterns inside strings; _scan_forbidden_bundle re-scans final bundle and maps first hit to refusal code.

Surface defaults to 1280x800 or first frame_ref size, derives ax_enabled from cdp/atspi/godot states and perception_mode from ground_truth/ax presence; vision defaults from observations; states merge explicit refs, Wender objects, then observation ground_truth by sha.

Journal states: optional header then records with core_seq 1..n and kind in received/admitted/refused/executed/verified/surface_changed; transitions require exact keys, increasing seq with no gaps, unique msg_id, and prev_sha256 equal to running hash.

Canonical JSON invariant: sorted keys, compact separators, no floats/NaN, no NUL/surrogates, non-string keys rejected, nesting depth at most 32, ints within safe 53-bit bounds, Frame/bytes/bytearray/memoryview rejected.
Strict load invariant: input capped at MAX_BUNDLE_BYTES (262144), rejects NUL bytes, PNG/JPEG/GIF/RIFF/PDF magic, UTF-8 BOM, duplicate keys, constants, and floats before canonical recheck.

Bundle contract mirrors mw.run_bundle.v1.schema.json via embedded defs (slug/sha256/date/hostname/tag/text, box/point/bps, surface/step/element/ref/refusal); validator resolves local $ref, anyOf, required, additionalProperties false, ranges, patterns, enums, const, uniqueItems.

Semantic contract beyond schema: steps seq must equal 1..n, paste kind iff text_len present, boxes need positive area, recorded points inside viewport, vision boxes positive, cross-group ids unique, refusal step_seq within steps, domains valid hostnames.

Box contract: accepts {x,y,w,h} with w/h at least 1 or 4-int [x0,y0,x1,y1] with x1>x0,y1>y0; marks require box_px/bbox/xywh, derive relative_xy_bps 0..10000 from explicit pair or recorded point, default 5000,5000.

Receipt contract requires action_receipt/v0.2 schema, verified True, bounded proposal_id/timestamps, after_frame sha/generation/size, verification method pixel/element/state_sha256; state path validates wender.state/v1 and hashes attrs with box None.

Refusal contract maps 9 input codes (STALE_FRAME, BUDGET_* merged, LOCKED_BY_OTHER to POLICY) into 7 exported reason codes with default failure_tag/summary/mitigation; explicit failure_tag must be one of 6 allowed tags; ids unique slugs.

All failures raise ExportError(ValueError) with machine code; _fail always raises, callers wrap ObservationError as bad_shape. No partial bundle is returned; build/validate/dumps either return clean copy or raise.

Journal failures: empty text, blank line, non-object entry, header key mismatch, bad seq/kind/msg shape raise corrupt_journal; non-increasing seq or reused msg_id raises duplicate_record; prev mismatch raises chain_mismatch; supplied head disagreeing with tail raises chain_mismatch.

Content failures overwrite schema errors: forbidden scan yields forbidden_pixels/host_path/cookie/credential/personal_data; oversize yields bundle_oversize; extra keys yield unknown_field; hostname/seq/geometry/id/refusal-range violations yield semantic_error.

Step failures: missing proposal/verdict/receipt shape yields bad_shape; verdict/receipt proposal_id mismatch yields uncorrelated; admitted without verified receipt yields unverified_receipt; unknown receipt schema yields unknown_version; unsupported action type yields bad_shape.

User-visible symptom is export aborts with ExportError code text (for example chain_mismatch, unverified_receipt, forbidden_pixels) and no bundle bytes; over-redaction symptom is fields replaced by fallback words like redacted, untitled, verified, or mark.

No threads, locks, retries, or timers; ordering is sequential index order with caps (64 vision/state/refusal, 256 steps); slug dedup uses caller-supplied used_ids set mutated across vision/state/refusal projections.
Limits enforced everywhere: bundle 262144 bytes, steps 1..256, vision/state/refusals 0..64, tags 0..16, domains 1..16, strings bounded (summary 240, labels 80, med 400), ints int32/safe bounds.

Key constants: BUNDLE_SCHEMA mw.run_bundle.v1, JOURNAL_HEADER_SCHEMA metaviewer.journal/v1, SESSION_RECORD_SCHEMA session_record/v0.2, GENESIS all-zero sha, MAX_BUNDLE_BYTES 262144; slug/sha/date/hostname/tag regexes define wire patterns.

Depends on observe.validate_observation for full observation objects, observe.compute_battery_state_sha256 for state digests, wender_bridge.validate_state for Wender STATE, and perception.base.Frame as forbidden runtime type; no network or service calls.

Loop runner executes N independent single-shot observe-propose-admit-act-verify trials and emits one canonical receipt schema metaviewer.ai-loop-report/v1 with keys schema,trials,verified,pass,results and integer ratio adjudication.

run_trials(client_factory,planner,trials,min_verified,timeout_ms,surface_id,perception_adapter,goal,kind) is the main entry; it validates callables and bounds then loops trial 1..trials with proposal_id trial-N without retrying a refused or failed proposal inside a trial.
run_holdings_trials is a Holdings-only wrapper that forwards all arguments to run_trials with kind holdings, so every trial uses kind holdings and lane_submit stays forbidden.

main(argv,client_factory,planner,stdout,stderr) CLI runs trials or validates --verify-receipt file; it supports --trials,--min-verified,--timeout-ms,--scripted-verified,--kind,--receipt-out and returns 0 pass, 1 fail, 2 usage or shape error.

_wrap_planner adapts 1-,2-,3-arg planners, deep-copies observation/action/expectation into trial_context, accepts dict-with-action-expectation or 2-tuple, rejects lane_submit action on holdings kind or ground_truth observation with PlannerError POLICY.

Client construction dispatches on signature arity: >=2 required args gets (trial,kind), 1 required gets (trial), 0 required tries zero-arg then falls back to one-arg; _arity counts VAR_POSITIONAL as 3.

Surface id precedence is callable(trial,kind), then non-empty string, then client.surface_id string, then client.frame dict surface_id string, else fixture; empty callable or string result raises ValueError.

compute_ratio(verified,trials,min_verified) uses only exact ints, rails trials 1..1000 and 1<=min_verified<=trials and 0<=verified<=trials, returns (verified,trials,passed) with passed as verified*trials>=min_verified*trials.
canonical_json rejects non-canonical values via _reject_non_canonical then dumps with sort_keys, separators (, :), ensure_ascii False, allow_nan False, producing compact UTF-8 without floats.

Each trial ends in one row status: verified with code OK, refused with ToolRefusal or Observation/Surface code, timeout with TIMEOUT, unverified with VERIFICATION_FAILED or MISSING_WITNESS; verified rows require witness_present true.
Default alternation is odd trial holdings and even trial browser; forced kind overrides it; unknown kind raises ValueError. Holdings trials never emit lane_submit.

Witness requires receipt verified true, verification.method in pixel,element,state_sha256 with non-empty detail; holdings or state_sha256_change expectation additionally requires ground_truth.source holdings_lane and after_frame.tick within min_tick..max_tick.

validate_report enforces exact report keys, schema match, trials count and results length match, trial index order, per-trial kind sequence, non-empty proposal_id and code, boolean verified and witness_present, and verified true iff status verified and code OK.

ToolRefusal appends refused with exc.reason_code; VerificationFailed maps receipt status timeout to timeout/TIMEOUT else unverified with receipt code; bare TimeoutError maps to timeout/TIMEOUT; Observation/SurfaceError maps to refused; ToolValidation/ValueError maps to unverified.
A verified receipt without an acceptable witness is downgraded to verified False, witness_present False, status unverified, code MISSING_WITNESS and is never counted in verified_count.

Shape violations raise LoopReportError via _fail with bad_shape; verified-count mismatch raises tampered_verified and pass mismatch raises tampered_pass; CLI prints CODE: detail to stderr and exits 2.
User sees one canonical JSON receipt on stdout, or CODE: detail on stderr with exit 2 on bad input, and exit 1 when printed receipt has pass false because fewer than min_verified trials verified.
Bounds are trials int 1..1000, min_verified int 1..trials, timeout_ms int 1..60000; validate_report rechecks bounds with timeout slot fixed to 1000. No retry or timer inside a trial.

FakeHoldingsToolClient implements observe/propose/wait_verify with AdmittedExecutor dispatch; faults stale_frame, replayed_nonce, out_of_bounds, missing_witness, unverified_receipt, wrong_witness_method drive refused, timeout, or unverified paths deterministically.

make_holdings_double shares one seen_nonces set across all trials so replayed-nonce faults persist; trial fault selection prefers faults_by_trial then first verified_count clean trials then default fault stale_frame.

Stdio MCP bridge exposes mv_observe,mv_list,mv_propose,mv_wait_verify as mechanical dispatch to synchronous tools functions off the event loop; admission and verification stay in core and stdout carries protocol frames only.

Server.handle(message) accepts only dict with jsonrpc 2.0, string method, optional str/int id, and keys subset jsonrpc,id,method,params; malformed shape returns Invalid Request -32600 and notifications with no id return None.

tools/list requires empty params after initialize and returns deep-copied schemas; tools/call requires exact keys name,arguments with string name and dispatches via _call_tool_impl bound to one client.

serve(client) reads stdin lines capped at MAX_FRAME_BYTES 1MiB until EOF, decodes each frame, writes one NDJSON response per request, closes on over-cap or unterminated line, and never emits non-protocol output.

Protocol version is 2025-06-18 local compatibility target; every inbound and final outbound frame including fallbacks must fit 1048576 bytes plus newline, else a Response too large -32603 frame is emitted.

JSON-RPC ids are correlation tokens capped at 128 encoded JSON bytes: ints must be safe integers within 2^53-1, strings at most 128 chars and 128 UTF-8 bytes of json.dumps; oversize id in request returns -32603 and fallback uses null id.

_call_tool_impl validates closed args, resolves tools module late, checks ToolClient attrs observe,list_surfaces,propose,wait_verify plus exception classes, then runs the matching tools call in asyncio.to_thread and maps outcome to CallToolResult.

Each tool takes exactly its closed keys: observe surface_id+timeout_ms, list cursor+limit+timeout_ms, propose proposal+timeout_ms, wait_verify proposal_id+expectation+timeout_ms; timeout_ms int 1..60000, ids match pattern, limit int 1..256.
Ids must be non-empty strings at most 128 chars matching [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]*; cursor alone also permits null; type(x) is int rejects bool for timeout and limit.

Server starts uninitialized; initialize with protocolVersion string, capabilities dict, clientInfo dict sets initialized true and returns tools capability; ping, tools/list, tools/call before that return Initialize first -32000.

ToolRefusal with reason in STALE_FRAME,SURFACE_NOT_AGENT_CONTROLLED,LOCKED_BY_OTHER,BUDGET_EXCEEDED,OUT_OF_BOUNDS,POLICY and core_seq null or int>=1 returns isError true text core refused: CODE; other shapes return internal error.
VerificationFailed with dict receipt returns isError true text verification failed plus frozen receipt copy; missing or non-serializable receipt returns internal error instead of echoing input.

Unknown tool returns unknown tool; _InvalidArgs returns invalid arguments; ToolValidationError or ValueError returns invalid tool payload; TimeoutError or ClientError timeout returns request timed out; unknown_version and other ClientError map to fixed transport texts.

Caller sees CallToolResult with one text item and structuredContent; success carries sorted compact JSON in both; errors carry fixed texts unknown tool, invalid arguments, verification failed, invalid tool payload, request timed out, transport error, unknown contract version, internal error.

Tools module is resolved late via _get_tools to avoid import-order breakage; ImportError or missing observe,list_surfaces,propose,wait_verify,ToolRefusal,VerificationFailed,ToolValidationError fails closed to internal error.

Caller input is never echoed in diagnostics; non-serializable or non-finite tool payloads and out-of-shape refusal or receipt fields are replaced by internal error to keep frames bounded and serializable.

Tool set is frozen to four names with fixed descriptions and closed input schemas requiring exact keys and additionalProperties false; nested proposal and expectation bodies are validated by tools.py, not here.

Closed untrusted command client for MetaViewer core admission: default verbs use v0.2 with trusted MV_CORE_CONFIG registration; --v02 spells the same path and injected-send legacy v0.1 path remains test-only.
run(argv,send) routes to _run_v02 unless send is injected, when it runs legacy _run_legacy; raw leading --v02 token is stripped before v0.2 parsing. main returns the process exit code.

_run_v02 handles observe,list,propose,wait-verify,record-start,record-stop with mandatory socket,session-id,agent-instance,core-instance,timeout-ms,max-line-bytes,max-reply-bytes identity and caps flags.

Legacy path supports propose --json-arg --timeout-ms --max-line-bytes --max-reply-bytes [--socket] plus reserved observe skeleton; any observe spelling is refused as unsupported_operation with exit 2.

Propose preflight requires action_proposal/v0.2 and runs tools._check_proposal plus a never-sent make_envelope; record verbs require record_request/v0.2 with matching ram/disk start/stop op and run _check_record_request; wait-verify runs _check_expectation.
Endpoint is explicit absolute --socket path or XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/metaviewer/core.sock; relative explicit path yields usage_error and missing runtime dir yields endpoint_error.
CLI integers are canonical positive base-ten with 1..10 digits matching [1-9][0-9]*; repeated flags are rejected by _OnceAction instead of last-wins and parser diagnostics never echo caller input.

Input files are read capped at max_line_bytes, must be strict UTF-8 single JSON object with duplicate keys and non-finite constants rejected and floats finite-checked; over-cap or unreadable input becomes input_error.

Legacy head routes envelope/v0.1 bodies, rejects other proposal families as unknown_version, requires agent-to-core proposal shape, and requires reply from core to agent with matched instances, session_id, and proposal_id.

Legacy propose prints validated reply and exits 0 admitted, 1 refused, 2 on refuse paths schema_error, unknown_version, input_error, endpoint_error, transport errors, timeout, unexpected_reply, unsupported_operation.

v0.2 list needs --limit and no cursor on other verbs; ToolRefusal prints verdict refuse with reason_code exit 1; VerificationFailed prints receipt exit 1; success prints result JSON exit 0; mapping failures exit 2.
All refuses write one fixed record verdict refuse with code and fixed error text to stderr with stdout empty; version pin failure text is trusted component pins do not match.

Transport mapping: timeout or TimeoutError to timeout, unknown_version stays, schema/bad_shape to schema_error, UNAVAILABLE to transport_unavailable, NOT_FOUND to endpoint_error, length/PROTOCOL to transport_error, connect versus call phase decides endpoint versus transport for socket and value errors.

User sees either result JSON on stdout, or refuse verdict on stdout for core refusal and unverified receipt, or one-line refuse record on stderr with empty stdout when local validation, endpoint, transport, or version checks fail.

Trusted startup uses --config or MV_CORE_CONFIG JSON peers list to pin agent hello, core hello, session_id, endpoints, and dependency pins; mismatch or unreadable config is usage_error. Sequence persists under endpoint dir as .mvctl-SHA256(seq-scope).seq.

Core owns admission, ownership, replay, focus and input evidence; missing focus/input evidence stays a verification refusal and receipt alone never fabricates proof. Import failure of client or envelope maps to transport_unavailable.

List exposes single-page tool protocol with required explicit --limit and optional --cursor and no implicit page size; timeout-ms, max-line-bytes, max-reply-bytes bound the ToolClient session and frame sizes.

Usage parser converts argparse errors to refuse usage_error exit 2 without echoing input; duplicate flags, abbreviations disabled, and preflight envelope validation before connect prevent malformed or replayed proposals reaching the core.
Absorbing run handoff latch watches sensed stop state once and writes one metaviewer.handoff/v1 record; it provides no solver, retry, reset, or resume operation.
Private MemoryWeb home admission refuses tracked, unsafe, oversized, or browser-profile-bearing homes and never silently repairs them; it performs no browser profile persistence.
HandoffLatch(path).inspect(sensed,seq,write) returns True if already latched or after latching on stop, else False; write(path,bytes) is called exactly once with sorted-keys JSON plus newline.

Inspect builds state from sensed.state or sensed.ax, observed url, frame_urls, headers, calls wender.perceive.stopstate.detect without acquiring new perception or persisting detector values, then optionally upgrades explicit observed_wall markers.

Only observed_wall dict with observed true and kind login_wall or captcha_wall creates synthetic stop with reason kind, confidence 100, evidence ax_role_name; login controls alone are not walls and a new ReplayOwner starts a new authorized run.

Latch states are open then latched; first is_stop true flips latched true and emits record with surface_id,step_index,reason,confidence,evidence_kinds; persistence failure must never reopen admission and later inspects stay True.

Emitted record schema is metaviewer.handoff/v1 with surface_id from sensed.frame.surface_id, step_index seq, reason, confidence, sorted unique evidence kinds; path is returned directly and through closed run schema evidence_refs.
Operator sees a run stop only on login_wall or captcha_wall markers or detector stop; otherwise the latch stays silent and the run continues with no handoff file written.
resolve_home(repo_root,override) returns absolute lexical path preserving symlinks for later admission; relative override or any .. part raises HomeError MW_HOME_PATH; default is repo_root/memoryweb.

canonical_home resolves only after refusing links in home and ancestors and does not create; ensure_home creates only the final directory mode 0700 with parents already existing via no-follow descriptor walk.
Ancestor walk opens from anchor with O_NOFOLLOW and stat without following links; symlink or .. yields MW_HOME_SYMLINK or MW_HOME_PATH; OSError ELOOP maps to MW_HOME_SYMLINK else MW_HOME_MODE.

check_home with is_tracked predicate raising on indeterminate status refuses tracked homes MW_HOME_TRACKED, .git as MW_HOME_NESTED_REPO, profile names and leveldb-style dirs as MW_HOME_PROFILE, over-capacity, depth, size, sqlite headers, non-regular types.

Caps are at most 10000 entries, 32 nested directories, 1MiB per file, 65536 bytes per workflow file; workflows subtree flag only relaxes the per-file limit and refusing leveldb excludes its CURRENT,LOCK,LOG,MANIFEST,ldb,log members.

Profile detection is casefolded against Cookies, Login Data, History, Preferences, storage dirs, profile N pattern, -wal/-shm/-journal suffixes, SQLite format 3 header and WAL magics 377f0682,377f0683 using only magic-header reads.

site_root(home,site,repo_root) validates site id [a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63} else MW_SITE_ID, rejects any symlink on candidate or parents, returns home if sites/site dir exists else read-only builtin root, missing builtin gives MW_SITE_MISSING.
Site selection picks an entire site and never merges workflow files; built-ins are a read-only source and callers never install them into the home; non-directory site path gives MW_SITE_PATH.

Traversal uses directory descriptors and os.scandir with O_NOFOLLOW opens, checks mode uid and 0700 on the home, and closes every descriptor; invalid paths report MW_HOME_PATH and filesystem access failures MW_HOME_MODE.
Stop detection is pinned to wender/perceive/stopstate.py:89-176 detect; handoff inspects existing STATE only and never opens a new perception path.
Existing unsafe homes are refused rather than repaired; final-directory create ignores FileExistsError then revalidates mode so a pre-existing world-readable or non-owned home still fails closed.

__init__.py keeps perception package import inert via lazy __getattr__: base names resolve from .base, VCorePerceptionAdapter from .vcore, MetaMusePerceptionAdapter from .meta_muse; unknown names raise AttributeError.
Entry is PerceptionAdapter.perceive(frame_ref, frame, prev). Package __getattr__ is the import entry: _BASE_NAMES go to base, the two provider names go to vcore/meta_muse submodules.

FakePerceptionAdapter.perceive is the offline/test entry: takes frame_ref mapping plus optional Frame/path/None frame and prev, validates dims and args, returns fixed vision with empty regions/elements.

Provider selection entry: register_perception_adapter(name,factory) binds names, available_perception_adapters returns sorted names, create_perception_adapter(name,*args,**kwargs) builds adapter or raises unavailable.
Validation entries: frame_dims(frame_ref)->(width,height) reads only dims; check_vision(vision,width,height) validates closed vision dict against v0.2 caps then observe._check_vision.

Data flow: frame_ref Mapping supplies width/height via frame_dims; frame/prev Frame buffers must match those dims per _check_frame_arg while Path/str stay opaque; perceive emits dict with summary, changed_regions, elements.

check_vision flow: enforce _MAX_SUMMARY/_MAX_REGIONS/_MAX_ELEMENTS/_MAX_NAME caps first without scanning unbounded arrays, then delegate key sets, geometry, roles, confidence to observe._check_vision; ObservationError is re-raised as PerceptionError with same code.

Contract: perceive returns exactly summary:str, changed_regions:list, elements:list passing check_vision for bound dims; failures raise PerceptionError. Perception populates only closed vision sub-object; admission, freshness, witnesses stay with core.

Frame invariant: frozen RGB24 row-major buffer with width/height exact ints >0 and len(data)==width*height*3. Violations raise bad_shape: non-int dims, non-positive dims, non-bytes data, length mismatch.
Integer invariant: _is_int uses type(value) is int so bool never passes as integer. Applies to Frame dims, frame_dims, check_vision width/height.
frame_ref invariant: must be Mapping with strict positive-int width/height; anything else raises bad_shape frame_ref is not an object or width/height malformed.

Error contract: PerceptionError(ValueError) carries code plus message without credential material. Codes: unknown_version foreign version, bad_shape type/key/bounds deviation, unavailable missing provider, timeout expired call.

If vision is not dict, summary not str or >4096 chars, regions/elements not lists or >4096 entries, or element name >65536 chars, check_vision raises bad_shape. Observe failures re-raise as PerceptionError preserving code.
If register name is empty/non-str or factory not callable, raises bad_shape provider name malformed / factory is not callable.
Tester using fake provider always sees summary 'fake perception: no change' with no regions or elements, because FakePerceptionAdapter is deterministic stdlib-only and never detects change.

User-visible failure is a ValueError/PerceptionError with text like Frame width and height must be positive, Frame data length N != M, frame_ref width malformed, vision summary malformed, changed_regions malformed.
Wire caps bound memory/scan: summary<=4096 chars, changed_regions<=4096, elements<=4096, element name<=65536, aligned with mv_tool_result.schema.json. Caps checked before delegating to observe.
Depends on metaviewer_agents.observe._check_vision for key sets, geometry, roles, confidence; base only adds caps and error-type translation to PerceptionError.
Flow: read lock JSON -> expected commit for name -> resolve env root -> if .git exists verify HEAD and tree else verify wheel direct_url.json and RECORD -> return root Path.

Error contract: DependencyLockError(ObservationError,RuntimeError) carries code and message. Codes: bad_lockfile, unavailable, commit_mismatch, dirty_tree. Any untracked executable/Python or unrecorded wheel file fails closed as dirty_tree.

Two verification branches: git checkout path when root/.git exists (rev-parse HEAD, ls-files index flags, _verify_tree, status porcelain) versus wheel path (direct_url.json commit, _verify_wheel_tree). No branch falls through.
Checkout invariant: every tracked blob at pinned commit re-hashed as git blob SHA1 must match, modes 100644/100755/120000 with executable bit consistent; empty tracked set fails as dirty_tree.

Untracked-file rule: regular files with exec bit, forbidden names, .py/.so/.pth/.sh and similar suffixes, or inside .dist-info/.egg-info count as payload and fail dirty_tree; other plain data files are tolerated.

Wheel invariant: RECORD rows must be 3-column with valid relative paths, sha256= hex or base64 digest plus matching size; every file under root must resolve into verified set; __pycache__ bytecode needs matching parent .py.
Startup-hook invariant: sitecustomize.py, usercustomize.py, sitecustomize.*/usercustomize.* prefixes, or any .pth filename rejected in checkout, RECORD, and wheel-root walk.
Wheel provenance invariant: exactly one X-Y.dist-info matching normalized name, with direct_url.json vcs_info vcs==git and full 40-hex commit_id; ambiguous or missing metadata fails as unavailable.
If env var missing/blank or root not a directory, raises unavailable. If git HEAD != locked commit or wheel commit != locked commit, raises commit_mismatch with actual vs expected.

If tracked bytes/modes differ, suppressed index flags (lowercase or S), tracked modifications, symlinked dirs, non-regular files, or unrecorded payloads appear, raises dirty_tree differing from pinned tree/wheel tree.

Git inspection failures (spawn error, non-zero exit) raise unavailable cannot inspect dependency checkout; environment strips GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE, Python settings, credentials, user/global config with 2.0s timeout.
Malformed lock, I/O, duplicate keys, non-unique components, short SHAs, or unknown name raise bad_lockfile invalid dependency lock.

User sees startup refusal naming the env var or commit: VQA_VE_ROOT is required, dependency root is not a directory, name at <actual> expected <pinned>, or name differs from pinned tree; no private package is imported.
Git subprocess uses sanitized env, DEVNULL stdin, captured output, strict utf-8, 2.0s timeout; PATH is the only inherited locator.
Depends only on stdlib plus git executable on PATH for ls-tree/rev-parse/ls-files/status; wheel branch uses RECORD csv, hashlib sha256, base64 digests, and direct_url.json PEP 610 provenance.
Symlink directories, __pycache__ bytecode without parent source, .pth hooks, and sibling .dist-info RECORDs are explicitly rejected; missed hook or exec-bit payload would be code execution at import.
Deny lists: forbidden checkout names sitecustomize/usercustomize/__init__/pyvenv.cfg, startup prefixes, and payload suffixes .py/.so/.pyd/.dll/.pth/.whl/.sh/.bash and archives.

meta_muse.py fronts Muse Spark via injected runtime transport: adapter owns wire bounds, strict output validation to closed vision contract, and credential hygiene; admission, freshness, witnesses stay with core.
Construction entry __init__(transport, credential, max_line=16384): transport must be callable, credential None or nonempty bytes/bytearray copied to bytes, max_line exact-int >=1 or bad_shape.

Perceive entry perceive(frame_ref, frame, prev): validates frame_ref schema/dims, contains frame args, binds RGB24 pixels, checks sha256, calls transport(request,credential), validates one JSON line into vision dict.

Flow: frame_ref width/height/sha256 -> bind bound_frame from Frame, /proc/self/fd dup+pread, or _ramws_frame for None/RAM paths -> sha256 compare -> deep-copied request {schema,frame_ref,frame,prev} -> transport -> strict JSON {schema,vision} -> check_vision -> _BoundVision copy.

Wire contract is unit-owned: request schema muse.vision.request/v1 with exact keys schema/frame_ref/frame/prev; response must be exact keys schema/vision with schema muse.vision/v1, else bad_shape or unknown_version.
frame_ref must be Mapping with schema frame_ref/v0.1 or v0.2 and exact-int width/height>=1. frame_ref/v* unknown suffix raises unknown_version; other malformed schemas raise bad_shape.
Containment rule: Frame dims must agree; str/Path only under /dev/shm/ canonical non-symlink resolved path or /proc/self/fd/<digits> canonical form, no NUL/empty/.. escape; else bad_shape.
Integer check uses type(value) is int so bool is rejected; value below minimum raises bad_shape.
Transport returns one UTF-8 JSON line of at most max_line bytes (default 16384 from Cafe framing); longer, non-bytes, or non-utf8 responses raise bad_shape.
Response JSON must be strict: non-strict constants rejected, duplicate keys rejected, recursion/decode errors map to bad_shape not strict JSON.
If credential None, raises unavailable muse credential not configured. Transport exceptions collapse to unavailable muse transport failed: <TypeName> so messages never echo credential material.
If bound pixels sha256 != frame_ref sha256, raises identity_mismatch pixels disagree with frame_ref. Frame __post_init__ length and fd size/type checks raise bad_shape first.
If response keys inexact, schema empty/non-str, or schema != muse.vision/v1, raises bad_shape or unknown_version unknown muse response version. Vision then must pass base check_vision.
All local validation raises PerceptionError via _fail with bad_shape, unavailable, or unknown_version; transport payload bytes are never logged or echoed.

User sees describe-frame failure as PerceptionError like muse transport failed: TimeoutError, muse response exceeds line bound, muse response is not strict JSON, unknown muse response version, or pixels disagree with frame_ref.
FD path dups owned descriptor and uses pread to preserve caller cursor, then closes; fstat must show regular file of exactly width*height*3 bytes or bad_shape.
Depends on vcore helpers _BoundVision, _check_hex64, _ramws_frame for sha256 check and RAM binding, and base check_vision as single validation source for v0.2 caps plus observation contract.

Credential lives in memory only, copied from bytearray, never logged/serialized/echoed; request deep-copies frame_ref and returns deep-copied _BoundVision so caller mutation cannot corrupt wire state.

perceive(frame_ref, frame, prev) is live-tick entry. Validates timeout, binds width/height/sha256 from frame_ref, checks Frame/path/None args, loads missing frame from ramws_path, verifies pixel digest, tries vserve if vadapt/vserve.py present then falls back to one-shot unless identity_mismatch or fallback disabled.

_perceive_vserve builds describe request with frame_raw or pinned frame path, optional prev_raw/prev, marks_out/ocr_marks. Holds queue slot plus ExitStack SHM pins, starts vserve under lock, sends one request_id-correlated roundtrip with one restart-and-retry on unavailable/desync within budget.

run_vcore(verb, args) covers offline QA verbs selftest/analyze/pack/cite-check/verify-citations/rejudge via python -m visioncore.cli. Validates verb membership and str args without NUL, runs bounded, parses JSON object, checks vqa schema allowlist and rc agreement.

project_element_table(frame_ref, vision_or_c2) projects to vqa.element-table/v1 evidence with frame_sha256/width/height/elements bbox/role/name/score_ppm. Accepts raw C2 dict with schema key or normalized vision dict; raw C2 is re-parsed and digest-checked, normalized vision must retain _BoundVision binding.

Frame inputs flow as Frame bytes, /dev/shm paths, or /proc/self/fd/N. One-shot encodes Frame to PNG via _png_bytes into memfd passed by pass_fds. Vserve writes Frame RGB24 to mkstemp 0600 file as path,w,h or pins existing path by full read plus copy under ExitStack cleanup.

Vserve uses JSON-lines over stdin/stdout: {request_id,op,...} plus newline, UTF-8, control line cap 65536. Reply line buffered in _vserve_rx_buf with selector timeout, validated by _parse_vserve_reply, result unwrapped for hello/ping/status/describe then fed to C2 parser.

C2 bytes parse to frame_sha256/changed/regions/crops/marks/timing_us/mark_cap_reached. _vision_from_c2 maps marks to bbox/role/name/confidence elements, else crops to role crop with 0.5 confidence, builds summary string. check_vision validates, then wrapped in _BoundVision carrying frame_sha256 provenance only in-process.

Persistent server lifecycle: lazy start plus hello verify, health via ping and optional status, restart kills/reaps/respawns/re-hello. First spawn sets _vserve_has_started; later spawns increment _vserve_restarts against max_restarts. Shutdown closes stdin then EOF wait 0.1s, SIGTERM 0.2s, SIGKILL 0.2s with full reap and atexit weakref hook.

Request correlation is strict: seq increments per hello/ping/status/describe, exact type-plus-value match on request_id and op. Rx buffer must be empty before write and empty after newline; pipelined bytes, mismatch, or blank/EOF reply closes process and marks desync so stream cannot silently shift.

Frame identity must hold end to end: frame_ref sha256 is 64 lowercase hex, Frame bytes sha256 must equal it, C2 frame_sha256 must equal expected input digest and frame_ref sha, normalized vision must be _BoundVision with same frame_sha256 else identity_mismatch.

Timeout is finite non-bool in (0,60]. Single deadline from perceive start propagates to lock acquire, pinned-python probe, vserve start/roundtrip, and RAM reads. Exhausted deadline raises timeout; lock scope fails timeout instead of blocking forever.

C2 contract ve.cu_describe/v1 exact. Width/height ints match input; changed bool present iff prev given; regions max 16 score-descending boxes in frame; crops max 8 with reason changed/salient; marks max 24 sequential id, known kind, unit score, optional ocr_text max 64 UTF-8 bytes; timing_us int; cap flag derived when absent.

Vserve reply must be object with exactly 8 keys and schema ve.vserve.reply/v1. ok bool, rc in 0,2,3,4,5,6, code/detail typed. ok requires rc 0, code OK, empty detail, dict result, request_id present. Error requires rc nonzero, code not OK, result null; rc 4/STALE_FRAME maps STALE_FRAME, rc 5 unavailable, rc 6/BUDGET_EXCEEDED budget.

Hello result requires schema ve.vserve.hello/v1, capabilities list containing describe and frame_raw, raw_shm and frame_raw true, ring bool, max_control<=65536, max_frame<=33554432, max_sessions<=16. Status requires active<=max and session_ids length exactly active_sessions.

One-shot failure: nonzero exit decodes stderr capped 1000 chars. rc 2 bad_shape refused, rc 4 STALE_FRAME stale, rc 5 unavailable gate failed, rc 6 BUDGET_EXCEEDED budget, else bad_shape with code. When vserve already failed, fallback error may be chained or vserve error re-raised with fallback detail appended.

Vserve desync path: nonempty rx before request, pipelined bytes after newline, EOF, timeout, oversize, or uncorrelated app error closes and reaps proc. One retry after restart if restarts remain. Four consecutive non-hello successes reset restarts to 0; budget exhausted raises unavailable.

User sees no table or stale elements: PerceptionError bad_shape, unknown_version, identity_mismatch, STALE_FRAME, unavailable, BUDGET_EXCEEDED, timeout, commit_mismatch, dirty_tree. Texts include C2 digest disagrees with input frame, vserve closed stdout, queue capacity exhausted, PNG dimensions disagree, ramws bytes disagree.

All vserve I/O serialized by reentrant lock with deadline-bounded acquire. In-flight bounded queue capacity 1..4 default 2, policy abort: acquire over capacity raises BUDGET_EXCEEDED, release when empty raises bad_shape, slot context guarantees release.

RAM handoffs live under /dev/shm, marks strictly under /dev/shm/vqa-cu. Raw/pinned files are mkstemp 0600 unlinked via ExitStack. RGB length must equal w*h*3 and fit 33554432 else BUDGET_EXCEEDED. PNG path verifies IHDR dimensions and IEND with no trailing bytes.

Children spawn with close_fds, explicit pass_fds, new session, minimal env PATH/HOME/LANG/PYTHONNOUSERSITE/PYTHONSAFEPATH/PYTHONPATH. _run_bounded multiplexes stdout/stderr with selector, caps stdout 1MiB and stderr 1MiB, kills and fails bad_shape on exceed or timeout.

Requires checkout files vadapt/cu_describe for fallback, vadapt/vserve.py regular non-symlink for persistent mode, visioncore.cli for run_vcore, and absolute pinned interpreter with numpy>=2.0.0. Ve root must contain no .pth or sitecustomize/usercustomize hooks else dirty_tree.

Path traversal guarded: O_NOFOLLOW open, fstat regular-file/owner/size checks, reject symlinks, non-/dev/shm, noncanonical, NUL/empty. /proc/self/fd/N validated lexically only and rejected for vserve. Full file read must match fstat size; PNG vs RGB decided by magic then dimension-checked.

Extra site is supply-chain risk: absolute realpath-canonical, owned by current UID, root-owned ancestor chain without group/other write, no writable or symlink content, no customization modules, 200k entry cap, identity rechecked before probe/spawn and after scan to detect replacement.

planner.py is the in-tree MetaViewer planner: Holdings observations yield one validated action_proposal/v0.2 with an input action, element-table calls yield a left-click plus witness. It also serves as MV_WENDER_PLANNER_CMD pipe target.
plan() branches: observation alone delegates to plan_holdings(); observation plus element_table plus goal runs element-table click planning. Both paths end with recheck before returning a deep copy.

main() is the pipe CLI: takes no argv, reads up to 1 MiB JSON from stdin, dispatches wender_envelope vs observation vs observation_wrapper, prints canonical JSON to stdout, maps PlannerError to EXIT_CODES on stderr.

invoke_planner_cmd() spawns an external planner argv over stdin/stdout via wender_bridge._run_bounded, accepts either action_proposal/v0.2 or {action,expectation} and re-wraps the latter with surface/based_on_frame/budget before recheck.

Holdings data flow: validate observation and ground_truth, prefer explicit action if supplied, else vision element with highest confidence, else frame-center click; then build state_sha256_change expectation from truth tick plus tick_window.

Element-table flow: _validate_inputs checks observation, table, goal and frame binding; _select_target_index picks exact then partial then highest score_ppm match; _build_state_and_nodes derives nodes, ax digests, viewport and actionable list.
Expectation window is [truth.tick+1, truth.tick+tick_window]. Recheck rejects min_tick below tick+1 and inverted min_tick greater than max_tick, so the proposal only advances forward in tick space.

Closed-key invariant: element table must equal {schema,frame_sha256,width,height}, each row exactly {bbox,role,name,score_ppm}, each bbox exactly {x,y,w,h}; response must equal {action,expectation,state,target_node}.

Frame-binding invariant: proposal surface_id and based_on_frame sha256/generation must equal observation frame_ref; state viewport must equal frame width/height; rebuilt wender.state/v1 must equal supplied state byte-for-byte.

Holdings contract: schema action_proposal/v0.2 with proposal_id 1-128 chars, budget max_ms 1-3600000 and max_retries 0-10, action in {click,key,type,scroll}, expectation type state_sha256_change with before equal to ground_truth.state_sha256.

Element-table contract: action must be left click inside frame and inside target_node box; with ground_truth expectation is state_sha256_change, otherwise changed_region bbox must equal target box and stay in frame.

All rejections raise PlannerError(code,detail) via _fail; CLI prints code: detail to stderr and exits with EXIT_CODES mapping bad_shape 1 through unavailable 12. Library callers receive the exception.

Generation-control path: names matching Stop/Detener (case-insensitive, leading whitespace allowed) are excluded; if no candidates remain the planner fails with code generation_control and refuses to target them.
Geometry path: bbox with non-positive size fails bad_shape; bbox escaping frame or computed click escaping frame fails out_of_bounds; click inside frame but outside target bbox fails alignment.
Policy path: any action or proposal with type lane_submit fails with code policy; non-input action types outside click/key/type/scroll also fail policy even if well formed.

User-visible symptom: CLI prints e.g. frame_mismatch: proposal based_on_frame disagrees with observation frame to stderr and exits 3, emitting nothing on stdout; automation sees empty stdout plus nonzero exit.
