Missing shm file maps to NotFound. precheck_frame_on_not_found then validates generation, size, sha256 shape and surface liveness. If the surface is destroyed or non-live it returns Ok without retiring the daemon; stale generation or unknown surface becomes StaleFrame or invalid instead.

Daemon envelopes batch up to 32 items. A frame superseded by a later same-surface generation with valid metadata and pre-verified pixels skips pixel read and verification. Large frames at least 512x512 pixels verify in spawn_blocking; batches yield briefly after frame work.

Daemon Case0 creates and Case1 updates, Lost or Destroyed surfaces. Create sets agent_controlled from wire control; updates preserve stored agent_controlled. Active maps to live, Destroyed prunes human_inputs, loss of Human control marks pendings case4_expired.

Session clock is origin elapsed plus offset and must stay below MAX_WIRE_INTEGER, about 104 days. Reaching the ceiling logs core clock exhausted and fails closed with ClockCeilingError without mutating authority; restart is required. Idle waiter ticks sample the clock once.

Full peer queue installs a terminal surface_event error QUEUE_OVERFLOW once in a reserved slot and returns QueueOverflow while keeping the sender alive for delivery. Disconnected queue maps to Disconnected. Writer flushes the terminal envelope then retires the endpoint and clears its subscriptions and tool state.

A saturated tester sees one surface_event error with code QUEUE_OVERFLOW saying the peer queue is exhausted and to reconnect and refresh, then the connection closes. Normal queue memory stays bounded; only the reserved diagnostic is guaranteed.

Ui SurfaceRequest Case5 op input becomes HumanInput, then a daemon input command with origin human bound to the supplied proposal_id or a minted human-input core_seq id. Agent Case5 is refused with Policy. Pendings track seq, Ui endpoint, surface, Ui proposal id and expiry flag.

Daemon receipts for human proposal ids settle pendings. Verified or error receipts map through adapter_input_refusal to typed refusals sent to the originating Ui; success sends admitted action_verdict to the Ui only, never back to the daemon. Destroy, Lost and control changes prune or expire pendings.

Proposal admission needs a connected daemon else Policy refusal. After admit it applies Dispatch; post-admit send failure applies DispatchFailed and evicts the proposal. Failed dispatch emits a dispatch refusal. Cancellations evict proposals and notify the agent with SurfaceNotAgentControlled without blocking human control.

Layout slot_id resolves through slot_surface except destroyed ids. Unknown, non-live or ungrounded slots yield LAYOUT_UNKNOWN_SLOT for extended ops else unsupported. Agent-controlled surfaces are read-only. Placement failures return typed codes. Fold and unfold fan out state_changed views; other ops fan out the raw intent.

Core sends list probes tagged core-keepalive on a probe interval. Only daemon replies refresh the unchanged idle deadline; probes cannot keep a silent peer alive. Responsive idle daemons survive multiple deadlines while silent peers expire. Graceful EOF drains batches; abort drops unrouted batches.

Pre-tombstone archives with a Destroyed lifecycle outcome and missing destroyed state are detected only after strict recovery refuses. Open then fails with UPGRADE-REQUIRED directing operators to stop peers, archive the session unchanged, start a new session_id, and never replay the archive.

Shutdown closes frame timings, clears connections, observers and subscription sets, then flush_sync persists the journal and joins its background worker. Drop and ServeGuard repeat the flush on teardown and log failures to stderr. Retire also settles daemon-owned human pendings.

Bounds are ReplayTable 100_000 entries, bounded per-peer sync queues, human_inputs cap 100_000, frame and event inspection cap 64 MiB, legacy scan up to 100_000 event files, and session ids limited to alphanumerics plus dot, dash and underscore.

Publishers see invalid frame witness, frame digest mismatch, generation regression, unknown surface, invalid frame path or outside shared memory when shm files are missing, symlinks, wrong owners or modes, wrong sizes, stale generations or mismatched digests.

Frame open uses Linux-only O_NOFOLLOW and O_NONBLOCK plus O_DIRECTORY variants differing between aarch64 and x86. Unsupported platforms return unsupported frame open ABI. Kernel-level no-follow open is load-bearing against symlink replacement between metadata checks and pixel reads.

Daemon Observation needs retained witnesses or it receives an unsupported Policy verdict. Accepted notices commit SurfaceNotice without fanout. Every daemon event and receipt retains tool state, prunes against authority, and polls tool waiters before forwarding or replying.
Regression suite for serve layer pins routing, journal recovery, clock ceiling, frame batching, human-input and shutdown behavior against regressions.
Control enters via Fixture::route/component attach and Server::route/route_daemon_batch; daemon FrameRef and frame_ready envelopes drive authority apply, witness, capture and fanout to UI.

Agent proposals create pending/leases, daemon receipts settle them; verdicts go to UI/agent, dispatches to daemon; tool_state retain/wait_verify exposes receipts; journal scan must equal in-memory state.

Surface live/lost/destroyed and proposal pending/draining transitions: error observes without cancel, state_changed lost cancels pending to draining; retire/destroy/release_control expire human_inputs.

At or above MAX_WIRE_INTEGER clock, route and poll refuse with ClockCeilingError and leave domain_snapshot, snapshot, core_seq and serial unchanged; below ceiling each route samples now() exactly once.
Contract and published adapter frame paths are admitted with sha256 digest check; symlink components, traversal, outside-root paths and bad digests fail closed via witness refusal.
Server::read_shm_pixels_under anchors ramws_path under given shm root, verifies size/sha, rejects root itself and ParentDir traversal.
Legacy archive with frame admitted after Destroyed fails Server::open with UPGRADE-REQUIRED mentioning archive; current tombstone journals do not classify as legacy.
Corrupt/Empty/Blank/Utf8Bom/MissingLf/Oversize/Unsealed journal variants surface typed JournalError on Authority::recover yet Server::open maps legacy-destroy history to UPGRADE-REQUIRED.
Refused Destroyed for unknown surface journals POLICY refusal with no destroyed key; later Empty journal recovers as Corrupt(empty) and must not mention UPGRADE-REQUIRED.
After Destroyed, FrameRef and frame_ready are refused and never published to UI, domain unchanged; refusal send QueueOverflow is swallowed while Disconnected propagates as SendFailure.
Failed forward to saturated daemon or failed verdict to agent releases pending/leases with nothing dispatched; commit failure during HumanInput append returns Err and forwards nothing.
Saturated 1-slot daemon queue refuses human input with refused POLICY verdict, no human_inputs entry and no HumanInput journal event; freeing one slot admits next input.
Daemon batch lookahead verifies superseding pixels: valid predecessor commits before mismatched-sha or 65MiB oversize successor fails the batch; all-valid batch coalesces to latest generation.
skip_superseded_frame at clock ceiling fails with ClockCeilingError before recording replay state; below ceiling the same seq can be superseded and later seq routes normally.
Client half-closing after a fold request still receives the queued ActionVerdict reply rather than losing it on EOF.
Idle poll_tool_waiters_tick samples now() once and stamps identical ts_ns on all woken wait_verify replies; ceiling poll fails before dequeuing so no waiter is lost.

Refused human-input receipts are not retained so wait_verify returns NOT_FOUND, admitted ones stay VERIFICATION_FAILED across reopen; daemon retire journals refusal settlement and never resurrects or duplicates verdict.
release_control keeps human_inputs receipt fence marked case4_expired; later receipt emits admitted verdict, clears fence, never misroutes to agent, identically live and after crash recovery.
SHM root is a caller-supplied directory honoring custom temp roots with 0700 dir and 0600 file modes in tests.
Frame examples come from contracts/examples/v0.2/frame_ref.valid.json and surface events; pixel bytes and sha256_hex link wire metadata to shm file content.

This file proves core recomputes receipt verified status from native evidence and frame witnesses instead of trusting daemon claims, covering closed decoding, nine negative controls, and typed wait_verify mapping.

Entry is four #[test] functions run by the Rust harness; each builds Temp dir, proposal/before/receipt fixture, then calls decode_envelope, verified_native_fields, Server::open, route, or poll_tool_waiters.

proposal() derives action_proposal from before frame plus receipt id; envelope() wraps receipt as envelope/v0.2 body; fixture() loads action_receipt.valid.native-key.json then rewrites after_frame and before sha256/generation/ts_ns from Temp files.

verified_native_fields must return status verified with receipt.verified true only when native_evidence, focus, timestamps, kind, surface, frame change, and after_frame ts line up; nine mutated receipts must return None.
decode_envelope enforces closed native_evidence schema: missing unknown field or null focus_verified/input_ts_ns must be Err, while fully valid envelope must be Ok.

Each bad mode maps to None: missing removes native_evidence; stale sets input_ts_ns 0; wrong-surface/focus break binding; future 3000000 and late 2000000000 break time bounds; kind click, unchanged sha256, error failed each void verification.
Valid result converts to MvToolResult::Case5 with schema mv_tool_result/v0.2, op wait_verify; test asserts matches Case5, pinning the typed success shape for wait_verify callers.

Go side emits before pixels and receipt; Rust asserts before sha256 equals Temp hash of first pixel vector and after_frame sha256 equals hash of second vector, then re-runs verified_native_fields and checks focus_verified and input_mono_ns passthrough.
Requires Go toolchain plus daemon-adapter tree at CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR parent; GO env var selects binary, default go. Failure panics with expect Go toolchain required, so missing Go fails this test.
User-visible effect is none directly; tester sees Go stdout/stderr on assertion failure and mismatched sha256 or verified false when cross-language encoding drifts.

wait_verify path opens Server with session receipt-proof, copies frame hashes into root artifacts, inserts agent Connection with MAX_SEND_QUEUE channel, seeds verification_contexts, retains ActionReceipt, pushes Waiter with 1s deadline, then poll_tool_waiters.
Valid mode publishes status verified with receipt.verified true; missing/stale/wrong-surface/wrong-focus publish status error code VERIFICATION_FAILED; waiters must be empty after poll in every mode.
Result body preserves request_id equal to mode string; valid versus error branches distinguished only by status/code and receipt.verified, pinning typed failure contract for UI/agent waiters.

R3 test drives full custody: Connect, retain_witness, Surface with frame generation 1, agent proposal route admitted, daemon receipt route settles; pending and leases must empty after each receipt while tool_state.receipts stores core verdict.

Forged claim verified true plus state_sha256/forged detail with focus false forwards verified false, method pixel, detail missing invalid or unmatched witness. Valid evidence with same forged method forwards verified true, method pixel, detail frame-bound witness matched.

This file proves reconnect semantics: a queue-overflowed connection is terminally retired with a typed error yet the same endpoint can reconnect fresh, and daemon nonces survive restart via journal replay.

registration() builds Registration from endpoint plus hello/v0.2 with fixed version and commit; config() wires session reconnect with core plus daemon/agent/ui peers; Temp supplies state dir for Server::open.

attach() opens UnixStream pair, spawns connection task with server and uid, then decodes envelope seq 1 nonce and write_frame hello from component endpoint to core; returns client socket plus join handle.
Overflow path: saturating send returns Err QueueOverflow downcast from SendFailure; reader gets terminal body whose data.code equals QUEUE_OVERFLOW; connection task must terminate within 2s timeout.

After overflow close, second attach with nonce overflow-second must get Command::Hello again, proving endpoint reconnect uses restarted sequence rather than staying wedged; drop socket then join task.
What user sees is UI stream ends after backlog with QUEUE_OVERFLOW terminal, then a fresh connect succeeds and gets hello; without this, overflowed UI would stay dead or replay stale seq.
Fill holds server MutexGuard without await so writer cannot race saturation fixture; reads use tokio timeout 2s around read_frame; task join asserts orderly shutdown before reconnect.
Bounded by MAX_SEND_QUEUE channel depth; exactly that many sends succeed, one more fails; sockets and tasks dropped explicitly to release server Arc before test end.
Second test attaches daemon twice with nonces daemon-first and daemon-second, each expecting Hello then drop plus task join, then drops server and reopens Server::open on same state dir.
Each attach journals its nonce; after restart recovered.replay.contains(session reconnect, daemon endpoint, nonce) must hold for both nonces, proving journal retains both generations.
Nonce evidence is append-only across reconnects and restarts: neither generation overwrites the other, and replay lookup by session plus endpoint plus nonce is the durable identity.
Depends on tokio UnixStream pair, decode_envelope, write_frame/read_frame, connection, and Server::open/bind semantics; no Go, no shm, no pixel I/O in this unit.

This file is the serve regression suite: it pins frame witness, custody, cancellation, layout, lost-surface, recording, and recovery behavior through live daemon/agent/ui peers plus direct Server state assertions.
support::run builds current-thread tokio runtime for each async test; uid reads peer_cred uid from a UnixStream pair; Temp creates metaviewer-core-test-PID-NEXT dir and Drop removes it.
daemon_barrier sends daemon list tool_call and expects refused POLICY verdict; it fences earlier daemon messages on that connection without timed probe, so unexpected dispatches fail the test.
SharedFrame writes WIDTH 100 HEIGHT 60 RGB bytes of f under /dev/shm/mv-wire-PID-NEXT-frame mode 0600; value clones frame_ref.valid.json with real sha256, ramws_path, generation; Drop removes file.

proposal clones action_proposal.valid.json keyed by based_on_frame sha256/generation; control builds ui_intent take/release; tool_call wraps mv_tool_call; tool_result expects MvToolResult with agent-test-seq request_id and asserts op/status.

start_server binds runtime/core.sock and spawns serve; setup connects daemon/agent/ui; surface loads surface.valid.json; created forwards surface created to ui; close_server aborts task and waits for Arc count 1.

Missing shm leaf queued beyond lease: both bare frame and frame_ready forms stay unadmitted with surface frame None; later fresh generation 2 forwards to UI; false digest generation 3 fails witness Err, closing without retiring daemon.

Admitted proposal plus wait_verify registers waiter; take_control triggers notify_cancellations then control dispatch; waiter empties, agent gets UNAVAILABLE result, authority draining holds cancelled; unknown proposal wait gives NOT_FOUND.

Retaining a waiter alone enqueues nothing; notify_cancellations for cancelled emits ActionVerdict then wait result request_id cancel-wait code UNAVAILABLE and clears waiters, leaving queue empty after.
list with cursor null needs no metadata for lookahead and returns one surface with next_cursor surface-demo; advancing to that cursor when metadata removed gives error UNAVAILABLE.
ToolState.retain drops destroyed/lost surfaces and their frames: after 1000 created/frame/state_changed cycles surfaces and frames must be empty, proving no dead metadata retention.
Receipt retention capped at 128 in arrival order: after 200 retains, len <=128, receipt-0 evicted, receipt-199 present; same bound rechecked after 200-receipt recovery batch.

Agent fold refused POLICY; ui fold/unfold/fold emit state_changed with visibility pinned/folded/unfolded; later daemon state_changed cannot reverse folded; unknown slot fold refused POLICY; recovery preserves folded.
Layout intents with empty slot, extra keys, or surface_id instead of slot_id fail decode_envelope Err for fold/unfold/hide/show/move/tab/float, so malformed UI intents never reach routing.

move/tab/float set placements position, hide/show set hidden; each step checkpoint-copies state dir under authority lock and reopens to prove replay stability; illegal hide/tab, unknown slot, read-mode, agent show give POLICY plus LAYOUT_* error and unchanged placements.
copy_tree recursively copies state dir with permissions under authority mutex; journal deliberately has single writer, so copy preserves lock gate and later restart comparison is exact.
Stale daemon state_changed human arriving after release_control must publish agent control to UI and keep authority agent_controlled true; only fresh daemon agent snapshot completes release.

16-frame burst coalesces to generation 16 on take_control forward; 17-24 burst preserves order with human then agent state_changed and latest gen 24; regression gen 20 inside burst refused STALE_FRAME while gen 33 admitted.
Streams 1280x900 RGB24 3.456MB frames; take/release intents must forward within 1000ms, 100ms when MV_PERF_STRICT=1; emits MEASURED_CONTROL_UNDER_STREAM take/release ms and asserts ceilings.
Valid gen 33 forwards; oversize 65MB gen 34 frame retires daemon with read_frame None while committed generation stays 33, proving invalid lookahead does not skip valid predecessor.
Regressed gen 20 with missing /dev/shm leaf after committed gen 32 retires daemon promptly within 300ms; close observed as None frame, not silent drop.
recordStart returns ok plus recording_id; burst gens 2-5 all captured so recordStop frames equals 5; proves active recording disables coalescing that would otherwise drop intermediates.
Expired waiter with deadline 10ms past plus 32-frame gapless daemon batch must resolve at batch flush: agent_rx try_recv must be Ok after daemon shutdown, proving flush polls tool waiters.

read_shm_pixels_under /dev/shm-unavailable-prefix plus frame() must Err fail-closed; same frame under valid prefix with missing leaf returns Ok None silent drop. Prefix outage versus leaf miss are distinct.
Frame on destroyed surface notifies daemon first with proposal_id frame msg id decision refused reason POLICY before barrier reply, then barrier also refused POLICY.

Lost via state_changed lost journals Lost lifecycle, forwards state_changed lost with authoritative agent control and folded visibility, cancels inflight proposal SURFACE_NOT_AGENT_CONTROLLED, refuses new proposal, human input POLICY, take_control POLICY, screenshot SURFACE_UNKNOWN.
Late active and gen 2 frame after lost each refused POLICY; live stays false, frame stays gen 1, refresh_after fence unchanged; later agent proposal still refused SURFACE_NOT_AGENT_CONTROLLED.
Late bare frame_ref on lost surface refused POLICY with proposal_id echo; frame and refresh_after fence must equal pre-frame values, proving no replace or fence clear.

Takeover- and lost-cancelled draining proposals cleared by late receipts without retaining receipts or forwarding ActionReceipt to agent; next agent message must be mv_tool_result; reopened state holds neither receipt.

Inflight human input settled on lost with state_changed plus refused POLICY verdict and cleared human_inputs; disconnected UI queue variant still journals settlement; reopened human_inputs stays empty.
After journaled lost, reopen snapshot surfaces surface-demo live false; reconnected daemon/agent/ui get no spontaneous state_changed or verdict within 50ms; list returns empty surfaces ok.
frame_subscribe and destroy on lost surface each refused POLICY with proposal echo; remaining_budget unchanged, no subscription added, daemon barrier proves nothing forwarded.

Peers use instance COMPONENT-test, contract v0.2, fixed commit hash; session serve-session; recovery_proposal overrides budget max_ms from IDLE_DEADLINE to tolerate persistence delay while still expiring at that deadline with BudgetExceeded.
Regression harness for serve: budget/policy refusals, queue saturation signal vs disconnect, 3.45 MB frame latency ceilings, and human-input admission/forwarding with journal replay recovery.

registration(component) builds a Registration by deserializing endpoint component plus instance and hello schema hello/v0.2 contract v0.2; every test server Config is seeded through it for core/agent/daemon/ui.

CoreState::new(budget,1) contract: SurfaceRequest op input with key Enter is rejected with Refusal::Policy and leaves remaining_budget at 1; op list is lifecycle, returns None and decrements to 0; further list returns BudgetExceeded at 0.
If non-lifecycle op bypassed policy, budget would decrement on refused input. Fails as wrong reason or remaining_budget change. Observed via apply() return reason and remaining_budget assertions.
Server::open(config, root 0700, effective_uid) with sync_channel(1) Connection id 1 epoch 0; first send Hello succeeds, second send fails. Terminal Mutex holds the typed diagnostic.
Queue full: send returns SendFailure::QueueOverflow(peer) and terminal receives envelope body event error code QUEUE_OVERFLOW. Queued Hello is preserved on rx, not replaced by diagnostic.
Receiver dropped: next send returns SendFailure::Disconnected(peer) with no new terminal notification. Distinguishes saturation diagnostic from disconnect silence.
Overflow diagnostic envelope must decode via decode_envelope and serialize to event error/QUEUE_OVERFLOW. Asserts wire shape of reserved typed signal.

Opens Server frame-lat-session, registers ui/daemon connections epoch 1, Connect plus Surface srf-lat owner agent live, daemon handshake via UnixStream pair and HandshakePolicy, then 8 frame_ready envelopes seq gen+1.

Ceilings: mean <= 4*hash_ms+50 ms, absolute safety cap 1500 ms for mean and max; MV_PERF_STRICT=1 switches mean ceiling to 60 ms. Prints STAGE_BREAKDOWN_PER_FRAME and MEASURED_CORE_FRAME_PATH with hash_ms, mean, max, batch.
After 8 generations journal scan must yield 2+8 boundaries and surfaces[srf-lat].frame.generation == 8, proving replay reproduces final frame state.

User would see slow or stalled video: UI frame_ready never arrives within budget or790 test panics with mean/max exceeded message. Cause here would be extra hashes, fsyncs, or fanout delay on 3.45 MB frames.

Surface srf-1 owner agent, agent_controlled true, live, frame 1280x720; UI and daemon handshakes via write_frame/handshake_at; helpers send_ui/send_daemon wrap surface_request/v0.2 and route_at with seq/ts.
While agent-controlled, UI input hi-agent-owned key a is refused decision refused reason LOCKED_BY_OTHER to UI, nothing to daemon. Take control ui_intent take-1 forwards op take_control to daemon.

Admitted key/type/click/scroll are forwarded to daemon as surface_request input with origin human and unchanged action; no UI reply. Daemon input_applied goes to UI only; receipts become action_verdict to UI only, never to daemon.

Receipt mapping: verified false with applied detail yields admitted; error SURFACE_NOT_AGENT_CONTROLLED yields refused with that code; surface_event error unsupported yields error event plus refused POLICY for hi-click-1.
Negative inputs refused with no daemon forward: duplicate hi-key-1 POLICY, click x1280 y720 OUT_OF_BOUNDS, forged origin agent POLICY, post-release_control hi-after-release LOCKED_BY_OTHER.
Control states: agent-controlled blocks human input; take_control admits; release_control re-locks. Release forwards op release_control to daemon before refusals resume.

Journal replay invariant: scan(journal.jsonl) state snapshot equals live snapshot. Recovery invariant: reopened server retains pending hi-scroll-1 but not settled hi-key-1/hi-type-1/hi-click-1; late receipt yields refused POLICY to UI.
Each test uses temp dir mv-*-pid with 0700 plus frame test shm dir, removes it after. Server drop before remove_dir_all; leaked dir or open fd would fail cleanup.
Depends on tokio current-thread runtime, UnixStream pair, HandshakePolicy/WireLimits, decode_envelope/write_frame/route_at, sha256_hex, journal scan, and /dev/shm availability.

Best-effort diagnostic frame clock independent of authority: records disjoint wall-clock stages per accepted frame to JSONL, bounded at 4 MiB and 256 queued rows, with saturation disable-once and single-log I/O failure.

Clock::new(frame) seeds Row surface_id/generation/width/height and start time; read(pixels) copies shm_read_ns/hash_ns plus skipped_hash_ns/hash_skipped and folds earliest read_started; finish stamps total_ns elapsed.

Additive stage helpers set skipped_hash_ns/hash_skipped, accumulate parallel_wait_ns, set surface_queue_depth without touching base keys; Row builders with_skipped_hash/with_parallel_wait/with_surface_queue_depth do the same.

Row JSON keys are fixed base set plus optional skipped_hash_ns/hash_skipped/parallel_wait_ns/surface_queue_depth omitted when None; byte_len/witness_journal_ns/capture_ns/fanout_ns/total_ns are wall-clock disjoint stages.

Writer::start(path) creates sync_channel 256, spawns frame-timings thread that waits for first Row, opens file with frame_open_flags mode 0600, rejects non-regular file, truncates to 0, then appends rows.
No accepted frames means no artifact: worker exits on recv failure without creating file. Unauthenticated/refused traffic must never create timing file.

submit enqueues depth via on_enqueue then try_send; Full rolls back counts and permanently clears sender after first disable log; Disconnected rolls back and clears sender relying on worker already-logged I/O error.
I/O failure latched once with eprintln frame timings disabled plus error; worker clears in-flight queued to 0. close drops sender and joins thread; Drop calls close.
per_surface BTreeMap guarded by Mutex with poison-tolerant into_inner; flags/counters are AtomicBool/AtomicU64. Worker owns file and drains channel; submitters only try_send, never block frame path.

Per-surface telemetry tracks queued/peak_queued/submitted/drained; drained decrements queued and increments drained; clear_in_flight zeroes queued on I/O death; snapshot/peak/current accessors expose depths.
File never exceeds 4 MiB; rotation drops all oldest rows keeping only complete newline-terminated JSON. Three half-file rows leave one line with last padding c.
Start then immediate close creates no file. Proves diagnostic side-channel has no artifact cost when no frame accepted.
Directory as timing path makes worker open fail; thread joins, submit after failure is harmless no-op with sender None. Second submits after disconnect stay safe.
User sees missing timings file or single eprintln frame timings disabled plus OS error when disk/path bad. Cause is non-regular destination or thread spawn failure, not authority logic.
256 fills queue, 257th Full disables sender/count 1/marker Some; popping one row then submitting gen 999 is still rejected and never appears among drained 0..255.

Production Clock::read emits 13 ordered keys with hash_skipped false and skipped_hash_ns 0 and hash_ns >0; stage recording only adds parallel_wait_ns 4000 and depth 4, preserving all base keys and 4 MiB rotation.
32 rows across 4 capsules drain to queued 0, peak >=1, submitted/drained 8 each, file holds 32 lines. Bad directory writer under same load latches io_failure_count exactly 1.

4-capsule fill reaches depth/peak 64 each; 8 overflow rows disable once; post-drain submits 1000..1003 rejected; persisted 256 rows parse as truncation-free JSON with generation/skipped/parallel/depth intact.
Constants QUEUE_CAPACITY 256 and MAX_BYTES 4 MiB bound memory and disk; SATURATION_DISABLE_MARKER string is the single user-visible saturation log line.
Depends on frame_open_flags, VerifiedPixels, serde_json rows, BufWriter file with O flags 0600, and frame-timings background thread; independent of authority decisions.
First accepted frame after restart truncates file, discarding prior rows. Flush per row favors prompt readers over throughput; truncation races favor completeness over history.

Rebuild tool read views from committed boundary witnesses. ToolState caches surfaces, frames, ground truths, proposals, receipts and waiters so observe, list, propose and wait_verify serve live authority-consistent views without holding the authority lock.

tool_call is the mv_tool_call/v0.2 entry. Case2 propose is re-decoded as ActionProposal and routed to admit_proposal; Case0 observe, Case1 list and Case3 wait_verify first apply Input::SurfaceNotice with the boundary witness, then branch per op.

Daemon holdings_lane intake gate. accept_daemon_observation returns bool; accept_and_retain_daemon_observation retains boundary plus canonical state bytes as witnesses and returns Ok(None) on any gate or sidecar failure.

observe flow: load authority surface, require live, require tool frame matching authority sha256 and generation, attach holdings ground truth only if agent-controlled with no human input, return observation with frame_ref and optional ground_truth via tool_result.

list flow: iterate authority surfaces in BTreeMap lexical order, skip non-live and cursor-covered ids, cap at limit args, overlay tool metadata with authority agent/human control, return surfaces plus next_cursor from last entry.

propose flow: Case2 becomes ActionProposal envelope preserving msg_id as tool id. Admitted verdicts prune then retain_proposal and reply status admitted; refused admission or dispatch reply status refused with reason_code.

wait_verify flow: waiter registered with deadline, poll_tool_waiters settles on receipt arrival, pending removal, or timeout. Verified receipts project verified_native_fields_with_witness; otherwise returns VERIFICATION_FAILED, UNAVAILABLE cancelled, or timeout with verified false.

Surface states: live views in surfaces, dead views pruned when authority is_destroyed or not live, destroyed tombstones in destroyed set. Case0/Case1 destroyed or lost removes surface, frame, ground truth, layout and placement; destroyed records a tombstone, lost only evicts.

Proposal states: retained in verification_contexts with before frame and in proposal_witnesses as before_gt plus after witness. Receipt arrival pins both; evict_proposal drops unsettled context. New proposal on same surface evicts stale unsettled siblings; take_control clears surface ground truth and contexts.

Frame identity ignores tick: committed equals candidate if JSON equal, else equal after removing tick from both objects. Used to join tool frames, daemon observations, and Case2 witness frames to committed boundary frames.

Daemon observation and prune liveness require dispatched true, unknown false, matching epoch, agent-origin envelope, and optional surface match. Connect epoch bump or unknown pending silently invalidates the join.

Result envelope is mv_tool_result/v0.2 echoing request msg_id and op, extended with status fields. Errors use status error with codes NOT_FOUND, UNAVAILABLE, VERIFICATION_FAILED. Nested payloads keep v0.2 schema tags and field sets.

Case2 state_sha256_change requires witness frame equal to receipt after_frame on same surface, generation strictly after based_on_frame, before digest equal to want.before, after digest changed, tick inside min/max and monotonic, frame tick match, and both state JSON bytes present under artifacts.

observe fails closed: unknown surface returns NOT_FOUND Unknown surface; non-live returns UNAVAILABLE Surface is not live; missing or stale tool frame returns UNAVAILABLE No current frame. No observation is returned.

list fails closed when tool metadata missing: returns UNAVAILABLE Missing surface metadata instead of a partial list. Cursor is exclusive lexical surface id; limit zero is rejected earlier at closed envelope decoding.

wait_verify fails as: unknown id NOT_FOUND Unknown proposal; per-peer waiter overflow UNAVAILABLE Too many pending waits; settled receipt without witness VERIFICATION_FAILED with case2_wait_detail or focus proof absent; cancelled pending UNAVAILABLE Proposal cancelled; deadline timeout with verified false.

Daemon intake returns false or Ok(None) when vision present, ground_truth missing or not holdings_lane Value, surface destroyed or unknown, not live, not agent-controlled, frame sha/generation/size mismatch, no human-input exclusion, no unsettled dispatched proposal, or sidecar open, owner, mode, size or canonical digest check fails.

User sees empty or stale observe with No current frame, list missing a live surface or error Missing surface metadata, propose refused with Admission refused or Dispatch refused, wait_verify stuck then timeout with verified false, or error VERIFICATION_FAILED with detail such as state_sha256 unchanged, tick outside window, or canonical state JSON bytes absent.

Waits hold no authority lock. Waiters queue per peer with Instant deadline timeout_ms and MAX_SEND_QUEUE per-peer cap. poll_tool_waiters drains ready waiters; send failure SendFailure is swallowed so one dead reader cannot block receipt settlement or other waiters. remove_peer drops a peer's waiters.

Bounded indexes by arrival: receipts and receipt_order capped at 128, proposal witnesses at 128 preferring eviction of unsettled entries, per-surface frame ground-truth rings at 16, destroyed tombstones at 128. Receipt refresh moves id to back without consuming a slot; receipt eviction drops context and witnesses.

Verification depends on verify_receipt Evidence, hash-addressed files under root artifacts keyed by sha256, and canonical::canonicalise_and_verify_state with MAX_STATE_BYTES. Native path additionally requires focus_verified true, non-empty native surface id, kind match, ok result, and monotonic input timestamps.

Prefixed tombstone cuk-ai-slot- whose stripped base is still live in surfaces must never be evicted; evict_destroyed skips such entries. prune retains contexts only for dispatched current-epoch agent pendings or settled receipts and re-records dead ids as destroyed.

Holdings sidecar is read only via anchored /dev/shm dir with symlink, uid, mode 077, non-empty size, dev/ino stability, and canonical digest checks; duplicate candidates or any mismatch fail closed. take_control and human_inputs gate agent ground-truth exposure and daemon acceptance.

Regression pins tool-view lifecycle correctness under churn: destroyed surfaces leave live views intact, tombstone and receipt indexes stay bounded, prefixed tombstones shadowing live surfaces survive, and receipt refresh does not consume a slot.

Test-only constructors build Command inputs from contracts examples: surface_event clones surface.valid.json with chosen id and state, receipt clones action_receipt.valid.json with chosen proposal id. Both feed ToolState.retain directly.

Flow retains created surface, optional frame, layout fold marker, then destroyed event; asserts live maps drop the id while destroyed set grows. Second loop retains 2000 receipts and refreshes one id to verify order back-pointer and eviction of the oldest entry.

Surface transitions asserted per id: before destruction surfaces, frames and layout contain the id; after destroyed event none contain it. Live surface surface-live persists through 10000 destroy cycles of other ids.

Invariants checked each iteration: destroyed length at or under DESTROYED_CAP with order length equal to set length; receipts length at or under RECEIPT_CAP with order length equal to map length. Final receipt count equals cap.
Closed decoding contract: mv_tool_call list with limit 0 decodes as Err InvalidField, while the same envelope with limit 1 decodes ok. Zero-limit lists never reach tool_call.

If tombstone eviction dropped the prefixed id cuk-ai-slot-surface-live while base surface-live stays live, or if receipt refresh consumed a slot, assertions on contains and receipt_order back equal refreshed would fail.

Bounds pinned: destroyed settles at DESTROYED_CAP with surface-0 evicted and surface-9999 retained; receipts settle at RECEIPT_CAP with proposal-0 evicted and proposal-1999 retained. Final frames and layout are empty after full destroy churn.
Depends on contracts examples surface.valid.json, frame_ref.valid.json and action_receipt.valid.json, plus ToolState retain path and DESTROYED_CAP and RECEIPT_CAP constants from tools.rs.

Prefixed tombstone hazard: cuk-ai-slot-surface-live destroyed tombstone must survive even at cap pressure because unprefixed surface-live is live. Test also asserts slot_surface mapping of the prefixed id returns itself.
Validates LaunchSpec before any spawn: epoch nonzero, canonical program/cwd, bounded args/env, no NUL bytes, Daemon-exempt Python recipe gate with isolated imports and empty private cwd.
Supervisor.start calls validate(spec) before checking runtime; rejects with InvalidConfig or InvalidEpoch before reserving an Entry.
Supervisor.new calls validate_limits; rejects zero or over-cap timeouts, poll>reap, zero/oversize stderr chunk, diagnostics cap, descendant cap.
Predicate for each env key: nonempty ASCII uppercase/digits/underscore, rejects LD_/DYLD_/PYTHON/NODE_/ELECTRON_ prefixes and 9-element denylist.
Helper requires absolute path, canonicalize succeeds and equals input, and is_file; used for program binary and reaper runtime path.
All four Durations must be nonzero and <=60s; poll_interval<=reap_timeout; stderr_chunk_bytes 1..65536; max_diagnostics_bytes 1..1048576; max_descendants 1..4096.
Key must match [A-Z0-9_]+, must not start with LD_, DYLD_, PYTHON, NODE_, ELECTRON_, and must not equal BASH_ENV, ENV, GCONV_PATH, HOSTALIASES, ZDOTDIR, GLIBC_TUNABLES, LOCPATH, NLSPATH, TZDIR.
initial_epoch!=0 else InvalidEpoch; program must be canonical file; cwd absolute dir and canonical-equal; args<=4096 each <=65536 no NUL; env<=256 entries keys<=256 values<=65536 no NUL.
Bad epoch returns InvalidEpoch; bad path/args/env or recipe/cwd violation returns InvalidConfig; caller Supervisor.start aborts before Entry insert, no loss recorded.
Any out-of-range limit returns InvalidConfig; Supervisor.new fails and no Supervisor is constructed.

User sees service never starts; logs/status show InvalidConfig or InvalidEpoch. Cause is non-canonical/symlinked program, relative cwd, oversize args/env, forbidden env key, or missing -I -S -B recipe.
Canonical equality pins the exact inode path: no symlinks, no .. or trailing slash aliasing; canonicalize failure means missing file and returns false.
Limits are caller-supplied SupervisorLimits; caps (60s, 64KiB chunk, 1MiB diagnostics, 4096 descendants) bound spawn, reap, and evidence threads.
Depends only on std Path metadata, canonicalize, PermissionsExt mode bits, read_dir emptiness; no transport, verify, or async runtime.
Serialized lifecycle owner for Daemon/Agent/Vision/Executor services: owns entries, losses, shutdown flag; spawns private per-service subreaper via bundled Python, never PATH search.
Constructor validates limits then builds empty entries/losses; fails with InvalidConfig on out-of-range limits.
Host pins canonical interpreter path once before any start; rejects if entries nonempty or path not canonical file.
Guards ShuttingDown and AlreadyRunning, validates spec, requires runtime set, prechecks exec bit (EACCES errno 13), inserts Stopped Entry then launch.
Private spawn loop: sets Starting, spawns OwnedProcess, polls pid/valid/root_alive until ready; on early exit or startup timeout records loss and stops.
Caller must first authenticate hello off-thread; only transitions Starting|Ready to Ready after refresh and epoch match, else StaleEpoch/Unavailable.
Core handoff gate called under same serialized owner: refreshes, checks epoch then available flag; denies with StaleEpoch or Unavailable.
Explicit restart requires no pending loss for id; records ExplicitRestart, needs complete stop_inner, bumps epoch checked_add, then launch.
Resume revokes all services: records Resume loss per entry, bumps epoch, stops each; returns losses or CleanupIncomplete on any failure/overflow.
Records Shutdown loss unless already Stopped/Unavailable, then stop_inner; returns ReapReceipt.
Sets shutting_down, stops every entry, returns receipts; subsequent start/restart fail with ShuttingDown.
Runtime path plus spec and limits flow into OwnedProcess::spawn; evidence root pid/start and terminal flag flow back via poll/valid/root_alive; receipt flows from stop_inner.
Losses accumulate in Vec<ServiceLoss> via record_loss; core drains with take_losses before effects; report_loss adds external Exit/Eof style reasons with epoch check.
Entry lifecycle Stopped->Starting->Ready|Unavailable->Stopping->Stopped|Unavailable; confirm_ready is only Starting|Ready to Ready edge; loss_recorded latches one loss per generation.
available is true only when lifecycle Ready, no loss_recorded, not shutting down, and no queued loss for service; pid comes only from captured reaper evidence.
Failed initial spawn with no process removes Entry and strips its losses so retry of same service is not poisoned; busy-executable errno preserved.
Early exit yields SpawnFailed errno None or CleanupIncomplete if receipt incomplete; startup timeout yields DeadlineExceeded or CleanupIncomplete; lifecycle set Unavailable.
Returns cached complete receipt without re-reaping; else requests stop, waits graceful+reap+4*poll, finishes readers; incomplete sets Unavailable and retains process.
Stop waits bounded graceful+reap+4*poll interval, sleeps poll_interval; receipt reaped/surviving/failures bounded by max_descendants evidence cap.
Limits caller-supplied capped at 60s; runtime is pinned canonical interpreter path; Command uses exact path with -I -S -B -u -c reaper.
Depends on launch validation, process OwnedProcess spawn/poll/finish, types for ids/errors/receipts; tokio sleep/timeout for polling; no stdout/stdin service traffic.
Exec with open writer returns ETXTBSY errno 26; nonexec returns EACCES 13; both must leave entries empty for retry, verified by regression tests.
Owns reaper Child plus evidence threads: spawns bundled Python reaper with cleared env, captures root pid/start on stdout, counts diagnostics on stderr, enforces signal safety.
Builds Command(runtime, -I -S -B -u -c reaper.py + timeouts + cap + cwd + program + args), process_group 0, piped stdio, env_clear, writes length-prefixed NUL env on stdin pipe.
try_wait once; maps exit code 0|10 to terminal true else false; caches terminal; OwnershipLost on wait error.
Validates child pid as safe target then closes stdin control pipe to ask reaper to stop; no signal sent here.
Requires terminal true and readers finished, joins threads, checks invalid flag and root in reaped set; returns reaped+[child id] or CleanupIncomplete/DeadlineExceeded.
Converts i64 to i32, rejects <=1, own pid, own pgid, or unowned; returns pid or UnsafeTarget; shared by Rust and mirrored in reaper.py signalable.
Service env travels only on private stdin pipe as key=value NUL stream with decimal length line; runtime process itself gets env_clear so no service key leaks.
Stdout reader parses first line pid+start as root, later lines single pids into bounded reaped set; stderr reader counts retained/dropped bytes without storing bytes.
valid is !invalid latch; root_alive re-reads /proc pid stat start and live state; startup requires pid Some, valid, and root_alive together.
pid returns only captured root from evidence lock, not child.id; None until reaper prints valid root line.
Parses /proc/pid/stat after last ), field0 state !=Z|X means live, field2 pgid, field19 starttime; any read/parse failure maps to OwnershipLost.
Command.spawn error maps to SpawnFailed with raw_os_error; missing stdin/stdout/stderr maps to SpawnFailed errno None; invalid evidence line sets invalid but drains pipe.
Non-true terminal gives CleanupIncomplete; unfinished readers give DeadlineExceeded; join failure or missing root proof gives CleanupIncomplete with survivors retained.
User sees spawn failure or service never Ready, diagnostics counters only. Caused by bad runtime path, closed pipe, malformed reaper output, or reaper exit 20.
Two detached threads own stdout/stderr readers sharing Arc<Mutex<Evidence>>; main thread polls child; finish joins only when both finished.
Reaped set bounded by max_descendants, evicting non-root oldest; stderr chunk sized by stderr_chunk_bytes, totals capped by max_diagnostics_bytes with saturating dropped count.
Timeouts passed as float secs args to reaper.py, cap as int; chunk and diagnostics caps size reader buffers; 64-byte take(64) line reads on stdout.
Depends on reaper.py via include_str, /proc stat for identity, pidfd concept via reaper, Unix process_group; Drop only closes stdin, never signals stale pid.
Signal policy must reject pid 0/1/self/group and unowned; root proof retained after proc exit so finish can verify reaped root even when /proc gone.
Private per-service subreaper: sets PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER, launches service with private env pipe, prints root pid/start, discovers descendants, handles SIGTERM then SIGSTOP/SIGKILL, exits 0/10/20.
Unit tests for private signalling boundary with mocked os/signal; no host signal issued, covers pid validation, send errors, discovery permission, bounded reap.
Args graceful,budget,poll floats, cap int, cwd, program, plus service args; stdin starts with byte-length line then NUL-separated key=value env; control EOF triggers graceful shutdown.
Prunes exited pidfds, verifies retained identities, walks /proc/pid/task/*/children limited by cap, opens pidfd for each new child, raises Overflow/Permission on budget/unsafe.
Sends signal via pidfd_send_signal in reverse ownership order; ProcessLookupError tolerated, unsafe target raises PermissionError before backend call.
WNOHANG waitpid loop; closes pidfd, records root_status, prints each new pid up to cap else sets failed; returns True when no children left.
Env dict parsed from raw OS bytes via split NUL and =; passed as env to Popen with DEVNULL stdin/stdout and inherited stderr; stdout evidence lines flow to Rust reader.
States: discover loop while control open, SIGTERM grace period, SIGSTOP/SIGKILL budget period, exception drain; exit 0 clean, 10 unexpected root exit, 20 failure/overflow/timeout.
signalable requires exact int type, 1<pid<=2147483647, owned true, not self pid nor self pgrp; bool/float/str rejected by type check.
Reads /proc/pid/stat as bytes, splits after last ), returns ppid and starttime; tolerates non-UTF8 comm via binary split.
Thread children scan capped at cap entries, raw children string capped at cap*12+1, owned size capped at cap; overruns raise OverflowError thread_budget/descendant_budget.
prctl failure returns 20; bad env/int/open raises to OSError/ValueError/Overflow handler which SIGKILL drains then returns 20; observation failure never returns success.
Finally closes all owned pidfds; Drop-equivalent ensures no fd leak even on exception path.
Service output stops, supervisor reports SpawnFailed CleanupIncomplete or DeadlineExceeded. Caused by unsafe pid, descendant overflow, lost /proc identity, or grace/reap timeout expiry.
Freeze pattern before kill: discover, SIGSTOP, rediscover, SIGKILL to close racing-fork window; selector on stdin with poll timeout interleaves discover/reap.
Owned dict pid->(pidfd,start) and reaped set bounded independently of cumulative births; cap bounds memory and printed receipt history.
Graceful, reap budget, poll interval floats and cap int come from SupervisorLimits via Rust spawn args; cwd/program positional; no config files.
Linux-only: prctl 36, pidfd_open, pidfd_send_signal, /proc task/children, selectors/select poll; Python stdlib only, no interpreter env inheritance.
Owned pid 0 must raise before backend; exited pidfd tolerated but permission error propagates; mutant replacing 1<pid with 0<=pid must be rejected.
Service identity enum Daemon/Agent/Vision/Executor; ordered BTreeMap key for entries and losses.
Input struct: service, canonical program, args, cwd, env map, initial_epoch; validated by launch::validate before Entry creation.
Caller-supplied timeouts and storage bounds consumed by new/launch/stop_inner and passed to reaper.py.
Five states Stopped/Starting/Ready/Unavailable/Stopping; Ready means authenticated, Unavailable latches loss, Stopping transient in stop_inner.
Nine reasons Exit/Eof/WaitFailed/IoFailed/ProtocolRejected/StartTimeout/ExplicitRestart/Resume/Shutdown; recorded once per epoch via loss_recorded.
Thirteen errors; SpawnFailed carries Option errno (Some for exec failure, None for pipe/evidence); DeadlineExceeded vs CleanupIncomplete distinguishes timeout from incomplete receipt.
Snapshot service, lifecycle, available bool, service_epoch, pid Option; available true only if Ready and undisputed.
Loss binds service plus service_epoch plus reason; take_losses drains vector for core to consume before effects.
Proof of cleanup: service+epoch, reaped pids including root+child, surviving pids, failures list, complete flag true only if failures empty.
Copyable byte counters retained_bytes/dropped_bytes; counts stderr without retaining sensitive bytes.
Clone/Debug only; epoch u64 with checked_add overflow to EpochOverflow; args OsString allows arbitrary OS bytes except NUL rejected at validation.
User sees typed errors StaleEpoch on epoch mismatch, AlreadyRunning on duplicate start, ShuttingDown after reap_all, UnsafeTarget/OwnershipLost on signal/identity failure.
Durations startup/graceful/reap/poll plus stderr_chunk_bytes, max_diagnostics_bytes, max_descendants; all bounded by validate_limits.
No dependencies beyond std BTreeMap/PathBuf/Duration/OsString; shared by supervisor, process, and regression tests.
Confusing SpawnFailed None vs Some: None means pipe/evidence fault without OS errno, not exec denial; callers must not retry None as EACCES.
Publishes owner-only Unix socket: verifies 0700 runtime dir, probes stale socket, stages 0600 socket in fresh 0700 stage, atomically renames or hard-links to final path.
Bounded newline-delimited envelope reader with read deadline, oversize/incomplete/utf8 checks, delegated to read_frame_with_limits.
Takes final path, expected uid, probe_deadline; creates parent 0700, locks dir inode nonblocking, validates inodes/modes before and after each step.
Byte-at-a-time read until newline or max_frame_bytes; empty EOF returns None, partial EOF Incomplete, over-cap Oversized, bad JSON mapped to Decode.
Serializes envelope via BoundedBuffer cap, revalidates by decoding, appends newline, writes under write_deadline; serde io error maps to Oversized.
Verifies peer cred uid, enforces HANDSHAKE_DEADLINE from accepted_at instant, reads one frame, pins sender/recipient/session, version, component, full hello equality.
Builds candidate registration envelope and round-trips through decode to validate policy; checks sender component equals hello component or IdentityMismatch.
Every post-handshake envelope must match endpoint/recipient/session and not be Hello; else IdentityMismatch or AlreadyReady; uid exposed via uid().
Staging lifecycle: create 0700 stage -> bind s -> chmod 0600 -> verify inode/mode -> rename (stale) or hard_link (absent) -> final verify; Drop removes s and dir.
Every path component must not be ParentDir and not a symlink; final dir must be dir owned by uid with mode exactly 0700, else UnsafeRuntimeDir/MissingRuntimeDir.
Identity is dev+ino+uid triple; checked for directory vs lock, old vs now stale socket, stage vs prepared, final vs prepared to detect replacement.
peer_cred must succeed else Unavailable; uid must equal expected else ForeignUid; handshake maps to HandshakeError::Peer.

Zero deadline or missing filename gives ProbeInconclusive; non-socket/wrong uid gives NotSocket; live connect gives LiveSocket; refused proceeds; inconclusive probe or changed inode gives IdentityChanged.
Future accepted_at or past deadline gives MissingPolicy/Timeout; non-hello gives ExpectedHello; UnknownVersion gives VersionMismatch; field mismatch gives Identity/PinMismatch.
User sees connection refused/timeout or dropped message. FrameError Io/Timeout/Oversized/Incomplete/InvalidUtf8/Decode/Encode names the stage; handshake failures show Version/Pin/IdentityMismatch.
Nonblocking flock on open dir fd held through probe and publish; WouldBlock maps to IdentityChanged; never blocks Tokio thread; cooperating publishers serialize, arbitrary writers excluded.
Write fails FileTooLarge when len+new>=cap; NEXT_STAGE atomic u64 gives unique .mv-pid-n stage names; SocketStage Drop cleans unclaimed stages.
Expected uid, sender/recipient endpoints, session_id, hello pin from trusted registration; limits supply read/write deadlines and max_frame_bytes.
Depends on Unix DirBuilderExt mode, PermissionsExt, symlink_metadata, UnixListener/Stream, tokio timeouts; no umask mutation; hard_link for atomic no-replace publish.
Collision or preexisting non-0700 stage is refusal not repair; test asserts 0755 dir fails CreationModeUnavailable and mode untouched.
Recomputes terminal ActionReceipt from frame-bound evidence; ignores incoming verified/method/detail; admission epoch/lease/ownership remain preconditions.
Ownership tests for frame file gating: shared modes rejected, 0600 accepted, foreign uid rejected, byte-length mismatch rejected, via /dev/shm fixtures.
Reads immutable RAM file: checks effective uid, canonical path under /dev/shm equal to input, 00 group/other bits, exact byte_len, open-identity match, hash match.
Takes proposal, before/after observations, receipt, Evidence; computes method/predicate per Case0-3 plus shared bindings; sets verified and detail message.
Evidence carries before/after RGB slices, before/after state JSON, semantic_frame_sha256, previous_state_sha256, element witnesses, OCR texts; all from capture owner not executor bit.
Requires width/height/generation nonzero, width*height*3 no overflow and <=256MiB MAX_RGB_BYTES; else None which fails callers closed.
SHA256 hex of bytes must equal frame.sha256; valid_rgb also requires exact length match and nonempty.
State bytes must be nonempty <=1MiB, parse as JSON object, canonical_bytes equal input bytes, digest equals expected state_sha256.
Case0 needs same dimensions, nonzero bbox inside frame, both RGB present; scans bbox rows for any differing RGB triplet; capped lengths make indexing safe.
Any gate failure returns InvalidData: bad length, non-/dev/shm or symlink, mode with group/other bits, uid mismatch, size change, double-open dev/ino drift, hash mismatch.
Unmatched witness yields verified false with detail missing, invalid or unmatched witness; bindings require proposal/frame/surface/generation/time/budget/error all match.

User sees action marked unverified with missing, invalid or unmatched witness though executor claimed success. Caused by absent pixel change, wrong element state, tick/state hash mismatch, or stale frame binding.
Caller must hold generation lease through verification; double metadata checks (before open, after open, after read) close replacement races; no locks taken.
Allocation bounded before untrusted read: byte_len caps Vec at length+1 via take; MAX_STATE_BYTES 1MiB caps canonical_state parsing.
MAX_RGB_BYTES 256MiB and MAX_STATE_BYTES 1048576 are hard-coded; no caller limits; frame_ref width/height/generation drive allocation gate.
Tests create /dev/shm/mv-ownership files 0600 then chmod; foreign test bind-mounts root-owned fixture via unshare user+mount namespace; never reads foreign bytes.
Group/other bits 640/604/666/620/602 must fail closed; foreign uid must give InvalidData not PermissionDenied except pre-check; serve shm reader enforces same triple gate.
Pure closed decoding and checked logical clocks for the wire. Owns Envelope, Clock, limits, lexical preflight and schema validation before any typed use.
decode_envelope(raw) decodes with default limits; decode_envelope_with_limits(raw, limits) is the checked entry used by transports.
Control: raw str -> size check -> preflight -> serde_json Value -> integer rails -> version probe -> typed Envelope -> schema valid + terminal_lengths. No I/O inside.
Envelope requires schema exactly envelope/v0.2, deny_unknown_fields on Envelope and Endpoint, body is closed Command union. Mismatch returns UnknownVersion or InvalidField.
All wire integers stay in JSON safe-integer rails +/-9007199254740991 until contract upper rails publish; narrower schema bounds still authoritative.
Clock(u64) has one transition checked_next: v -> v+1, terminal on u64::MAX returning NumericError::Overflow. new/get are pure constructors/accessors.
WireLimits::default sets max_frame_bytes 1048576, max_depth 32, max_keys 256, max_string_bytes 65536, read/write deadlines 30s. Constants add handshake 5s, send queue 256.
WireLimits::new rejects zero limits or zero deadlines with MissingOrZero, and out-of-range frame/depth/keys/string with Inconsistent. Upper caps mirror defaults.
If raw.len()+1 exceeds max_frame_bytes, return Oversized before parsing. Receiver drops the frame; caller sees DecodeError::Oversized.

preflight rejects nesting beyond max_depth, duplicate object keys, key count over max_keys, string bytes over limit, array commas over 4096, bad escapes as DepthExceeded/DuplicateField/KeyLimitExceeded/StringLimitExceeded/ArrayLimitExceeded/Malformed.
Non-finite or out-of-rails numbers fail check_integer_rails with OutOfBounds, including f64 beyond rails. Prevents rounding across schema bounds.
Envelope schema not envelope/v0.2, unknown body version, or hello contract_version not v0.2 returns UnknownVersion before typed deserialization.
Typed serde failure returns Malformed; schema valid() or terminal_lengths failure returns InvalidField. valid covers $ref, const, enum, oneOf, types, bounds, patterns.
User sees action or message silently rejected or never applied; logs show Oversized, Malformed, UnknownVersion, OutOfBounds or InvalidField from decode. No partial Envelope is returned.
terminal_session data/write must carry params.b64 whose decoded length equals params.byte_count; otherwise terminal_lengths fails and decode returns InvalidField.
Refusal codes are fixed SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE strings STALE_FRAME, SURFACE_NOT_AGENT_CONTROLLED, LOCKED_BY_OTHER, BUDGET_EXCEEDED, OUT_OF_BOUNDS, POLICY via code() and Display.
ramws_path_ok requires /dev/shm/ prefix, 1-8 segments, each 1-128 chars starting alnum or _, charset alnum ._- , total path <=255 bytes.
pattern_ok implements only known patterns: ramws path, token, hex 40/64, base64 multiple-of-4 with <=2 padding, /-paths without NUL/CR/LF. Unknown pattern returns false.
Optional<T> distinguishes Missing from Present including explicit null handling: Deserialize always tries T so explicit null for non-nullable T fails; Missing serializes as none and is skipped.
No locks, threads, or shared mutable state; preflight, valid, decode and Clock ops are pure reentrant functions on caller-owned data.
Bounded stack Vec for preflight depth, BTreeSet per object for duplicate keys; limits cap depth 32, keys 256, strings 64KiB, frame ~1MiB, queue 256, deadlines 5s/30s.
Depends on serde/serde_json for parsing and on schemas module for embedded envelope and family schemas; payload module supplies closed Command type.
Lexical preflight must precede untagged Command buffering or a crafted duplicate-key or huge payload could buffer before rejection. Do not reorder.
valid() evaluates $ref target plus sibling keywords (const/enum/oneOf/bounds); a naive $ref-only validator would accept wrong const or generation/sha mismatches per unit test.
Closed wire payload types matching versioned v0.2 contracts. Defines every body schema carried by Envelope.body as strict serde structs and untagged unions.
Command untagged union of 19 bodies (ActionProposal through UiIntent) is the deserialization entry; serde tries each variant in order after envelope pre-validation.
Envelope.body JSON -> Command untagged dispatch -> one concrete struct (e.g. MvToolCall, SurfaceRequest, TerminalSession). deny_unknown_fields rejects extras at leaf.
Every payload carries a schema const tag like action_proposal/v0.2, hello/v0.2, surface/v0.2; wrong tag fails closed decode. Structs use deny_unknown_fields throughout.

ActionVerdict is refused with reason_code+core_seq or admitted with core_seq. MvToolResult propose mirrors admitted vs refused+detail; wait_verify goes pending+retry_after_ms, verified, timeout, or error.

Surface state is active/standby/ceded/destroyed/lost, visibility folded/unfolded/pinned, control agent/human/shared. Events created/state_changed/frame_ready/input_applied/error carry surface or frame_ref.
TerminalSession ops spawn/started/resize/data/write/ack/resync/attach/close/exit/error form request lifecycle; error codes include UNKNOWN_PROVIDER, STALE_GENERATION, BACKPRESSURE, POLICY.
RecordEvent lifecycle started(mode ram/disk/screenshot) -> frame_captured/exported/stopped(frame/byte counts) with dropped(ram_ring_oldest) and refused branches.

ActionProposal binds proposal_id+surface_id+based_on_frame(sha256+generation)+action+expectation+budget; action cases click/key/type/scroll/wait/lane_submit, expectations changed_region/element_state/state_sha256_change/text_present.
NativeInputEvidence optionals keep absent focus proof distinct from false: native_surface_id/kind/focus_verified/result are Optional and never verify success when missing.
FrameRef and observe frames require rgb24 format, surface_id, generation, tick, ts_ns, dims, ramws_path, sha256, capture_us. Observation vision/ground_truth are Optional.
MvToolCall ops observe/list/propose/wait_verify each have fixed args shapes; list cursor is string-or-null untagged and limit; wait_verify carries proposal_id+timeout_ms.
SurfaceRequest input params carry surface_id+proposal_id+optional origin agent/human+action; take/release_control change SurfaceControl ownership; record_start/stop carry recording_id.
Hello requires contract_version v0.2 plus component core/ui/daemon/agent/vision/wender, versions, commits, dependency name/version/commit list.

Settings theme is metaviewer-light/dark, providers list, recording_destination object-or-null, limits memory/max_fps/ring_bytes. SessionRecord kinds received/admitted/refused/executed/verified/surface_changed chain by core_seq+prev_sha256.
UiIntent fold/unfold/hide/show/pin/move/tab/float/layout_save/layout_load plus take/release_control; slot ops keyed by slot_id, move/tab by group_id+index.
Unknown field, wrong schema tag, or mistyped untagged variant fails serde decode; caller in mod.rs maps it to Malformed or InvalidField and no Command is produced.

User sees click/key/type ignored, observe returns error, verify stays pending or times out, recording stops with empty file; wires carry refused/error with STALE_FRAME, POLICY, VERIFICATION_FAILED or similar.
Refusal/reason codes must be one of STALE_FRAME, SURFACE_NOT_AGENT_CONTROLLED, LOCKED_BY_OTHER, BUDGET_EXCEEDED, OUT_OF_BOUNDS, POLICY across verdicts, tool results and record events.

Verified receipt requires verified true, empty error string, pixel/element/state_sha256 verification detail, after_frame and focus/input/frame linkage; error variant uses PROTOCOL/UNAVAILABLE/NOT_FOUND/VERIFICATION_FAILED.
Depends only on serde and serde_json::Number plus parent Optional for missing-vs-null fields; no validation logic here, validation lives in mod.rs valid().
confidence uses serde_json::Number (float allowed) while wire rails still apply; absent Optional vision/ground_truth/native_evidence must not be treated as false or zero.
Embedded contract references for scalar and union validation. Serves compiled-in v0.2 JSON schemas to the wire validator without runtime file reads.
schema(name) takes an exact file name like envelope.schema.json and returns the parsed Value, or None when unknown or unparseable.
Match name -> include_str! of contracts/v0.2/<name> at compile time -> serde_json::from_str -> optional mv_tool_result tag projection -> Some(schema).

Known names cover 20 contracts: action_proposal, action_receipt, action_verdict, capsule_meta, catalog_entry, envelope, frame_ref, hello, mv_tool_call, mv_tool_result, observation, record_event, record_request, session_record, settings, surface, surface_event, surface_request, terminal_session, ui_intent.
mv_tool_result embedded definitions with legacy /v0.1 schema const tags are projected to /v0.2; every field, bound and closed-object constraint is otherwise preserved verbatim.
Unknown name hits the catch-all arm and returns None. Callers treat missing schema as InvalidField and reject the message.
If embedded JSON fails to parse, from_str ok()? yields None and the message is rejected as InvalidField rather than panicking.
If mv_tool_result $defs is absent or not an object, get_mut chain returns None via ? and schema() returns None, failing validation closed.
User sees valid-looking messages rejected with InvalidField or UnknownVersion when the contract file is missing, corrupted, or the version projection did not apply.
Only the schema const string is rewritten and only on suffix /v0.1; no other keyword, bound, pattern or required set is altered by the projection.
Compile-time dependency on contracts/v0.2/*.schema.json via include_str! and on serde_json for parsing; sole consumer is wire validation in mod.rs valid().
Schemas are baked into the binary and parsed per call; no cache, no I/O, no locks. Cost is a parse per validation call.
Pure function with no shared state; safe to call concurrently from any decoder thread.
Silent None on every failure mode (unknown name, bad JSON, missing $defs) collapses distinct causes; debug by checking the exact file name and embedded contract text.
Projection only handles tags ending /v0.1 under $defs properties/schema/const; any legacy tag elsewhere keeps the old version and will fail downstream version checks.

main.go is the daemon adapter process entrypoint. It builds a SIGINT/SIGTERM context, loads runtime via daemon.RuntimeFromEnv, runs daemon.Run with CLI args and stderr, and exits with code 2 on env error.
capsule.go models Holdings ground_truth witness and strictly parses native Holdings observe JSON plus generic request/error envelope and Backend seam for manager use.
Control enters via main with signal.NotifyContext for SIGINT/SIGTERM, os.Args[1:] as CLI args, os.Stderr for errors, and context cancellation driving daemon.Run shutdown.
main flows: RuntimeFromEnv error prints to stderr with exit 2; else code comes from daemon.Run(ctx, args, stderr, runtime), then stop() and os.Exit(code). No other output path.

ParseHoldingsObserve takes raw CLI bytes, enforces single-line bounded JSON object, runs ipc.ValidateJSON, decodes with DisallowUnknownFields, validates sha/tick/revision/frame/elements/state, returns GroundTruth.
GroundTruth fields: Source must equal holdings_lane, StateSHA256 64 hex chars, Tick 0..9007199254740991, State is in-memory only with json tag -. Matches contracts v0.2 observation.ground_truth.
ValidateGroundTruth rejects nil, wrong Source, bad digest, Tick above MaxHoldingsTick; if State non-empty it must be at most 1048576 bytes and pass validateHoldingsStateJSON.
parseHoldingsUint53 accepts only canonical unsigned tokens: non-empty, no leading zero, all digits, ParseUint 64-bit and value at most MaxHoldingsTick. Anything else is invalid integer token.
validateHoldingsStateJSON requires non-empty UTF8 at most MaxHoldingsStateBytes, trimmed form starts with open brace, parseValue succeeds, and no trailing bytes remain after skipWS.
stateJSONValidator parses value by leading byte: object, array, string, true/false/null, integer. Depth above 64 fails. skipWS skips space tab LF CR only.

parseObject fails on missing key quote, bad string, duplicate key, missing colon, nested value error, unterminated object, or missing comma/brace. parseArray fails on element error or missing comma/bracket.

parseString fails on unescaped control below 0x20, unterminated quote, or invalid escape JSON; parseInteger rejects leading zeros, floats with dot/e/E, negatives below range, and values above MaxHoldingsTick.
extractHoldingsObserveState errors ambiguous when both state and observation present; wrapper must be object with decodable state; empty means absent; over 1 MiB or invalid state JSON fails.

ParseHoldingsObserve returns malformed_cli fault when input empty/oversize/non-UTF8, multiline, not starting with brace, ipc.ValidateJSON fails, unknown fields or trailing data exist, or sha/tick/revision/frame/elements/state invalid.

User sees Holdings observation rejected: input produces no GroundTruth, downstream proof omitted, caller gets malformed_cli with detail like invalid holdings tick or CLI output is not a bounded closed JSON object.
Operator sees startup error text on stderr and process exit 2 when RuntimeFromEnv fails; otherwise exit code comes from daemon.Run and signal handling just cancels context.
NewErrorEvent requires surfaceID 1..128 chars, non-nil fault with Code 1..128 and Detail 1..65536; emits Schema surface_event/v0.1, Event error, Data with surface_id/code/detail.
capsule.go depends on cli.Fault via fault helper, ipc.ValidateJSON with maxHoldingsObserveDepth budget, encoding/json strict decoding, digest hex check, and utf8 validation. No native spawn here.
Limits: MaxHoldingsTick 9007199254740991, MaxHoldingsStateBytes 1048576, state depth 64, observe depth 67 (64+2+1). ParseHoldingsObserve default maxBytes is state cap plus 64 KiB.

Struct decoding would drop duplicate keys, so ParseHoldingsObserve pre-validates whole line with ipc.ValidateJSON and uses DisallowUnknownFields plus dec.More and second Decode expecting EOF to catch repeats and trailing JSON.
egress_policy.go maps stored egress to native start network mode, publishes proxy policy for allowlisted capsules, and wraps the runner to inject proxy args and translate open-mode setup failures.
egress_started.go freezes adapter-local start evidence with actual argv mode and exact record bytes before native start. No wire fields are added; evidence is local digest and timestamps.
Egress schema must be metaviewer.capsule_egress/v1; Mode open requires zero domains, allowlisted requires 1..256 domains. Domains must be unique normalized exact ASCII hostnames.
exactHostname requires dot, length at most 253, lowercase, not IP, no localhost/local/internal/lan/home.arpa suffix, valid labels, and at least one letter to reject numeric address forms.

writePrivateEgressFile marshals value, checks 64 KiB, opens egress dir, refuses existing special/permissive files, writes random temp file O_EXCL/NOFOLLOW then Renameat and dir Sync for atomic publish.

browserNetwork loads egress, intersects with cfg.NetModes, maps allowlisted to proxied and open to open/legacy, checks proxy binary, publishes policy or verifies record, returns egress/mode/policy for start args.
Network modes: empty/legacy passes args unchanged, open appends --net open, proxied appends --net proxied --policy file. Unknown mode or proxied without policy is NET_EGRESS_INVALID.

WriteEgressPolicy only for allowlisted egress with valid profile identity and container match; writes identity.policy.json with browserid.proxy-policy/v1 approved map then re-reads egress and fails with NET_EGRESS_CHANGED on drift.

browserNetwork on injected runner uses MV_SRF_STATE_DIR only; allowlisted there gives NET_PROXIED_UNSUPPORTED. Native path validates state dir, missing proxied capability gives NET_PROXIED_UNSUPPORTED.

browserNetworkRunner.Run appends --proxy-bin for proxied start; missing proxy pre-spawn gives refusal. Open-mode native setup fault maps to NET_OPEN_PREREQ demanding image rebuild plus firewall witness.

User sees browser capsule start refused with allowlisted egress requires native runner, proxied capability missing, policy changed during preparation, or open prereq asking for operator-approved rebuild.
User sees egress file rejected as invalid schema/mode/count or domains must be unique normalized exact hostnames when hostname has uppercase, IP form, bad suffix, or duplicate entry.

verifyEgressRecord re-reads after publication and compares schema/mode/ordered domains; create path also snapshots digest before network prep and aborts if digest changes. Never starts with stale policy.
Egress file cap 65536 bytes; read uses LimitReader cap+1 and rejects EFBIG/EACCES on oversize, wrong owner, wrong mode 0600, or non-regular. Dir walk holds fds, uses O_NOFOLLOW, checks uid and 0700.
proxyExecutable requires absolute path under MV_SRF_BIN_DIR named srf-egress-proxy that is regular and executable; else NET_EGRESS_INVALID. Path uses captured root, never request data.

egressRecordDigest returns absent when egress dir or identity file missing, else hex sha256 of exact record bytes. egressState returns native runner stateDir or MV_SRF_STATE_DIR env for injected runners.

Symlink and permission attacks are refused: egressDirectory never follows symlinks, checks last two dirs for uid/0700; reads require owner/mode/size; writes refuse links and permissive files instead of replacing.
handoff.go owns session-local single-use input permits and human/agent control takeover. Takeover cancels in-flight input; release needs drained input and fresh capture. ControlReady is local seam.
human_binding.go exports host-only v0.3 binding witness with no profile payload or lease token. Real runner writes ready/epoch/geometry file; renderer names never select container or socket.
identity_profiles.go admits browser identity and host-exec program profiles from trusted startup template and finite display pool, guarding protected ids and static entries.
control handles take_control/release_control with surface_id plus owner. take_control needs human owner and agent control; release needs human control and no pending input. Emits state_changed event.
Control states agent/human per binding. take_control flips agent to human, bumps epoch, cancels pending. release flips human to agent, bumps epoch, sets refresh true. Human role capsules immutable.

control fails with surface when binding missing/inactive, POLICY when draining, human role immutable, wrong ownership, or release with pending input. release_control params parsed separately from take_control.
DrainInput fails with POLICY unless proposal exists for that surface and is both cancelled and done; success deletes pending entry. ControlReady fails with surface unless active binding exists.
nextInputEpoch increments per-surface counter; beginCapture snapshots current epoch; hasPending scans pending map for surface. Epochs gate capture versus input ordering.

PublishHumanBinding skips non-browser NativeKind and invalid surface/container ids, requires validated stateDir and 0700 human-bindings dir, writes temp file then rename to surfaceID.json with schema metaviewer.human_binding/v0.3.
Operator sees takeover blocked: human takeover requires agent ownership, or takeover input must be drained before release. Human input during agent control is refused until release and fresh capture.
configureIdentityTemplate selects browser 1280x900 non-protected profiles sorted, clones first as template, collects displays sharing its RAMRoot as finite pool. Empty selection leaves template nil.

ProfileFor never bypasses static map: static non-dynamic ids return not-found. profileFor falls back to template only for valid non-protected stored ids. programProfileFor additionally forces desktop_capsule/host-exec/agent/depth 0.
admitProgramProfile refuses static ids, bad/protected ids, and exhausted display pool with stop a capsule first. admitIdentityProfile also requires IdentityExists success for dynamic ids.

Static create with dynamic allocation colliding on same RAMRoot/display fails with configured display is in use. displayOccupied counts quarantined and non-destroyed bindings as occupying the display.

Display pool bounded by template RAMRoot matches; permits bounded elsewhere to 100000 attempts. releaseIdleIdentityProfile deletes dynamic profile only when no non-destroyed binding and not quarantined.
IdentityExists runs srf-identity-admin show --id and requires returned profile_id to equal requested id; mismatch or runner error maps to identity/profile fault. Never opens browser profile files.
Control and binding maps are guarded by manager mu; ControlReady and DrainInput lock mu. Takeover cancellation calls pending cancel funcs while holding mu; completion must fail against lost binding.
Dynamic profile reuse must not collide: runnerSearchPath exposes PATH for host binary resolution; humanSurfaceID pattern 1..128 chars guards binding file names against traversal.

liveness.go owns background native-absence detection without native liveness reply: periodically runs bounded frame verb per active capsule, counts only typed unavailable/refused replies as misses, and emits one state_changed lost event after consecutive misses.

login_lock.go owns fail-closed operator-login guard: refuseLoginInput blocks agent input while an operator login view is opening or teardown is uncertain, using local loginLocks plus state-dir view registration files, without inspecting credentials.

MonitorLiveness(ctx, emit) is the public entry: validates LivenessInterval and non-nil emit, starts time.Ticker at LivenessInterval, defers Stop, then delegates to monitorLiveness with ticker channel; caller session owns cancellation and transport ordering.

monitorLiveness(ctx, ticks, emit) is the testable loop: tick channel is fake-clock seam in tests while production passes owned ticker channel; closed channel returns nil, ctx Done returns ctx.Err, each tick snapshots active bindings then probes serially one capsule at a time.
IsAbsenceFault(err) is the classifier entry: unwraps cli.Fault and returns true only for Code unavailable or refused; all other faults and non-Fault errors return false and reset the miss sequence.

refuseLoginInput(container) is called on agent-origin input path: returns LOGIN_ACTIVE fault if loginLocks[container] is set, else if runner exposes LoginActive(string) and it errors or reports true, returns LOGIN_ACTIVE; otherwise permits input.

Probe data flow per active binding: under mu snapshot Container, RunID, recoveryProbe, profile and frame args (frame --container <c> [--window <w>]); unlock; clock before; execute with LivenessTimeout ctx; clock after; relock and revalidate identity before counting miss or clearing recoveryProbe.

Loss data flow: on misses[id] >= LivenessMisses call markLostLocked(id,true,true) under mu to build v0.2 state_changed event, delete misses entry, unlock, then emit(ctx,ev) outside mu and call CompleteLost(id, delivered); failed emit returns error and ends monitor session.

Per-capsule miss counter misses[id]: absence with clean probe and session contexts increments; any non-absence, deadline, malformed, setup/usage, binding change, or destroyed/terminal state deletes entry; threshold crossing emits lost once and clears counter.
