Delivery rollback uses recoveryProbe token: CompleteLost(false) flips lost back to active with fresh recoveryProbe; only a later successful bound frame whose token matches pre-probe snapshot clears it; stale probes from before rollback are ignored by token mismatch.

Only proven absence counts: deadlines (probeCtx.Err != nil), session cancellation, cli_failed, malformed_cli, and setup/usage faults never increment misses and break consecutive sequence; unknown output never proves loss.

Positive frame evidence contract for recovery: Seq>0, Generation==Container, size within surface geometry, hex64 SHA256RGB24, path under FramesRoot, CaptureMonoNS within [OriginNS,before,after], window identity/geometry match; else recoveryProbe stays set.

Monitor contract: LivenessInterval>0 and emit!=nil else configuration fault; terminal or destroying bindings are never probed; one serial probe per active capsule per tick with no overlapping sweeps or catch-up loop.

If probe returns unavailable/refused with clean contexts, misses++ and after threshold markLostLocked produces lost event for emit; if probe returns deadline/malformed/setup fault, misses deleted and no event is produced.

If emit returns error, MonitorLiveness returns that error and session ends without retry, avoiding duplicate lost announcements; if ctx is cancelled during probe loop, pending probe result is discarded and ctx.Err is returned.

If in-memory login lock is set, Lstat fails unexpectedly, or state-dir validation fails, agent input fails with LOGIN_ACTIVE or configuration fault; uncertain teardown stays closed and only verified view-stop clears the lock.
User sees agent clicks/keys rejected with LOGIN_ACTIVE operator login blocks agent input while operator login view is opening; human input path is unaffected by this check.

Mu is held only to snapshot active list and to reconcile after probe; native execute, clock reads, and emit run outside mu so manager operations are not blocked across LivenessTimeout; per-tick probes are serial, never parallel sweeps.

Resources: one time.Ticker for session lifetime, one child probe ctx with LivenessTimeout per capsule per tick, capped native output via execute; probe group is killed on timeout; ticker stopped on return.

Defaults and bounds from NewManager: interval 5s, misses 2, timeout min(Timeout,2s); interval 1ms-1h, misses 1-100, timeout within (0,Timeout]; explicit MV_LIVENESS_INTERVAL/MISSES override with same validation.

Depends on Manager.execute native frame verb, cli.Fault codes, cli.ParseLine frame decode, digest hex64 match, under() frames-root check, Manager.clock monotonic source, markLostLocked/CompleteLost delivery tracking.

Depends on identityContainer pattern, ProcessRunner.validateStateDir 0700 current-uid check, os.Lstat on state-dir/views files, and Manager.loginLocks map; no dependency on renderer, profile files, or lease tokens.
manager.go binds public kinds to native programs, geometry, display and RAM allocation, and owns create/input/capture/destroy/view plus loss tracking with quarantine on uncertain native effects.
Handle validates schema surface_request/v0.1/v0.2 then dispatches create/list/destroy/input/take_control/release_control/view/login/view-stop/frame/record; unknown op or schema gives fault.
NewManager requires runner/clock, OriginNS nonzero, absolute BinDir, MaxSurfaces>=1, MaxOutputBytes 1..1048576, Timeout 0..3min, valid profiles, NetModes subset, bounded liveness values.
Profile geometry 1..8192, display :N pattern, RAMRoot under /dev/shm, NestedDepth 0..1; browser needs browser/empty program, desktop needs admitted program, vm/holdings need mappings.

Surface states active/lost/destroyed. Destroy moves active to lost then destroyed after verified stopNative. MarkLost needs confirmed absence; CompleteLost false rolls back to active with fresh recoveryProbe token.

Quarantine set before native start, cleared only on pre-spawn refusal, verified cleanup, or success. Capacity counts live bindings plus quarantined; lost bindings still consume reservation until verified destroy.

create refuses protected ids, bound profile with PROFILE_ALREADY_BOUND, capacity/quarantine with uncertain, host-exec without dynamic/binary, geometry/kind mismatch, display pool exhausted, identity_unavailable on exit 4.

Holdings create expects single-element array with slot 1, holdings container pattern, runID, display/size match, ReadyLine/ReadyMS, frames under RAMRoot. Identity create expects single w1 window within profile size.
Failed create with syntactically valid cleanup identity attempts stopNative; collisions on run/frames/container invalidate cleanup. Uncertain fault retains quarantine when no native proof exists.

stopNative needs mu, parses stopped==container and removed_verified; identity needs explicit true, holdings needs verifier hook. ConfirmedAbsent unavailable plus holdings verifier can settle; else uncertain retains slot.
input parses proposal/origin/action, enforces active binding, role/control checks, login lock for agent, fresh frame and unused permit. Click/key/type/scroll each have strict arg validation.
Text limits NativeTextMaxRunes 2000 per native call and AdapterTextMaxRunes 16384 per proposal; long text splits into serial verified chunks with one permit, sequence evidence hashed per chunk.

Agent Holdings input does pre-observe, native input, VerifyHoldingsInput, post-observe; GroundTruth attached only when both parses succeed and state presence matches. Human Holdings never calls observe.

Input fails on draining, human role, login active, wrong control with SURFACE_NOT_AGENT/HUMAN_CONTROLLED, stale permit, invalid click/key/text/scroll, refused receipt, unverified mono timestamps or focus proof.

Native receipt needs InputMonoNS within OriginNS..2^53-1 and before/after clocks; windowed surfaces also need surface/window/kind match, focus_verified true, result ok. Holdings receipts must be timestamp-only.

Capture needs active binding, no recoveryProbe, no pending, epoch snapshot; runs frame verb, revalidates epoch/binding, checks path under FramesRoot, seq/generation/size/sha/time/window, updates geometry for windowed.
Capture fails on inactive/recovery/destroying, pending input or epoch change, native error, malformed frame, allocation mismatch, or timestamp outside OriginNS..before..after window.

view resolves by surface_id or container for active bindings, rejects holdings and duplicate views, handles login lock and view-stop; destroy drains BeforeDestroy, stops view, requires verified stopNative.

WireCode passes through A-Z shape, maps binding/profile-bound, uncertain/capacity, identity_unavailable, host_program_unavailable to stable codes, else ADAPTER_<CODE> or ADAPTER_ERROR. Always matches wire pattern.
User sees profile already bound, surface capacity or unresolved outcome, identity exclusively held by live capsule or abandoned lease, or text exceeds adapter limit when input too long.
User sees capture/input refused with input must be drained before capture/destroy, fresh frame and unused permit required, or unverified receipt/frame identity time mismatch after native clock skew.
All handlers hold mu except native execute/view/verify calls which unlock; pending input uses cancellable context keyed by proposal, takeover cancels; used permits capped at 100000.
Human wheel lowering uses WheelStepPx 50 per step, at least one, at most ScrollMaxSteps 20, dominant axis only, centre when x/y absent. Human text uses paste only for non-0x20-0x7E runes.
HandleFor needs caller correlation 1..128 chars, maps non-Fault to native_failed, emits surface_event error via NewErrorEvent with version-adjusted schema. SubscriptionBinding needs active surface.
Shared RAM roots need unique runIDs and disjoint frame dirs including native Holdings paths; under() rejects dot, absolute, or escaping rel. Colliding allocation grants no cleanup authority.
ConsumeOpeningMode/Profile fallback: valid mode file returns mode, missing returns fallback, hostBinary present refuses. ConsumeOpeningProgram needs agent mode plus non-empty binary.

Opening file must live under stateDir/opening-modes/<profile>.json with dir 0700, file 0600 owned by uid, size at most 1024, schema metaviewer.opening_mode/v0.3, matching profile and human/agent mode.
consumeOpeningRequest fails on bad profile, bad stateDir, bad dir owner/mode, open/stat errors, oversize or non-regular file, ParseLine error, schema/profile/mode mismatch, or remove failure.
ResolveHostBinary trims, caps 256 chars, rejects control/non-ASCII and shell chars; absolute must be clean regular executable; bare name resolved via absolute clean PATH dirs only.
ResolveHostBinary fails on empty, relative slash path, dot names, unclean absolute, missing/non-executable target, or PATH miss, always as host_program_unavailable with trimmed name in detail.
Operator sees opening mode refused or host_program_unavailable: <name> with reason invalid name, path must be clean, relative refused, or not found in PATH when host binary request is bad.
NewProcessRunner needs absolute binDir, maxOutput 1..1048576, timeout 0..3min, allowed env keys only, single PATH required, captures MV_SRF_STATE_DIR separately from child env.
validateStateDir requires absolute clean path, existing dir owned by current uid with exactly 0700, no symlinks/special bits; creates only final egress dir elsewhere, never parents.

Run admits only srf-identity-surface/srf-holdings-capsule under root plus admin show with valid id; identity surface appends owned --state-dir and rejects caller --state-dir flags; runs with timeout, group kill, capped buffers.

Unadmitted executable, caller state-dir flag, or pre-start state validation returns preSpawnRefusal. Start errors map to uncertain or pre-spawn; exit 2 with host_program_unavailable marker maps to typed refusal.
Nonzero exit otherwise maps via cli.ExitFault with first printable stderr line up to 256 chars appended. Deadline/cancel maps to uncertain native command deadline or cancellation.

User sees native operation has no verified result or exit-code fault with stderr reason suffix when binary crashes; pre-spawn config faults clear quarantine while post-spawn uncertain faults retain it.
Each Run owns fresh process group via Setpgid and Cancel kills negative PID with SIGKILL; WaitDelay 1s reaps helpers. Never accepts caller PID; CommandContext Kill alone would leak helpers.

Stdout capped at limit, stderr at min(limit,4096); cappedBuffer.Write rejects overflow. NewRuntime reads MV_SRF_BIN_DIR plus optional liveness knobs with same bounded validation, fails startup on invalid explicit values.

NewRuntime builds env from PATH/HOME/XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/MV_SRF_STATE_DIR/SRF_IDENTITY_STORE_ROOT/SRF_PROXY_REGISTRY/SRF_EGRESS_PROXY only, then NewProcessRunner and NewManager. SearchPath returns PATH for host resolution.

No request may add executable, env key, or shell text; PATH lookup skips non-absolute/unclean dirs and checks regular executable bits without invoking shell. State flag ownership prevents dir override.
protect.go refuses native operations naming protected containers and tracks process-local pendingCreate authority so a reply alone cannot create cleanup rights.
quarantine_count.go exposes AdmissionProfiles snapshot where unbound quarantine consumes same reservation as live binding; only verified destruction releases it, lost still counts.
Dispatch seams call refuseProtectedContainer before any create state or native call: profile-derived container prediction, actual bound container, and execute args are all checked.
Protected match returns protected_container fault naming the container; caller must abort before quarantine or cleanup. No folding or argv mutation occurs during check.

pendingCreate holds Generation/NativeKind/Container/Slot per profile from before start; pendingCleanup validates generation/kind match, protected check, live-container absence, then slot/pattern by kind.

Holdings cleanup needs slot equal and holdingsContainer pattern; identity cleanup needs identityContainer pattern only, since native starts generate random names and authority comes from generation not prediction.
pendingCleanup false on missing/generation-mismatch profile entry, protected container, live binding with same container, or wrong slot/pattern. False grants no authority to clean native files.
AdmissionProfiles locks mu, copies quarantined true entries, adds every non-destroyed binding profileID, returns map. Callers use it to report possible native incumbents without exposing bindings.

creates map entry added under mu before execute and deleted via defer; cleanup check and stopNative run after failure while still holding logical authority. AdmissionProfiles snapshot is read-only copy.

Prediction-based cleanup would delete wrong container; design requires pending generation plus reply correlation plus live-map absence. Colliding run/frame allocations explicitly clear cleanup container.
Resident ring capture shares input exclusion and session clock with CLI capture but permits a fresh frame predating the read; validates an active drained binding before and after native read.
Called with ctx, surface id, and read callback taking Binding and returning NativeFrame; returns updated Binding, frame, error without touching subscription teardown.
Requires active surface, no destroying flag, no pending input, and unchanged Container, RunID, input epoch across the read; otherwise fault surface or POLICY binding changed.
If CaptureMonoNS is before OriginNS or after post-read clock, returns cli.Fault ring_wire resident capture clock outside session; caller receives empty frame.
On success TSNS equals CaptureMonoNS minus OriginNS and the surface refresh entry is deleted; clock mapping keeps session-relative timestamps.
Holds manager mutex for binding checks and beginCapture epoch, releases during native read, then re-locks to verify no concurrent destroy, input, or rebinding intervened.
Stops a hostile writer from its own capture goroutine without subscription teardown; quarantine blocks further input and capture for the profile.
Marks surface lost, runs stopNative, then marks destroyed and clears inputEpochs and refresh; quarantine flag is set then removed after stop.
Walks an absolute clean path with held directory descriptors; no component may be a symlink and only the final component may be created 0700.
Rejects non-absolute or unclean paths with EINVAL; opens root with O_NOFOLLOW|O_DIRECTORY|O_CLOEXEC and each part with Openat; caller must still check owner and mode.
Symlink, missing intermediate, or permission error returns errno; failed Stat after descriptor handoff still closes the file without leaking fd.
Runner abstracts native CLI execution; Clock supplies monotonic nanoseconds used for session origin and capture window checks.
Parses one bounded closed JSON object from CLI stdout into dst; enforces maxBytes, single line, leading brace, IPC JSON limits, and unknown-field rejection.
Empty, multi-line, over-size, non-object, or schema-violating output yields Fault malformed_cli; decode error is returned to CLI caller.
Exit 0 means nil; unknown family gives unknown_family; negative gives uncertain; srf families map 2 usage 3 setup 4 unavailable 5 malformed 6 refused 7 cli_failed else invalid_exit.
Fault carries Code and Detail; Error renders Code colon Detail; Unsupported builds unsupported fault naming the operation.
Owns bounded private replay ledger with exclusive flock; reservations are fsynced before dispatch and corruption fails closed.
Ledger file must be uid-owned, nlink 1, mode 0600, size under 32 MiB, newline-terminated; parent dir is synced; existing entries are re-admitted on open.
Short write, write error, or sync failure truncates back to pre-stat size and syncs; if truncate or sync fails the authority latches failed and refuses further reservations.
Refuses when count reaches 100000, Seq is zero or not increasing per sender, Nonce empty, or Key plus Nonce already seen; prevents replay and overflow.
Requires same-uid peer; when a core pin is configured the hello must be hello/v0.2 from core with matching commit; later envelopes must keep SessionID, From, To.
Derives sender key from inbound envelope, allocates next Seq, random 16-byte hex nonce, checks monotonic origin, durably reserves, then emits envelope/v0.2 with swapped From To and TsNS offset.
User sees capture rejected or daemon refuses new messages: logs ring_wire clock outside session, POLICY binding changed, replay or capacity refused, or replay rollback unverified after disk failure.
Creates the configured dispatch seam for surface requests; accepts externally authenticated hello without replying and publishes one initial frame synchronously on create.
Requires non-nil capsule Manager and frames Publisher; returns an ipc.Handler taking ctx and envelope and returning JSON replies or error.
Decodes envelope body header, short-circuits hello/v0.2, decodes capsule.Request, calls manager.Handle, rewrites list via listSnapshots or runs create capture-publish path.
Create must return exactly one created event with a surface id; human-role openings return immediately with no agent frame consumer or capture.
On agent create: resolve SubscriptionBinding, Capture, re-marshal created with live binding, Publish, then append frame_ready; any step after creation triggers compensation.
Capture, remarshal, or publish failure runs compensate which issues destroy under WithoutCancel with 30s timeout and returns CreationError with surface id, cause, rollback.
Preserves committed identity when initial capture fails, including when verified compensation cannot complete; Unwrap joins Cause and Rollback.
Rewrites each created snapshot to state_changed after strict validation; error events pass through unchanged.
Returns invalid list snapshot when JSON is malformed, schema is not surface_event/v0.2, event is not created, unknown fields exist, or surface id is empty.
Depends on capsule Manager for Handle, SubscriptionBinding, Capture and on frames Publisher for Publish; continuous capture stays with subscription service.
Compensation uses caller-cancel-immune context but bounded to 30s; uncertain removal is still reported with committed identity rather than hidden.
Initial frame publication applies transport backpressure synchronously; no background capture task is started here.
Builds the full daemon runtime from trusted environment: profiles, state dir, view, recorder, capsule manager, frame publishers, replay authority, IPC policy, and hello.
Requires absolute MV_SRF_BIN_DIR, MV_SRF_STATE_DIR, SRF_IDENTITY_STORE_ROOT, SRF_PROXY_REGISTRY, XDG_RUNTIME_DIR and non-empty MV_SESSION_ID, MV_CORE_INSTANCE, MV_DAEMON_INSTANCE.
MV_SRF_NET_MODES must be a JSON array of legacy, open, proxied without duplicates; absent means legacy behavior.
MV_EXPECTED_CORE_COMMIT must be 40 lowercase hex when set; MV_CONTRACT_DIR defaults to contracts/v0.2; MV_COMPONENT_COMMIT falls back to VCS revision.
Anchors replay creation to a canonical no-symlink walk: absolute clean path, O_NOFOLLOW per component, only final component may be mkdir 0700.
Fails closed with configuration fault on bad env, non-private state dir, wrong owner, bad profiles, unavailable CLOCK_MONOTONIC, or invalid startup hello envelope.
Creates view from environment, recorder with origin clock, capsule manager with 16 surfaces and 90s timeout, shared 512 MiB frame budget, and per-RAM-root publishers.
Each publisher keeps at most 64 generations per surface, 128 MiB per surface, 512 MiB global, 64 MiB max frame, minimum 4s retention.
Implements wire dispatch for record, create, input, destroy, and list; tracks owned publishers, pending releases, last wire frames, and state sidecars.

Create resolves profile, delegates to dispatch handler, registers recorder surface, records frame_ready refs, and marks agent surfaces owned. Input carries checked native evidence directly, never from cache.
Failed inputs settle verified false with last wire frame as diagnostic context only; human input without baseline emits diagnostic frame_ref and error instead of proof.
Per-recording polling task runs on ticker until cancel, refusal, or recorder close; stopRecording, stopSurface, and stopAll cancel and join tasks.
Start is idempotent per recording id; polling optionally takes per-surface lock with TryLock spin and emits events under session emit.
Only drained agent type and key inputs settle up to 1500ms at 50ms intervals waiting for SHA change; clicks and human input keep existing capture policy.
Returns last frame when deadline nears or context expires without change; capture errors propagate unless a prior frame exists and only the bounded context expired.
Writes state JSON as .state-basename with O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW 0600, size-capped; base name must be safe and RAM root must pass canonical dir walk.
Retains at most 16 state sidecars per surface; evicted paths are removed from disk.
Maps errors through capsule WireCode into surface_event error with surface id, code, detail; falls back to MsgID when surface id is absent.
Accepts one session hello by building fresh capsule runtime, ring source, per-root subscriptions, recorder, display taps, and liveness monitor.
Rejects second hello with handshake fault and requires session emission; MV_RING_FPS defaults to 60 and MV_CAPTURE_RING selects ring source.
Publishes new manager, recorder, subscriptions, and handler only after all fallible setup succeeds so rollback closes staged subscriptions without touching live state.
Shutdown lists surfaces then destroys each within 30s total budget; each destroy gets equal remaining share with 10s minimum floor; budget exhaustion is reported per surface.
Returns zero when no budget or nothing queued; otherwise remaining divided by queued, raised to min of remaining and minimum slice.
User sees adapter refuses to start or input receipt says verified false; logs name private state directory required, invalid profiles, monotonic completion refused, or post-input proof missing.
DISPLAY ring base defaults to tmpfs path with 0700 creation; XDG runtime under tmp may not be tmpfs, so base selection matters for frame transport.
Serializes native creates and destroys on one core connection and across processes with a shared directory flock; checks host MemAvailable before create and after initial capture.
Floor is min of 20 GiB and MemTotal divided by 4; each incumbent reservation costs 512 MiB matching the frame budget.
Refuses with RAM_ADMISSION_REFUSED when memory unreadable, total zero, available above total, live negative, reserve multiplication overflows, or available below floor plus reserves.
Holds an in-process mutex plus a blocking exclusive flock on the admission directory for the whole create or destroy sequence.
Reconciles own reservation records, counts directory entries, pre-checks RAM, persists reservation before spawn, runs create under grace context, then post-checks RAM.
Post-check failure destroys only the new surface under a 30s detached context; unverified removal or rollback error returns CreationError with cause and rollback.
Ignores parent cancellation for at most grace after parent cancel while preserving parent values; caller must call cancel to release the timer.
Uses MV_RAM_ADMISSION_DIR or XDG runtime metaviewer ram-admission; requires uid-owned 0700 directory opened via canonical walk before flock.
Writes one fsynced 0600 file per reserved profile named owner hash plus profile; removes only own stale names and never reclaims other owners on PID death.
Augments refusal with counted records and foreign share, directing operators to dry-run reclaim only after proving native containers absent.
Requires absolute clean existing canonical RAM roots with no symlinks and pairwise disjoint paths; nested roots are rejected.
Parses MemAvailable and MemTotal in kB exactly once each; rejects duplicates, wrong units, zero total, or available above total.
Runs the adapter either as authenticated streaming client or as listener; declares internal routing only with no wire authority.
Takes ctx, empty args, stderr writer, and optional single Runtime; returns process exit code 0 on success or 2 on usage and startup errors.
Prints adapter unsupported arguments, startup cancelled, one runtime required, or policy and handler required to stderr; connect or serve errors also map to exit 2.
Exposes 14 operations including create, input, view, login, record and screenshot, all sharing one backend typed configuration refusal until native configuration exists.
User sees create refused with host MemAvailable below floor plus incumbent reserves, or adapter exits 2 with unsupported arguments on bad CLI use.
Runs the client-first core transport handshake over Unix socket: dials, checks peer, sends daemon hello first, then multiplexes data and control lanes with session binding.
Requires validated IPC config, non-nil policy and handler, and registration from core to daemon with session id; registration body is the local daemon hello.
Refuses non-Unix peers, unadmitted UIDs, and envelopes whose schema, From, To, SessionID, Seq, or Nonce break the registered core route.
Reader validates framing, route, schema, authentication, and replay reservation, then routes keepalive, hello, policy refusal, frame refusal, control, or data queue.
Uses separate outbound and authority mutexes, 256-item FIFO staging between socket read and 64-item data channel, plus a 64-item control channel so control never blocks behind data.
Take_control and release_control go to the control lane behind a barrier gate; later data carries the gate waiter. Workers drain on clean EOF; failures cancel before join.
Core liveness probe is answered in the reader before any queue and never reaches the handler or capsule state, protecting the core idle deadline.
Bounds frame verdict correlation by MaxReplayEntries; oldest frame MsgIDs are evicted first. Session emit uses ShutdownTimeout per line and cancels session on write failure.
Abnormal read, framing, validation, route, schema, auth, dispatch, or write failure records first session error, cancels session, joins workers, and returns it.
Shares subscription lifetime with the session and profile publisher; frame subscribe starts polling while unsubscribe and destroy drain before replying.
Intercepts frame_subscribe and frame_unsubscribe requests; all other operations pass to the next handler unchanged.
Parses surface_id with bounded ParseLine; unsubscribe drains before manager mutex because in-flight CLI capture holds that mutex until subscription cancels.
Bind, publisher, subscribe, or unsubscribe errors map through wireFailure to surface_event error; successful unsubscribe returns no replies.
Human-role openings never start a frame poll; agent subscriptions require the publisher for the binding profile RAM root.
Provides per-surface mutexes plus a shared mutex for empty ids; stream data dispatch locks the target surface except for subscribe, unsubscribe, and destroy.
Session carries ctx, work mutex, surface locks, and synchronous bounded emit used by subscriptions, recorder polling, and liveness monitor.
User sees stream drop or frames stop: logs show registered core route refused, core surface request required, dispatch error, or peer credentials refused.
Proposal verdicts gain no admission from reason code alone; only bounded STALE_FRAME refusals matching a sent frame are consumed, POLICY refusals are only logged.

Per-surface diagnostic rate limiter: aggregates skipped_polls over a 30s window and aligns stage_summary cadence; MV_ADAPTER_DIAG=verbose restores per-event lines while errors/warnings are never rate-limited.
DefaultDiagnosticsInterval is 30s aggregation window; verboseStageSummaryInterval is 5s when verbose and no explicit interval; DiagModeEnvVar MV_ADAPTER_DIAG with value verbose selects verbose mode.

Subscriptions calls initSurface on poll start, recordSkippedPolls on missed deadlines, allowErrorOrWarning before error/warning lines; writeSessionCloseSkippedPolls emits final total at session close.
Input missed count accumulates into surfaceSkipWindow.windowSkipped; on window expiry returns summed count with true signalling caller to emit one aggregated line, else returns 0,false to suppress.
Per-surface window states: uninitialized zero start, accumulating within interval, expired when now >= start+interval and skips>0 then resets start=now and count=0 and emits sum.

recordSkippedPolls returns (summedSkips,true) only at window boundary, else (0,false); allowErrorOrWarning returns true normally, false to suppress duplicate error/warning within interval when faultRateLimitErrors is set.

User sees one adapter: surface <id> skipped_polls=N line every 30s instead of per miss; with MV_ADAPTER_DIAG=verbose they see a line per miss. Absence of lines does not mean no misses, only window not yet expired.
All mutable maps guarded by sync.Mutex; nil receiver is safe returning env-based verbose/false/disabled; initSurface and record paths lazily create maps under lock.
Bounded memory: one surfaceSkipWindow entry and one errorWindows timestamp per surface id; no timers or goroutines owned by limiter.

NewDisplayTaps binds ctx/cfg; Start launches per-surface goroutine if MV_DISPLAY_TAP != off and id matches ringComponent; StartReplies starts taps on frame_ready with Generation>0 or created events with SurfaceID.
Stop cancels one task and waits for done or caller ctx; Close marks closed, cancels all tasks then Stops each joining errors; Err returns last tap refusal/termination error per surface.

ResolveDisplayTarget derives target from capsule.Binding native state file <stateDir>/<container>.json, parsing XID, geometry, display; validDisplayTarget enforces display ^:[0-9]+$, container/run shape, XID!=0, 1..4096 dimensions.

Per-surface loop: Admit gate, Resolve, validate, session; on session error emit diag and backoff 100ms doubling to 2s; binding change detected every 250ms retires session with DISPLAY binding retired; ctx cancel exits.

W8U path requires HELLO before frames, checks seq=next, then publishes and ACKs; XWD-concat path reads header/name/colormap/pixels per image and publishes; any malformed header or geometry ends session with error.

Missing/invalid display yields typed DisplayTapRefusal DISPLAY_MISSING/DISPLAY_INVALID leaving VERIFIED capture unaffected; Unwrap maps to cli.Fault with same code; Is matches on code or wildcard empty code.
Sentinel refusals for missing/invalid display and non browser/program windows; ResolveDisplayTarget returns DISPLAY_UNSUPPORTED when NativeKind is not browser/program or Window empty.

If Admit fails, records error, logs adapter: DISPLAY tap refused by RAM admission once and returns without retry. If Resolve or validDisplayTarget fails, records typed refusal, emits adapter: DISPLAY tap <id>: resolve error, and returns.

Control header mismatch, END length error, unexpected HELLO, framing without hello, frame header/dimension/stride/digest mismatch, leg length error, or XWD geometry error each returns DISPLAY control/HELLO/framing/header/geometry error and retires session.

User sees no DISPLAY image but VERIFIED capture continues; Diagnostics shows adapter: DISPLAY tap <id>: session ended: <err> or resolve error. Stderr tail is appended as (sender stderr: ...) when present.

Supervisor mutex serializes tasks map; one goroutine per surface with cancel/done; deferred delete removes only same task pointer; session renews below recorder cap with 9-minute timeout and separate kill context for process group.

Bounds: 4096 px per dimension, one record plus one converted frame, two-slot tmpfs ring; record cap is 144+2*(4*W*H+1MiB); sender process owned in own process group with Setpgid, Cancel SIGKILL, WaitDelay 100ms.

W8U binding JSON schema w8u-binding/1 with sorted keys, digest sha256 over binding; control header W8UC ver 1 with kind/len/digest; ACK kind 2 carries seq,seq+2; publish validates RGB length and geometry match.

ResolveDisplayTarget opens identity state with O_NOFOLLOW, enforces regular 0600 owned file <=1MiB and Ready/container/run match; tailBuffer keeps only last 2048 stderr bytes under mutex to bound diagnostics.
Per-surface tmpfs ring file exposing latest DISPLAY RGB frames via shared mmap header plus two RGB slots; generation distinguishes incarnations after unclean shutdown.
Frames backend stub: New returns backend whose Subscribe/Unsubscribe always return cli.Unsupported frame_subscribe/frame_unsubscribe; real capture lives in Publisher/Subscriptions.
DisplayRingPath builds <runtime>/metaviewer/display/<id>.ring; open creates/mmaps file; publish copies RGB into alternating slot with seqlock; close unmaps, closes and removes path.
Rejects ids not matching ringComponent with DISPLAY_INVALID refusal; empty runtimeDir falls back to DisplayBaseDir; path is always <base>/metaviewer/display/<id>.ring.
Ref schema frame_ref/v0.2 carries surface_id, generation, tick, ts_ns, width/height, format rgb24, ramws_path, sha256, capture_us; produced by Publisher.publish per accepted frame.
publish validates RGB length W*H*3, bumps seq odd during copy then even after, selects slot (next/2)%2, copies RGB, stores mono timestamp, publishes generation/width/stride in header at open.

Open validates target, traverses to runtime parent without symlinks, mkdir display 0700, verifies private tmpfs, O_EXCL create 0600; on EEXIST validates stale regular 0600 owned nlink 1 on tmpfs then unlinks and recreates.

Directory must be tmpfs fstype 0x01021994 uid==euid mode 0700; file size is 64+2*W*H*3; header magic MVDISP1, widths, stride 3*W, version 1, generation; stale file must be regular 0600 nlink 1 same uid on tmpfs.

Invalid target, unsafe dir/file, or mmap/truncate/chmod failure returns error and closes partial state; never follows links or reclaims special files; caller surfaces error via DisplayTaps session diag.
RGB length mismatch returns DISPLAY RGB length; target change after open returns DISPLAY ring geometry changed; nil file lazily reopens with new target.
Any Subscribe/Unsubscribe call fails with unsupported fault; callers must use Subscriptions/Publisher path instead of this Backend.
Viewer sees frozen or missing DISPLAY image when ring open fails; Diagnostics/log shows DISPLAY requires private tmpfs directory ... or unsafe stale DISPLAY ring instead of frame content.
Single-writer seqlock via atomic seq: odd means tearing, even means consistent; readers sample seq before/after; unsafe.Pointer on mapped bytes; no mutex held.
Mmap size 64+2 frames RGB24; munmap plus close plus remove on close; open lazily re-entered from publish when file nil; Fchmod enforces 0600 after create.
Depends only on internal/cli Unsupported constructor; no I/O, no goroutines, no state.
Reclaim path unlinks only basename inside verified fd via Unlinkat/Openat O_NOFOLLOW; traversal uses openRingDir without following symlinks including existing runtime root.

Retains time- and byte-bounded ring of recent immutable raw publications per surface, converting verified native PNGs to RGB24 leases; only adapter-created raw files are reclaimed, native PNGs stay producer-owned.

NewPublisher validates config and creates private output dir under RAMRoot; Publish/PublishForced write unconditionally, PublishIfChanged/PublishWithTimings deduplicate when enabled; all funnel to internal publish.

readSource opens PNG via dir-fd traversal with no-follow, checks owner/mode/nlink/size/immutability, then decodeAndVerifyPNG checks IHDR dims, decodes PNG, enforces opaque alpha, hashes RGB24 and compares to f.SHA256RGB24 before atomic write-link.

Validates identity/sequence/geometry, fast digest-gated skip, dedup refresh of latest retention, then simulated eviction planning under group lock, random-name tmp write, link, commit ref with Generation=p.next++; any error clears skipReady gate.

Requires id==binding surface, container==generation, seq>0 and monotonic per native, 64-hex sha, W/H within binding geometry and MaxPixels/MaxFrameBytes; window binding must match f.Window dims when set.
Native digest equality may skip source IO only after successful publication with identical geometry; any failed attempt disables gate until another verified publication.

All bound violations return generic frame identity, allocation or pixels refused without detail; RAMRoot must be cleaned absolute under /dev/shm/; MaxRetained !=1, retention <=60s, surface<=256MiB, total<=1024MiB.
Returns (prevRef,false) on dedup hit with Skipped=1, (newRef,true) on write; unchanged content via hardlink reuses bytes when size matches; skipped counts digest-gated polls.
Path escape, symlink, non-regular, wrong uid/group bits, nlink!=1, size out of range, short read, or mtime/content change between stats returns frameError or IO error and disables skip gate.
Bad PNG magic/IHDR dims, decode error, bounds mismatch, non-opaque alpha, or sha mismatch returns frameError; caller treats as publish failure without writing lease.
Over per-surface slots/bytes or global total after oldest-first eviction down to 2-generation floor returns frameError without writing; unlink failure mid-commit returns frame lease release error.
Viewer sees stale or missing frame with no crash; downstream gets capture_failed event; logs show only generic refusal, so geometry/hash/capacity causes are indistinguishable to user.
Per-publisher mutex plus optional Budget mutex for cross-publisher caps; peers locked in Budget order during planning; isCancelled checked before/after IO and under lock to drain on unsubscribe.

Live 64MiB budgets keep 64 gens/128MiB/surface/4s min; >=1MiB fixtures 16 gens; small <1MiB 2 gens; global default 512MiB; eviction reclaims burst past MinRetention to 2-gen floor, refreshing latest timestamp on dedup.

Expired leases unlinked via output fd Unlinkat tolerating ENOENT; Release records each unlink immediately so partial release plus Close never reclaims same lease; Close removes output dir and deregisters budget.
openRAMRoot requires tmpfs fstype and uid match, refuses world-writable; PNG decode supports RGBA/NRGBA fast compact path and generic opaque path rejecting any alpha!=0xffff/0xff.

Writes via Openat temp 0600 relative to held dir fd with SameFile check, then Link+Unlink temp; verifies output dir identity before link to avoid mutable-ancestor swap; random 16-byte hex lease names.
Opt-in resident shared-memory frame source: reads capsule writer ring.rgb24 directly when MV_CAPTURE_RING=1 after validated root; failures after selection never fall back to legacy CLI pair.
One-time mode selector: tries open() when enabled, else keeps legacy source; emits capture_mode=<legacy|ring> reason line only when enabled; refused root selects reported legacy mode.

SelectRingSource wraps legacy Source with RingSource and RingPollInterval; NewRingSource checks vqa-ring group and validates root; Capture resolves binding then reads ring and retains max two payloads per surface.
UseRingSource binds handoff before subscriptions; PublishRGB24 publishes retained raw by seq/path match; Forget clears pinned geometry and payloads after subscriptions drain or hostile root.

read validates dir/file, header, geometry, scans slots with double-read torn check, digest match and mono age, keeps best seq payload; take matches by path/seq/generation/sha and dequeues for Publisher rawMode.

CaptureResident callback supplies binding; on RingError non missing/stale/torn calls Forget then RefuseResident stopping writer; missing/stale/torn propagate without stopping; success appends payload trimmed to last two.
Header magic OSRG ver 1, 1..16 slots, 1..4096 W/H, stride==W*3, 1..120 fps; slot header requires even nonzero lock, seq>=1, matching W/H; size must equal 64+slots*(64+W*H*3).
Geometry must fit binding surface, exact match when no window; first geometry pins per surface, later mismatch yields ring_geometry; mono must be within [origin, now] and age<=500ms else stale.
Codes ring_root/ring_wire/ring_hostile/ring_missing/ring_length/ring_geometry/ring_stale/ring_torn with detail resident ring refused; stale/torn unwrap to DeadlineExceeded.

Non-absolute/unclean path, openat failure, non-tmpfs, missing nosuid/nodev/noexec flags, mode!=02770, uid/gid mismatch, or bad run/window component yields ring_root/ring_wire/ring_missing/ring_hostile.

Zero/multiple entries, non ring.rgb24 name, mode!=0640, bad uid/gid/nlink, short header, size mismatch, torn double-read, digest mismatch, or all-stale yields ring_length/hostile/geometry/stale/torn; final header/stat recheck can still fail hostile.
User sees capture_mode=legacy reason=<detail> line at startup when ring refused; after ring selected, stale/torn frames appear as capture_failed events with no silent fallback to legacy capture.
Mutex guards pinned geometries and per-surface payload queues (cap 2); retries default 4 clamped 1..16; slot scan is lock-free file ReadAt with pre/post header compare for tear detection.
Root fixed compiled /dev/shm/vqa-ring, not configurable; writer uid 10001; poll interval is 1/fps clamped 1..120fps and capped at 40ms spacing.
Enabled flag plus fps select ring; open failure reason string reported; interval returned is RingPollInterval(fps) on success else 100ms.
Per-surface 2-stage capture/publish/emit pipeline overlapping capture N+1 with decode/publish/emit of N via unbuffered handoff, preserving FIFO order, generation monotonicity and cancellation drain.

NewSubscriptions validates bounded deps and spawns cancellable scope; Subscribe starts poll+publishLoop goroutines; Unsubscribe cancels, drains with ShutdownTimeout and clears failure; Close cancels all and unsubscribes each.

poll captures under per-surface lock with CaptureTimeout into pipeCh; publishLoop publishes via Publisher, marshals frame_ready surface_event/v0.2, emits with CaptureTimeout; delivery failure terminates subscription with retained error.

Per-tick: TryLock surface, Capture, unlock, transient vs confirmed handling, handoff, advance monotonic next and count skips; single capture_failed Needs 2 consecutive proven absence faults to set markLost and emit state_changed lost.

On unchanged dedup hit records stage and acks without emit; on failure emits capture_failed with skipped_polls, optionally Begin/CompleteLost handshake and WaitLostDelivered before terminal error; on success increments emitted/confirmed and records stages.

Only 2 consecutive capsule.IsAbsenceFault (unavailable/refused) confirm loss; context canceled/deadline never counts; first transient absence emits warning transient capture failure (1/2) and continues.
Source.Capture supplies binding/frame; optional LossMarker stages/rolls back lost event and coordinates delivery; Emit must honor context; delivery failure terminates instead of queueing.
At most MaxSubscriptions recent failures retained; resubscribe or explicit unsubscribe clears prior failure; TerminalError returns retained task error if any.
Invalid id, duplicate subscription, capacity reached, closed session, or cancelled parent returns inactive session/invalid identity, already subscribed, or capacity error without starting goroutine.
Publish error triggers adapter: surface <id> error line plus capture_failed event with skipped_polls; emit error joins publish+delivery errors, sends one bounded failure notice, then terminates task.
capture_failed event built via capsule.NewErrorEvent code capture_failed detail capture, publication or delivery refused (skipped_polls=N); marshal failure itself becomes terminal task error.

User sees adapter: surface <id> skipped_polls=N total_skipped_polls=M and periodic stage_summary samples with p50/p95 ms lines every 30s (5s verbose); missing lines mean window not expired, not zero misses.

Per-surface exclusion replaces global lock: explicit SurfaceLock func, else shared CaptureLock, else auto per-surface mutex; poll uses TryLock with 1ms backoff until CaptureTimeout; at most one capture+one publish in flight per surface.
Poll deadlines use monotonic session clock; missed deadlines counted via atomic skipped plus per-surface map, never queued; Serial config or fake clock forces ack rendezvous disabling overlap.
Stage windows keep up to 4096 samples each for window and lifetime; summaries compute p50/p95 per capture/decode/hash/write/total; dedup requires >=2 initial unchanged polls and >=1 emitted frame.

MaxSubscriptions, PollInterval, CaptureTimeout, ShutdownTimeout, DeduplicateUnchanged, InitialUnchangedPolls, Serial, Diagnostics writer/interval, OnSkippedPolls/OnStageSummary hooks; default diagnostics 30s.

Interval override else verbose 5s else 30s via diagLimiter; limiter initSurface/recordSkippedPolls/allowErrorOrWarning gate all diagnostic lines; publisher release hook clears confirmed/failure state.

Cancellation checked at capture, handoff, publish and emit boundaries with errSubscriptionCancelled rollback; Unsubscribe/Close use bounded ShutdownTimeout waits to avoid wedged sender blocking shutdown.
client.go Connect is the daemon-side core client: dial unix socket, verify peer, send daemon hello, then route admitted core frames to handler and write replies.
config.go Config carries socket path, UID, frame/JSON bounds, replay/connection caps and hello/read/write/probe/shutdown timeouts for the frozen transport.
frame.go Framer implements newline-delimited JSON framing with read/write mutexes, deadline arming and pre/post JSON validation.
json.go ValidateJSON bounds containers/strings/keys/array items and rejects duplicate keys, extra values and lone surrogates.
keepalive.go KeepaliveReply is the shared core liveness-probe definition so plain and streaming paths answer identically without handler work.
Connect(ctx,cfg,policy,registration,handler) requires cfg.Validate, non-nil policy/handler, registration core->daemon with SessionID; else complete client registration required.
Registration Body is locally configured daemon hello, never peer data; first admitted frame must be hello/v0.2 from core, later only surface_request/v0.2.
Validate rejects MaxFrameBytes>1MiB, MaxDepth>32, MaxStringBytes>64K, MaxKeys>256, MaxArrayItems>4096, empty path, non-positive bounds, HelloTimeout>5s, ReadTimeout>30s.
Write refuses len>=MaxFrameBytes or embedded CR/LF as invalid outbound frame, validates JSON, appends LF and loops short writes; zero write is ErrShortWrite.
Read strips trailing LF, rejects overflow beyond MaxFrameBytes as frame limit exceeded, maps bare-EOF-with-bytes to UnexpectedEOF, then ValidateJSON.
Closed JSON contract: string/key length, depth, key/array caps, no duplicate keys, single value, UTF-8 valid, no lone surrogate escape.
Probe iff MsgID starts core-keepalive- and Body is surface_request/v0.2 op list; reply is fixed surface_event error DAEMON_KEEPALIVE, caller must skip handler.
Outbound path: handler replies -> policy.Wrap under authority mutex -> json.Marshal -> ValidateEnvelope outbound contract -> Framer.Write under outbound mutex.
Inbound path: Framer.Read -> ValidateEnvelope -> body schema/component check -> Authenticate+Reserve under authority lock -> dataIn or ctrlCh dispatch.
Read uses bufio ReadSlice loop handling ErrBufferFull; Write validates then writes LF-terminated frame with write deadline from arm().
States: hello sent, then first=true expects core hello and skips dispatch; after first, every frame dispatched; take_control/release_control switch lane and install ctrlGate.
Three workers: bounded FIFO stager (maxDataBacklog 256) decouples socket read from dataCh(64); data lane honors ctrlGate wait; ctrl lane(64) closes done after dispatch.
Control preempts in-flight data: data queued after take_control waits on ctrlGate; barrier ensures ordered handoff without head-of-line blocking on dataCh.
Separate readMu/writeMu allow concurrent Read/Write; arm picks min(ctx deadline, now+timeout), installs SetDeadline, AfterFunc forces expiry on ctx cancel.
Dial non-UnixConn gives unix peer required; PeerCred/PeerAdmitted failure gives core peer credentials refused; hello handler error aborts before first write.
Route mismatch (schema/from/to/session/Seq==0/empty Nonce) gives registered core route refused; wrong body gives core surface request required; both fail session then exitLoop.
Abnormal read/framing/validation/route/schema/auth failures cancel session before worker join; clean EOF drains lanes without sessionErr; sessionErr checked on exit.
Violations surface as string/depth/key/array limit, invalid or duplicate key, unclosed container, extra JSON value, invalid encoding, lone surrogate escape.
User sees daemon never connects or drops immediately: wrong SessionID/endpoints, peer UID mismatch, or core hello missing causes instant Connect return with registration/credential/route error.
Bounds: dataCh/ctrlCh 64, staging backlog 256, dial/hello timeout HelloTimeout, idle reads ReadTimeout; UnixConn closed deferred, session cancel on fail.
Hello bounds first frame; Read bounds later idle reads; both explicit and capped by frozen contract; Write/Probe/Shutdown must be positive.
Depends on Policy.Wrap/ValidateEnvelope/Authenticate/Reserve, Handler dispatch, PeerCred admission, Framer deadlines over unix socket.
Drift hazard if probe definition duplicated: fixed prefix and reply body must stay shared or streaming and plain clients answer differently.
message.go defines Envelope/Endpoint wire shape plus Policy interface binding ValidateEnvelope, Authenticate, Reserve and Wrap for the authority integration.
peercred.go reads SO_PEERCRED (PID/UID/GID) from a UnixConn and admits only the configured UID, binding the socket peer to core identity.
policy.go SchemaPolicy snapshots the v0.2 schema filesystem into a closed contract validator and delegates auth/replay/wrap to caller Authority.
NewPolicy(c,source,authority) validates Config, requires schema FS and authority, resolves envelope.schema.json, demands closed v0.2 envelope with body choices.
ValidateEnvelope(raw) enforces frame size, ValidateJSON, schema accept, terminal length check, then unmarshals to Envelope; unconfigured policy errors.
Policy callers must run ValidateEnvelope on complete closed body before Reserve; Reserve must survive reconnect/restart; Wrap allocates adapter seq/identity.
Schemas load lazily from fs.FS via ReadFile+UseNumber decode, cached by file#fragment; JSON pointer fragments unescape ~1/~0; compile builds schemaNode tree.
Raw bytes -> length check -> ValidateJSON -> generic decode -> envelope.accept -> terminalLengthsOK -> typed Envelope unmarshal and return.
Envelope requires schema/msg_id/ts_ns/from/to/session_id/seq/nonce/body; SenderKey is session+component+instance for replay reservation.
Only closed schemas: additionalProperties must be false; open type unions, unknown types/keywords, empty oneOf, nonlocal refs are refused at compile.
accept enforces $ref, const DeepEqual, enum membership, oneOf exactly-one, kind, required/closed props, min/max items/props/length, integer lexeme and range.
RAMWS paths must match ^/dev/shm(/[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}){1,8}$, len 10-255; segment regex checked per part, no network resolution.
Integers must match -?(0|[1-9][0-9]*) lexeme, be integral big.Rat within +-9007199254740991, plus schema minimum/maximum when present.
Strings checked by rune count for min/maxLength, pattern (with \u0000 rewrite), ramwsPath flag; numbers compared as big.Rat against minimum/maximum.
Compile states: cache placeholder pending detects cycles -> cyclic schema error; malformed deployment panics recovered as malformed contract schema, never partial admission.
NewPolicy fails on bad Config, nil source/authority, missing/undecodable envelope.schema.json, nonlocal ref, bad fragment/pointer, open/empty/cyclic schema.
ValidateEnvelope fails with frame limit, JSON bound error, or closed v0.2 envelope/body refused when accept or terminal length check rejects.
PeerCred fails on SyscallConn/Control/GetsockoptUcred errors; PeerAdmitted false when cred.UID != cfg.UID, causing credential refusal upstream.
User sees valid-looking request rejected: closed v0.2 envelope/body refused appears when an extra field, wrong const, second oneOf match, or b64/byte_count mismatch occurs.
Operator sees daemon refuses all traffic at startup: malformed contract schema means deployed schema files are broken, not client data; needs schema redeploy.
Authority ops are caller capabilities with no local replay fallback; ValidateEnvelope must precede Reserve so replay state never records unvalidated bytes.
Validation is allocation-bounded by Config caps (frame/string/depth/keys/array); oversize raw rejected before decode to avoid memory blowup.
Policy snapshots supplied FS at NewPolicy; no network fetch; Authority remains mandatory injected dependency for Authenticate/Reserve/Wrap.
DeepEqual const/enum on decoded UseNumber values is type-sensitive; schema numbers must use json.Number form or valid messages can falsely miss.
session.go Serve is the daemon listener loop: admit Unix peers, enforce hello-first v0.2 contract, run handler, write replies with backpressure, shutdown gracefully.
socket.go Listen binds the private rendezvous socket with ownership/mode/symlink checks, stale-socket probing and umask-safe creation.
Serve(ctx,listener,cfg,policy,handler,log) validates cfg, requires listener/policy/handler/log; cancels per-connection context on shutdown.
Listen(ctx,cfg) requires live ctx, valid cfg, absolute SocketPath whose parent is a 0700 UID-owned non-symlink dir.
RuntimeSocketPath(runtimeDir,uid) demands absolute 0700 UID-owned non-symlink dir, creates metaviewer subdir 0700, returns surfaces.sock path.
Per connection: PeerCred admit -> NewFramer -> Read (hello timeout on first) -> ValidateEnvelope -> hello/version check -> Authenticate -> Reserve -> handler -> Wrap/Marshal/Write.
Handler(ctx,Envelope) returns reply bodies; Serve wraps each via policy.Wrap, marshals, Framer.Write synchronously to retain backpressure, no send queue.
Every frame must be envelope/v0.2 with Seq!=0, Nonce!="", core->daemon; first body must be hello/v0.2; no version fallback, successor union hello only in v0.2.
Existing socket must be 0600 UID-owned socket; bound socket re-verified 0600 owned; umask 0177 during bind; SetUnlinkOnClose(false) with inode-pinned cleanup.
Connection states: peer check -> framing -> validation -> auth -> reserve -> dispatch loop; first flag gates hello timeout and hello-schema requirement, then cleared.
Shutdown states: ctx cancel -> listener close + close tracked conns -> break accept -> wait stopped -> wg.Wait up to ShutdownTimeout else deadline error.
Rendezvous dirs must be Lstat dir, perm exactly 0700, owned by uid; any deviation is unsafe runtime directory.
CloseListener removes only the inode stored at Listen; if path now differs (SameFile false) it reports socket replaced before cleanup and keeps new file.
Any peer/framing/ValidateEnvelope/version/Authenticate/Reserve/handler/Wrap/Write failure logs adapter: connection refused and drops that connection without reply.
Post-handler ctx.Err checks prevent late Wrap/write after cancellation; defer conn.Close reclaims fd when ctx-ignoring handler eventually returns.
If ctx-ignoring handler exceeds ShutdownTimeout, Serve returns handler shutdown deadline exceeded joined with accept error rather than hanging.
Dial probe success means socket already served; non-ECONNREFUSED means staleness unproven; SameFile change means changed during probe; all refuse bind.
User sees connections silently dropped and log line adapter: connection refused; caused by wrong UID peer, non-hello first frame, bad seq/nonce, or failed reserve.
Operator sees daemon will not start listening: unsafe runtime/socket directory, symlink parent, already-served socket, or unproven stale socket error.
Accept loop plus per-conn goroutine tracked in clients map under mu; MaxConnections refuses excess; shutdown closes listener and all tracked sockets.
MaxConnections caps concurrency; wg tracks handlers; ShutdownTimeout bounds drain; conn + listener descriptors closed via defer and CloseListener.
HelloTimeout bounds first frame read via WithTimeout; ShutdownTimeout bounds handler drain; MaxConnections and log writer are mandatory external inputs.
Requires externally supplied authority policy; never substitutes local replay map; handler and log are caller-owned.
Umask is process-wide so bind must precede other writers; global bindMu serializes binds; inode map prevents deleting a replaced socket on cleanup.
capture.go Manager.capture runs the surface frame helper, validates metadata/window/geometry, verifies PNG+SHA, stores owned RAM copy in ring.
capture(ctx,requestID,id,r) looks up Surfaces[r.surface], builds BinDir/Family frame --container (+--window for identity), refuses protected containers.
Runner.Run -> ParseLine frameReply -> seq/geom/mono checks -> window/generation checks -> ramFile read (ring+1 cap) -> PNG decode -> per-pixel hash -> temp copy.
frameReply needs Seq>0, Width/Height>0, MonoNS>=OriginNS and <=2^53-1; generation from Seq or Generation numeric/string; window/state optional.
Holdings capsule must carry no Window; identity surfaces need window ID==Surface.Window and W/H equal Width/Height, else invalid frame window binding.
Frame path must satisfy under(/dev/shm,FramesRoot) and under(FramesRoot,Path); file must be regular tmpfs via ramFile, else outside RAM/not-regular/not-tmpfs.
Mono timestamps are session-relative (MonoNS-OriginNS) and capped at 2^53-1 for wire safety; larger values rejected as invalid frame metadata.
Monotonicity + rate: generation must increase, mono>=lastNS, gap>=1e9/fps; else stale or over-rate frame. Geometry checked before decode/alloc.
Ring states: compute evicted/dropped to fit size+new<=ring; remove oldest files; on remove error truncate kept prefix and abort new copy; emit dropped then frame_captured.
export without Destination returns DESTINATION_UNSET refusal; suffix .tar or grantIsDir selects exportDir else exportFile.
exportDir fails with DESTINATION_UNAVAILABLE on bad path, over-bound archive, missing frame, header/payload/seek/close errors, grant replaced, open failure.
exportFile same bounds plus invalid file path for / or non-clean path; open uses O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW so existing file yields DESTINATION_EXISTS.
safeErrDetail unwraps Path/Link/Syscall errors to inner cause, returns fallback when empty or containing / to avoid leaking paths.
User sees recording stops or gaps: stale or over-rate frame, PNG geometry mismatch, RGB witness mismatch, frame exceeds ring/memory, or outside RAM root.
User sees stop/export refused: destination already exists, destination cannot be opened, grant was replaced, export exceeds byte bound, digest mismatch.
Export pre-hashes tar with preDigest to derive RecordingID-sha tar name, then writes second tar via countWriter; final digest must equal pre-hash or mismatch error.
lstatAt stats via O_PATH|O_NOFOLLOW descriptor + Fstat so final symlink swap is detected; fd/path dev/ino must match before and after write.
countWriter counts tar bytes for ByteCount; archive blocks ((bytes+511)/512*512+512)+1024 header bounded by capBytes before any disk write.
Owned copies live under MkdirTemp /dev/shm/metaviewer-record- as frame-*.png; failed writes/seeks remove the new temp file to avoid leaks.
Incomplete export owns only successful O_EXCL create: cleanup Unlinkat only when fd and path dev/ino still match, else leaves replacement alone.
Depends on Runner helper output, cli.ParseLine 1MiB cap, png decode, sha256 rgb24, tmpfs statfs magic 0x01021994, syscall Openat/Unlinkat.
Refusals carry POLICY codes (UNSET/EXISTS/UNAVAILABLE) distinct from raw errors; export fallthrough converts non-Refusal failures to DESTINATION_UNAVAILABLE.
record.go Manager owns bounded RAM captures and authorized tar exports: Handle admits requests, Poll captures frames, stop seals, Release reclaims, Close wipes RAM.
NewManager validates Runner/Clock, RingBytes 1..1GiB and <=MemoryBytes, MaxFPS 1..120, BinDir absolute, Destination/capability, surface bindings.
NewFromEnvironment(originNS,clock) requires nonzero origin and clock, allowlists 7 env keys, builds 1MiB/90s runner, optional MV_RECORDING_DESTINATION.
Handle(ctx,raw) parses closed record_request/v0.2, enforces identities/ceiling/surface, routes ram/disk_stop, disk export-retry, start or screenshot.
Poll(ctx,requestID,id) requires live recorder, identity requestID, unsealed recording; delegates to capture under manager lock.
parse uses ParseLine 1MiB for request then params, demands record_request/v0.2 + identity RequestID, per-op closed param set, exact field count, no null/missing.
Handle: base event with capped mono -> surface admitted -> stop vs sealed-disk-export vs new reservation (budget/memory checks) -> started or screenshot chain.
Allowed params: ram_start surface+recording+ring+max_fps; disk_start surface+recording+capability+path+max_fps; stops none extra; screenshot surface+capture only.
Disk destination must exactly equal configured CapabilityID+Path and be clean absolute; else DESTINATION_UNSET not-authorized refusal.
Hard ceiling capBytes 1GiB bounds ring, memory and tar block sum; per-request ring/fps must also fit configured RingBytes/MaxFPS and session MemoryBytes.
Recording: created unsealed ram/disk/screenshot -> Poll appends frames -> sealed by stop/screenshot/Close/UnregisterSurface; sealed frames counted retained after eviction.
Release only sealed captures: removes owned RAM copies, keeps reservation on failure for retry, then tombstones id in released and deletes record; no release event on wire.
stop validates active same-surface same-mode; disk mode exports first then appends exported; always emits stopped with FrameCount/ByteCount.
IDs match ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,127}$; identity surfaces need window ^w[0-9]+$; families only srf-identity-surface/srf-holdings-capsule; FramesRoot under /dev/shm.
Paths must be absolute <=4096 Clean==self no NUL/CR/LF; under() requires Rel not . .. hidden or absolute, enforcing RAM-root containment.
Clock mono capped at 2^53-1; exceeding sets withinCeiling false and Handle refuses with monotonic clock exceeded wire ceiling.
Handle refuses POLICY for bad bounds, unadmitted surface, already-used identity, inactive stop; BUDGET_EXCEEDED for over-limit ring/fps or session memory exceeded.
Sealed ram/screenshot disk_start with same surface retries export; export Refusal mapped to refused event, other errors to DESTINATION_UNAVAILABLE with safe detail.
Release returns unknown recording when absent, recording is active when unsealed, raw remove error on owned-copy failure; Close seals all and nils frames.
User sees start rejected as recording identity was already used after any prior use including released tombstones; must use fresh recording id.
User sees disk stop with empty tar plus refused/export error: destination unset, not authorized, already exists, unavailable, or over byte bound.
Single mu guards records/released/config/closed/hooks; Handle/Poll/stop/Register/Unregister/Release serialize; PollInterval/CanStop/Default* read under lock.
UnregisterSurface seals active recordings for id, deletes owned copies keeping failures, zeroes ring if empty, then runs unregister hooks outside lock.
Close RemoveAll private RAM root only, never producer frames; ramFile enforces /dev/shm prefix, O_NOFOLLOW open, regular file, tmpfs magic or rejected.
Destination traversal uses pinned descriptors from / with O_NOFOLLOW|O_DIRECTORY; symlink races fail closed; grant dev/ino pin detects replacement.
MemoryBytes/RingBytes/MaxFPS bound all admissions; defaults from env are 64MiB/8MiB/30; BinDir from MV_SRF_BIN_DIR; Destination only from MV_RECORDING_DESTINATION.
Unconfigured Backend Start/Stop/Screenshot return recording authority unsupported; real capture uses capsule runner + cli Clock/ParseLine.
Abort silently drops active recording and owned copies for failed initial poll; Release tombstone means aborted id can never be reused.
process.go ProcessRunner launches the foreground view helper in its own process group and separates the one-line readiness announcement from completion.
view.go Manager bridges operator views without agent admission: one active view per capsule, busy guard, login-gated paste, validated stop receipts.
Start only accepts [srf-identity-surface view|login --container ID]; validates state dir before exec, waits 30s for first announcement line.
Run only allows srf-identity-surface view-stop|paste-text; rewrites argv[0] to BinDir join and delegates to bounded short runner.
Open(ctx,id,login) checks capsule, refuses when closed/views/busy, starts helper, parses announcement, registers view, reaps via Done watcher.
Stop runs view-stop and validates receipt; Paste demands 1..16384 valid UTF-8, login view, runs paste-text --file - and checks rune receipt.
Open: busy mark -> runner.Start -> parseInfo -> store active -> background Done deletes entry; finish clears busy and idle channel.
Announcement must parse ViewInfo with http URL host 127.0.0.1 valid port 1..65535 no user/fragment, Native non-empty, Socket absolute; else malformed_cli.
Stop receipt needs stopped_view==id, PID>1, seconds 0..60; Paste receipt needs container==id and pasted_runes==RuneCount(text); else malformed_cli.
Capsule ids match ^srf-(id|pg|vm)-[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,39}$; protected containers refused before any runner or state check.
Lifecycle: absent -> busy(opening) -> views[id] active -> busy(op) -> deleted on Stop/child-Done/Close; double open or op-while-busy refused.
announcementWriter captures only first newline line up to 65536 bytes; overflow sends nil; later output drained without retention; sent flag one-shot.
State dir must be absolute Clean==self, IsDir, no symlink, mode exactly 0700, uid==euid; whole path walked with O_NOFOLLOW from / so swap fails closed.
Start fails on protected container, usage/invalid command, cancelled ctx, bad state dir/owner, launch error, fast exit without line, 30s readiness deadline.
Fast helper may announce then exit before scheduler resumes: selects done branch yet still drains ready; missing line maps ExitError via ExitFault.
check fails on protected container, cancelled ctx, bad capsule id, nil runner; Open/Stop/Paste surface those as usage/configuration/refused faults.
Operator sees view unavailable or already registered when reopening same capsule, operating while busy, or after manager closed.
Agent sees paste refused as login view required when targeting a non-login view, or usage error for empty/oversize/non-UTF8 text.
Operator sees view launch failed, private state directory required/owner mismatch, exited before announcement, or readiness deadline after 30s hang.
Helper owns dedicated process group; Cancel sends SIGINT, WaitDelay 15s lets read-only restore finish; waiter always follows with SIGKILL then cancel/reap.
Close marks closed, cancels manager ctx (cancels starts), closes each child, waits for busy idle up to 5s; Done watcher cleans exited views under lock.
Never derive PIDs from stdout; killGroup validates pid>1 and !=self/pgrp, maps ESRCH to ErrProcessDone; parent pid reuse cannot signal wrong group.
One Process per capsule held in views map with Close func; child stdout/stderr not retained; Close reaps all; idle channel tracks busy drain.
Trusted host env only: PATH/HOME/XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/MV_SRF_STATE_DIR plus 3 SRF_* keys; BinDir from MV_SRF_BIN_DIR; state dir split out of child env.
Short commands share capsule.NewProcessRunner(root,env,64K,1min); long Start uses exec directly; faults via cli.Fault/ExitFault/ParseLine 64K.
WithoutCancel detaches child lifetime from caller cancel except explicit paths; manager AfterFunc ties startCtx to manager Close to avoid orphan helpers.
Local offline build bootstrap: runs ui/test/nesting.test.js with node --test, then execs ui/tools/package.js. Dependencies are preinstalled and all build inputs are local per header comment.
Invoked as bash script with no arguments. Control enters via environment: MV_PKG_OUT, CAPSULE_UI_KIT_REPO required; MV_ELECTRON_ZIP_DIR or ELECTRON_OVERRIDE_DIST_PATH required; MV_NODE_BIN optional.
Derives root from BASH_SOURCE parent, resolves node_bin from MV_NODE_BIN or node, runs nesting test file under root, then exec replaces process with package.js. No output file written here.
Requires MV_PKG_OUT external output dir and CAPSULE_UI_KIT_REPO pinned kit checkout set; requires one of MV_ELECTRON_ZIP_DIR or ELECTRON_OVERRIDE_DIST_PATH to locate local Electron files.
set -euo pipefail holds: unset variable, failing command, or pipe failure aborts. : ${VAR:?msg} asserts required vars before any work.
If MV_PKG_OUT unset/empty, shell exits non-zero with 'Set an external build output directory'. Same pattern for CAPSULE_UI_KIT_REPO with 'Set the pinned kit checkout'.
If both MV_ELECTRON_ZIP_DIR and ELECTRON_OVERRIDE_DIST_PATH empty/unset, prints 'Set MV_ELECTRON_ZIP_DIR or ELECTRON_OVERRIDE_DIST_PATH to local Electron files' to stderr and exits 1.
If node --test nesting.test.js fails, set -e stops run so package.js never executes. If package.js fails, exec exit status propagates as script exit status.
User sees immediate shell error naming the missing variable, or 'Set MV_ELECTRON_ZIP_DIR...' message, or node test failures, with no package produced. No log file is written.
Depends on node runtime, root/ui/test/nesting.test.js, root/ui/tools/package.js. No network or install step exists here.
Final exec replaces shell process; traps/handlers after it never run. Pipefail plus -u makes stray empty env values fatal rather than silently defaulted.
Runs two node processes sequentially, not concurrently. Second process inherits the first process image via exec, so only one lives at a time.
Judge installer/runner for MetaViewer: doctor checks only, install provisions app plus optional browser capsule (T2), run launches app, stop terminates app and removes leftover capsule state.
Launch path builds a sanitized env -i allowlist, prepares recordings/state/RAM dirs, then starts MetaViewer-linux binary with --ozone-platform=x11 and tracks child via run/metaviewer.pid.
Entry is metaviewer-judge.sh doctor|install|run|stop [--capsules] [--yes] [--no-firewall]. Invalid subcommand or flag calls usage which prints JUDGE_USAGE and exits 64.
Assets come from KIT/assets or MV_JUDGE_ASSET_DIR; missing names are listed with RELEASE_BASE URL, confirmed, fetched with curl --proto =https, then every named asset is hash-checked before use.

Receipt judge_receipt.json records schema, version, tier, arch, network_mode, node_version, docker version, smoke marker, profile_id, measured nproc/mem/shm facts, asset name-to-sha256 map; no timestamp, pid or host path.
Every asset must match kit SHA256SUMS entry from sums_digest. Mismatch fails JUDGE_ASSET; files this run downloaded are deleted. SHA256SUMS itself ships in kit and is never downloaded.
Tarballs must have no absolute paths, no .. members, match expected name regex, and contain only regular files/dirs (no links). App tarball must yield executable MetaViewer-linux-<arch>/metaviewer.
sudo only via sudo_step which prints description and exact quoted command, then confirm asks; --yes is the only non-interactive consent. Returns 0 ok, 99 declined, 98 sudo missing, else command rc.
All refusals print JUDGE_<CODE>: <problem> -- fix: <command> to stderr and exit 2. Usage errors print JUDGE_USAGE and exit 64. Identity store contents are never read.
Node path: reuse JUDGE_HOME/node or PATH node if major>=24, else unpack only */bin/node from node-linux tarball. Wrong major fails JUDGE_NODE requiring Node 24 asset.
Smoke requires PKG_TOOL present, --verify-install passes, then 600s timeout --smoke passes and prints METAVIEWER_MAIN_SMOKE_OK. Else JUDGE_SMOKE with last 3 log lines.
Run fails JUDGE_NOT_INSTALLED when APP_BIN not executable or receipt absent; fails JUDGE_RUNNING when running_pid finds live metaviewer pid. Stop-then-run is the fix.
Stop waits STOP_WAIT seconds after SIGTERM polling every 0.2s; overtime fails JUDGE_STOP_TIMEOUT. Any leftover container/socket/RAM/admission item prints JUDGE_STOP_LEAK and exits 2.

User sees confirmation prompts for downloads and each administrator step, JUDGE_NOTE lines for firewall fallback/decline, JUDGE_INSTALL_OK, JUDGE_DOCTOR_OK, METAVIEWER_MAIN_SMOKE_OK, JUDGE_STOP_CLEAN, or typed JUDGE_* fix lines.
Liveness is pidfile value plus kill -0 plus /proc pid cmdline containing metaviewer. run traps TERM/INT/HUP to forward SIGTERM to child and waits in kill -0 loop; install refuses while running.

Depends on preflight.sh facts/checks, node package.js tool, docker for T2, srf-identity-surface for capsule stop/capabilities, iptables/ip6tables/systemctl plus kit firewall files for open mode, AppArmor parser when userns restricted.
Read-only host readiness checker emitting typed JUDGE_<CODE> refusals (exit 2) or JUDGE_PREFLIGHT_OK. Never installs, writes, or escalates; sudo is never called.
Facts path reads meminfo, /dev/shm availability, node --version, arch, nproc, and open_ready to emit arch/nproc/mem_total_kib/mem_available_kib/shm_avail_bytes/node_version/network lines.
Sysdep path maps required tools to apt packages (base plus docker.io for T2) and lists missing package names once each for the installer to consume.

Phase static checks host facts installer cannot fix (os/arch/bundle_arch/xdg/shm plus T2 ram/cpuset/docker/net/disk). Phase all adds node/sysdep/userns/display and T2 image/net/profile/ram_stale checks.
Kit must contain metaviewer-linux-<host-arch>.tar.gz; only-other-arch kit fails JUDGE_BUNDLE_ARCH. Installed ELF e_machine must equal 62 (x64) or 183 (arm64) else counted and refused.
refuse increments FAILS and prints JUDGE_CODE: problem -- fix: command. Final FAILS>0 prints JUDGE_PREFLIGHT_FAIL tier/phase/count exit 2, else JUDGE_PREFLIGHT_OK.
Unknown uname -m fails JUDGE_ARCH directing to x86_64/aarch64 64-bit Linux only.
Missing node or major<24 fails JUDGE_NODE pointing at judge install for Node 24 from kit.
Any missing tool in SYSDEP_BASE (plus docker for T2) fails JUDGE_SYSDEP with sudo apt-get install -y <pkgs> fix.
When apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=1 and profile differs from kit apparmor/metaviewer, fails JUDGE_USERNS; fix is judge install, never --no-sandbox.
With xdpyinfo present: empty DISPLAY fails JUDGE_DISPLAY (Wayland-only vs no session distinguished); unreachable DISPLAY fails too with XWayland/xvfb-run fix.
SHM must be tmpfs with 512MiB free (T1) or 2.5GiB (T2); wrong fstype or low space fails JUDGE_SHM with mount/remount fix. MUT:JUDGE_SHM is deciding predicate.
Needs floor(total/4 capped at 20GiB)+4GiB available; shortfall fails JUDGE_RAM with close-apps/RAM/.wslconfig fix. Unreadable meminfo fails asking to mount /proc.
DOCKER_HOST/CONTEXT set fails JUDGE_DOCKER_HOST. docker info failure, rootless engine, or non-unix endpoint fails JUDGE_DOCKER; Docker Desktop fails JUDGE_DOCKER_DESKTOP.
Home and Docker-root free space each need 30GB else JUDGE_DISK with free-space/docker prune fix, reporting measured GB values.
Tester sees JUDGE_PREFLIGHT_OK tier/phase on success, or stderr JUDGE_<CODE>: ... -- fix: ... lines plus JUDGE_PREFLIGHT_FAIL count, and JUDGE_NOTE/JUDGE_OS warnings that do not fail.

Test seams: MV_JUDGE_PROC, MV_JUDGE_OS_RELEASE, MV_JUDGE_SHM_DIR, MV_JUDGE_CPUSET_FILE, MV_JUDGE_RUN_USER_ROOT, MV_JUDGE_APPARMOR_DIR, MV_JUDGE_FW_WITNESS, MV_JUDGE_REQUIRE_CPUSET, MV_RAM_ADMISSION_DIR, MV_JUDGE_KIT/ASSET/BIN/STORE/PROFILE/RAM_TOOL.
Open-network verdict needs firewall witness non-empty plus srf-identity-surface capabilities advertising open; image tags switch identity-browser 0.1.0 legacy vs 0.2.0 open.
Runs docker image inspect per required image; no locks or retries. capabilities probe is bounded by timeout 5.
Disk check walks up to first df-accepted parent for HOME and DockerRootDir. cidr_overlap uses integer IP math to compare host routes against reserved capsule ranges.
Offline volume entry: optionally checks workflow, prepares staged kit offline, then runs tests/e2e/run.py N times printing volume-e2e i/N PASS per iteration.
CLI argparse: --iterations 20|300 default 20, --prepare-only, --check-workflow. Reads .github/workflows/volume.yml for check mode, else prepare then loop subprocess run of tests/e2e/run.py.

prepare resolves kit, runs node tools/sync_kit.mjs, asserts node --version major>=24, npm ci --offline when vite missing, verifies electron 44.9.2 pin plus binary, stages dist from local zip when not executable, xvfb-runs electron --version.
Requires tests/e2e/run.py present else BLOCKED error; requires CAPSULE_UI_KIT_REPO or MV_KIT_CHECKOUT directory else E2E_PREREQ pinned kit absent. No fetch or checkout performed here.
Guards only volume-e2e job: strips comments/blank/name lines, then requires [ ! -f "$HARNESS" ], setup-node@, kit-checkout, npm ci, install_electron.cjs substrings else E2E_PREREQ workflow missing.
Missing npm packages only from cache (npm ci --offline --ignore-scripts). Electron only from locally supplied checksum-verified archive; unsafe absolute or .. zip paths rejected.
Absent run.py raises BLOCKED:... which main maps to exit 2; all other OSError/ValueError/RuntimeError/CalledProcessError print to stderr and exit 1.
Node version unparsable or major<24 raises E2E_PREREQ Node >=24. Electron package version !=44.9.2 raises pin mismatch; binary version output !=v44.9.2 raises binary mismatch.
Electron staging needs MV_ELECTRON_ZIP_DIR plus known arch else local archive required; checksum mismatch vs checksums.json, or existing dist present, raises E2E_PREREQ and aborts.
User sees E2E_PREREQ:... on stderr for offline violations, BLOCKED:... for missing harness, or per-iteration volume-e2e i/N PASS on stdout. prepare-only exits 0 after staging.
Iterations run sequentially via subprocess.run check=True in one process; first failing tests/e2e/run.py raises CalledProcessError and stops the loop.
Depends on node, npm cache, vite package, electron 44.9.2 dist, xvfb-run, local electron zip dir, pinned kit checkout, tests/e2e/run.py, volume.yml workflow file.
Env inputs: CAPSULE_UI_KIT_REPO, MV_KIT_CHECKOUT, MV_ELECTRON_ZIP_DIR. ROOT is parents[1] of this file. No network or toolchain install is configured.
Zip extraction chmods members from external_attr and forces electron 0755; incomplete dist is not overwritten but raises repair-explicitly error to avoid partial binary.

CLI: --lock, --deps-root, --timeout, --strict-head, --require-planner, --print-pins, --github-output. Print-pins validates and dumps JSON; github-output appends repo/commit/dir vars; else run_all_smokes.

deps.lock must be object with only components/schema_version, schema metaviewer.deps.lock/v1, non-empty components list, unique names, owner/name repo in allowlist, non-empty version, 40 lowercase hex commit, all three required components.
Checkout lookup tries deps_root/repo_basename then deps_root/name; both absent raises FileNotFoundError naming tried paths.
HEAD equal to pin reuses repo dir; else strict_head fails on mismatch, non-strict requires commit present via rev-parse --verify then materializes git archive tar into scratch tree dir.
Builds envelope/v0.2 carrying observation/v0.2 for 320x200 rgb24 surface cap-assembly-smoke01 with one button element, validating observation and envelope via agents library.

Planner stdout must be exactly one JSON line, no forbidden actuation keys, and one of {action,expectation,state,target_node} reply, envelope/v0.2 wrapping action_proposal/v0.2, or bare action_proposal/v0.2.
All JSON parses use duplicate-key rejecting hook; duplicate deps.lock or planner keys raise ValueError instead of silent last-wins.
