Any nested actuated/actuation/cdp/decision/executed/receipt/verdict/verification and related keys in planner output are rejected before acceptance.
Vision drives VCorePerceptionAdapter on synthetic 320x200 frames with two white rectangles; timeout, probe rc, bad JSON, or changed_regions != two expected boxes yields FAIL with detail.
Wender imports all WENDER_PUBLIC_ENTRYPOINTS, builds button state and validates digest; import failure or planner check failure yields FAIL. Absent planner is SKIP unless --require-planner.

Planner runs python -m wender.plan.cli with PYTHONPATH tree+agents, feeding observation/table/goal JSON; non-zero rc or invalid proposal returns False plus message; viewport/click-box/actionable checks enforced.
Requires go on PATH, builds srf-identity-surface and srf-holdings-capsule, checks capabilities banner, then runs daemon-adapter go tests with MV_E2E_LIVE=1; any step failure yields FAIL.
Duplicate component result, non-PASS status, or missing required component forces all_ok False and appends FAIL <req>: missing smoke result. Planner SKIP note adds extra SKIP line.
User sees PASS <component>: <detail> or FAIL <component>: <detail> lines, plus FAIL deps.lock: ... on lock errors. Planner SKIP prints literal SKIP (planner not pinned yet).
Planner request derives element_table via project_element_table from validated observation and goal ok, rejecting non-canonical table/goal before sending.
Each smoke returns frozen SmokeResult component/status/detail/duration_ms/planner_note; PASS requires exact expected regions, proposal verification, or go build plus tests all succeeding.
Smokes run sequentially in REQUIRED_COMPONENTS order sharing one TemporaryDirectory scratch root; each step bounded by timeout_s via subprocess timeout.
Default 60s per smoke step; vision adapter clamps to 1..60s. Scratch archive dirs named tree-<name>-<12hex>, plus srf-bin and 0700 srf-state dirs under temp root.
Vision expectation is exact pixel boxes; adapter or engine threshold drift fails even when detection is close. Planner click must land inside target box and target must be actionable.
Standalone AC-14 RSS gate: --self-test runs offline manifest matrix, --receipt evaluates a receipt, --probe measures built shell via rss_probe.mjs plus orphan audit and prints JSON summary.
Mutually exclusive --self-test|--receipt PATH|--probe, optional --electron and --exclude-pid-file. Loads tests/perf/budgets.json, writes GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY when set, exit 0/1/2 by result.

Budgets file must have exact keys, schema metaviewer.perf.rss-budgets/v1, 1280x900 viewport, sampleMs 5000/gate 120000/exit 600000, 4 rows with frozen bounds (main 200M, renderer 370M, tree 1150M, utility 260M) and gating only for CAPS keys.

Receipt needs rss-receipt/v1 schema, exact WORKLOAD ready/resize/reload/terminal-toggle/shutdown, empty orphans, duration>=gate, >=6 increasing samples within bounds, maxima over CAPS decide failures.

Probe launches electron rss_probe.mjs with MV_RSS_OUTPUT/PROFILE/EXCLUDES env in temp dir via bounded 180s helper from gate.sh, reads receipt, maps sample process roles, audits /proc identities, attaches argv and sandbox env.
Orphan role prefers recorded sample role, then main pid match, then --type=renderer/utility cmdline match, then comm name, else helper. Zombie state Z entries are ignored, not orphans.
All JSON loads reject nonfinite constants and duplicate keys. integer() requires exact int type and minimum, so bool/float/str never pass as counts or bounds.

Any ValueError/TypeError/KeyError returns ok False with failure string: bad schema/workload/orphans/duration, short cohort, clock regression, missing role, tree<sum(parts), late first/final sample, >10s gap, or cap exceedance.
Probe requires electron file, integer capsule-root pids, valid grace/poll; probe child rc!=0 raises. Orphan grace loop polls /proc stat starttime match until empty or ORPHAN_GRACE_MS 5000 expiry.
Self-test compares each manifest receipt verdict to expected_ok; always-under/always-over controls must each mismatch at least one case else counted failed.
User sees one JSON summary with passed/failed/skipped/source plus result/receipt or error. Live probe failures name probe child rc, missing binary, or orphan evidence blocking the gate.
Post-exit grace 5000ms polled every 100ms lets helpers tear down before declaring orphans; elapsed_ms recorded as orphan_grace_ms in receipt.
Frozen byte caps: rss_main 200M, rss_renderer 370M, rss_tree 1150M decimal bytes. Explicit capsule roots exclude complete subtrees via MV_RSS_EXCLUDES list.
Reuses gate.sh cleanup primitives descendants/process_identity/stop_process_tree/bounded by AST-extracting those FunctionDefs and execing them; absent primitive raises.
Assembles changes/unreleased/<slug>.md bullet fragments into CHANGELOG.md after existing Unreleased bullets, sorted by filename, deleting consumed fragments idempotently.
CLI --root default repo root with mutually exclusive --check or --dry-run. Check exits non-zero when malformed or pending; dry-run prints assembled text without writing/deleting.
Reads CHANGELOG.md UTF-8, collects fragments, inserts all bullets via insert_bullets_into_changelog, writes file and unlinks consumed fragments unless check/dry-run or no fragments.
Filename must match lowercase [a-z0-9-]+.md; body must be valid UTF-8, non-empty, every non-blank line a - bullet with content, each line <=1000 chars, no forbidden AI-attribution substrings.
Skips .gitkeep; symlink or non-regular file, unreadable file, or any single fragment error aborts whole run with errors. Entries sorted by name by default.
Requires ## [Unreleased] heading else ValueError. Inserts after last Unreleased bullet, or blank-line plus bullets directly under heading when none; preserves trailing newline.
Missing/unreadable/non-UTF8 CHANGELOG.md returns rc 1 with message. Fragment errors return rc 1 with list. Check mode returns rc 1 naming pending count/names when fragments exist or text differs.
User sees ERROR: ... lines on stderr for each violation, dry-run assembled changelog on stdout, silent success otherwise. Pending fragments block check mode.

Max line 1000 chars chosen above longest existing 621-char bullet. FORBIDDEN list blocks co-authored-by/generated with/claude/anthropic/chatgpt/openai/gpt-/gemini/codex/copilot/muse spark/llama/assistant/ai-generated case-insensitively.
States: no fragments -> rc 0 unchanged; check/dry-run -> rc plus output no write; normal with fragments -> write then delete; any error -> rc 1 no write.
ROOT is parents[1] of tool; changelog at ROOT/CHANGELOG.md, fragments at ROOT/changes/unreleased. SLUG_RE, UNRELEASED_RE, MAX_LINE_LENGTH constants govern validation.
Only stdlib argparse/pathlib/re/sys. No network or external tool; caller must ensure CHANGELOG.md and changes/unreleased directory exist.

One bad fragment blocks all assembly and no fragments are consumed. Successful write deletes every consumed fragment, so rerun is empty; interrupted write may leave changelog updated but fragments present.
check_contracts.py is fail-closed validator for documented contract schema subset; audits schemas, validates valid and invalid examples, enforces versioned coverage and frame drift checks.
main handles help flags, otherwise calls check_repository with defaults, prints ERROR lines to stderr, prints Contracts check OK on success, returns error presence as exit status.
check_repository builds one Validator per supported version, scans contracts version schema files and contracts examples layout, requiring valid plus invalid examples per schema.
loads_strict parses raw JSON with duplicate-key and invalid-constant rejection, then runs _finite check for nonfinite floats, lone surrogates and nesting limit 100.
Validator.load accepts only sibling schema filenames without slashes or parent markers, resolves under directory, rejects escapes, caches parsed schema by resolved path.
Validator.resolve splits ref at hash, loads sibling file when filename present, follows only defs pointers with tilde unescaping, otherwise raises reference errors.
Validator.validate recurses through $ref then type, const, enum, oneOf, object, array, string and number branches, threading root schema, JSON path and depth counter.
Audit tracks active schema ids plus depth to reject cyclic schema or nesting beyond 100; validate tracks depth to reject reference nesting beyond 100.
Value invariant enforced by _finite: finite numbers only, no lone surrogates, dict keys and list items checked recursively with nesting cap 100.
Object schema invariant: additionalProperties must be false; properties must be object; required must list unique declared properties; schema-bearing objects must require versioned schema const.
Schema identity contract: $id must equal versioned prefix plus filename, $schema must equal draft URI, title must be nonempty string; only KEYWORDS and TYPES allowed.

Field bounds contract: schema const must match versioned pattern; numeric minimum and maximum within safe rails, length and count ceilings at 65536; low and high pairs must not invert; pattern must compile.

Audit failure path: unsupported keyword or type, missing additionalProperties false, bad properties and required, bad enum and oneOf and defs and items shape raises ValidationError and records versioned file error.

Validate failure path: type, const, enum, oneOf exactly-one-branch rule, missing required, unexpected properties, item count, string length, pattern and number bounds each raise path-prefixed ValidationError.
Special terminal failure path: terminal session versioned data and write values with string b64 and integer byte count compare declared count against base64-derived length and fail on mismatch.
Visible symptom: tester sees ERROR lines for failing schema or example and nonzero exit; passing run prints Contracts check OK message listing audited schemas and accepted and rejected examples.

Strict-input symptom: duplicate keys, invalid constants, nonfinite numbers, surrogates, nesting overflow, unresolved references and cyclic schemas each surface as ValidationError text identifying the cause.
Resource limits: per-directory Validator cache, recursion caps at 100, string UTF-8 byte cap at 65536, count and length ceilings at 65536.
Config: ROOT defaults to repository root above tools; SUPPORTED_VERSIONS lists v0.1 and v0.2; BASE is versioned contract URL; versions argument must be deduplicated tuple of supported strings.
Dependency: standard library only json, math, pathlib, re, sys; reads schema and example files from disk; no network or subprocess.

Hazard in string patterns: trailing dollar anchor is rewritten to end-of-string token and slash-rooted patterns reject carriage-return and newline to mirror Rust decoder; any divergence breaks parity.

Hazard in v0.2 strictness: variant_coverage requires whole-document positives to witness every enum member, oneOf branch, property, items and $ref target; inline_frame_def strips metadata for frame drift comparison, any gap is error.
check_laws.py checks repository commit identity and message laws plus version and changelog fragment laws using only standard library.
main parses range, message-file, version and check-ident modes, dispatches to history, message, version or ident checks, prints ERROR lines to stderr, prints Laws check OK on success.
check_history lists revisions by rev-list, checks identity plus message per revision, then enforces changelog rules only for full hex revisions selected by enforced-revisions filter.
git helper runs git subprocess in ROOT; check_history splits show output on separator into author, committer and message fields, then applies identity and message validators.
check_commit_changelog runs git diff-tree name-status for a revision, fetches fragment blobs with git show, delegates path and content validation to check_changelog_changes.
Identity invariant: author and committer name and email must equal configured NAME and EMAIL pair; ident strings must match name, email, timestamp and timezone shape.

Message invariant: subject capped at 72 chars, must match allowed SCOPES plus colon plus imperative verb, verb must belong to VERBS set, whole message scanned case-insensitively for FORBIDDEN substrings.
Version invariant: VERSION must match SEMVER, CHANGELOG must contain matching release section, unreleased fragment directory is validated when present.
Fragment invariant: filename must be lowercase slug, content must be valid UTF-8 and nonempty, every nonempty line must be dash-space bullet, line length capped at 1000 chars, no forbidden words.
Vocabulary contract: SCOPES names product areas, VERBS bounds allowed imperative verbs, FORBIDDEN blocks co-authorship and model attribution phrases to keep history human-attributed.
Product-path contract: is_product_code_path strips leading dots and slashes, excludes named non-product files and prefixed docs, changes, catalogue, router, tests and hook directories.

Changelog contract: fragment enforcement flag plus direct-edit allowance with environment override; product-code change requires active fragment path, direct CHANGELOG accepted only during transition.
Identity and message failure path: forbidden pattern, overlong subject, bad scope shape or unsupported verb, identity mismatch each emit revision-prefixed error strings.

Fragment failure path: bad fragment path, symlink or non-regular file, invalid encoding, empty file, non-bullet line, overlong line, forbidden word, or missing fragment on product change each emit path-prefixed errors.
Infrastructure failure path: invalid semantic version, missing changelog section, unreadable fragment, or git subprocess failure collapse into cannot complete laws check error.
Visible symptom: user sees ERROR lines naming revision and rule on stderr with nonzero exit; clean tree prints Laws check OK.
No concurrency: sequential git subprocess calls, no locks, retries or timers; each revision checked in loop order.
Config: ROOT is repository root above tools; enforcement base pins first fragment-aware commit; fragment path pattern requires changes unreleased slug with lowercase alphanumerics and dashes.
Dependency: standard library only argparse, os, pathlib, re, subprocess, sys; reads VERSION, CHANGELOG, fragment files and git history; no network.
check_theme.py is offline G-THEME gate: verifies token to CSS parity, contrast usage matrix and system font stacks, rejects bundled fonts and generated drift.
main accepts root defaulting above tools, calls check, prints PASS with pair count on success or error text to stderr with nonzero exit.
check scans interface source, public, distribution and root distribution trees for bundled font extensions and fails closed on any match.
css_name projects token path to CSS variable by camel-to-kebab conversion, dot-to-dash replacement and lowercasing with metaviewer prefix.
Declarations parser extracts CSS variables from rule bodies; block selector lookup requires exactly one match for base root and per-scheme normal-contrast roots.
resolve_css follows var chains with visited-set cycle detection; resolve_token walks token tree then brace references and per-mode values with cycle detection.
Scheme loop checks both light and dark public schemes by mapping to underlying token modes, merging base root values with normal-contrast overrides before resolution.
Matrix invariant: contrastPairs must be nonempty list of dicts with exactly foreground and background nonempty string members, otherwise invalid matrix error.
Parity invariant: every matrix token path must resolve identically in token file and generated CSS case-insensitively, otherwise generated CSS differs error.
Contrast contract: every matrix pair plus explicit CSS and Vue color and background pairs must reach threshold ratio 4.5 to one using relative luminance formula.
Font contract: sans stack must start with system-ui and mono stack with ui-monospace and equal token stacks; any woff, woff2, ttf or otf under scanned trees is bundled-font failure.
Font failure path: bundled font match raises G-PKG error with repository-relative path; scan covers source, public and distribution outputs.
Resolution failure path: missing or ambiguous selector, unresolved or cyclic CSS token, cyclic token, unresolved colour, empty or invalid matrix each raise ValueError naming the token.
Theme failure path: contrast below threshold raises G-THEME scheme pair ratio error; CSS and token mismatch and non-system font stack raise descriptive errors.
Visible symptom: designer sees PASS with measured pair count or single error line describing failing pair, token, selector or font path.

Explicit-pair flow scans source CSS and Vue files except canonical CSS, strips comments, extracts co-occurring color and background variables per rule, normalizes alternate prefix, adds to checked pairs.
Resource accounting: check returns total checked pairs across both schemes; inputs are two design files plus recursive source scan, all bounded to interface tree.
Dependency: standard library only argparse, json, pathlib, re, sys; reads tokens JSON and CSS files; no network or rendering engine.

Hazard in coverage: comment stripping and first-media split plus exact selector match control parsing; unlisted inheritance is covered conservatively by surface combinations, new explicit pairs fail without matrix update.

Gate is the release/CI admission orchestrator: it pins manifests, release versions, dependency closures and frozen offline resolution, then runs laws/contracts/unit/agents/js/rust/go/ui/ui-smoke/perf legs and aggregates PASS/BLOCKED/FAIL.

Bash parses argv into selector: no args=skeleton, --self-test, or --leg <leg>; any other arity/value prints Usage to stderr and exits 2. Valid legs are skeleton|laws|contracts|unit|agents|manifests|js|rust|go|ui|ui-smoke|perf|self-test.

After selector checks, script resolves repo root from BASH_SOURCE, requires python3, sets PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and execs embedded Python main(); missing python3 prints BLOCKED <selector> plus BLOCKED aggregate and exits 2.

main() requires bash/python3/timeout/mktemp on PATH, installs SIGTERM/SIGINT handlers, then runs inside private_environment(); self-test runs GateTests, otherwise runs leaf() for each leg in LEAVES or the single selector and prints PASS/BLOCKED/FAIL per leg plus aggregate.

Per-leg rc maps via status(): 0=PASS, 2=BLOCKED, else FAIL. Aggregate over legs picks first present in order 124,2,1 else 0 and prints PASS aggregate or FAIL aggregate; skeleton runs manifests,laws,contracts,unit,agents plus js/rust/go/ui/ui-smoke/perf.

VERSION must be non-empty and identical in Cargo.toml workspace.package.version, Cargo.lock metaviewer-core, agents/pyproject.toml, ui/package.json, ui/package-lock.json; core/Cargo.toml must use version.workspace=true. Drift raises InvalidMetadata and fails manifests.

ui/package.json dependencies and devDependencies must exactly equal DEPENDENCIES/DEV_DEPENDENCIES pins (vue 3.5.43, electron 44.9.2, vite 8.3.4, etc.); caret/tilde/range, version change, unapproved entry, or incomplete closure fails manifests.

Rust tables allow only serde,serde_json,sha2,libc,tokio plus proptest in dev-dependencies; each version must be exact =X.Y.Z with optional features/optional/default-features; path/git or unlisted crate fails.

Cargo.toml workspace must be resolver 2, members [core], edition 2021, publish false, rust-version 1.97, release overflow-checks true; go.mod must be module metaviewer/daemon-adapter with go 1.26.0; scripts/check/build and private/type/main/engines are pinned.

Frozen resolution is verified only in disposable manifest-only trees: cargo metadata --offline --locked --filter-platform <rustc host> and npm ci --offline --ignore-scripts --dry-run; no installs, scripts, network, or repo writes are admitted.

validate_release_locks() collects workspace members plus tracked Cargo.lock files via git ls-files --cached -z (or only root lock without .git); every local metaviewer-core/member version must equal VERSION, else LOCK_VERSION_DRIFT/LOCK_METADATA_ERROR.

.gitignore must retain all ORIGINAL_IGNORE and REQUIRED_IGNORE lines (dist/,build/,coverage/,.env,*.key,auth.json,tokens,cookies/,profiles/) and must not exclude VERSION,deps.lock,Cargo.toml,locks,go.sum; violation fails manifests.
manifests leg runs under SIGALRM 300s guard via manifest_timeout; TimeoutError/subprocess.TimeoutExpired prints manifests: timeout rc 124; OSError/ValueError/TypeError message yields rc 1.

If a required target file/dir is absent, leaf() prints missing target: <name> and returns 2 (BLOCKED) for manifests/laws/contracts/unit/js/rust/go/ui-smoke/ui/perf, except agents absence returns 1 (FAIL). Child nonzero prints <leg>: child rc=<rc>.

Unit/agents legs reject vacuous success: zero tests, failing test, skipped, expectedFailure, unexpectedSuccess, ImportError/SystemExit all map to FAIL (rc 1) or BLOCKED (rc 2 for empty selection); printed PASS text without witness file does not pass.

User sees one line per leg PASS <leg> or FAIL <leg> or BLOCKED <leg> plus final PASS/FAIL aggregate. Failures add diagnostics on stderr: metadata drift, pin drift, stale lock, frozen offline resolution failed, child rc, missing tool/target, marker=False, SKIPPED reason.

Timeouts print timeout: <argv> and yield rc 124, timeout manifests: timeout, or child rc=124 lines; missing runner prints BLOCKED <leg>: missing bash/python3/timeout/mktemp; missing toolchain prints BLOCKED with missing tool or pinned formatter unavailable.

bounded() spawns with start_new_session plus MV_SUBREAPER_TOKEN, waits seconds (default 300, 600 for live probe), returns 124 on TimeoutExpired, then stop_process_tree() SIGTERM then SIGKILL only pids in recorded child tree/session, never caller group or pid<=1.

descendants() walks /proc stat parent/children plus session/process-group and token matching to avoid killing later siblings; subreaper_scope() reference-counts prctl child-subreaper so reparented setsid grandchildren are reaped without leaking prior state.

private_environment() creates mktemp -d 0700 with isolated TMPDIR/XDG_CONFIG_HOME/XDG_CACHE_HOME/XDG_DATA_HOME/XDG_RUNTIME_DIR and strips LD_PRELOAD/LD_LIBRARY_PATH/NODE_OPTIONS/PYTHONPATH/BASH_ENV/RUSTFLAGS and wrappers; dirs are removed on exit.

Cargo builds use CARGO_TARGET_DIR or TMPDIR/cargo-target; Go tests use short /tmp/g-* TMPDIR for socket paths; ui-smoke spools bounded output to temp file; npm ci preserves electron dist via ELECTRON_OVERRIDE_DIST_PATH copy.

Build legs require rustup run 1.92.0 cargo fmt plus cargo clippy, cargo test --locked --offline; ui requires node major >=24, npm ci offline, node --test, vue-tsc --noEmit, vite build; go requires go vet/test with GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local plus cross-arch vet/compile.

Env controls: MV_GATE_PERF_LIVE=1 enables live Electron RSS probe; MV_KIT_CHECKOUT/CAPSULE_UI_KIT_REPO selects kit checkout; ELECTRON_OVERRIDE_DIST_PATH, ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE, RUSTUP/CARGO/GO/NODE/NPM/VUE_TSC/VITE overrides must be executable paths, never shell fragments.

js leg requires MV_KIT_CHECKOUT checkout else kit absent FAIL; runs node tools/sync_kit.mjs then node tools/sync_kit.mjs --check under 300s deadline. perf always runs budget_gate self-test/offline receipt checks and proc_fields test before optional live probe.

ui-smoke requires node, executable <dist>/electron, and xvfb-run; runs test/smoke.mjs expecting METAVIEWER_SMOKE_OK then test/smoke-main.mjs expecting METAVIEWER_MAIN_SMOKE_OK; zero exit without exact marker line is FAIL.

Untracked build trees are never enumerated: manifest locks use git index or root lock only; frozen checks copy only manifests+stub lib.rs into temp dirs; GateTests copy only pinned files into fixtures and isolate CARGO_TARGET_DIR per invocation.

tools/gate_g_ai.py is a local-only G-AI assertion runner. It executes gates A1-A8 against a live surface and prints one canonical JSON receipt to stdout. Success is rc 0 status DONE; any failed assertion ends BLOCKED rc 5 with cleanup.

Entry is main(argv) with --surface mv-live-1 (only choice) and optional --receipt-out. It builds a receipt schema metaviewer.g-ai-receipt/v1 with assertions A1-A8 false and empty negative_controls, then runs preflight and run_gate.

run_gate flow: session_factory Session observe -> checked_frame -> VCorePerceptionAdapter.perceive -> raw_description/project_element_table -> wender_state twice -> local_plan or bridge plan -> build_proposal -> controls -> propose -> dispatch -> wait_verify -> post frame/state checks -> stale propose -> canvas.

canonical(value) is json.dumps with sort_keys, separators (,,:), ensure_ascii False, allow_nan False. Receipts, shim input, and Wender state equality all compare via this byte form; Wender output must round-trip with stdout.strip equal to canonical(state).

require(condition,detail) raises GateFailure code assertion_failed when false. Every gate uses it, so a failed condition aborts the run, lands in report error code/detail, and still runs session cleanup before printing BLOCKED.

rejected(call,exceptions,code) returns True only if call raises one of the expected exceptions with matching code attribute. If no exception or wrong code, it raises GateFailure negative_control_accepted for mutated evidence passing its gate.

checked_frame calls tools._check_frame, requires ramws_path resolves relative to /dev/shm, then hashes vcore._ramws_frame pixels. Digest mismatch raises PerceptionError bad_shape. Used for pre and after frames; failure blocks A2 or post verification.

Assertions A1-A8 mark stages: A1 preflight deps, A2 frame, A3 perception/table, A4 Wender state, A5 target/plan, A6 admission, A7 execution, A8 change receipt. main requires all true plus full negative controls and cleanup proof before DONE.

wender_state runs [python -c SHIM] with cwd root, env only PATH and LANG plus PYTHONPATH=root and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, 30s timeout. Nonzero exit raises GateFailure wender_subprocess_failed with last 2000 chars of stderr. Output must parse and pass validate_state.

raw_description hashes the checked frame pixels, creates marks under /dev/shm/vqa-cu, passes the PNG via memfd to python -m vadapt.cu_describe --frame /proc/self/fd/N --marks-out marks.png --json with scrubbed env and pass_fds, 30s timeout. Failure raises vision_subprocess_failed.

local_plan picks first node in state actionable with a box that passes AdmittedExecutor.check_target against latest nodes and frame. It returns the target and a left click at box center x+w//2,y+h//2. No candidate raises no_actionable_target.

controls() runs 19 negative controls before the sole live mutation: path, digest, binding, float, validate, custody, policy, focus, timestamp, window and no-change probes. REQUIRED_NEGATIVE_CONTROLS is the exact 19-key set including A6_stale and vision/wender missing/pin keys.

check_negative_controls requires negative_controls is a dict whose keys equal REQUIRED_NEGATIVE_CONTROLS exactly and every value is True, else assertion_failed incomplete negative controls. Called inside run_gate and again in main.

Post-action path requires after sha256 differs from before, tick in [frame.tick+1, frame.tick+100], post state sha256 differs from pre_state_sha256, and post battery differs from pre battery. Violations raise post-action pixels/state did not change or tick outside window.

Stale-generation probe copies the proposal with proposal_id suffixed -stale and calls tools.propose. It must raise ToolRefusal with reason_code STALE_FRAME, recorded as A6_stale True. Any other outcome raises negative_control_accepted.

Cleanup proof requires report cleanup dict with ram_absent True and empty remaining. live_evidence copies session.report minus wire_evidence. Missing proof raises cleanup proof missing and keeps the receipt BLOCKED.

Receipt write uses NamedTemporaryFile in receipt_out parent plus fsync and os.replace, then unlink missing_ok. OSError rewrites the report to rc 5 BLOCKED with receipt_write_failed. Stdout always prints the canonical report; return value is report rc.

User sees no DONE receipt: stdout is a BLOCKED receipt with rc 5 and error code such as assertion_failed, negative_control_accepted, wender_subprocess_failed, vision_subprocess_failed, no_actionable_target, or cleanup proof missing, plus detail text.

tools/mv_demo.py guards operator demonstration custody and offline MemoryWeb validation. record captures a native view to RAM then seals a private evidence dir; prompt renders a template; check validates an untrusted site copy without following links.

Entry is main(argv) with verbs record --identity --demo, prompt --demo --site, and check --site. Success prints schema metaviewer.demo/v1 ok true; any Refused, ForbiddenVerb, OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, TimeoutExpired or KeyboardInterrupt prints ok false error DEMO_REFUSED with exit 6.

record checks identity and demo, resolves home and tool paths, shows identity, reads an active lease, launches srf-identity-surface view --login --record, waits for announce, exports RAM/demo to evidence, then discards the RAM copy and returns evidence path plus digests.

identifier requires DEMO [a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,39} and SITE [a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63} full match, else Refused INVALID_ID. need(ok,code) raises Refused(code) on false; many gates use it for custody checks.

private_tree absolutizes a path, rejects .. parts and any symlink in the path or parents. evidence_root, export_demo, discard_ram, record, prompt and check all gate every directory through it before touching files.

read_regular opens with O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK, requires regular file owned by caller uid within size limit, then reads limit+1 bytes and enforces RECORDING_CAPACITY. Guards events.jsonl, README, frames, leases and digests against links, dirs and oversize data.
strict_json parses with object_pairs_hook that rejects DUPLICATE_JSON_KEY. Used for event rows, leases, announcements and digests so duplicated keys refuse instead of silently winning.

validate_events requires 1-501 newline rows each at most 4096 bytes, exact seq order, nondecreasing mono_ns, known kind, window wN or empty, modifier set, text_len rules, keysym allowlist, before/after frame names, int coords, dir set, and a final stop row with operator/limit/recorder_exited reason.

Admitted keys are raw X names: Return, Tab, Prior, Next, KP_Enter and similar plus F1-F35 and XF86 names. Bare a-zA-Z0-9 and punctuation in CHORD_KEYS are admitted only inside ctrl/alt/super chords; KP digits stay refused because the recorder reads level 0.

Text custody: only kind text may carry text_len 1-4096; other rows with text_len get RECORDING_TEXT_LEAK. Non-printable Prior/Next are admitted while KP navigation names refuse. Unknown keysym or chord violation raises RECORDING_TEXT_LEAK or INVALID_RECORDING.

Known names are events.jsonl, README.md, [0-9]+_(before|after).png and final.png or final_wN.png. export_demo refuses any other RAM entry with UNSAFE_RECORDING and requires events.jsonl, README.md and at least one final file.

drop_missing_frames removes before/after references whose file the recorder never wrote, since the after name is reserved 600ms before capture. Changed payload is revalidated; rows without dangling names keep exact bytes.

export_demo caps README at 32768, events.jsonl at 524288, frames at 33MB each and 1GB total, validates events twice around drop_missing_frames, overwrites README with fixed private text, requires every referenced frame exists, writes files 0600 plus digests.json, and removes the dest on failure.

record requires an active lease whose holder matches CAPSULE, a fresh evidence path and absent RAM/demo. The native announce must be a dict with http URL on loopback without userinfo or control chars, else NATIVE_VIEW_INVALID. Nonzero child rc raises RECORD_FAILED.

The recorder child runs with stdin DEVNULL, piped stdout and new session. KeyboardInterrupt forwards SIGINT and waits 180s; finally it SIGINTs a live child, waits, then kills. Stdout is closed after export so no native output escapes.

prompt and check first pass admitted_home, which reuses the git-ignore/tracking/profile gate including check_home. authoring_checkout requires MV_MEMORYWEB_REPO set and four marker files plus templates/site, else MEMORYWEB_REPO_REQUIRED or MEMORYWEB_FORMAT_MISSING.

prompt revalidates digests.json schema and per-file sha256 up to 32MB, requires events/README/final presence, revalidates events, then substitutes @EVIDENCE@, @SITE_DIR@, @DEMO@ and @VALIDATE@ into the AUTOMATE_FROM_DEMO template, refusing values with backticks or newlines.

copy_site copies an untrusted site without following links: depth at most 12, files at most 8192, bytes at most 128MB, no devices/sockets/FIFOs, dest dirs 0700. Violations raise SITE_CAPACITY or UNSAFE_SITE.

check resolves home and site root, distinguishes home vs builtin origin, copies the site into a disposable memoryweb checkout sans .git/__pycache__, replaces sites/site, then runs tools/build_index.py --root twice with and without --check under -I with no stdio, 180s timeout. Nonzero raises MEMORYWEB_CHECK_FAILED.

Operator sees DEMO_REFUSED on stdout with ok false and exit 6 when ids, paths, leases, recordings, digests, site bounds or the MemoryWeb build gate fail. No native output, event text, paths or exceptions escape; only that fixed error string is printed.

tools/mv_identity.py is operator-only browser identity custody; no profile payload is ever opened. Native admin has create/show only, list names metadata, delete uses the native per-id flock guard and lease record, and login/start remains operator work with explicit provisioning gates.

Entry is main(argv) with --store-root, --memoryweb-home and verbs create/list/show/status/delete/login/release. create needs --id --label plus --domains/--browser; release needs --holder. Success prints schema metaviewer.identity/v1 ok true; Refused and OS/subprocess errors print ok false error with exit 6.

checked_id requires ID [a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,39}. fresh_id adds operational plus reserved mv- and live-profile refusal; operational_id refuses foreign prefixes and protected holders; protected_identity matches mv- prefix or foreign/protected values for delete gating.

absolute requires absolute resolved paths; overlap rejects store root equal to or nested with REPO or memoryweb home with MUT-PROFILE-IN-REPO. private requires no symlink, directory/file kind match, caller uid ownership and no group/other bits, else UNSAFE_CONTROL_PATH.

native runs bin_dir binaries with DEVNULL stdin, capped 180s timeout, stdout at most 65536 bytes parsed as dict. Return 4 with absent_ok means clean foreground exit restored readonly. Other nonzero maps to NATIVE_UNAVAILABLE or NATIVE_REFUSED; bad JSON maps to NATIVE_REPLY_INVALID.

show validates the id, calls srf-identity-admin show, requires profile_id echo equals the request else NATIVE_ID_MISMATCH, and returns only public keys profile_id, browser, account_label, allowed_domains, created_unix, last_login_unix.

create validates label nonblank at most 128 chars without control chars, domains sorted unique at most 16 matching hostname syntax, program kind forbids domains and rebind checks PROFILE_ALREADY_BOUND. It reclaims unprovisioned profiles, calls native create, then show plus provision with rollback of a newly created metadata entry on failure.

reclaim_unprovisioned_profile only removes an empty host-owned 0700 directory via rmdir when metadata is absent and lease is not active, under the per-id guard. It never removes non-empty or uid-10001 directories and never opens payloads.

delete refuses protected or live ids with IDENTITY_PROTECTED, shows identity, holds the guard flock, requires lease absent or inactive else IDENTITY_BOUND, rejects symlink/non-file metadata or non-dir profiles, keeps the entry until privileged removal succeeds, then unlinks metadata and lock record but never the guard.

profile_path validates only directory metadata: profiles dir must be private, resolved and a direct child of root; target must not be a symlink, must resolve to itself, must sit directly under profiles, and must be absent or a directory.

profile_helper runs a root docker helper with no network that asserts no links, realpath containment and PWD equality, then mkdir/chown 10001:10001/chmod 0700 or rm -rf with post checks. Failure writes a CID receipt and refuses PROFILE_NOT_PROVISIONED; only Docker CID cleanup is attempted, never by name.

pending_state returns none/live/stale/unknown from the reservation file pid plus /proc start time. Ownerless or torn JSON is stale; missing /proc mount without self evidence is unknown. Unavailable process evidence never proves staleness.

status returns profile_id, provisioned bool, lease absent/active/inactive/invalid, login_pending, and login_recorded yes/no from last_login_unix. A recorded login is history, never proof of a current authenticated session.

release refuses protected containers and holder mismatch, requires exact CAPSULE holder, refuses LOGIN_IN_PROGRESS for live/unknown reservations, then calls native view-stop absent_ok plus stop. If the lease stays active it raises RELEASE_UNVERIFIED; success reports capsule removed with a hint.

login validates id, show, and inactive lease or exact capsule holder; provisions via native start srf-id-id when inactive; creates a 0600 pid/start reservation under the guard; reclaims stale owners after native view-stop; serves login with announcement URL validated as loopback http; restores readonly on exit.

SIGTERM/SIGHUP during login trigger KeyboardInterrupt and map to LOGIN_TERMINATED. Teardown ignores further signals, view-stops a live child, closes stdout, and only unlinks the reservation when readonly restore is proven; otherwise it is kept for reclaim.

Operator sees stderr hints for PROFILE_MISSING, PROFILE_NOT_PROVISIONED with sudo install -d -m 0700 -o 10001 -g 10001, RESERVED_ID, LOGIN_IN_PROGRESS or LOGIN_TERMINATED, plus stdout JSON ok false with codes such as IDENTITY_PROTECTED, IDENTITY_BOUND or NATIVE_REFUSED.

tools/mv_ram_admission.py is an explicit operator reclaim tool; it is never called by the daemon. It removes dead-owner RAM admission reservations only when native inventory proves the matching profile capsule absent, under the same directory flock as admission.

Entry is main(argv) with reclaim --dry-run or --apply. The directory comes from MV_RAM_ADMISSION_DIR or XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/metaviewer/ram-admission and must be absolute. Each item prints as sorted JSON; errors print error/action refused to stderr with exit 1.

RECORD is ([1-9][0-9]*)-[0-9a-f]{32}-([0-9a-f]{64})(--([a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}))? naming pid, hash and optional profile. NAME restricts container names to alphanumerics plus ._- for inventory parsing.

command runs subprocess with env scrubbed of DOCKER_CONTEXT, DOCKER_HOST, DOCKER_TLS, DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY and DOCKER_CERT_PATH when --host is present, so the verified explicit local endpoint wins over context/TLS env. 15s timeout; stdout is the only consumed stream.

absent(profile) returns True only for proven absence, False for present, None for unknown. It resolves the Docker host via context inspect when needed, requires a unix:// host, lists all container names, rejects unexpected names, and treats remote inventory as unknown.

Hash-only records require absence of all mv-* browser/program/VM capsules. Named profiles require absence of srf-id-/srf-pg-/srf-vm- plus that profile per PROFILE_PREFIXES from internal/capsule/manager.go. Random srf-ng-hcap-* holdings force False so they are kept conservatively.

pid_dead accepts only recorded ordinary pids above 1, never the caller or its process group (AC-10 guard). Signal-zero success means alive; ProcessLookupError means dead; PermissionError, OverflowError and OSError mean unknown and therefore not dead.
reservation requires regular file mode 0600 owned by caller with size 0 and link count 1. Anything else is unknown_or_unsafe_reservation and is kept.

reclaim requires the directory to be uid-owned 0700 opened O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW under LOCK_EX. Each name is checked in order: shape and reservation, sha256(profile) binding for suffix records, owner death, then native absence. Unknown owners or inventories keep the item with a reason.

The same directory flock as admission is held across listing, external inventory reads and removal. With --apply, owner, stat identity and reservation are rechecked after the read while still locked; on change the item is kept with reservation_or_owner_changed instead of unlinked, and the fd is fsynced after unlink.

Inventory is read-only, including protected containers, which never prevent reclaim of unrelated reservations. NativeInventory defaults to command runner but accepts an injectable run/absent for tests; OSError, SubprocessError, ValueError and TypeError map to unknown.

Operator sees one JSON line per reservation with action keep/would_remove/removed and reason owner_alive_or_unknown, native_capsule_present, native_inventory_unknown, or owner_dead_and_matching_native_absent. Unsafe names never disappear; dry-run changes nothing.
Directory config is MV_RAM_ADMISSION_DIR first, else absolute XDG_RUNTIME_DIR plus /metaviewer/ram-admission. A non-absolute result triggers parser error for absolute admission directory required.

Hazard controls: never follow symlinks, never kill or signal except zero-probe, never accept pid 1/self/group, never map holdings names back to profiles, and never treat unknown inventory as proof of absence.

tools/mw_ax_dump.py is a read-only AX dump and workflow anchor readiness check for a live capsule. It dumps sanitized AX to a 0600 file, reports marker MW_AX_DUMP with rows, window URL, focused element and per-anchor presence, returning 3 on anchor drift.

Entry is main(argv) with --repo, --capsule, --site, optional --workflow/--home and required --out. Refusals from OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError, KeyError, TypeError and backend errors print marker MW_AX_DUMP status refused with code/detail and return 6.

run_dump admits home, loads site workflows, extracts deduped anchors, connects backend, resolves identity/container from state dir, builds HostBackend, checks expected container, calls native ax --container capsule --window w1, sanitizes, writes private out, then compares anchor names against live names.

_need(condition,code,message) raises backend.refuse(code,message) or OwnerRefused(code). Callers use codes MW_CAPSULE_ID, MW_SRF_STATE, MW_WORKFLOW_ABSENT, MW_WORKFLOW_SCHEMA, MW_RUN_AX_SCHEMA, MW_IDENTITY, MW_RUN_CONFIG, MW_RUN_NO_SURFACE and MW_RUN_NATIVE.

If capsule arg starts with srf-id-, state dir JSON docs are scanned via private_json for Capsule.container matching it, returning lease ProfileID else stripping the prefix. Non srf-id- values pass through with no expected container.

Anchors come from preconditions, step preconditions/already_satisfied, target anchor_ref/required_anchor_refs plus frame_predicate bindings, and oracle postconditions. Only capability mv.ax.* bindings contribute; focus capability hints textbox, type_text/focus steps hint textbox else control.

Predicate bindings named name with non-empty value and capability empty or mv.ax.* yield (node,anchor,role). Target refs must start with ax: with stripped remainder. Dedup keeps first node, upgrading role to textbox when later evidence shows textbox.

Site workflows load from site_root(home,site,repo)/sites/site/workflows. Missing dir, missing workflow file or no JSON files raise MW_WORKFLOW_ABSENT; non-object JSON raises MW_WORKFLOW_SCHEMA. Reads are bounded via backend.bounded_read.

_sanitize_tree requires dict payload with list elements, drops value/text keys at top and per row, normalizes value_len to int or derives it from raw string value, and defaults to None. This strips private text while keeping lengths for matching.

_write_private_out creates parents, encodes sorted indented JSON plus newline, opens with O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_TRUNC|O_NOFOLLOW mode 0600, fchmods 0600 and writes. main then asserts the out file mode is exactly 0600.

Missing anchors rank up to 5 candidates excluding the anchor itself, scoring SequenceMatcher ratio plus bonuses: textbox role 2.0 or 0.35, ellipsis match 1.5, actionable 0.25, main region 0.15. Sorted by score desc then name.

When capsule resolution yields an expected container, host_backend.capsule must equal it else MW_RUN_NO_SURFACE. Native ax OSError maps to MW_RUN_NATIVE. Present anchors get empty candidates; any absent anchor sets all_present false, code MW_AX_ANCHOR_DRIFT and rc 3.

User sees JSON summary with rows and focused element; on drift the summary adds code MW_AX_ANCHOR_DRIFT with exit 3 and candidate names for each missing anchor. Config or native failures print a refused marker with code and detail and exit 6.

Depends on mw_run_backend for admit_home, site_root, connect, HostBackend, private_json, bounded_read and error types, plus live.PROFILE_ID_RE. Sys.path is extended with agents, tools and repo root before import.

tools/mw_home_check.py is a hosted offline admission check for a MemoryWeb home. With --workflow SITE/WORKFLOW it also checks provenance references the way the pinned gate opens them, refusing MW_PROVENANCE with one actionable line per fault; nothing is edited.

Entry is main(argv) with required --repo, optional --home and optional --workflow SITE/WORKFLOW. It prints schema metaviewer.mw_home/v1 with home, ok and code plus faults when workflow was requested. MW_HOME_PATH returns 2; other HomeErrors return 6.

Flow resolves repo, canonicalizes resolve_home output, defines tracked() via git ls-files, refuses tracked or unignored homes, ensures home, runs check_home(home,tracked), then optionally validates the workflow file exists and collects provenance_faults before reporting.

git(repo,*args) runs git -C repo with DEVNULL stdin/stdout/stderr and 10s timeout, returning the returncode. OSError or TimeoutExpired raises HomeError MW_HOME_GIT, so indeterminate Git status refuses rather than admits.

tracked(path) checks selectors memoryweb and the repo-relative path via git ls-files --error-unmatch. rc 0 means tracked, rc 1 means untracked, any other rc raises MW_HOME_GIT. A tracked home raises MW_HOME_TRACKED.

Ignore gates: git check-ignore -q memoryweb/x must exit 0, else MW_HOME_NOT_IGNORED when 1 or MW_HOME_GIT otherwise. A repo-relative home other than repo/memoryweb needs a second check-ignore on home/x with the same mapping.

provenance_faults(site_dir,workflow) reads site.json and workflows/W.json up to 1MB. Unreadable JSON yields relative: unreadable JSON. Missing provenance dict is skipped; otherwise source_ref before # must name a regular non-symlink file inside sites/SITE/ without absolute, empty, dot parts or :\\? chars.

Bad source_ref yields provenance.source_ref ... must name a file inside sites/SITE/ (for example NOTES.md). A non-human source whose receipt_sha256 differs from sha256 of the file yields provenance.source ... needs receipt_sha256 = sha256 of base, or source human with EXPLANATION-format base.

Workflow id must fully match [A-Za-z0-9_-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+ else MW_HOME_PATH with rc 2. Missing home/sites/site/workflows/workflow.json raises MW_WORKFLOW_ABSENT. Nonempty faults raise MW_PROVENANCE with rc 6 and the faults array echoed.

Result always includes faults key when --workflow was given, even on success or on path errors where it stays empty. home is the canonical string or null when resolution failed; ok mirrors absence of HomeError; code carries the refusal or null.

User sees one-line JSON such as ok false code MW_HOME_TRACKED, MW_HOME_NOT_IGNORED, MW_HOME_GIT, MW_WORKFLOW_ABSENT or MW_PROVENANCE. With provenance failure, faults lists one actionable line per bad site.json or workflow file naming the expected inside-sites file and hash fix.

Depends on metaviewer_agents.mw_home canonical_home, check_home, ensure_home and resolve_home plus HomeError codes, and on git CLI for ls-files and check-ignore. No home content is modified; ensure_home and check_home own all filesystem effects.
Run one admitted MemoryWeb owner workflow against the running packaged MetaViewer core via HostBackend, writing memoryweb-run.json report and receipt; never starts or reconfigures capsules.

run_entry validates slots, admits home, makes evidence dir, connect() attaches core, builds HostBackend, calls execute(); HostBackend.call dispatches ownership, network_context, ax, observe, perceive, state, propose, wait_verify.

observe merges tools.observe frame_ref with native ax tree plus url and observed_wall; perceive retains frame pixels, builds vqa.element-table from AX boxes, returns frame, table, ax, window; state_for runs wender shim subprocess for Wender IDs.

propose builds proposal from fresh frame, submits via tools.propose, waits once with tools.wait_verify, preserves native_evidence; wait_verify pops pending, checks binding, retains after_frame, returns verified receipt.

Each sensitive call re-runs ownership(): admin show identity match, exactly one active browser surface, exactly one leased active capsule. network_context then checks egress started witness matches current record hash and caches mode.

stage_corpus uses site root if site/workflow/step/run schemas exist else stages private copy with pinned builtin schemas; focus_corpus projects focus-only steps, marks already_satisfied, copies only sites and standards, rewrites workflow canon.

slot_text requires string id, ax --text-of reply with one matching row on id/role/name/box/focused, focused true, truncated false, text bytes match utf-8 length under 65536, unicode code point value_len matches native value_len.

retain hash-checks frame pixels against sha256, writes sha256.rgb once, rereads to prove equality. binding requires same surface, based_on_frame equals sha256/generation, proposal id match, after generation strictly greater.

private_json requires 0700 chain owned by uid, file mode 0600 or 0400 for witnesses, dict JSON. admit_home requires home tracked by git ls-files and memoryweb/x ignored via check-ignore before check_home.

discover_attach refuses MW_RUN_ATTACH if zero or many mv-daemon-adapter owned by app found, or ATTACH_KEYS missing. attach_env refuses on caller mismatch or missing CORE/RUNTIME. Explicit MV_CORE_CONFIG skips discovery.

revalidate_action refuses MW_REBIND_SURFACE on size change, MW_REBIND_TARGET on click/focus target signature change. rebind refuses MW_HANDOFF_REQUIRED on wall, MW_REBIND_PIXELS unless identical pixels or caret-only blink with monotonic generations.

Pixel race MW_REBIND_PIXELS retries without submit up to 3 attempts; STALE_FRAME core refusal retries with fresh AX up to 3; other refusals raise. Exhaustion raises MW_STALE_FRAME_EXHAUSTED. Only post-receipt slot readback gets extended window.

MW_GATE_* refusal is reworded with mw_home_check.provenance_faults naming file and remedy. Handoff path returns rc 4 HUMAN_HANDOFF. Failed owner without receipt preserves rc and verdict; success requires validated receipt.
User sees on stderr 'mw_run: site/workflow acts on identity in N s; interrupt now to cancel' then a wait. Notices over 300 s fail with MW_NOTICE and nothing runs.
Run stops for a human when AX shows CAPTCHA cue or sign-in dialog; observation carries observed_wall kind captcha_wall or login_wall. Nothing is clicked or solved.

After verified run, oracle anchor container text is read once into answer.txt and named in report. Capture failure returns captured false and never changes verdict; ambiguous button captions refuse capture.

readback_runner clones wender namespace and wraps _observe so only mv.ax.length.v1 on slot owner within slot_readback_deadline uses extended window; all other checks keep original deadlines. Deadline expiry raises MW_SLOT_READBACKDEADLINE once.

command runs subprocesses with no stdin, 30 s timeout, 1 MB stdout cap. native allows only srf-identity-surface ax and srf-identity-admin show, forwards only SRF store/registry keys, requires rc 0 and dict JSON.

Attach keeps only MV_CORE_CONFIG, XDG_RUNTIME_DIR, MV_SRF_BIN_DIR, MV_SRF_STATE_DIR, SRF_IDENTITY_STORE_ROOT, SRF_PROXY_REGISTRY. connect needs absolute CORE/RUNTIME, core.sock socket, exactly one agent peer, 30 s ToolClient with sequence file.
Drive synthetic local page through owned native human tile to prove typing, persistence, layout presets, and duplicate-bind refusal; never reads cookies.
close disposes boot once and exits with code; SIGTERM closes 0, window-all-closed ignored. P18_DEV_LOCK_ISOLATED logged on lock, P18_DEV_READY plus ready.json pid on boot.
Wrong root or display throws ISOLATION_REQUIRED; second instance logs SINGLE_INSTANCE and exits 7; boot failure logs message and closes 1.

Refresh bindings, assert capsule bound to mv-live-3, deploy synthetic page into capsule /tmp/p18-keymap.html, focus app window, ctrl+l navigate, click input, type target, tab+space persist, cycle presets, assert duplicate agent open refused.
click maps 1280x900 page coords into viewport rect with letterbox scale, moves via xdotool on :97. Spanish mode remounts surface so hello advertises layout before typing.

xdotool runs with DISPLAY :97, records pid, raises on nonzero rc. Asserts typed target with accents appears in chromium title and P18-SAVED in persistence title; NATIVE_KEYMAP_MISMATCH or SYNTHETIC_PERSISTENCE_NOT_CONFIRMED on mismatch.
Tester sees synthetic page title change to P18-TYPED plus typed value, then P18-SAVED after Persist click. Missing change means typing or persistence failed.
Duplicate metaviewerRoles.open for mv-live-3 agent must return PROFILE_ALREADY_BOUND; other codes fail assertion. Preset clicks emit rectangle JSON for single, side-by-side, grid, focus-strip.
Starts owned local page server via docker exec python http on 127.0.0.1:8765 in capsule, logged to local-page.log; records server, keymap, input, probe pids for cleanup.
Depends on ../ui/electron/main.js bindings, p18_live state/rpc/record, docker capsule chromium, xdotool and setxkbmap on :97, local file URL page.
Uses real X input and window focus on isolated :97 dev window only; must not run against operator display or reusable session. Realpath check prevents symlink root escape.
Prove six human/agent capsule switches preserve file localStorage marker and example.org cookie marker, kill old capsule, keep one pane, show progress.
Prove one clean capsule replacement preserves localStorage marker, swaps surface and capsule, then agent watch read-only connects.
Refresh bindings, wait 45 s for choices surfaceId, assert mv-live-3 and binding container in owned set. All helpers assert container owned before docker exec.
file_marker writes /tmp/p18-r2-state.html with optional seed, navigates file URL, requires P18-FILE-PERSISTED title within 20 s; file origins cannot hold persistent cookies.

Each cycle asserts duplicate open returns PROFILE_ALREADY_BOUND, clicks Switch button, waits 60 s for mode flip and new surfaceId, asserts old capsule gone, reseeds markers, asserts one viewport pane.

Observer sees Switching to target progress text, then new mode surface; missing progress raises SWITCH_PROGRESS_UNPROVEN, no flip raises SWITCH_UI_UNPROVEN, retained pane raises ENDED_LIFETIME_PANE_RETAINED.
assets dumps xpra index.html and Client.js lines around keyboard_layout/keymap/keycode into r2-xpra-keyboard-assets.log inside evidence, never profile storage; asserts rc 0.
keyboard forces human mode, sets es keymap, remounts active viewport so hello advertises layout, types Spanish positions via XTest keycodes from xkbcomp, requires P18-TYPED with accents in title.
Seeds P18-SAVED in old capsule, asserts duplicate refused, switchMode returns new surface agent role, asserts containers differ and old docker name gone, new capsule shows P18-PERSISTED.

If switch result not ok raises SWITCH_UNPROVEN; missing human mode in 60 s raises HUMAN_OPEN_UNPROVEN; missing Watch read-only button in 20 s raises AGENT_TILE_UNPROVEN; unwatched tile in 40 s raises AGENT_WATCH_UNPROVEN.
Controlled loopback fixture PAGE is 28px input page titled P18-LOADING that echoes typed value into title; deployed only to /tmp inside owned capsule.
Depends on p18_live STATE/rpc/record/refresh, owned dev app on :97/:100, docker exec python3, xdotool, setxkbmap, xkbcomp, X11/Xtst for physical keys.
Exercise owned dev app and capsule on :97 to prove menus render above native view, mode switch works, hidden cap releases view, reconnect reuses capsule.
Start isolated native fixture, wait for owned mv-live-3 human surface, run smoke, then stop only if state changed; startup emitted state verifies PIDs before signal.
run spawns child, records pid as live supervisor child, waits, raises LIVE_SUBCOMMAND_FAILED on nonzero rc. Finally stops via p18b_live stop only when STATE bytes differ.
connected waits 45 s for tile-status connected and choices status view ready; prints lastClient on failure then raises OWN_NATIVE_CONNECTION_UNPROVEN. Human mode must be readonly false.
capture screenshots app PID window via xwd on :97, asserts 24-bit RGB layout, saves .xwd evidence, returns pixel reader. Menu point must change from before to expected background color.
More menu over connecting view must stay visible; counts of CLIENT_CONNECTED and CLOSED in dev-app.log must be unchanged proving same connection retained, not reopened.

Switch to agent mode must yield new surfaceId, agent menu shows four items, Watch read-only sets readonly true, hide panel keeps dock hidden with zero rects, added presentation does not resurrect ghost frame.
run uses DISPLAY :97, records P18B screenshot fixture pid, 20 s timeout, raises OWN_SCREENSHOT_FAILED with stderr excerpt. Screenshot selects recorded app PID window, never operator display.
CONNECTING_NATIVE_COVERED_MENU if menu pixel already menu color before open; PIXEL_CONTRAST_UNPROVEN if no contrast; mismatch after open fails with before/after/expected tuple.

Hidden view with limit 0 must keep readonly false else SHOWN_VIEW_RELEASED; hidden view must disconnect within 15 s else HIDDEN_VIEW_NOT_RELEASED; restore must show reconnect prompt not auto-reconnect.
User sees human menu Switch to agent mode, I logged in, Stop capsule above native video; agent menu adds Watch read-only and emergency take control. Missing overlay means z-order failure.
Owns one dev window and capsule lifetime only; cleanup verifies starttime before signalling recorded PIDs and names only reserved capsule, preserving prior state bytes.
Depends on p18b_live STATE/rpc/record/refresh, Electron dev app, xwd/xdotool on :97, dockview API for synthetic presentation panel.
Launch owned dev MetaViewer on :97 with extra restart-ui, visibility, shortcut, pixel RPC ops for retained-view and restart acceptance.
Same owned launcher but suppresses first surface create request to prove acceptance starts empty; logs BOOT_CREATE_SUPPRESSED and rejects with that code.
50 ms file loop maps eval to main window JS, tile-status to xpra connected/readonly/layout/remoteWindows, visibility to tile visibles, shortcut to ctrl+key, pixel to 1px bitmap, quit to close.
close guards reentry, disposes boot, exits rc; SIGTERM closes 0, window-all-closed ignored. Logs P18C_DEV_LOCK_ISOLATED, P18C_DEV_READY, writes ready.json pid.
Boot uses ../ui/electron/main.js privileged scheme, main bindings, 1600x1000 geometry, layout bridge. R2 wraps core.request to reject only first surface_request create.
Bad isolation throws ISOLATION_REQUIRED; lock contention logs SINGLE_INSTANCE exits 7; unknown op throws OP_REFUSED; missing tile throws VIEW_ABSENT; boot error logs and exits 1.
suppressBootCreate starts true; first create flips false, logs suppression, rejects; later creates delegate to real core, so UI must handle empty start without auto surface.
Operator sees only own dev window on :97; tile-status shows connected and readonly flags, visibility shows which tiles visible. No renderer capability or operator session reused.
State confined to P18_ROOT config and electron-session dirs plus ready/request/reply JSON files; quit path writes reply before close to avoid lost RPC.
Depends on Electron app, BrowserWindow, ipcMain, protocol, session, core/wire/adapter bindings, shellRoot ui directory, runtime xdg dir and uid.
Isolation guard plus realpath check blocks symlink escape and wrong display; single-instance lock prevents two dev apps sharing one root and session.
Prove view/desktop switches retain bridge connection, shortcuts work, and actual app restart restores active view with ended capsule pruned.
Read-only final audit that owned PIDs and capsules are gone; writes cleanup.json and asserts no remaining capsules or running PIDs.
connections parses ss -tnp for pid endpoints and ss -ltnp listeners, asserts listeners loopback only else NONLOCAL_LISTENER; returns ports and established pairs to prove bridge persistence.
rss sums statm resident pages of pid plus /proc task children recursively, tracks peak_ui_kib; tolerates exited processes as zero.

active reports pressed view/desktop, visible desktops, capsule roles. Five human/agent toggles must hide/show native visibility flag; creative view hides tile; shortcuts ctrl+2 and ctrl+Tab switch desktop and view.

After switches ports must equal before and at least one established endpoint overlaps else BRIDGE_LISTENER_CHANGED or PERSISTENT_BRIDGE_CONNECTION_CHANGED; CLIENT_CONNECTED/CLOSED log counts must be unchanged proving no session reopen.

Restart gate waits for desktops/v1 with agent active 2; quits, waits pid exit, relaunches same cjs with saved env, waits ready.json, asserts agent-2 restored then human-2 with empty assignments and pruned panels.

Missing readiness raises LIVE_GATE_UNPROVEN; absent bridge raises OWN_BRIDGE_CONNECTION_ABSENT; restart refusal on SINGLE_INSTANCE or BOOT_REFUSED; missing ready raises RESTART_NOT_READY; reopened session fails SESSION_REOPENED.
Tester sees human and agent desktop buttons toggle pressed state and native tile appear or disappear; unexpected retained role or visible desktop means view leak.
Reads OUT/live.json seen pid:start keys, classifies live vs zombie via /proc stat, unions docker-started.jsonl containers, runs docker ps, writes remainingOwnCapsules/Pids/Zombies, asserts all empty.
Uses only read of /proc and docker ps plus one recorded Popen; no kill. Started container list comes from docker-started.jsonl lines, audit receipt in cleanup.json.
Depends on p18c_live main/STATE/EVIDENCE/ELECTRON/REPO, Electron restart, ss, /proc statm/stat/children, docker ps, metaviewer.load desktops schema.
Exercise owned dev window on :97 with real X drag, resize, header and keyboard sizing, desktop move, proving bridge ports stable and screenshots captured.
Run child command then report cgroup memory.peak bytes and rc as MEMORY JSON; exit with child rc for capped memory accounting.
Run capped P18G command receipts with owned process tracking, redirecting OUT to .p18c-evidence/p18g and isolating TMPDIR per invocation.
ports reads ss -ltnpH for live-app pid and asserts loopback only. snapshot raises own window, grabs :97 via ImageGrab, crops to outer geometry, saves native-label.png.
current_view requires expected viewport rect to match single visible view-bounds within 2 px within 10 s else NATIVE_BOUNDS_NOT_SETTLED; renderer must reconcile mount before gate.
drag converts client coords with screenX and frame offset, performs xdotool mousedown, small move, target move, mouseup with sleeps, then records descendants for ownership.

Floating preset, titlebar drag must move x by 100+, right-handle drag must widen by 70+, header wider/narrower and taller/shorter return within 2 px, menu hides view, move-new creates desktop-human-2.
ports before, after move/resize, after desktop switch, and after keyboard/header sizing must all be equal with sameBridge true; any new listener fails assertion.
Missing element or disabled button fails click assertion; unsettled bounds raises NATIVE_BOUNDS_NOT_SETTLED; ctrl+alt+Right/Left intercepted before xpra must widen then restore width within 2 px.
Evidence shows floating native window before, moved-resized, and desktop-2 screenshots; user would see native video move, grow, hide behind menu, reappear on desktop 2.
Reads /proc/self/cgroup relative path and sys/fs/cgroup memory.peak; prints MEMORY with peak_bytes and rc; no limits set here, only measurement wrapper of sys.argv command.
Depends on p18f_live STATE/OUT/rpc/descendants, p18f_verify record/run, Pillow ImageGrab, xdotool on :97, ss, docker capsule chromium via tile-status remoteWindows.

tools/router_index.py is the W0-ROUTER-INDEX repository router coverage compiler. Build mode compiles one ctx.node.v2 record per tracked source file into catalogue/nodes.jsonl and catalogue/routes.tsv. Check mode rebuilds the same bytes in memory and fails on stale artifacts, missing sources, broken doc links, mount or SHA disagreement, or nondeterministic kit leg.

main(argv) is the CLI entry: accepts only --check, else prints Router error: unknown option and returns 2. It resolves root from __file__, checks corpus agreement, loads kit schema and validator, reads git manifest, derives ids, compiles material, runs verify_kit, then branches to check legs or writes nodes/routes and prints METAVIEWER_ROUTER_COVERAGE 100% N files.

tracked_paths(root) runs git -C root ls-files -z --cached with GIT_TIMEOUT_S 60.0, decodes NUL-split UTF-8 entries, rejects non-canonical, duplicate, or empty manifests via RouterError. It defines the source universe; no filesystem recursion and no untracked discovery.

compile_material(root,paths,corpus,ids,schema,validate) reads each source with _safe_read, hashes SHA256 for source_sha256, derives title from basename, builds search via _build_search, validates against schema, emits canonical JSON lines with sort_keys and compact separators, plus id-path routes. Returns Material(nodes_jsonl,routes_tsv,source_paths).

_derive_ids(paths,corpus) maps every source to a deterministic collision-checked id. Semantic-first trailing-segment join wins when it fits MAX_COMPOSITE width, matches ID_PATTERN, and is unused. Otherwise stem-anchored sha256 digest fallback stem[:7]-digest[:12] is used; collisions or overflows raise RouterError instead of clipping.

_build_search(rel,name,stem,trigger,suffix,raw) emits triggers<=12, keywords<=24, plus problem_names<=5, tasks<=8, questions<=12. Test paths get test-centric triggers and exclusions; other paths combine filename, directory tokens with singular map, suffix hints, extracted symbols, and doc tokens. Empty triggers fall back to trigger.

check_mount_freshness compares mount shards in catalogue/router/docs/*.jsonl and router/index/SHA256SUMS against material node ids. It verifies SHA digests cover nodes plus every mount file, mount id set equals node id set, and every mount id resolves in the routes lookup from routes.tsv or in-memory routes.

Build state writes nodes/routes after verify_kit. Check state sequences: corpus agreement with targets, byte-compare nodes with coverage diagnostic, byte-compare routes unless untracked mirror, mount freshness, doc links. Any RouterError prints to stderr and returns 1. Success prints coverage line and returns 0.

Composite width law: len(corpus)+1+len(id) in bytes must be <= MAX_COMPOSITE 32. Corpus must match [a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,15}; id must match [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,31}. compile_material re-enforces width, pattern, exact id-map keys, uniqueness, non-empty universe, and canonical paths.

Every manifest, SHA, routes, and protocol target path must be canonical: non-empty, no leading slash, no backslash, no ./ prefix, no trailing slash, no control chars, no empty/dot/dotdot segments. _safe_read and _check_regular_target also lstat every ancestor, refuse symlinks, require regular files, and require readability.

Each node must satisfy ctx.node.v2 schema: schema,id,corpus,kind asset,title,purpose,anchors [{a:file,role:section}],search,status active,source_sha256. _load_validator loads router/kit/tools/jsonschema_lite.py validate(node,schema)->list; non-list return violates validator contract and fails closed.

catalogue/routes.tsv must start with id-path header, rows id-tab-path with canonical known paths and unique ids. catalogue/protocol.json must declare exactly one mount with corpus metaviewer and path catalogue/router. With check_targets, router.path_rule must be lookup: plus regular target and params must be a regular file.

Git manifest failure paths: TimeoutExpired -> Router error: git manifest timed out; OSError -> git manifest failed; nonzero rc -> rc plus 200 chars of stderr; non-UTF8 entry, non-canonical, duplicate, or empty universe -> RouterError. main catches RouterError, prints it to stderr, returns 1.

Error prefixes distinguish causes: Router error: for malformed input, kit, protocol, symlink, prohibited path; Stale or incomplete router: for missing source, stale bytes, broken doc link, mount or SHA mismatch. Unknown CLI option prints Router error: unknown option and returns 2 without running checks.

check_doc_links fails on non-UTF8 markdown, empty paren destination, undefined [ref], ambiguous scheme destination, escaping .. beyond root, or missing dir/file target. Markdown code fences, HTML comments, and inline code spans are stripped first so only real prose links are checked. Message cites file:line.

Kit leg failures: missing or symlink kit input, bad schema JSON, unimportable validator, builder build or --check run timeout after KIT_TIMEOUT_S, nonzero rc with last 200 stderr chars, or OSError. All raise Router error: kit builder failed or invalid kit input, failing the whole run.

A tester sees METAVIEWER_ROUTER_COVERAGE 100% N files on stdout when healthy. When stale, stderr shows Stale or incomplete router: catalogue/nodes.jsonl plus coverage mismatch: N sources vs M committed nodes; K digests differ. Missing sources show Stale or incomplete router: missing source <path>.

User-visible kit and mount faults include Router error: kit builder failed rc=N, kit builder timeout, missing kit input, corpus mismatch: protocol X != metaviewer, mount ids != nodes ids (M mount vs N nodes), SHA256SUMS mismatch for <rel>, incomplete SHA256SUMS, or broken doc link file:line: missing X.

No locks or retries. Ordering is fixed: manifest, ids, compile, verify_kit build then --check, then check-mode legs. git ls-files and each kit builder invocation have 60s timeouts; TimeoutExpired maps to RouterError. Builder stdout is discarded, stderr captured for diagnostics.

verify_kit writes nodes.jsonl under TemporaryDirectory mv-router-kit-* and runs builder twice, removing the scratch tree on return; repo tree is never touched there. compile_material holds full nodes and routes bytes in memory. Only GENERATED_EXACT and router/index/ plus catalogue/router/ prefixes are excluded from routing.

Fixed configuration: CORPUS metaviewer, NODES_REL catalogue/nodes.jsonl, ROUTES_REL catalogue/routes.tsv, PROTOCOL_REL catalogue/protocol.json, LLMS_REL llms.txt, MOUNT_PATH catalogue/router, MOUNT_DOCS_DIR catalogue/router/docs, INDEX_SHA_REL router/index/SHA256SUMS, plus kit builder, schema, thesaurus, validator paths.

External legs: git ls-files manifest, kit builder router/kit/tools/build_index_v2.py invoked as sys.executable builder --nodes --out --thesaurus --corpus, thesaurus json, schema ctx.node.v2.schema.json, and jsonschema_lite validator module. Stdlib only otherwise: hashlib, json, re, subprocess, tempfile, pathlib.

Fail-closed hazards: basenames operator.token, launch.token, auth.json, .env and *.key are refused even if tracked; symlinks at any ancestor level are refused; id collisions or width overflows raise instead of truncating; id map must equal source paths exactly or compilation refuses.

tools/sync_kit.mjs vendors pinned capsule-ui-kit source into ui/.kit/capsule-ui-kit from a kit-repo checkout per ui/kit.lock.json. It verifies content hash, package version, and KIT_SOURCE.json record, then atomically activates via staging directory. --check only verifies installed and source trees without copying.

CLI entry parses node tools/sync_kit.mjs [kit-repo] [--check], with fallback MV_KIT_CHECKOUT or CAPSULE_UI_KIT_REPO. More than one --check, extra positionals, dash options, or missing repo in sync mode prints usage ERROR and sets exitCode 1. Otherwise it calls checkInstalled or syncKit and prints JSON result.

kitDigest(root) hashes the kit tree with sha256-length-framed-tree: sorted entries, key length plus name plus content length framing. It skips KIT_SOURCE.json, node_modules, .git, rejects symlinks and non-file non-directory entries, and requires root to be a directory.

readPin enforces exact lock keys commit,contentHash,repo,version with 40-hex commit and 64-hex hash. verifyKit loads KIT_SOURCE.json and package.json, recomputes kitDigest, and requires schema capsule-ui-kit-source/v1, algorithm match, direction export or vendor, and version plus hashes equal to pin.

syncKit resolves kitRepo to repo top level, requires local to equal repo or packages/capsule-ui-kit, rejects symlink ancestors and source-destination overlap, verifies source, copies to .kit-sync-* staging excluding metadata, writes vendor KIT_SOURCE.json, re-verifies staging and source, then renames dest aside and activates staging.

KitPin contract is {repo,commit,version,contentHash} with exact key set. Record contract is schema capsule-ui-kit-source/v1, algorithm sha256-length-framed-tree, direction vendor for installed trees, plus verified version and contentHash. checkInstalled returns version, contentHash, direction after verifying both pin and tree.

Sync fails with kit absent when dest is not materialised, Kit metadata/pin/hash mismatch, Invalid kit lock, Kit repository/commit mismatch on HEAD or origin, symlink ancestor rejection, source-destination overlap, or activation failure with preserved backup path. All CLI failures print ERROR: message and set exitCode 1.

R3 fails with ROOT_REFUSED, CAPSULE_REFUSED, REMOTE_WITNESS_FAILED when REMOTE_PID missing or early exit, BASELINE_PAINT_ABSENT or RECOVERED_PAINT_ABSENT when cadence changed<1, RECOVERY_TIMEOUT after 20s without ready state advance, and REMOTE_KEY_MISSING when ctrl+t/w/q is not observed in r3-remote.log. Finally always kills remote and logs commands.jsonl.

A user sees JSON {version,contentHash,direction} on sync success or ERROR: reason on failure; probe prints SINGLE_INSTANCE with exit 1 when locked else SPIKE_LOCK_ISOLATED with exit 0; R3 prints JSON rows baseline, bridge-cut, reconnecting-overlay-pixel, reconnected, blur-refocus, ctrl-t/w/q, final-paint to stdout and r3-live.json.

syncKit has check versus copy states: check verifies dest plus identity and returns vendor direction; copy stages, verifies, activates, and removes backup. R3 moves baseline painted, bridge-cut, reconnecting overlay, reconnected ready with new origin, blur-refocus, key delivery, final paint.

No locks; ordering proves provenance by calling identity before and after staging verification: HEAD must equal pin.commit and origin must equal pin.repo. GIT_ environment variables are stripped before every git call so inherited repository overrides cannot spoof the checkout.

syncKit creates dest parent, mkdtemp staging, renames with backup previous file, and always removes staging in finally; failed activation attempts restore backup. R3 sleeps fixed intervals, polls every 0.1s up to 20s for recovery, samples cadence with timeout, spawns docker exec remote witness, TERM kills it, and waits up to 10s.

Hazards: symlink ancestors at dest, source, or staging parents are rejected; source-destination ancestry overlap is rejected; backup restore failure reports preserved path. Probe refuses non-isolated homes to avoid touching real MetaViewer data. R3 confines automation to the operator root and reaps the docker client so no witness is left to an unrelated reaper.

tools/xpra_tile_r3_contracts.py validates additive role contracts role_request and role_view_state plus their positive and negative file examples. It proves each schema is itself valid Draft 2020-12 and that every example is accepted unless its filename marks it invalid.

Entry is top-level script execution with no function or CLI flags. Running python3 tools/xpra_tile_r3_contracts.py walks the fixed name list role_request then role_view_state, loading each schema and iterating its sorted example glob.

Data flows root/contracts/v0.3/<name>.schema.json text into json.loads, through Draft202012Validator.check_schema, into a Draft202012Validator instance, then each root/contracts/examples/v0.3/<name>.*.json example is parsed and passed to validator.iter_errors to collect an error list.

States per contract are schema-checked then per-example accepted or rejected. The script processes role_request examples fully before role_view_state. First assertion failure aborts the run; there is no summary state, only printed per-file lines before abort.

Additive-contract invariant: valid examples must stay valid as contracts grow. Filename invariant encodes expectation: containing .invalid. means errors are required, otherwise zero errors are required. Sorted glob order makes the check sequence deterministic.

Schema contract is JSON Schema Draft 2020-12: check_schema must pass for role_request.schema.json and role_view_state.schema.json. Instance contract is asserted by bool(errors)==expected per example, with the example filename included as assertion detail on mismatch.

File contract: schemas live at contracts/v0.3/<name>.schema.json and examples match contracts/examples/v0.3/<name>.*.json relative to the repository root derived from parents[1] of the script. Example names ending accepted carry valid payloads; names with .invalid. carry payloads that must violate the schema.

Failure paths raise instead of returning codes: missing schema or example files raise OSError, malformed JSON raises json decode error, bad meta-schema raises check_schema error, and expectation mismatch raises AssertionError with the example name. Any exception stops later contracts and examples.

A user sees one line per example such as role_request.basic.json accepted or role_request.bad.invalid.json rejected. Success prints all lines and exits cleanly; failure prints lines up to the mismatch then an AssertionError naming the offending example file.

Fixed configuration with no parameters: contract names role_request and role_view_state, schema directory contracts/v0.3, example directory contracts/examples/v0.3, glob pattern <name>.*.json, and invalid marker substring .invalid. in the example filename.

Depends on stdlib json and pathlib plus third-party jsonschema Draft202012Validator with check_schema and iter_errors. It also depends on the published contract tree contracts/v0.3 and contracts/examples/v0.3 being present beside the tools directory.

AuthorityWire is the main-side host binding for the authority lane: it validates renderer IPC for propose, intent, surface input, settings, frames, terminal, clipboard and capsule creation, then forwards only closed JSON or trusted reader and port capabilities to core or frame source; paths never cross IPC.

When surface input fails the user sees clicks, keys, typed text or scrolls do nothing. Host logs METAVIEWER_INPUT_REFUSED surface=<id> code=<CODE> count=<n> and renderer gets {ok:false,code}. Stale sequence, rate excess, unknown surface or core refusal all present this way.
