When capsule creation fails the renderer gets {ok:false,code,reason,message,tone:refusal} on metaviewer:authority.createSurface plus console error for create refused. User sees closed text such as at most 4 capsules or no free profile, never CLI detail.

When the settings file is missing, oversized or invalid the UI silently keeps mv-light compact defaults. Host warns MetaViewer settings with code and using defaults, and notifies cadence subscribers with defaults so wall and recording cadence stay safe.

Intent path: non-string arg goes to surface-input handler. String arg must pass wire cap 256 KB JSON parsing and validateIntentBody exact op and params keys plus ID pattern, else INTENT or PAYLOAD is thrown. Core must return true or OUTCOME is thrown.

Surface-input path: validateSurfaceInputBatch returns SCHEMA for bad keys, schema, IDs, coords or key chords, or LIMIT for over 32 events or over 16 KB encoded batch; overlong type text is SCHEMA. Refusal is logged at most once per second per surface and code burst.

Core input reply {ok:true,accepted} advances lastSeq and clears partial state. Reply {ok:false,code} with optional applied, or a thrown code, is mapped to closed codes. SURFACE_UNKNOWN deletes the known surface and may drop rate and sequence entries for never-admitted surfaces.

installAuthorityWire takes ipcMain, contents, core, env, argv, terminal, clipboard, profiles, capsuleStates, listIdentities, frames, frameDiag and clock, installs handlers for wire plus side-terminal plus clipboard channels, and returns wall and recording fps getters, rate maps, notifyCreateRefusal and dispose.

Each ipcMain.handle wrapper rejects when disposed or observeSender verdict is not admit from the privileged origin, rejects wrong arity, rejects payloads over the wire byte cap, then dispatches to handlers with sender supplied for terminal open, attach, resize and close.

Propose forwards a validated JSON string as {op:propose,json} to core.request and checks the result with verdictReply. Intent forwards {op:intent,json}. Input forwards {op:input,batch} with release_all events filtered. Results or {ok:false,code} flow back to the renderer.

Frames flow main-side only. frames.subscribe stages entries by surface_id, drainPendingEntries serializes delivery through deliverAuthorityFrame which reads via reader, posts via port, and emits metaviewer:authority.frames with frame_ref plus projected surface and optional transfer ports.

Wire lifecycle is unsubscribed versus subscribed, creatingCapsule guard for concurrent createSurface, and disposed which clears maps and streams, closes readers, revokes ports with shutdown, disposes terminal and removes handlers. Frame states reconcile the boot capsule reservation.

Only closed objects are accepted: exact key sets, plain prototypes, data descriptors and no symbols. Well-formed strings reject lone surrogates. Bounded ID and key token patterns apply. A JSON reviver preserves float versus integer spelling until field validation.

Intent uses schema ui_intent/v0.2 with ops take_control, release_control, fold, unfold, hide, show, move, tab and float and strict param keys. Proposal uses action_proposal/v0.2 with click, key, type, scroll, wait and lane_submit. Verdict uses action_verdict/v0.2.

Surface input uses surface_input/v1 or v0.2 with click, key, type, scroll and release_all, seq from 1 and non-negative stream_id, frozen batch. Cadence {wallFps,recordingFps} is closed and non-empty. Frozen settings map metaviewer themes to mv preferences.

Overlap is guarded by per-surface inFlight plus prevSeq as max of last and inFlight, with progress synced from core getInputProgress. Frame delivery uses a single drain promise to serialize posts. Nested display-only checks run before validation. InFlight is cleared in finally.

Bounds are 64 frame streams, 64 surfaces and rate and sequence maps with oldest or unadmitted eviction, 60 batches per second per surface, 32 events and 16 KB per batch, and 256 KB wire cap. Settings writes use no-follow opens plus temp rename and directory sync.

Recording destination comes from MV_RECORDING_DESTINATION as an absolute existing directory outside the source tree. Renderer gets only opaque token recording:configured or null. Settings path comes from XDG_CONFIG_HOME or HOME config outside the source.

Depends on main observeSender and privileged origin for sender admission, frameReader and framePort for stream creation, ptyBroker facade through the side-terminal adapter, and dynamic profilePicker pickCreateRequest when an identity lister is supplied. Adapter detail maps to PROFILE_ALREADY_BOUND.

Traversal and alias hazards are handled by outside-source checks, ancestor realpath checks, directory and file lstat validation, no-follow opens, symlink refusal and ownership and mode checks. Prototype pollution is blocked by prototype, symbol and descriptor checks. Renderer cannot supply paths, argv, env or cwd.

Button service runs one host-owned demo at a time by spawning python3 tools/mv_demo.py for record, prompt and check verbs, keeps completion and ownership until child exit, seals evidence for Stop, and reports only closed public refusals to the renderer.

User sees demo.start return DEMO_BUSY when a run is active, demo.stop return DEMO_NOT_RECORDING when idle, demo.prompt return DEMO_REFUSED when the demo does not match the sealed demo, or BUTTON_UNAVAILABLE on unexpected failure. CLI detail never reaches the renderer.

During record the first stdout line must be a single-key {url} row with a valid viewer URL; otherwise the run fails and no URL is announced. During prompt the output must contain exactly one text fence or clipboard is untouched. Check and record validate a closing demo schema row.

promptBlock throws PROMPT_SOURCE unless the source contains exactly one ```text fence. copyBounded throws CLIPBOARD_BOUND unless UTF-8 length is within bounds, and request maps any thrown error to {ok:false,code:BUTTON_UNAVAILABLE}.

Child output over 65536 bytes fails the run and triggers disposal with the short budget. Non-zero exit, failed flag, bad viewer URL, bad demo schema row, or site, validated or source mismatch also yields public DEMO_REFUSED with no CLI text exposed.

createButtonService takes root, demoRoot, clipboard, env, spawnTool, killGroup and stop and dispose budgets. request(method,args) first asserts the button call, then handles entry.copy, demo.start, demo.stop, demo.prompt and check paths.

Launch builds argv as mv_demo.py plus record with identity and demo, prompt with demo and site, or check with site, spawns detached python3 with a filtered env, pipes stdout and stderr, resolves ready on first URL or on exit, and resolves done on exit with a public reply.

Prompt path copies either docs/AGENT_ENTRY.md for entry.copy or the child prompt output for demo.prompt into the bounded clipboard. Record path announces the viewer URL early. Check path only returns its closing validation result.

Only active may be set. demo.start sets it and clears it on failed ready or failed done. demo.stop stops it, records sealedDemo on success and clears it. Other methods refuse with DEMO_BUSY while active. prompt requires sealedDemo to equal the requested demo.

Launch states are running, announced, settled and failed. stop sends SIGINT to the negative process group and arms SIGKILL after the budget; a later shorter budget re-arms the timer. close settles once, clears timers and computes the public reply.

Operator Stop uses 300000 ms to let the tool seal evidence, while quit-time disposal and output-overflow failure use 10000 ms. A shorter later budget always re-arms an in-flight longer timer so Stop cannot outlive disposal.

Accepted methods are entry.copy, demo.start, demo.stop, demo.prompt and check with preload button-call shape. Record requires identity and demo, prompt requires demo and site, check requires site. A check result from another source than the operator site is refused.

One demo at a time is enforced by the active guard. stop is idempotent and shares the same done promise. Timer callbacks for record deadline 30000 ms and other verbs 420000 ms race only through the failed flag and single settle.

Child runs detached with ignored stdin and piped output, capped at 65536 total bytes. Clipboard writes are capped at 16384 bytes. stopTimer and verb timers are always cleared on close. dispose stops the active run with the dispose budget.

Runtime comes from demoRoot tools/mv_demo.py, entry text from root docs/AGENT_ENTRY.md, and packaged demos from the operator MV_OPERATOR_REPO checkout for Git admission. Child env keeps only PATH, LANG, LC_ALL, TMPDIR, TZ, HOME, XDG dirs, MV_SRF_BIN_DIR, MV_SRF_STATE_DIR, SRF_IDENTITY_STORE_ROOT, MV_MW_HOME and MV_MEMORYWEB_REPO.

Depends on node:fs readFileSync for the entry file, node:path join for tool and doc paths, node:child_process spawn injectable as spawnTool, process.kill injectable as killGroup, and preload assertButtonCall and viewerUrl for call and URL validation.

Shell is disabled and argv is fixed so the renderer cannot inject executable, cwd, env or shell strings. Signals target the negative child pid to contain the group. Stderr and stdout share the overflow budget. Detail from CLI errors stays private.

Byte plane is pure lossless accounting for terminal sessions with no DOM, timers, filesystem or Electron. Each session and direction ledger ingests contiguous base64 frames and retires them through cumulative parser-consumed ACKs; an accepted byte is never dropped.

When the wire violates contiguity, base64, size or lifetime the caller gets PlaneError with a stable code and counter-only message, never payload bytes. The session is closed and onFault fires once with a context copy and code.

Producer sees pause advice once when buffered bytes reach the high watermark and resume advice once when drained to the low watermark or below. Counters never lose bytes; pause and resume callbacks carry no payload.

Ingest faults the session on seq gap versus duplicate, non-strict base64, frame over maxFrameBytes, too many unacked frames, too many unacked bytes, or lifetime overflow. Fail closes the ledger, calls onFault once, then throws. Malformed caller input throws TypeError before any effect.

Acknowledge throws and leaves the ledger untouched on ack at or below the acked seq, unknown seq with no boundary, or byte count not equal to the recorded cumulative boundary. Unknown session, closed ledger or generation mismatch also throw without mutating counters.

createBytePlane takes limits plus onPause, onResume and onFault and returns open, ingest, acknowledge, attach, close and snapshot. Contexts carry session, direction, serviceGeneration, epoch and attachmentGeneration. Frames carry seq plus strict base64. ACKs carry cumulative seq plus bytes.

Ingest validates context, generation and ledger, checks seq equals lastSeq plus 1, decodes base64 to owned bytes, enforces pending, frame-count and lifetime caps, records cumulative sent offset per seq, appends to the replay tail and may emit pause. Returns a fresh byte copy.

Attach bumps attachmentGeneration after a service match and strictly increasing generation check, then returns a display-only replay suffix with firstSeq, lastSeq, oldest-first bytes and truncated true once any byte aged out of the bound. Close releases replay and ACK boundaries but keeps lifetime counters.

Ledger moves from open to closed on fatal fault or close; closed is sticky and idempotent for close. Pause latches on crossing high water and unlatches on draining to low water. Attach only advances attachment generation; service change or non-increase throws stale-generation.

Session is non-empty without NUL, direction is input or output, generations and ack fields are unsigned safe integers, seq is a safe integer, and b64 matches strict padded base64. Invalid shapes throw TypeError before ledger lookup so no state changes.

Limits require every bound at least 1, lowWater below highWater, highWater at or below maxPendingBytes, and safe sums for pending plus frame and lifetime plus frame. All bounds are validated before any ledger or buffer exists, with owned copies kept.

Input and output are distinct ledgers keyed by direction plus NUL plus session. Host callbacks receive fresh context copies. ACK seq 0 with 0 bytes is valid only as input shape; acknowledge still requires strictly increasing seq and an exact recorded boundary.

No timers or locks; accounting is synchronous. Flow controller fires onPause once on rising through high water and onResume once on falling to low water. Reset clears buffered bytes and pause. Snapshot reads buffered and paused without side effects.

Buffered and lifetime arithmetic is checked for safe-integer overflow before commit. Replay retains at most replayBytes, trimming the head first and marking droppedBytes sticky. Ingest returns sliced copies so callers cannot mutate retained chunks.

All flow and plane bounds come from the caller options object with no implicit layer defaults. Missing options, non-function pause, resume or fault observers, or an invalid limits object throw TypeError or RangeError during construction.

Only Node Buffer base64 measurement and decoding is used; no DOM, timers, filesystem, Electron or network. Host supplies onPause, onResume and onFault observers and owns parser consumption behind cumulative ACKs.

Wire violations cannot silently drop accepted bytes: they fault explicitly and preserve lifetime counters. Error text carries counters only. Stale or off-ledger operations leave the ledger untouched rather than resyncing.

Capture bridge is the metadata-only transport seam between renderer capture IPC and a host core binding. Only capture metadata crosses; operational transport failure is reported as unavailable and no media bytes or paths cross this seam.

User sees capture buttons do nothing with {ok:false,code} where code is SURFACE_UNKNOWN, ALREADY_RECORDING, NOT_RECORDING, CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE, NESTED_DISPLAY_ONLY, LIMIT, DESTINATION_UNSET, CAPTURE_UNKNOWN, NOT_SEALED, DESTINATION_UNAVAILABLE, DESTINATION_EXISTS, BUDGET_EXCEEDED or POLICY.

When the core transport throws, the renderer gets {ok:false,code:CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE} instead of an exception. When export has no configured destination it gets DESTINATION_UNSET. Nested walls get NESTED_DISPLAY_ONLY for capture calls.

Bad channel, wrong arity, wrong key set, wrong schema, bad request_id, bad surface, capture or recording id, bad destination, non-ai mode, or max_fps outside 1 to 60 throws PAYLOAD or ARGS or CHANNEL before the core is touched.

Core reply {ok:false,code,request_id} is accepted only for the closed code set with matching request_id. Any other shape or unknown code throws OUTCOME. Valid shapes are frozen per method including optional dropped_frames on recordStop and digest plus size bounds on export.

installCaptureBridge takes ipcMain, contents, core, nested flag and env, validates the main-only recording grant once, installs metaviewer:capture.* handlers for screenshot, recordStart, recordStop, export, list, subscribe and unsubscribe, and returns dispose.

requestCapture validates the call then issues core.request with {op:capture,method,request}. Calls without a request use list or subscription paths with an empty refusal request_id. Export requires a non-null configured destination on both sides.

Renderer request schema capture_request/v1 flows to core record or capture handling; sealed metadata rows, shot descriptors, recording descriptors and export digests flow back frozen. State events flow from core.subscribeCapture through validCaptureState filtering to metaviewer:capture.state only when subscribed.

Bridge holds disposed and subscribed flags. Subscribe sets subscribed true, unsubscribe clears it. Dispose clears subscribed, revokes the core subscription and removes handlers. Nested=true installs nothing and every capture path stays display-only.

Capture rows and state use phases idle, starting, recording, stopping, sealed and error. State events carry type capture.state plus recording_id, surface_id, phase, frames and elapsed_ms; invalid states are dropped and never forwarded to the renderer.

Objects must have exact sorted keys, plain data descriptors and no extra keys. IDs match the bounded human pattern, numbers are non-negative safe integers, request_id is 1 to 64 printable characters, list holds at most 64 rows, export bytes are positive within 16 MB with hex digest.

RecordStart takes mode ai plus surface_id with optional max_fps; recordStop takes recording_id; export takes capture_id plus destination recording:configured or null plus optional max_fps; screenshot takes surface_id. Core inherits MV_RECORDING_DESTINATION; renderer never supplies a path.

No media is buffered here; export metadata is bounded by digest and size checks and list by row count. Recording destination is resolved once at install from the same main-only grant as authorityWire, so per-call filesystem work is avoided.

Destination grant comes from MV_RECORDING_DESTINATION through recordingDestination; unset or empty stays null and makes export return DESTINATION_UNSET. Native export must dispatch through record_request disk_start for the sealed ID with that grant.

Depends on core.request for capture and optional core.subscribeCapture for state, main observeSender and privileged origin for sender admission, preload ContractError for channel, arity, payload, sender and outcome errors, and authorityWire recordingDestination for the destination grant.

A closed refusal set that lacked BUDGET_EXCEEDED and POLICY turned core refusals into thrown OUTCOME and shut the host connection down; the set now includes both. Unknown reply codes still throw rather than being passed through as success.

Core launcher supervises one pinned Rust child: single-flight spawn, scrubbed env, bounded stdio/queues, handshake-gated live state, trusted-ledger reap. Main never respawns; Rust owns state after hello.

Adapter launcher supervises bundled daemon adapter next to core with dev-stack env subset, preflight checks, handshake wait, and typed degraded fallback so app stays core-only when adapter is absent or crashes.

createCoreLauncher validates exact option keys, absolute bounded command, NUL-free args, scrubbed env, pid/pgid, killFn/handshake/transport/limits/ownership/callbacks before any spawn; bad options throw CoreLauncherError.

scrubChildEnv builds frozen core env from allowlist LANG/LC_ALL/PATH/TMPDIR/TZ plus validated XDG_RUNTIME_DIR; PATH keeps only absolute segments max 32, missing/unusable PATH refuses ENV_PATH with no fallback.

scrubAdapterEnv starts from scrubbed core env, retains ALLOWED_ADAPTER_ENV subset, forwards validated MV_RECORDING_DESTINATION separately and bounded nonempty MV_RECORDING_CAPABILITY_ID; MV_SRF_NET_MODES never comes from parent.
validateKillTarget admits only primitive safe-integer pid>1 distinct from selfPid/selfPgid with safe-integer identities; boxed/proxy/coerced values refused; total, never throws.
Single-flight start latch set before spawn; repeated start shares one promise; core goes unavailable forever on failure and never respawns; adapter never respawns in a loop, spawnCount at most 1.
Core states idle->starting->live or ->unavailable; authority_epoch only from verified hello else null; first terminal reason wins; dispose forces unavailable synchronously to block racing start.

Spawn null, unsafe pid, malformed handle, listener refusal, connect/handshake timeout, bad epoch, EOF/error/exit/close all move to unavailable with reasons like core spawn failed, HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT, bad authority epoch.

request when not live throws NOT_LIVE; unmeasurable throws REQUEST_SHAPE; over maxRequestBytes throws REQUEST_BYTES; queue count/bytes overflow throws QUEUE_FULL/QUEUE_BYTES; transport runs once with requestTimeoutMs, never resent.
Non-byte stdout chunk or partial line over maxStdoutLineBytes or non-UTF8 fails child to unavailable and stops tree; stderr only retains bounded tail maxStderrTailBytes and never fails child alone.
User sees Degraded mode (CODE): adapter absent or crashed, capsules unavailable, running core-only; detail appends redacted stderr tail with secrets/tokens and control chars stripped.
Refusals surface as CoreLauncherError CODE: message with codes OPTIONS/SPAWN/COMMAND/ARGS/ENV_PATH/SETTINGS_DESTINATION/VERSION_MISMATCH/NOT_LIVE/QUEUE_FULL/REQUEST_TIMEOUT.
withTimeout races task against deadline, aborts controller on timeout, always clears timer; in-flight count/bytes incremented before await and decremented in finally.

stopChild TERMs owned guard-admitted pids in reverse ledger order, awaits waitForExit with shutdownTimeoutMs, escalates to SIGKILL on deadline, then bounded rewait; never throws; zero signals when nothing spawned.
Bounds: env value 4096 chars, PATH segments 32, env name 64, path 4096 chars; handshakeTimeoutMs over 10000 refused.

discoverAdapterNetModes probes deployed srf-identity-surface capabilities v1 once at startup with 1500ms timeout, proxy vars stripped; missing/failed/malformed leaves MV_SRF_NET_MODES absent for legacy; snapshot cached in networkProbes.
Forbidden env families DYLD_/ELECTRON_/LD_/NODE_/PYTHON plus BASH_ENV/ENV/GCONV_PATH/HOSTALIASES/ZDOTDIR never reach child; finders list present forbidden names from malformed-proof enumeration.
Recording destination must be bounded absolute NUL-free path, realpath to existing directory, outside source tree; otherwise SETTINGS_DESTINATION or SETTINGS_IN_REPO refusal.

Default adapter handshake polls XDG_STATE_HOME/metaviewer/sessions/$MV_SESSION_ID/events/1.json or ADAPTER_HANDSHAKE_OK stdout line every 20ms until handshakeTimeoutMs; exit/degraded aborts with ADAPTER_EXITED.
Presentation-only desktop layout state shared by renderer and packaged gate: per-view walls with active/next ids, assignments of surfaces to view/desktop, dockview geometry preserved.
Identical chord grammar in renderer and native xpra input boundary mapping Ctrl combos to desktop resize/toggle/select actions with fixed closed payload.
createDesktopState returns schema metaviewer.desktops/v1 with human/agent views each holding desktop id 1; max 16 walls per view.
validateDesktopState enforces exact keys, schema match, known views/presets, positive safe-int ids below next, unique ids containing 1 and active, layout only via validator callback.
Saved panel capsuleId must be string, occur once globally, and match assignments view/desktop; prototype keys __proto__/constructor/prototype and whitespace ids rejected.
assignSurface pins surface to current active desktop of view, preserving existing home if same view; desktopRows filters rows by assignments view/desktop pair.
Unknown view throws CAPSULE_ROLE_UNPROVEN; role and backend identity immutable, only desktop moves within view.
addDesktop when 16 desktops or id overflow throws DESKTOP_LIMIT; else appends blank desktop, bumps next, makes it active.
removeDesktop refuses id 1, unknown id, or occupied wall returning false; on success filters wall, resets active to 1 if needed, then compacts ids and remaps assignments atomically.
moveSurface changes only desktop within same view, returns false if unknown surface or target; follow=true also switches activeView and view active to target.
normalizeDesktopLayout deep-clones layout and wraps leaf root into branch root preserving group and width because Dockview runtime requires branch root.
pruneDesktopLayout drops panels failing keep(), filters views/groups/floating/popout grids, fixes activeView/activeGroup, creates empty desktop-empty branch if root lost, prunes savedWallPlacements.
Ctrl+Alt+arrows without Meta/Shift maps to resize narrower/wider/shorter/taller; Ctrl+Tab toggles, Ctrl+1..9 selects desktop N; Ctrl+Alt alone or other combos return null.

interceptDesktopShortcut ignores unknown chords unless code in captured set; preventDefaults, tracks keyUp release, adds code to captured, dispatches CustomEvent metaviewer:desktop-shortcut with JSON detail via executeJavaScript.
Assignment id and layout panel checks block prototype pollution and cross-view aliasing; duplicate capsuleId across desktops fails validation.
Config: DESKTOP_SCHEMA metaviewer.desktops/v1, VIEWS human/agent, PRESETS single/side-by-side/grid/focus-strip/floating, limit 16.
Depends only on dockview grid schema grid.root/panels/views/floatingGroups/popoutGroups/activeGroup; no Electron import, usable in renderer and layout gate.

Per-tile 20-30fps DISPLAY reader for metaviewer/display/<surface>.ring using seqlock protocol: guarded open, bounded seqlock reads, RGB24 conversion, stale detection, VERIFIED-only fallback when absent.
Host coordinator owns per-surface readers and display ports, allocating MessageChannel only after valid ring appears so VERIFIED-only surfaces incur zero port transfers.
Main-process forwarder posts display ports to webContents via authority.frames only after isolated preload receiver-ready, queuing up to 256 surfaces otherwise.
createDisplayReader takes runtimeDir/surfaceId/uid/maxFps 1-30/staleTimeoutMs/size limits/visible/clock/timers/onFrame/onState/onRefusal; bad options throw DISPLAY_READER_OPTIONS.
64-byte header requires magic MVDISP1, zeroed bytes 48-63, width/height within limits, format RGB24/BGRX32, stride>=width*bpp, slotBytes within maxFrameBytes, size equals header+2 slots.
Slot converted to tightly packed RGB24: direct copy for RGB24 without padding else row striping; BGRX32 maps [B,G,R,X] to [R,G,B] per pixel honoring stride padding.
readOnce does guarded reopen on inode/dev change, header1 parse, generation-change reopen, size check, seq 0/odd/unchanged fast paths, slot read, header2 torn check, then RGB convert and onFrame.
Ring lives under $runtime/metaviewer/display/<id>.ring walked without symlink follow; dirs 0700 uid-owned, file 0600, tmpfs magic required; reads capped 30/s, stale after 2000ms.
Reader states absent/active/stale; advance of capture_mono_ns moves to active with timestamp; no advance for staleTimeoutMs moves to stale; absent on missing ring or failed guard.
Returns RING_ABSENT on ENOENT/ENOTDIR, OPEN_SYMLINK on symlink/ino-dev mismatch, STAT_UID/STAT_MODE on owner/mode, STAT_NOT_FILE on non-file, NOT_TMPFS on statfs miss or non-tmpfs, OPEN_IO otherwise.

Returns HIDDEN when invisible, IN_FLIGHT on overlap, RATE_LIMITED over maxFps, CLOSED after close, EMPTY_RING on seq 0, TORN_SEQ_ODD/CHANGED on tearing, UNCHANGED on duplicate, SIZE_MISMATCH/INVALID_HEADER with close.
User sees frozen tile marked stale after 2s without new capture, or VERIFIED-only static rendering when ring absent; no crash, polling continues.
Polling paces at 1000/maxFps with drift-corrected target, unrefed timers, single outstanding timer; setVisible/stop defer handle close via closeAfterRead until in-flight seqlock read drains.
File handles closed on hide/stop/generation change/mismatch/close; close awaits readDrain before releasing; scratch slot buffer reused and grown only when needed.
Depends on framePort createDisplayPort and node worker_threads MessageChannel; renderer port transferred once subscribed, revoked port nulled; pull requestPort replaces endpoint max 4/s per surface.
surfaceId regex alphanum start plus . _ : - up to 128 chars, rejects .. and slash; runtime root must be absolute normalized length 1-512 NUL-free to block traversal.
Retail diagnostics log at most one line per stage per surface up to 256 surfaces and posted plus first ACK or 3s TIMEOUT per live surface; ACK requires display_ack/v1 with even seq>=2.
Bridge validates sender/mainFrame app://metaviewer/ origin and exact schemas display_request/v1 and display_diagnostic/v1; bad events dropped; post failure closes port and records posted=false.
Instrumentation exposes readsAttempted/readsPerSecond/framesRead/tornReads/refusals/reopens/lastRefusal/lastGeneration/lastSeq; validated u64 kept as strings across clone.

Env-gated main-process frame pipeline diagnostics for live QA and production-path E2E. Tracks deliveries posted, frame_ack outcomes, stream revocations by reason, and preload notices. Writes atomic 0600 frame-diag.json in verified private run dir. Adds no window.metaviewer facade.

Enabled only when MV_FRAME_DIAG=1 in non-packaged, non-nested launch. Packaged launch with var set throws RETAIL_ENV; other non-empty values except 0 throw RETAIL_ENV. Run dir precedence: runDir, MV_FRAME_DIAG_DIR, MV_QA_RUN_DIR, MV_E2E_RUN_DIR, XDG_RUNTIME_DIR, runtime.xdgRuntimeDir via validateQaRunDir.

installFrameDiag(options) resolves config and returns frozen handle with recordCadence, recordRehashDiag, handleReportDiag, recordDelivery, recordReaderRefusal, recordPortRefusal, recordStateOnly, recordAck, recordRevocation, getSnapshot, flush, dispose. Registers IPC handlers when enabled.

metaviewer:frames.reportDiag and metaviewer:frame.diag IPC handlers validate sender with observeSender against contents and PRIVILEGED_ORIGIN. Require exactly one argument; disposed bridge throws FRAME_DIAG_DISPOSED. Report path also registered when disabled unless nested.

record* mutates counters and last* plus pushEvent ring, then scheduleWrite increments seq, buildSnapshot freezes schema, requestedWallFps, main counters, preload state, and schedules serialized writeFrameDiagSnapshot through writeChain with pendingBatch coalescing.

validateFrameDiagPreload enforces closed data-only keys for three accepted shapes, schema frame_diag_preload/v1, non-negative safe-int counters, inWallApp boolean|null, bounded origin without NUL, SURFACE_ID_RE, generations >=1, DOM strings <=512. Returns frozen normalized record with rehash defaults 0.

validateFrameRehashDiag requires plain object with exact keys rehashSkipped and rehashDone, both non-negative safe integers, no accessors or symbols. Returns frozen pair. Used by reportDiag and recordRehashDiag paths.

Per-session monotonic rehash max stored in WeakMap for object senders and Map for scalar keys, plus global latestRehashMax. Any decrease throws FRAME_DIAG_DECREASE. Merges use Math.max for both counters.

Enabled state holds deliveriesPosted, refused by reader/port, portAnnouncements, stateOnlyPosted, acksReceived, acksByOutcome 7 keys, revocationsTotal/byReason, readerRefusalsByCause, lastDelivery/Ack/Refusal/Revocation, recentEvents. Disabled handle no-ops except cadence and rehash tracking.

Packaged launch with MV_FRAME_DIAG set throws RETAIL_ENV refuses diag. Invalid MV_FRAME_DIAG value throws RETAIL_ENV. Nested launch with --nested-depth=1 forces disabled without error. Missing run dir fails in validateQaRunDir.

Snapshot over 64 KiB throws FRAME_DIAG_PAYLOAD. Run dir must be existing non-symlink directory owned by uid with mode 0700 else FRAME_DIAG_RUN_DIR. Target symlink or non-file throws FRAME_DIAG_SYMLINK. Post-write mode must be 0600 regular file else FRAME_DIAG_WRITE.

Bad sender verdict throws its code with sender refused. Wrong arg count throws FRAME_DIAG_ARGS. Bad payload throws FRAME_DIAG_PAYLOAD. Rehash decrease throws FRAME_DIAG_DECREASE. All leave counters unchanged.

Tester sees no frame-diag.json when disabled, packaged, or nested, or stale file when throttled to one write per second per session. Disposed report calls fail visibly with FRAME_DIAG_DISPOSED instead of updating snapshot.

Preload and report writes occur only when state changes and at most once per second per session using injectable clock. Deferred writes use unref timer. Cadence changes mark dirty and share the same budget.

Atomic durable write uses temp .frame-diag-pid-uuid.tmp with O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW mode 0600, chmod, writeFile, fsync, rename, post-write lstat verify, directory fsync, and best-effort temp unlink in finally.
recentEvents ring keeps at most 16 frozen copies. Session write timestamps use WeakMap plus scalar Map. Snapshots and rehash maxima are frozen. Timer cleared on flush and dispose.
Depends on validateQaRunDir for directory verification and on observeSender, PRIVILEGED_ORIGIN, MainError from main.js for sender gating and typed errors. No renderer facade method is added.

assertOutsideSource rejects any candidate inside repository SOURCE_ROOT before and after realpath, preventing diag writes from overwriting source. Symlink and mode checks plus O_NOFOLLOW close target-swap hazards.

requestedWallFps defaults to 30 and only accepts safe integers 3, 30, 60. Enabled cadence change marks dirty and schedules write. Snapshots expose requestedWallFps at top level, in main, and preload shape retains it.

Direct utility to renderer frame delivery over a brokered MessageChannelMain port. One instance binds one tile lifetime and carries at most one unacked frame plus one pending replacement. Bulk bytes never relay through main. No Electron import so tests run under Node with fakes.

createFramePort validates wiring, binds principal epoch surfaceId surfaceGeneration and limits, attaches message and close listeners, starts port, and returns frozen postFrame, acceptAck, revokeFramePort, getInstrumentation. Invalid wiring throws FramePortError.

createDisplayPort builds unverified DISPLAY sender for one surfaceId with postDisplayFrame, postDisplayState, close, getInstrumentation. Uses display_frame/v1 and display_state/v1 so display frames cannot enter VERIFIED admission or receipts.

Sender postFrame sends first unacked frame via postMessage frame_delivery/v0.2 with correlation, queues later frames as pending. Receiver admits newest into held slot, consumes via onFrame, posts frame_ack/v0.2, releases lease. Sender ACK clears inFlight and promotes pending.

checkIdentity validates object shape and safe-integer epoch and generation before comparing binding. Mismatch returns SURFACE_MISMATCH, STALE_EPOCH, STALE_SURFACE_GENERATION, or INVALID_BINDING. No state changes on any refusal path.

checkFrameShape validates positive frameGeneration, leaseId, rgb24 format, positive width height, Uint8Array bytes, byteLength equals bytes length and width*height*3 within maxFrameBytes, 64-char lowercase sha256 non-null, pixelSpec object. Caps checked before products.

ACK path requires matching principal epoch surface binding, kind ack and schema when present, positive generation, leaseId, string correlation, outcome in ACK_OUTCOMES. Only exact inFlight triple of generation leaseId correlation clears the slot.

Sender states are empty, inFlight set, pending set. Receiver states are held set and consuming set. acceptedFloor and ackedFloor only increase. Revoked is terminal with revokeReason and revokedAtMs; further posts and ACKs are refused.

Newest-only queue: sender replacement releases old pending as SUPERSEDED; receiver replacement releases old held as SUPERSEDED and ACKs it SUPERSEDED. Active consumer defers SUPERSEDED outcome until its promise settles, preserving exactly-once release.

postFrame on revoked port returns PORT_REVOKED; receiver role returns INVALID_BINDING; stale generation returns STALE_FRAME_GENERATION. Identity and shape failures return their refusal and increment refused without mutating floors or slots.

Receiver with bad kind or schema increments refused and drops. Identity failure drops. Shape failure sends best-effort REFUSED ack when correlation usable. Stale generation sends REFUSED ack. Refused arrivals are never retained.

Wire or public ACK with no matching inFlight returns LEASE_INVALID and increments refused. Replay at or below ackedFloor returns ok duplicate true with no change. Wrong role or revoked port returns PORT_REVOKED or INVALID_BINDING.
Each delivery arms ackTimeoutMs timer guarded by generation and token. Matching ACK disarms it. Stale timer firings are ignored. Expiry increments timeouts and revokes with TIMEOUT.

Receiver consumption serializes on receiverChain in admission order. onFrame resolves to outcome or REFUSED on throw or bad shape. Revocation during consume overrides outcome with revoke cause; ACK skipped when revoked.

Every held frame gets exactly one onReleaseLease call after state is final. Throwing owner increments releaseFaults and records lastReleaseFault without breaking transport. Revoke releases inFlight, pending, and held.

revokeInternal is idempotent, detaches listeners, best-effort closes port, releases holdings, then calls onRevoke once with binding copy and reason. Remote close maps to ENDPOINT_RESTART and ends the binding.

limits has no defaults and requires positive maxFrameBytes, finite ackTimeoutMs above zero, positive maxSurfacesPerPort else INVALID_BUDGET. Receivers require onFrame; senders must not carry it. Optional clock, setTimer, clearTimer, sender onAck must be functions.

Depends only on brokered port with postMessage plus on/off or addEventListener and optional start and close. Unwraps Electron MessageEvent data or bare messages. Timestamps and timers are injectable for tests.

User sees frozen or missing tile after TIMEOUT, PORT_REVOKED, or ENDPOINT_RESTART revocation. Superseded frames never paint; only newest is consumed. Refused postings return ok false with reason and detail and send nothing.

Size caps precede allocation-sized products to block hostile lengths. Digest presence is checked but recomputation stays with reader. Null digest rejected. Display port schemas isolate unverified frames from verified admission.

frameReader.js verifies immutable rgb24 frame generations in an Electron utility process. It admits frame_ref/v0.2, acquires a published source via injected capability, copies a bounded private snapshot, declares C-PIXEL layout before hashing, and returns an owned VerifiedFrame with SHA-256 match.

createFrameReader(options) is the sole factory. It validates closed binding, limits, pixelEnvironment, acquirePublishedLease and onReleaseLease with no defaults, then returns frozen {readFrame, closeReader}. Bad options throw FrameReaderError and admit nothing.

readFrame(frameRef, {signal}) verifies one reference. It refuses when closed, on bad options or signal, then admits the ref, checks surface, null digest, stale generation, dimension and byte budgets, and concurrency slots before queueing executeRead.
closeReader() aborts every in-flight read and refuses later reads. It aborts active controllers with 'closed', awaits pending settlements, is idempotent, and never unlinks a source.

Admit path copies frame_ref/v0.2 into a frozen object. It checks closed keys, schema tag, lexical ramws path, surface_id pattern, generation, tick/ts_ns/capture_us, dimensions, format rgb24, and sha256 hex. Caller object is never returned so later mutation cannot widen the read.

Execute path: acquirePublishedLease with bound identity and ref, admitLease against binding and expected bytes, readOwnedBytes with maxBytes, type and length checks, PNG rejection, frozen pixelSpec stamping, SHA-256 digest, owned copy, source release, then delivery or drop.

Refusal vocabulary FRAME_REASONS is frozen and shared with the port. Reader emits INVALID_CONTRACT, INVALID_BUDGET, INVALID_BINDING, INVALID_GENERATION, INVALID_PATH, UNPUBLISHED, LEASE_INVALID, SIZE_MISMATCH, DIGEST_MISMATCH, NULL_DIGEST, SURFACE_MISMATCH, STALE_FRAME_GENERATION, TIMEOUT, IO_ERROR, CLOSED.

Acquire failures crossing to frameDiag use closed ACQUIRE_CAUSE_CODES without paths or bytes: FRAME_BINDING, STALE, OPEN_PATH, OPEN_ENOENT, OPEN_SYMLINK, OPEN_EACCES, OPEN_IO, STAT_IO, STAT_NOT_FILE, STAT_UID, STAT_MODE, SIZE. Extracted only from causeCode or code.

All shapes are closed: frame refs, options, binding, limits and pixelEnvironment must have exactly the expected own keys sorted-joined. Extra or missing keys refuse. Options must not carry symbol keys.

C-PIXEL layout for rgb24 (format, RGB order, 3 bytes per pixel, width*3 stride, top-left, no alpha, sRGB) plus width, height, strideBytes and configured environment witnesses is frozen into pixelSpec before hashing and never defaults DPR.

Per-reader state holds closed flag, lastAccepted generation floor, inflight count, active abort controllers and pending promises. Pre-acquire refusals touch neither producer nor floor. Only a fully verified delivery advances lastAccepted to ref.generation.

Concurrency is bounded by maxConcurrentReads with inflight counting and TIMEOUT no-read-slot refusal. Each executeRead owns an AbortController in active set and a task in pending set. closeReader aborts all active and settles pending via allSettled.

Each read races acquire and byte reads against a readTimeoutMs timer via awaitUnlessAborted. Timer range is capped by MAX_TIMER_MS. Abort origin is timeout, caller, closed or opaque aborted. Late settlement after abort never escapes unhandled.

Byte budget is explicit: maxFrameBytes, maxWidth, maxHeight and packed expected width*height*3 with safe-integer and overflow checks. Dimensions above 16384 refuse as SIZE_MISMATCH. Acquire and read use frozen {maxBytes: expected}.

Pre-acquire path refuses without touching producer: unknown keys, bad schema, bad path root or pattern, bad surface id, bad generation, bad witnesses or dimensions, bad format or sha256, surface mismatch, null digest, stale generation, over-budget dimensions or bytes.

Lease admit refuses LEASE_INVALID on malformed lease, bad capability, bad identity, identity or generation mismatch, bad lease id; UNPUBLISHED when published is not true; SIZE_MISMATCH on byteLength mismatch. Malformed but releasable leases are released; well-typed identities notify owner.

Snapshot path drops the lease exactly once then refuses: bytes-not-uint8 when not Uint8Array, bytes-shared when buffer is not ArrayBuffer, snapshot-length-mismatch, and INVALID_CONTRACT png-signature-in-rgb24-payload when payload starts with PNG magic.
Digest path compares SHA-256 of received bytes to ref.sha256. Mismatch drops lease and returns DIGEST_MISMATCH. Test-mode refs carrying all-zero digest refuse early as NULL_DIGEST with no acquire.

Abort path maps closed to CLOSED and caller or timeout to TIMEOUT with detail aborted or read-timeout. If a lease is held it is dropped once; if acquire is pending the late lease is retired silently. Post-verify abort or close after source retire still notifies and refuses.

Capability throw before lease admit becomes IO_ERROR with detail acquire-failed plus closed cause token when recognized, else read-failed. A late-settling acquisition after termination is released via releaseLateLease with no owner notice so it never leaks.

User sees frozen or skipped frames: stale replays return STALE_FRAME_GENERATION, overloaded readers return TIMEOUT no-read-slot, closed readers return CLOSED. No pixels are delivered; caller gets {ok:false, reason, detail} and dropped leases fire onReleaseLease.

Corrupt or forged frames produce no image: SIZE_MISMATCH, DIGEST_MISMATCH, LEASE_INVALID or INVALID_CONTRACT. Log or reply carries only frozen reason and short detail like snapshot-length-mismatch, never paths or bytes.

Binding needs non-empty principal and surfaceId, positive epoch and surfaceGeneration. Limits need positive maxFrameBytes, maxWidth, maxHeight, readTimeoutMs within timer range, maxConcurrentReads. pixelEnvironment needs environmentId and finite positive zoom and dpr.

Depends only on node:crypto hashing and the injected trusted producer capability for publication, path safety, ownership and retention. Producer reclaim protocol is absent; SNAPSHOT_VERIFIED retire reason stays local. Callback and producer faults propagate loudly.

No TOCTOU between hash and copy: SharedArrayBuffer is refused, digest and owned Uint8Array copy run synchronously before any await or callback. Admit never aliases caller objects; delivery bytes are a private copy, never shared memory.

Reader enforces only lexical /dev/shm/ bounds, length, pattern, NUL, traversal and canonical segments; symlink ancestry, owner and type stay with the capability. Source and delivery leases are separate: success retires source via release and delivery lease stays downstream.

createMainBindings({env, createMessageChannel, getPeerCredentials, inputDeadlineMs}) validates config, authenticates peer, completes hello, checks socket identity, starts keepalive, and returns {core, wire}. Any acquisition failure throws a closed cause via acquireFail.

send(body, messageId, onWritten) frames envelope/v0.2 with from, to, session_id, seq, nonce and body. It enforces MAX_WIRE and writable length, increments seq, and throws CORE_SEAMS_ABSENT on disposed socket or unsafe integer seq.

receive(env) validates envelope keys, session, endpoints, ts_ns, seq ordering, nonce and msg ids, then dispatches hello, capture replies, created or state_changed, layout errors, verdicts, intents, frame_ref and frame_ready. Any shape violation calls shutdown.

core.request handles create, cadence, capture, input, intent and propose. Create is serialized, cadence applies locally, capture builds record_request/v0.2 with host-owned ids, input queues batches, intent or propose sends JSON with deadline and single healthy-timeout tolerance.

Wire is newline-delimited JSON envelopes over a unix socket. Incoming bytes accumulate to MAX_WIRE, split on newline, UTF-8 fatal decode and JSON parse. Received seq must increase; hello completes handshake. Outgoing lines larger than 1 MiB are refused.

Frames flow via publish: validate frame_ref, coalesce per surface to max published generation, store frozen latestFrames, then drainSurface per surface to listeners. buildFrameEntry creates a channel, binding, readerOptions with acquirePublishedLease, and portOptions.

Input flows via per-surface queues holding batches, cloned events, applied counts and resolvers. Drain checks admissibility, coalesces consecutive type events within byte limits, sends one action per turn via sendInputActionToCore, and records applied-prefix progress for retried partially applied batches.

Surfaces map holds frozen surface/v0.2 by id up to 64 entries. Events created and state_changed insert or update, destroyed or lost remove and clean channels, subscriptions, frames, stream ids, deliveries and input queues. departed set remembers bounded oldest ids to avoid settling a reopen create with a stale error.

Identities match narrow patterns, endpoints equal component plus instance with exact keys, hello carries schema hello/v0.2, contract v0.2 and commit hash. Create params allow only browser, desktop_capsule, game_capsule or vm with bounded geometry and optional nested_depth for desktop_capsule.

Creates serialize with SURFACE_CREATE_BUSY when one is in flight and SURFACE_CREATE_TIMEOUT after 60s. Settlement comes from a created event of same profile, a contract error on unknown surface, or an action verdict. Profile-bound or quarantined details map to SURFACE_PROFILE_BOUND or QUARANTINED.

Capture uses disk_start carrier with sealed capture id and host-owned destination grant, never a renderer path. recordStart uses ring bytes and effective max_fps from override or recordingFps default 3. Export requires configured destination else DESTINATION_UNSET. Stop identity is host-owned.

Acquisition reports closed BINDING_ACQUISITION_CAUSES without foreign messages or paths: CONFIG_ENV, RUNTIME_DIRECTORY, SOCKET_PATH, CONFIG_OPEN, CONFIG_READ, CONFIG_VALIDATE, HOST_CAPABILITIES, HOST_SETTINGS, SOCKET_CONNECT, PEER_CREDENTIALS, PEER_NOT_READY, HELLO_TIMEOUT, HELLO_CLOSED, HELLO_PROTOCOL, SOCKET_CHANGED.

Peer auth reads SO_PEERCRED and kernel VFS inode via python helper on the live fd. PEER_NOT_READY retries on the same socket within hello timer; probe timeout or IO becomes PEER_PROBE failure. Identity must match process uid and socket inode else shutdown.

Config and ramws opens pin every directory with O_NOFOLLOW via /proc/self/fd, refusing .. and dot segments. Owner-only mode and uid checks apply. ENOENT, symlink, access and generic IO map to OPEN_ENOENT, OPEN_SYMLINK, OPEN_EACCES or OPEN_IO.

Frame acquire classifies FRAME_BINDING, STALE for older generation, OPEN_PATH, OPEN_ENOENT, OPEN_SYMLINK, OPEN_EACCES, OPEN_IO, STAT_IO, STAT_NOT_FILE, STAT_UID, STAT_MODE, SIZE. Failures mark failedFrameGenerations so stale arrivals do not overwrite newer pending generations.

Input admissibility returns CORE_UNAVAILABLE, SURFACE_UNKNOWN, STALE_STREAM, NOT_IN_CONTROL, SCHEMA for out-of-bounds clicks or unknown kinds, or LIMIT. Each refused batch resolves {ok:false, code} without disposing wire or channels; send timeouts also report CORE_UNAVAILABLE per batch.

Intent and propose await verdicts with 3s deadline. One intent timeout on a healthy active session with reply progress rejects that intent with CORE_TIMEOUT and keeps wire alive; silent peers or repeated timeouts without progress call shutdown. Destroy errors map to CAPSULE_STOP_REFUSED.

User sees tile that never opens, frozen video, or ignored clicks and typing. Logs show only METAVIEWER_SURFACE_CREATE_SENT or WIRE_REPLY markers and closed codes like CORE_SEAMS_ABSENT, SURFACE_CREATE_BUSY, STALE_STREAM or CORE_UNAVAILABLE. Frames coalesce so older out-of-order arrivals never overwrite newer pending generation.

Per-surface input drains serially with draining flag and inFlightSeq tracking. Type bursts coalesce into one action bounded by adapter text bytes. Click, key and scroll send one primitive at a time. Partially applied prefixes persist as partialSeq and partialApplied for resume.

Bounds are 1 MiB wire and config, 64 MiB frames, 64 surfaces and pending calls, 4096 pixels per axis, 3s request and hello deadline, 256 queued input events per surface, 16384 adapter text bytes. Channels and input queues evict oldest beyond 64.

Trusted options are host-only: MV_CORE_CONFIG absolute path, XDG_RUNTIME_DIR socket directory with 0700 and socket 0600, XDG_CONFIG_HOME settings for wallFps and recordingFps, resources path. No renderer pathname or capability is accepted. Cadence listeners receive frozen wallFps notices.

Depends on node net, fs, path, crypto and util, Electron MessageChannelMain when present, terminalHost and displayReader hosts, authorityWire validators, and captureBridge assert functions. Clipboard falls back to no-op when Electron is absent.

Never reconnects: keepalive sends list every 10s to survive 30s receive-idle close, and socket inode, device, mode and uid are rechecked after handshake. Input refusals never dispose wire or frame channels. Capture metadata uses frozen error-detail carrier never reaching renderer consumers.

humanTrace.js records continuous human_trace/v0.3 input events with tile and capsule coordinates, viewport, AX row and redaction flags. It validates geometry and clocks, then writes JSONL rows through a bounded synchronous sink.

identityMarkers.js stores operator confirmation metadata separate from opaque browser profiles. It reads and confirms per-profile login_confirmation/v0.3 markers with owner-only files and atomic no-clobber writes.
identityProtection.js guards identities owned by other projects or the live launcher from deletion. It keeps foreign prefixes and a protected holder set in sync with tools/mv_identity.py.
keyboardLayout.js reads only XKB layout metadata from the app host display via setxkbmap -query, returning the first layout token or XPRA_KEYMAP_UNAVAILABLE.

createHumanTrace({sessionId, surfaceId, capsuleId, write, clock, maxEvents}) binds ids, origin time and counters, returning frozen {setActive, record}. record validates kind, clock, geometry, coordinates, button, phase and scroll fields before persisting one row.

createHumanTraceFile builds a host-owned no-clobber file sink with byte budget and pause callback; createHumanTraceBuffer builds bounded memory chunks with explicit exportTo. Both wrap createHumanTrace with unbounded event count and enforce limits in write.

pruneHumanTraces(directory, retentionDays) removes only private regular human-trace JSONL files older than cutoff, recursing once into profile directories. It refuses bad retention, non-directory roots, wrong owner or mode, or symlinked roots.

identityMarkers(directory) returns {read, confirm}. read opens profile.json no-follow, checks owner, mode 0600 and size, validates schema, profile_id, source operator and timestamp. confirm creates host directory, writes temp file, fsyncs and renames atomically.
isForeignIdentity checks prefix list or protected holder set; isProtectedIdentity adds mv- prefix. Both are pure string predicates used to refuse deletion of foreign or protected identities.

Event plus geometry plus AX context flow into a row with schema, session, surface, capsule, seq, monotonic_ns, kind, coords, viewport, ax_row and details. Click carries button, scroll carries deltas, key carries phase plus redacted key. Row JSON plus newline goes to write; false sink return skips seq advance.

Kinds are click, move, key and scroll. Only navigation keys may be retained; all printable keys are withheld. AX context must be a trusted capsule row, never HTML canvas or raw DOM objects. Sensitive defaults true when AX is missing, flagged sensitive, or password.

Clock must be monotonic non-decreasing bigint within safe integer; geometry widths and capsule sizes are positive safe integers; point coordinates are finite inside viewport; capsule coords scale linearly. Seq starts at 1 and increments only after successful write.

Record refuses with TRACE_BINDING_REFUSED on bad ids or write, TRACE_EVENT_REFUSED on unknown kind, TRACE_LIMIT on event cap, TRACE_CLOCK_REFUSED on backward or huge clock, TRACE_GEOMETRY_REFUSED, TRACE_COORDINATE_REFUSED, TRACE_BUTTON_REFUSED, TRACE_KEY_PHASE_REFUSED or TRACE_SCROLL_REFUSED.

File sink throws TRACE_LIMIT on bad maxBytes, TRACE_PROFILE_REFUSED on bad profile, TRACE_DIRECTORY_REFUSED on owner or mode mismatch, TRACE_CLOSED after close, TRACE_WRITE_FAILED on short write. Budget overflow pauses, fires onPause once, and returns false without writing. Buffer throws TRACE_LIMIT on overflow and removes partial export on failure.

Marker paths require lowercase profile pattern else IDENTITY_MARKER_REFUSED. Read returns null on ENOENT and rethrows other errors. Confirm validates directory owner and 0700 with realpath equality, uses O_EXCL 0600 temp plus rename, and always cleans temp.

File traces default to 50 MiB with shared budget object tracking bytes and paused flag; buffer defaults to 4 MiB. File writes loop on partial writeSync, count bytes, fsync on close. Pause is sticky once budget is exceeded.

Recorder is synchronous and bounded: write result is checked before seq and time advance, so overflow refuses before publication. setActive gates recording; close disables active then fsyncs and closes fd.

Retention defaults to 14 days; prune cutoff is now minus retention days. File helper optionally nests directory by profileId, creates 0700 dirs, prunes, then opens human-trace UUID jsonl with O_CREAT, O_EXCL and O_NOFOLLOW 0600.

Uses node fs and promises, path join, crypto randomUUID for filenames and temp names. No raw DOM or user object spreads reach persistence. Keyboard path shells only to setxkbmap; peer and display code live elsewhere.

Never follows profile symlinks: directory and file checks use lstat, realpath equality, uid and mode masks, O_NOFOLLOW and no-clobber create. Prune deletes only matching regular files owned by caller past cutoff.

Text learning has no channel here: key details store only navigation key name when not sensitive, else null with redacted true. AX row is stored only when not sensitive and row is a non-negative safe integer, else null.

User sees paused or missing trace: write returns false when paused or over budget, record throws TRACE_LIMIT at cap, prune silently keeps fresh files. Marker misuse surfaces as IDENTITY_MARKER_REFUSED; keyboard failure surfaces as XPRA_KEYMAP_UNAVAILABLE with no layout.

Main supervises Electron window lifecycle, default-deny navigation/permission policy, privileged app:// bundle serving with strict CSP, retail launch guards, fuse constants, and Rust core plus daemon-adapter supervision. Rust owns state; main admits no privileged receiver without observeSender.

bootProductionMain(handles) is the production entry on injected handles app, BrowserWindow, ipcMain, protocol, session, core, adapter, bridge, geometry, env, argv, runtime, wire. Validates exact keys, single-instance lock, retail verdict, Electron pin, then registers scheme, resolves paths, starts core/adapter, builds window and bridges.

Direct entry mainDirectEntry runs only when argv[1] equals this module under Electron; requires electron, checks retail and ELECTRON_PIN, registers privileged scheme before any await, loads host bindings, calls bootProductionMain, logs METAVIEWER_MAIN_READY. Plain Node import stays inert.

Window creation flows through createWindowOptions({width,height,preloadPath}) with frozen sandbox/contextIsolation/no-node flags, then attachWindowPolicy(win,session) wiring will-navigate, will-redirect, will-frame-navigate, window-open, webview and permission handlers to default-deny decisions.

Renderer bytes flow protocol.handle(app)->handleAppRequest(canonicalRoot,request): canonicalize root, check pinned dev/ino/fd, parse raw URL, scan raw segments with decodeSafeSegment, resolve/join, lstat, realpath containment, open descriptor identity, size/digest checks, then Response with Content-Type and CSP, optional per-response style nonce.

Layout IPC flows renderer->ipcMain.handle(load/save)->observeSender admit->arity check->decodeLayoutLoad/Save->entry.decode->entry.invoke reading/writing presentation/layout.json outside source tree. admitBridge enforces exactly two entries mirroring CHANNELS.load/save with {channel,decode,invoke} shape.

First-surface flow builds one surface_request/v0.2 create from MV_SRF_LIVE_PROFILE/MV_SRF_PROFILES with defaults kind browser 1280x900 mv-live-1, sends core.request with 60s race, classifies ok:false, error event, refused verdict or created event, reserves pending:profile in capsuleStates and notifies wireBridge or defers to pendingBootCreateError.

Renderer readiness needs three witnesses: index 200 response, did-finish-load, and admitted metaviewer:renderer-ready ping with top-frame URL app://metaviewer/index.html and live contents. Gate emits once then logs METAVIEWER_RENDERER_READY; response(false), missing finish, or wrong URL never fires.

Boot states: validate->lock->ready->paths->serve->bridge->options->harden->core live->adapter(optional)->window->IPC/bridges->loadURL->lifecycle->ready. Any failure calls unwind removing IPC handlers, disposing bridges, destroying window, unhandling scheme, closing pinned fd, disposing adapter then core. dispose shares one promise.

Only app://metaviewer URLs with empty credentials/port and no raw path escape are allowed; decideNavigation allows only canonical bundled URLs, decideWindowOpen/decidePermission/decideWebviewAttach always deny. Every malformed, foreign, oversized or escaping value denies.

Privileged IPC admits only event.sender strictly identical to expected live contents, not destroyed, id>=1, senderFrame identical to sender.mainFrame, non-detached, origin equals PRIVILEGED_ORIGIN and URL passes isPrivilegedFrameUrl. Refusals return frozen {verdict:refuse,code} and mutate nothing.

Response CSP is exactly default-src none, script/style/img/font self, connect/frame/object/base/form none. buildCsp(null) returns base; with 24-byte base64 nonce it extends only style-src with nonce. Malformed nonce throws CSP_NONCE. HTML nonce path requires <head> and rewrites meta policy plus injects metaviewer-style-nonce.

Load accepts only undefined payload returning null; save accepts only bounded UTF8 string <=256KiB that parses as JSON, else LAYOUT_BOUNDS. Storage validates via kit decodeAndMigrateLayoutProfile with scope metaviewer/default/main-wall or desktop validator, refuses inside source tree, enforces owner-only 0700 dir and 0600 temp+rename.

Retail refusal returns frozen {ok:false,code}: ARGV_SHAPE, RETAIL_FLAG on forbidden inspect/require/no-sandbox flags, RETAIL_ENV on forbidden env or packaged MV_E2E_LIVE/MV_FRAME_DIAG, NESTED_DEPTH on bad/duplicate nesting, UNKNOWN_SWITCH. Condition: dash-led token not in known runtime switches. bootProductionMain throws MainError(code).

Bundle serve never throws: canonicalize failure, pinned root/dev/ino mismatch, asar archive mismatch, bad URL/host/credentials, escape segment, symlink/dir, oversize >8MiB, digest mismatch or HTML without insertion point returns 403 with base CSP; missing file returns 404. Catch-all returns 403.

Sender refusal codes: SENDER on malformed event, sender mismatch, destroyed handle or throwing getter; FRAME_NULL, FRAME_DETACHED, SUBFRAME on non-identical frame, FRAME_ORIGIN, FRAME_URL. IPC listener then throws MainError(code,sender refused) to caller; layout arity mismatch throws LAYOUT_BOUNDS.

When MV_SRF_BIN_DIR set and adapter start error, non-live, or handshakeSeen false, boot logs METAVIEWER_BOOT_REFUSED <ADAPTER_* code> with redacted detail and throws ADAPTER_UNAVAILABLE/DEGRADED/START_FAILED before window construction, then unwinds core. Without MV_SRF_BIN_DIR core-only boot continues despite adapter failure.

User sees app exit immediately or no window: wrong Electron version logs ELECTRON_PIN, second instance quits with SINGLE_INSTANCE, core not live throws CORE_UNAVAILABLE, adapter not live refuses with dialog text to check MV_SRF_LIVE_PROFILE/RAM_ROOT or unset MV_SRF_BIN_DIR. Renderer sees 403 forbidden or 404 not found in bundle loads.

User sees empty main wall with capsule still creating: first-surface timeout or refusal logs METAVIEWER_SURFACE_CREATE_PENDING then METAVIEWER_SURFACE_CREATE_DEGRADED {code,reason} with SURFACE_CREATE_TIMEOUT/REFUSED/FAILED and keeps window. Renderer ready never logs METAVIEWER_RENDERER_READY if index blocked or ping sender refused with RENDERER_READY.

Adapter-supervised first create fires once without awaiting before window build, bounded by independent 60s timer unrefed; pending work never consumes readiness budget. will-quit prevents reentry with quitting flag, preventDefault, then shared dispose promise before app.quit. Unwind releases in reverse: hide, IPC, bridges, window, scheme, adapter, core.

Bundle root pinned by open directory/archive fd in pinnedProtocolFds; every open validates fstat dev/ino/nlink and /proc/self/fd path before descendant traversal with O_NOFOLLOW/O_DIRECTORY. Prior fd closed on re-serve and unwind. File cap 8MiB, layout 256KiB, URL 2048, preload 4096, adapter shutdown grace 45000ms above 30s close budget.

Pinned config: ELECTRON_PIN 44.9.2, PRIVILEGED_ORIGIN app://metaviewer, FUSE_VERSION 1 with exactly nine FUSE_TABLE rows, six required protections, buildFuseConfig emits {version,0..8,strictlyRequireAllFuses}. Geometry default 1280x720, surface default 1280x900, surface timeout 60000ms, MAX_ARGV 256x4096, runtime switches user-data-dir and ozone-platform.

Depends on injected Electron handles, hostBindings.createMainBindings via MV_CORE_BOOTSTRAP absolute owner-only file or ./hostBindings.js, coreLauncher createAdapterLauncher/findForbiddenEnv/redactAdapterDiagnostic, kit layout decoder at ../.kit/capsule-ui-kit layoutProfile.js and ./desktopLayout.js, role/operator/capture/display/authority/qa/frameDiag bridges, and mv_identity.py under resources/operator/tools when packaged.

Traversal hazard: WHATWG normalization would erase .. so scan uses raw request-target segments, rejects residual % to block double-encoding while allowing %25, plus backslash/NUL, dot segments, decoded separators. Resolved path containment rechecked after realpath, symlink files/dirs refused, descriptor identity replaces stat to close TOCTOU swap.

Path alias hazard: rendererRoot must be absolute bounded canonical directory; preload must be regular non-symlink file outside renderer root with no symlink in dist/preload chain; XDG runtime dir must be caller-owned non-symlink with 000 other bits and metaviewer subdir 0700; layout directory refused inside SOURCE_ROOT via relative check on candidate and canonical ancestors.

nesting.js is the display-only nested Electron entry: it admits only --nested-depth=1 retail launches, serves dist/renderer with a read-only IPC layout, isolates the profile, and shows the window only after the renderer wall settles.

openingMode.js stages one exclusive opening-mode record at <stateDir>/opening-modes/<profileId>.json with schema metaviewer.opening_mode/v0.3 and returns an async cleanup closure that unlinks it, ignoring ENOENT.

enterNested(argv,env,display) is the gate: it calls validateRetailLaunch(argv,env), throws on !verdict.ok or !verdict.nested, otherwise runs display(). The packaged bottom block calls it with process.argv/env before app ready.

Packaged Electron startup imports electron, checks app.isPackaged or argv[1] equals this file, then enableSandbox(), registerPrivilegedScheme(), and startDisplay(electron). Renderer load target is PRIVILEGED_ORIGIN/index.html.

installReadOnlyLayout(ipcMain,contents,registered) registers fixed read handlers for load, metaviewer:nested.depth=1, nested.self=null, recording.destination=null, settings.load=null; all privileged save/settings/authority/side-terminal channels throw. Sender checked by observeSender with PRIVILEGED_ORIGIN.

Contract: verdict.ok must hold else throw '<code>: nested launch refused'; verdict.nested must hold else throw 'NESTED_DEPTH: this display-only build requires --nested-depth=1; depth >= 2 is refused'. No core, capsule, terminal or socket capability is passed.

Read handlers require observeSender verdict admit and zero args, else throw 'DISPLAY_ONLY: layout sender refused' and return fixed values. Write/authority/terminal handlers always throw 'DISPLAY_ONLY: layout persistence is disabled; privileged actions are disabled'.

Nested profile isolation: resolved userData gets suffix '-nested-depth-1' unless already present. Renderer must expose window.metaviewer.load as function, have no window.require, and show .metaviewer[data-wall-settled=true] before show.

Startup states: whenReady -> serveBundled -> create BrowserWindow -> attachWindowPolicy -> set nested userAgent -> install layout -> loadURL -> poll settle up to 100x100ms -> show -> log METAVIEWER_NESTED_DISPLAY_READY. Any throw triggers cleanup and DISPLAY_ONLY-prefixed rethrow.

If process.versions.electron is not ELECTRON_PIN throw 'Electron must be <pin>'. If requestSingleInstanceLock fails throw 'SINGLE_INSTANCE: profile already in use'. If 15000ms race expires throw 'DISPLAY_ONLY: startup deadline exceeded'.

If wall never settles throw 'DISPLAY_ONLY: isolated renderer wall did not settle'. If win destroyed or expired, assertAlive throws 'DISPLAY_ONLY: display destroyed or startup deadline exceeded'. Failure path removes IPC handlers, window listener, window, and single-instance lock.

User sees a second viewer window never appear or vanish immediately; console shows DISPLAY_ONLY startup/wall/sender errors or SINGLE_INSTANCE. Save, settings save, authority and side-terminal actions always fail with persistence/privileged disabled text.

Wrong launch shows immediate refusal: '<code>: nested launch refused', NESTED_DEPTH depth message, or 'Electron must be <pin>'. Crash on render-process-gone or preload-error calls app.exit(1) after console.error(error.message).

Startup is Promise.race(startup(),deadline). Settled check is a serial 100-attempt loop with 100ms sleeps calling executeJavaScript and assertAlive before and after. expired flag blocks further progress after timeout or catch.

Lifetimes: single-instance lock held until failure cleanup calls releaseSingleInstanceLock; BrowserWindow destroyed on failure; ipcMain handlers tracked in registeredChannels and removed in reverse; window-all-closed listener removed; timer cleared in finally.

Fixed config: deadlineMs 15000, window 1280x720 with preload dist/preload/preload.cjs and title MetaViewer plus autoHideMenuBar, renderer dir dist/renderer with styleNonce true, userAgent token '--nested-depth=1'.

Depends on ./main.js for validateRetailLaunch, registerPrivilegedScheme, serveBundled, createWindowOptions, attachWindowPolicy, observeSender, CHANNELS, ELECTRON_PIN, PRIVILEGED_ORIGIN, and on electron app/BrowserWindow/protocol/session/ipcMain.

stageOpeningMode(stateDir,profileId,mode,hostBinary?) requires profileId ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$ and mode human|agent else CAPSULE_MODE_INVALID; hostBinary allowed only for agent, absolute, length<=256. Foreign profileId throws IDENTITY_PROTECTED.

Directory <stateDir>/opening-modes must be uid-owned, mode 0700, realpath equal to itself else CAPSULE_MODE_DIRECTORY. File uses O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW mode 0600, JSON synced; write failure unlinks the path.

operatorBridge.js is the host-only operator seam: identity tool runner, private handoff watcher with ack records, per-profile egress publishing for next capsule start, and button delegation. No agent channel or credential operation is registered here.

installOperatorBridge({ipcMain,contents,env,tool,buttonRoot,demoRoot,clipboard,admit,openLogin,...}) installs one ipcMain.handle per OPERATOR_METHODS as metaviewer:<method>, admits senders via admit(event), replies via assertOperatorReply, and starts a 1s refresh timer.

service.request(method,args) validates with assertOperatorCall, routes BUTTON_METHODS to buttons, identity.* to runIdentity, egress.* to private state, handoff.* via latched records. refresh() rescans handoff candidates and notifies metaviewer:handoff.state.

All handoff/egress file access goes through privateDirectory fd traversal refusing symlinks, then readPrivate/writePrivate with uid, 0700 dir, 0600 file, 64KB limits. Egress writes publish the adapter exact record under <MV_SRF_STATE_DIR>/egress/<identity>.json.

identityRunner spawns python3 <tool> <method> [--id ...] with a filtered env allowlist and no shell. stdout carries JSON schema metaviewer.identity/v1; login stderr is scanned only for 'Operator login view: http://...' to open the loopback view, never sent to UI.

publicIdentity allows only profile_id,browser,account_label,allowed_domains,created_unix,last_login_unix else IDENTITY_REPLY. Output is {id,label,domains,logged_in:'unknown',browser?} and must pass assertOperatorReply identity.show; null history is unknown, not logged-out.

toolRefusedCode parses stdout JSON schema metaviewer.identity/v1 ok:false error matching ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_-]{0,63}$. IDENTITY_PROTECTED/PROFILE_MISSING/PROFILE_NOT_PROVISIONED/IDENTITY_BOUND pass through, others become IDENTITY_REFUSED; unavailable/malformed returns null.

Per-run states: spawn -> accumulate stdout/stderr with 64KB cap -> optional login URL open -> close(rc) -> validate reply -> map rows. Nonzero rc uses toolRefusedCode else IDENTITY_EXIT. Login additionally requires opened view and login_view_closed true.

Handoff states: candidate -> private read + validHandoff -> check .ack.json match -> latched unacked/acked -> request writes ack and marks acked -> notify. Missing/failed reads never clear a latched notification; full latch evicts one acked entry.

Refusals: foreign id or protected delete rejects IDENTITY_PROTECTED before spawn. Byte cap yields IDENTITY_LIMIT, bad login URL yields LOGIN_URL/VIEW, timeout yields IDENTITY_TIMEOUT, bad shape yields IDENTITY_REPLY, nonzero exit yields refused code or IDENTITY_EXIT.

Identity errors map to IDENTITY_PROTECTED/REFUSED/MISSING/NOT_PROVISIONED/BOUND else IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE. Egress failures return NET_EGRESS_IO, open without support returns NET_OPEN_PREREQ, allowlisted without proxied returns NET_PROXIED_UNSUPPORTED.

User sees identity list/create/login/delete fail with IDENTITY_PROTECTED, IDENTITY_REFUSED, IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE, IDENTITY_TIMEOUT, or PROFILE_NOT_PROVISIONED; login view never opens or reports LOGIN_URL/LOGIN_VIEW.

User sees handoff list empty or acknowledge fail with HANDOFF_UNAVAILABLE, egress change rejected with NET_OPEN_PREREQ, NET_PROXIED_UNSUPPORTED, or NET_EGRESS_IO; renderer receives {ok:false,code} rather than an exception.

Each spawn has a 30s timer, 1800000ms for login; login stop uses SIGINT then SIGKILL after LOGIN_STOP_GRACE_MS 200000. live set tracks terminators; dispose stops in-flight children. Bridge refresh runs every 1000ms unrefed.

Descriptors: every directory level held open via /proc/self/fd traversal with O_NOFOLLOW; files capped at 65536 bytes. writePrivate uses temp .operator-<uuid> O_EXCL 0600, fsync file and dir, atomic rename, read-back equality check else PERSISTENCE_FAILED.

Handoff discovery bounds: HANDOFF_DISCOVERY maxScan 4096, maxRuns 32, maxAgeMs 21600000, maxLatched 64, file memoryweb-run.handoff.json. Only 32-hex names within 6h are considered, sorted newest first.

Depends on tools/mv_identity.py plus optional MV_OPERATOR_REPO checkout, coreLauncher adapterNetworkProbe for net modes, buttonBridge createButtonService, preload asserts and validators, and node fs/path/url/child_process/crypto.

TOOL_UNAVAILABLE (IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE,NATIVE_UNAVAILABLE,ABSOLUTE_PATH_REQUIRED) means tool could not run and never maps to a refusal. IDENTITY_REFUSALS are the only closed codes surfaced; missing native provisioning uid 10001 mode 0700 surfaces as PROFILE_NOT_PROVISIONED.

preload.js exposes a frozen narrow renderer API as metaviewer with only load/save plus wired authority/input/capture/operator/frames/terminal/clipboard. It shapes and byte-caps every ingress argument before invoke and validates every reply. Main re-validates; preload never authorizes.

Bundled CJS entry requires electron, snapshots contextBridge/ipcRenderer as data properties, detects nested via --nested-depth=1 and qa/frameDiag flags, then calls createPreloadFacade. ESM import does nothing. After load it sends metaviewer:renderer-ready once unless nested.

createPreloadFacade({transport,bridge}) validates deps then exposes frozen api via exposeInMainWorld(metaviewer). Renderer calls api.load()/save()/authority.* /input.send/onResult/capture.*/operator.*/frames.reportDiag/sideTerminal.*/clipboard.*/qa.reportAnchors. Each call validates, invokes metaviewer:<suffix>, validates reply.

Control: renderer api -> assert/wireCall admission -> transport.invoke(channel, frozen args) -> main -> reply validators -> frozen reply or throw. Frames/display/terminal ports arrive via transport.subscribe callbacks, validated then forwarded with window.postMessage or delivered to listeners. No channel/path/handle crosses to renderer.

Layout load channel takes 0 args; save takes exactly 1 layout string capped at 256*1024 UTF-8 bytes via utf8Bytes. Load reply must be null or bounded string; save reply must be literal true. Off-set channel throws CHANNEL; bad vector throws ARGS; bad payload/outcome throws PAYLOAD/OUTCOME as ContractError.

Deps must be exactly own-data {transport,bridge} with no symbols and no accessors. transport.invoke and bridge.exposeInMainWorld must be data-function properties found by prototype walk. Violations throw ContractError DEPS. Same accessor rejection applies to electron contextBridge/ipcRenderer and qa/frameDiag flags.

Button calls allow only entry.copy/demo.* with exact keys and id pattern [a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*. entry.copy/demo.stop take 0 args else 1. Replies ok:false must be BUTTON_UNAVAILABLE/DEMO_REFUSED/DEMO_BUSY/DEMO_NOT_RECORDING; ok:true must be exact {ok} except demo.start {ok,url} where url is http localhost/127.0.0.1/[::1] <=2048 chars.

Operator calls enforce exact data-only keys, arity, identityId/identityLabel, sorted unique egress domains with exactEgressHost, validEgress schema/mode, validHandoff schema/surface_id/step_index/reason/confidence/evidence_kinds, gesture operator-acknowledge. Violations throw OPERATOR_ARGS/OPERATOR_PAYLOAD before invoke.

Operator replies: ok:false must carry listed IDENTITY_*/NET_*/HANDOFF_UNAVAILABLE codes; ok:true required. handoff.list rows<=64 validHandoff; egress rows carry valid record/net_mode legacy|open|proxied/reason; identity rows<=256 with logged_in unknown|yes|no. createOperatorFacade also blocks nested with NESTED_DISPLAY_ONLY and filters handoff.subscribe by same validator.

Capture methods screenshot/recordStart/recordStop/export/list/subscribe/unsubscribe validate schema capture_request/v1, printable request_id 1..64, capture ids, destination null|recording:configured, mode ai, optional max_fps 1..60. Replies freeze ok shapes: list<=64 rows, export bytes 1..16MiB sha256 hex64, sealed recording with optional dropped_frames, shot dims>0.

qa.reportAnchors takes one plain-object {schema:qa_anchors/v1,seq>=1,rows<=512}. Each row needs anchor 1..200 1..6 slash segments, role [a-z][a-z0-9_-]*, name<=128 no NUL well-formed, rect ints w/h>0. Normalized JSON must fit 64KiB UTF-8 else PAYLOAD. Channel refused unless transport.qa and not nested.

frame.diag accepts only 3 legacy/key sets with schema frame_diag_preload/v1, integer counters, optional rehashSkipped/rehashDone, inWallApp bool|null, origin<=256, surface/frame generations>=1, dom strings<=512. frames.reportDiag takes closed {rehashSkipped,rehashDone} integers. Violations throw PAYLOAD.

Surface input batch needs schema surface_input/v1|v0.2, capture surface_id, stream_id>=0, seq>=1, 1..32 events. click/key/type/scroll/release_all shapes strictly checked; type text<=1024 codepoints; JSON<=16KiB. Failures return SCHEMA/LIMIT locally without IPC. Reply accepted 1..event count or refusal NOT_IN_CONTROL/SURFACE_UNKNOWN/STALE_STREAM/LIMIT/NESTED_DISPLAY_ONLY/SCHEMA/CORE_UNAVAILABLE.

Domain wireCall routes qa/frame/capture/authority/settings/terminal/clipboard channels, checks arity, JSON shape and 256KiB cap, terminal spec cols 2..500 rows 2..300 session regex, clipboard no NUL. Frame notices require frame_ref/v0.2 rgb24 sha256 and surface/v0.2 fields within cap. Unknown channel throws CHANNEL.

Capture phases idle/starting/recording/stopping/sealed/error. capture.subscribe registers Symbol token, adds deliver to shared set, seeds idle states per surface when in metaviewer-app, invokes capture.subscribe, and only forwards frozen validCaptureState. Unsubscribe removes token; last removal invokes capture.unsubscribe. Cap 64 subscribers.

DISPLAY ports buffer one port per surface up to 256 until same-origin router ready (display-ready or display-request from app://metaviewer). Ready flushes pending via postMessage display-port then clears. Stage diagnostics PRELOAD_GOT_PORT/PRELOAD_FORWARDED/ROUTER_ATTACHED/FIRST_FRAME/FIRST_PAINT/REFUSED/VISIBILITY dedup per surface; unload closes buffered ports.

Per-surface input queue tracks lastSeq/inFlightMaxSeq/draining/lastIpcAt/ipcStamps. send rejects stale seq SCHEMA and over-queue LIMIT 256 events. Drain coalesces consecutive type events to 1024 chars, waits 20ms coalesce and 50 IPC/s throttle, sends one wire batch per stream, advances lastSeq on ok else resolves failure. destroyed/lost surfaces drop queue.

Terminal sessions bind to creator token in TERMINAL_SESSION_SENDERS (max 256, oldest evicted). attach/resize/close from another sender throws TERMINAL_IO_REFUSED. attach may wait one microtask for queued port then wraps with bridgeTerminalPort which normalizes bytes to Uint8Array and listener payloads to {data}. close deletes ownership.

Bounds: layout/settings/propose/intent/clipboard 256KiB UTF-8; qa snapshot 64KiB; input wire 16KiB and 14336 coalesced text bytes; input 32 events/batch, 256 queued, 64 surfaces; capture subscribe 64; display ports/stages 256 surfaces; terminal senders 256; frame ports extra beyond first are closed. All replies frozen.
