Condition: wrong channel/arity/type/oversize/invalid reply. Next: sync throw or rejected promise ContractError CHANNEL/ARGS/PAYLOAD/OUTCOME/LIMIT. Logged nowhere here; returned to renderer caller. Main never invoked on ingress failure; renderer must surface the rejection.

Condition: nested display (--nested-depth=1) calling terminal/clipboard/createOperator/capture/input or subscribing side-terminal.port. Next: local throw DISPLAY_ONLY or resolved {ok:false,code:NESTED_DISPLAY_ONLY}. Receiver is renderer feature; user sees disabled terminal/capture/input in nested wall.

User sees copy/demo buttons do nothing, demo viewer never opens, screenshot/record/export/list report unavailable/busy/not-recording, typed input dropped, identity/egress/handoff actions rejected. Code surfaces typed {ok:false,code} such as DEMO_BUSY, ALREADY_RECORDING, SURFACE_UNKNOWN, LIMIT, IDENTITY_REFUSED.

User sees layout/settings save or load silently fail or promise reject with PAYLOAD/OUTCOME. Happens when text is not a string, multibyte text exceeds 256KiB even with few chars, or main returns non-true/non-string. Renderer keeps old layout; no partial write occurs.

Fixed exposure metaviewer, privileged origin app://metaviewer, fixed channels metaviewer:layout.load/save plus wired metaviewer:<suffix> set. qa enabled only if electron.qa or --qa-anchors=1 and not nested; frameDiag only if electron.frameDiag or --frame-diag=1 and not nested. No runtime widening.

Depends on Electron contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld and ipcRenderer.invoke/on/send/removeListener, plus window.postMessage/MessagePort and document .mv-surface for diag. Transport double lacking subscribe disables frames/capture subscribe paths. Main mirrors channel literals and re-validates; renderer-ready handshake needs ipcRenderer.

Getter/symbol/prototype tricks are treated as attacks: accessors rejected, exact own-keys required, plain-prototype checked, frozen copies returned. Lone surrogates counted as replacement bytes and rejected in names/type text. Byte length uses custom utf8Bytes so multibyte cannot slip past char-count checks.

profilePicker.js picks the browser profile for Add capsule creates. Pure sync core with injected env/surfaces/identities; no fs/process/network/Electron. Rules: browser-kind candidates in map order live-first, skip bound profiles, require existing identity, cap 4 live, typed refusals fail closed.

Authority wire calls pickCreateRequest({env,surfaces,listIdentities}) which summarizes surfaces, awaits listIdentities(), then delegates to pickProfile({env,live,bound,identities}). Direct callers can use pickProfile when live/bound/identities already known. Both return frozen Pick or Refusal.

Inputs: env record MV_SRF_PROFILES/MV_SRF_LIVE_PROFILE, host surface states, identity rows via listIdentities. Flow: configuredProfiles parses map -> summarizeSurfaces counts live and bound profile_ids -> identityIds keeps valid ids -> pickProfile filters free then identity-ready first -> returns request {schema:surface_request/v0.2,op:create,params} or refusal.

Candidates are browser-kind entries of MV_SRF_PROFILES JSON (<=1048576 bytes); malformed/empty falls back to single live MV_SRF_LIVE_PROFILE or mv-live-1. Live id first when present. Entry defaults kind browser 1280x900; honors width/height 1..16384 and nested_depth 0|1 only for desktop_capsule. Non-browser kinds filtered out.

summarizeSurfaces accepts Map or iterable; skips non-plain states and destroyed/lost. Every other state counts toward live even without readable profile_id; only validId [a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63} profile_ids join bound set. Null/undefined surfaces mean live 0 empty bound.

identityIds keeps only rows that are plain objects with string id matching PROFILE_ID; labels/domains dropped. Non-array input yields empty set. Caller distinguishes null identities (list unavailable) from empty set (no identities) to select refusal code.

pickCreateRequest requires listIdentities function else PICKER_INPUT_INVALID. It awaits reply; only plain {ok:true} rows become identities, exceptions or non-ok yield null identities. Never falls back to unchecked profile; identity failure becomes typed refusal via pickProfile.

refusalReply maps refusal.code to frozen {ok:false,code,message,action}; NO_FREE_PROFILE message prefixes configured count with singular/plural; unknown codes map to PICKER_INPUT_INVALID. createRefusalReason returns operator sentence per code, default mv-live-2 for NO_IDENTITY with validId check, generic fallback for unknown codes.

Picker states: ok vs five refusals. Order fixed: input invalid -> capsule limit -> no free profile -> identity unavailable -> no identity -> pick. A bound live profile is never re-offered. Boot create path unchanged and still uses first profile; picker only serves additional Add capsule creates.

Condition no free browser profile, identities null/unreadable, or free profiles lack identities. Next returns NO_FREE_PROFILE / IDENTITY_LIST_UNAVAILABLE / NO_IDENTITY with configured/live/missing. Renderer shows static copy; NO_IDENTITY offers Create identity action; wire never creates identities here.

User presses Add capsule and nothing opens; renderer shows At most 4 capsules run at once... or Every configured profile is already in use... or No free profile has an identity yet... or identity list could not be read... Operator sees matching sentence including mv-live-2 hint. No ids/paths leak in copy.

At most 4 concurrent capsules sharing cpuset 10-14, each up to 4GiB plus 2GiB shm. Map input capped at 1048576 bytes. Identity/domain lists bounded by validator patterns; refusal missing lists only free profile ids, never environment values.

First candidate equals boot create profile. Returned request params always carry valid profile_id, kind browser, geometry w/h, optional nested_depth only for desktop_capsule. All outputs frozen; configured counts browser candidates only, so non-browser map entries never inflate capacity.

Malformed MV_SRF_PROFILES JSON, oversize map, invalid ids, or destroyed-state miscounts fail closed to single live fallback or typed refusal rather than unchecked create. PICKER_INPUT_INVALID covers non-plain env, negative/non-int live, non-Set bound/identities, or missing listIdentities function.

Supervised PTY broker splitting duties: main supervises and admits, broker child owns PTY handles, core owns admission. Renderer and child exchange only provider references over versioned line-delimited JSON; executable paths, argv, cwd and env never cross from renderer.

Provider spawn entry: validateProviderArgv checks argv 1..33 items, NUL-free, each <=4096 B, argv[0] non-empty and not dash-led. buildProviderSpawn requires absolute argv[0] and returns {file, args}; legacy loginShell arg is accepted but not executed.

Shell spawn entry: resolveLoginShell honors only absolute bounded NUL-free override or $SHELL else /bin/bash fallback. buildShellSpawn allows only --noprofile/--norc on bash basenames then -l -i. quoteShellArg single-quotes validated argv for -c strings.

Env entries: validateProviderEnv copies only allowlisted names from host env, refuses scrubbed and credential-looking names, truncates oversize values at UTF-8 boundary. validateSpawnEnv strictly checks an already-built env with no truncation. isScrubbedEnvName covers LD_, DYLD_, NODE_OPTIONS, ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE, PYTHON*.

Child transport entry: createLineFramer assembles bounded NDJSON with maxLineBytes cap, blank lines ignored, oversize/malformed reported via onError. createStdioLink feeds stdin chunks plus Electron parentPort string messages, emits JSON lines on stdout, framing faults become local {ev:error,id:null} syntheses.

Broker child spawn: spawnTerminalBroker requires absolute bounded entry and cwd, re-verifies env via validateSpawnEnv, takes main-injected runtime kind electron|node-test. Electron tunnels input via postMessage with piped stdout; node-test uses piped stdin. Returns send/onMessage/onExit/dispose handle.

Child engine runBroker owns PTY handles behind versioned generation-gated link. Open carries provider reference only; specs come from server-owned profiles Map validated by assertSpawnProfile. Commits outcomes against main-issued admissions via authority.commitOutcome; malformed input yields typed error events, never crashes.

Main IPC bridge registerTerminalIpc binds fixed metaviewer:terminal.* channels for open/attach/close/write/resize/ack/capabilities. Each call re-authenticates principal, enforces {owner,value} envelope, refuses exe/cwd/env/argv/path/PATH/channel keys, admits per-op via authority.admit, then dispatches once to child.

Renderer facade createTerminalFacade wraps preload seams request/subscribe. capabilities bootstraps owner; open/attach/close/write/resize/ack wrap values in frozen {owner,value}. write gated by setEnabled UX flag starting disabled; ack and output stay live. Post-dispose calls return frozen {ok:false}.

Request flow: renderer facade -> IPC open with provider/command/cols/rows -> bridge validates, admits, checks profile equality against owned map, forwards {op,id,provider,command,admission} over transport link -> child engine spawns via injected pty.spawn and emits {ev:open,pid}.

Output flow: PTY onData chunks -> per-session seq/sent accounting -> {ev:data,seq,b64} events -> bridge ledger.ingest with fresh PlaneContext per call -> publish {kind:data,bytes}. Ack flow reverses: facade ack -> bridge ledger.acknowledge plus child forward -> child validates seq/bytes against boundaries map and resumes PTY.

Wire contract: every broker message and IPC outcome carries version 1; child and bridge check version and serviceGeneration, rejecting BAD_VERSION and STALE_GENERATION. IPC uses closed prefix metaviewer:terminal. with seven fixed methods; renderer never sends raw channel names.

Spawn profile closed shape: exactly {argv,command,cwd,env,executable,loginShell} plus optional class/sessionClass. command shell|provider must match sessionClass shell|ai; capsule-ai maps to ai. Shell argv must be empty; provider argv[0] must equal executable; all paths absolute bounded NUL-free.

Dimension and write contract: cols 2..500 default 80, rows 2..300 default 24 enforced on open and resize. Write b64 must match strict BASE64_RE and decode to <=65536 B; child additionally UTF-8 fatal-decodes and reports INVALID_INPUT on failure.

Env secrecy invariant: any name matching TOKEN|SECRET|PASSWORD|PASSWD|AUTH|CREDENTIAL|PRIVATE|KEY case-insensitively or scrubbed prefixes is refused loudly and never reaches a child. Errors carry only stable codes and fixed remedies, never PTY output or secrets; exit reasons limited to SESSION_CAP, SESSION_EXPIRED.

Identity grammar: session and provider ids must match [A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,128}; env names match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,127}. Unknown ids, malformed ids and duplicate live ids are refused; closed ids are tombstoned and stay refused as SESSION_CLOSED.

Session states: absent -> live on spawn+record -> paused on backpressure -> closing during staged teardown -> exited with tombstone. Bridge tracks live map plus closed set capped at 256; child tracks sessions map plus tombstones set capped at 256. Closed sessions answer SESSION_CLOSED; unknown answer UNKNOWN_SESSION.

Staged close: kill SIGHUP, wait 100ms for child exit, then SIGTERM and wait 250ms, then SIGKILL, then reapOwned. Unstaged dispose path skips signals and goes to SIGKILL. Lifetime timers expire sessions with code 0 and reason SESSION_EXPIRED; byte-cap exhaustion closes with SESSION_CAP.

Per-class spawn brake: token bucket burst 16 refill 1/s plus consecutive-failure breaker tripping 60000ms cooldown after 3 failures. consumeAttempt gates open; spawn/shape/record faults call recordFailure, success calls recordSuccess. canAdmit is non-consuming check.

Single-threaded async engine with reentrancy guards: closing flag plus closePromise coalesces concurrent closes; onChildExitWaiter wakes staged waits; dispose wakes all waiters then closes each session. Throwing subscribers are swallowed so one listener cannot break peer stream; audit commit faults surface as AUDIT_FAILED.

Caps: 8 total sessions, 4 shell plus 4 ai; shell 8388608 B lifetime and 3600000ms, ai 67108864 B and 14400000ms selected by session class. Pending overflow beyond maxPendingBytes 524288 or maxPendingFrames 4096 faults session with code -1.

Backpressure: unacked bytes >=131072 pauses PTY; resume below 65536 on valid ack. Ack must exactly match boundaries seq->bytes or ACK_REFUSED. Line cap 262144 B; overlong lines dropped once with LINE_TOO_LONG. Tombstones evict oldest beyond 256.

normalizeLimits merges partial overrides over frozen defaults, rejects unknown keys and non-positive safe ints, propagates sessionByteCap/lifetimeMs to class caps when class keys absent, requires low<high<=maxPending. Returns frozen effective limits before any session exists.

External seams: validateKillTarget from coreLauncher plus injected getpgid own-group check for kill guard; node-pty factory injected for tests; Electron UtilityProcess.fork shape for production; createRequire package resolution and fs existsSync for native dir lookup.

Open refusal path: SESSION_LIMIT/CLASS_LIMIT/SPAWN_BRAKE tombstone the id, emit error with fixed remedy from BROKER_REFUSAL_REMEDIES, and commit refused outcome. Bridge open mirrors with UNKNOWN_PROVIDER, DIMS_RANGE, PROFILE_REFUSED, TRANSPORT_FAILED, PLANE_FAILED outcomes carrying version+generation.

Op fault path: write/resize/ack/pause on non-live id yields SESSION_SHAPE, SESSION_CLOSED or UNKNOWN_SESSION; bad payload yields WRITE_SHAPE, WRITE_TOO_LARGE, DIMS_RANGE, ACK_SHAPE, ACK_REFUSED, PAUSE_FAILED/RESUME_FAILED/WRITE_FAILED/RESIZE_FAILED. Bridge plane ingest fault closes ledger, forwards close, publishes PLANE_FAULT.

Framing fault path: oversize buffered line emits LINE_TOO_LONG once and drops; malformed JSON or non-object line emits MALFORMED. Parent and child synthesize {version,ev:error,id:null,code} and continue streaming. Version/generation mismatch yields BAD_VERSION/STALE_GENERATION; unknown op yields UNKNOWN_OP.

User-visible: new terminal refuses to open with SESSION_LIMIT or CLASS_LIMIT remedy to close a session; rapid retries get SPAWN_BRAKE to wait and retry. Stalled output that never resumes points to missed ack below low-water; truncated replay after reattach reflects plane attach suffix with truncated flag.

Kill hazard: signalling own process group or negative group pids is refused; unknown group via throwing or non-int getpgid refuses. Group teardown belongs to supervisor which proves each member. Shared repo guard plus own-group check means misuse returns false rather than signalling.

Resolution hazards: resolveExecutable scans at most 32 absolute PATH segments with injected canExecute probe; relative slash paths, dash-led names and empty trusted PATH resolve to null. resolveNodePtyDir is fail-closed with NATIVE_ABSENT when override, sibling, packaged and package resolution all miss.

Single-session PTY seam: validates one trusted main-owned spawn spec, spawns one xterm-256color PTY at 80x24, and shuttles bounded output frames, input ports and acks. No shell command strings; byte-port credit is cumulative via seq and sent/acked counters.

Utility-process binder: waits for first parentPort message carrying exactly one MessagePort plus {session,spec}, loads node-pty, creates one PtySession bound to that port, then starts the port. One spec and one renderer byte port per utility process; no renderer spawn requests accepted.

validateSpawnSpec requires exact keys {args,cwd,env,file}, absolute file and cwd, args array <=32 each string <=4096 B NUL-free, env record with names matching [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]* and values <=4096 B NUL-free. Throws INVALID_SPAWN_SPEC; returns defensive copies.

createPtySession requires session matching [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128} else INVALID_SESSION. Spawns with {cwd,env,name,cols,rows,encoding:null} for undecoded chunks. Returns frozen {receive,close}; disposables hold onData and onExit subscriptions.

loadNodePty resolves node-pty dir via broker resolveNodePtyDir with env and resourcesPath, requires it with createRequire on package.json, and demands spawn function else TERMINAL_UNAVAILABLE. Defaults are process.env and process.resourcesPath.

startPtyUtility binds parent.on message once: ignores messages after bound or with ports.length!==1. On node-pty load failure posts {session,error:TERMINAL_UNAVAILABLE} and closes port. Port messages route message.data to runtime.receive; receive faults close runtime and port; port close closes runtime.

Output: PTY onData string|Uint8Array -> normalized Uint8Array -> sent+=len, boundaries seq->sent, send {session,seq,bytes}. Input: receive {bytes,seq,session} with Uint8Array writes Buffer to PTY. Control: {ack,bytes} advances credit; {cols,rows} resizes. Exit: onExit sends {session,exitCode}.

receive closed message shapes keyed by sorted keys: bytes,seq,session with Uint8Array and seq==inputSeq+1 and <=65536 B; ack,bytes,session with ack>ackSeq and boundaries match; cols,rows,session with safe ints cols 1..500 rows 1..300. Session field must equal bound id; anything else throws INVALID_MESSAGE, CLOSED_OR_INVALID or SESSION_MISMATCH.

States: open -> live streaming -> paused on backpressure -> closed terminal. close is idempotent via closed flag: disposes listeners, kills PTY, clears boundaries. onExit sets closed, disposes, clears, sends exitCode. After closed, receive always throws and onData is ignored.

Credit invariant: sent counts emitted bytes, acked counts consumed bytes, boundaries maps unacked seq to cumulative sent. Input seq must be strictly +1; ack must be forward and exactly match stored boundary. Violations throw INVALID_INPUT or INVALID_ACK instead of advancing state.

Overflow caps: single chunk >65536 B, unacked sent-acked+len >524288, or >=256 pending boundaries triggers close plus send {session,error:OUTPUT_OVERFLOW}. Pause at sent-acked>=131072 via pty.pause; resume when ack brings it below 65536.

Listener lifetime: disposables array holds onData/onExit handles; disposeListeners shifts and disposes each with swallowed faults. close and onExit both funnel through it so double-exit cannot double-send; port close and receive-fault paths both call runtime.close safely.

Spawn fault: INVALID_SPAWN_SPEC on bad spec shape, non-absolute file/cwd, oversize or NUL values, bad env names; INVALID_SESSION on bad session id. Both thrown synchronously before spawn, so no PTY is created and caller must surface TERMINAL_UNAVAILABLE or equivalent.

Utility fault: node-pty absent yields {session,error:TERMINAL_UNAVAILABLE} to port then port.close. No retry inside utility; main must respawn or report. Bound flag prevents second session hijack on same parent; wrong port count messages are silently ignored.

User-visible: terminal goes dead and closes after a burst of output with OUTPUT_OVERFLOW error; typing does nothing after close with no error; window resize beyond 500x300 is ignored because receive throws. Empty utility with TERMINAL_UNAVAILABLE message means node-pty failed to load.

Depends on broker resolveNodePtyDir for fail-closed native lookup, node:module createRequire for packaged load, node:path join, and injected spawn matching node-pty signature. Expects Electron ParentPort with on/ports/start semantics; started automatically when process.parentPort exists.

Trust boundary: spec comes only from trusted main via parentPort event.data; renderer never supplies file/args/cwd/env. Strict absolute-path, NUL-free and size checks block command injection and env smuggling. Single-bind plus exact-one-port rule blocks cross-session port reuse.

Opt-in read-only QA anchor bridge for live vision runs: preload validates closed qa_anchors/v1 payload, main revalidates sender and atomically writes 0600 qa-anchors.json inside the live stack private run directory, never a renderer path.

Entry is installQaAnchors(options) with ipcMain.handle on metaviewer:qa.anchors; each invoke passes event plus exactly one snapshot arg through observeSender admission, validateQaSnapshot, then serialized writeQaSnapshot.

Enablement entry is resolveQaConfig: packaged builds refuse MV_E2E_LIVE, nested --nested-depth=1 returns disabled, otherwise MV_E2E_LIVE must equal 1 and runDir comes from runDir/MV_QA_RUN_DIR/MV_E2E_RUN_DIR/XDG_RUNTIME_DIR.

Data flow: renderer snapshot -> validateQaSnapshot normalizes and freezes {schema,seq,rows} -> JSON.stringify -> writeQaSnapshot checks runDir identity, writes temp file with O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW 0600, fsync, rename to qa-anchors.json, post-write stat, dir sync.

Bridge states: disabled returns {enabled:false, dispose noop}; enabled registers handler with pendingBatch plus writeChain; disposed flag rejects new invokes with QA_DISPOSED while dispose removes handler then awaits writeChain.

Snapshot must have exact own data keys rows,schema,seq; each row exact anchor,role,name,rect; each rect exact h,w,x,y; arrays must be dense with Array.prototype and no extra own keys; objects must have null or Object prototype and data descriptors only.

Wire contract: channel metaviewer:qa.anchors carries one qa_anchors/v1 snapshot; seq positive safe integer; rows max 512; rect x,y safe ints with w,h positive ints in CSS px; role matches ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$; whole JSON max 64 KiB.

Anchor grammar: 1-6 slash segments, total 1-200 chars, each 1-64 chars matching ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,63}$, no empty or . or .. segments, no leading/trailing slash; name max 128 chars, no NUL, lone UTF-16 surrogates rejected.

Run directory must be absolute bounded path outside repository SOURCE_ROOT, exist as owner-only 0700 directory owned by current uid, not a symlink; canonical realpath is rechecked with same ownership and mode.

Malformed payload throws MainError QA_PAYLOAD: bad keys, schema, seq, non-dense rows, invalid anchor/role/name/rect, or over 64 KiB serialized; caller handler converts to invoke rejection, nothing is written.

Bad launch context throws MainError: packaged with MV_E2E_LIVE gives RETAIL_ENV, bad MV_E2E_LIVE value gives RETAIL_ENV, bad/absent run dir gives QA_RUN_DIR; installQaAnchors then registers nothing and stays disabled when not enabled.

Pre-write lstat, O_NOFOLLOW directory open, (dev,ino) pin, realpath outside-root check, target leaf symlink/non-file check, temp device check, and post-write 0600 same-device check can throw QA_RUN_DIR/QA_SYMLINK/QA_WRITE; temp file is unlinked via /proc/self/fd path when safe.

Tester sees live run produce no qa-anchors.json or stale anchors: invoke rejected for sender refused, QA_ARGS, QA_PAYLOAD, QA_DISPOSED, or run-dir identity changed during write; log carries MainError code and fixed message, never renderer path.

Concurrent invokes coalesce: pendingBatch.snapshot is replaced and callers share pendingBatch.batch; writeChain serializes writeQaSnapshot calls so only latest queued snapshot per batch hits disk, chain errors swallowed to keep queue alive.

Holds O_RDONLY|O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW dir fd across whole write, verifies (dev,ino) before temp open, before write, before rename and after; temp name .qa-anchors-pid-uuid.tmp created O_CREAT|O_EXCL 0600, chmod, writeFile, fsync, rename, then dir sync.
Limits: QA_MAX_ROWS 512, QA_MAX_BYTES 64 KiB, QA_MAX_NAME_CHARS 128, QA_MAX_ANCHOR_CHARS 200, segments 6 x 64 chars; launch token --qa-anchors=1, channel metaviewer:qa.anchors, file qa-anchors.json.

Depends on main.js observeSender and PRIVILEGED_ORIGIN for sender admission, MainError for typed failures, node fs/path/crypto for atomic write and canonicalization; injectable fs seam lstat/open/realpath/rename/unlink only for tests.

Parent directory swap or symlink at runDir or qa-anchors.json target would redirect writes outside private dir; mitigated by dir fd pinning, triple (dev,ino) checks, O_NOFOLLOW, and refusal when target leaf is symlink or off-device.

Main-process role host for human/agent capsule surfaces: admits renderer role ops over metaviewer:roles.v0.3, creates/stops/mounts Xpra views, keeps capsule/socket selection and identity names in main, exposes only role, profile ids, state and opaque success to renderer.

Entry is installRoleHost({electron,window,core,env,capsuleStates,admit,...}) registering ipcMain.handle(CHANNEL,handler); handler requires admit(event) and schema metaviewer.roles/v0.3, dispatches choices/surfaces/create/create-program/open/switch/stop/mount/resize/visibility/close/raise/status/confirm-login.

Create flow: validate choice -> choices/identity list -> stageMode -> core.request create -> verify surface active and control matches role -> store in capsuleStates/openingRoles. Mount flow: readRoleBinding -> runHumanMode -> openXpraHumanBridge -> attachXpraHumanTile with trace recorder.

Surface authority comes from core.getHumanSurface; must be active and profile-admitted or SURFACE_UNKNOWN. Per-surface view states closed/connecting/ready/reconnecting/lost/error tracked in viewStates; transitions map tracks stopping/starting during switchMode.

Close revokes epochs/sessions/viewStates and closes Xpra session; stop additionally requires core.stopSurface acknowledged destroyed before releasing profile. SwitchMode stops then creates opposite role; new identity has no VERIFIED frame until fresh capture.

Role/control ownership must match: human role requires control human, agent role requires control agent, checked at mount entry, after re-authoritative lookup, and continuously via active() closure and 100ms timer that closes mismatched or lost capsules.

Strict closed-shape IPC: message must have exact keys per op (e.g. create needs choice,op,schema), no accessors; create choice must be exact {profileId,role}; create-program choice must be exact {binary}; mount/resize need exact bounds plus surfaceId.

Binding file at <stateDir>/human-bindings/<surface_id>.json must be private regular 0600 file owned by host uid under 4096 bytes, realpath equal to path, schema metaviewer.human_binding/v0.3 with matching surface/profile/role, control_ready, 1280x900, container srf-id-*, run_id.
Bounds must be exact {x,y,width,height} safe integers, non-negative origin, positive size, x+w and y+h within 16384; mount/resize reject otherwise with XPRA_BOUNDS_REFUSED.

Program capsule binary must be bare name or clean absolute path without shell metachars, resolved via PATH plus /usr/local/bin,/usr/games,/usr/local/games,/usr/sbin,/sbin; must be executable regular file; errors carry code HOST_PROGRAM_UNAVAILABLE with host_program_unavailable prefix.

Native create failure maps to fixed log METAVIEWER_SURFACE_CREATE_REFUSED code/detail with native diagnostics withheld; wrapper detail after ': ' mapped to PROFILE_ALREADY_BOUND, SURFACE_CAPACITY_OR_QUARANTINE, CAPSULE_SLOT_UNAVAILABLE, IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE or ADAPTER_*; renderer gets {ok:false,code} or code+reason.

Create guards: SURFACE_CREATE_BUSY single-flight, PROFILE_ALREADY_BOUND, CAPSULE_LIMIT_REACHED via MAX_CAPSULES, NO_IDENTITY when unavailable, IDENTITY_PROTECTED for foreign or mv-/reserved names, PROGRAM_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN when renderer picks profile; on mode-unproven surface it compensates via stopSurface and requires destroyed ack or CAPSULE_STOP_UNPROVEN.

User sees capsule list missing identities, create button spinning then error code, or black tile that never becomes ready: mount logs METAVIEWER_XPRA_STAGE stage TIMEOUT/ERROR/LOST, tile overlay stays Connecting/Reconnecting, typed code surfaced for Reopen.

Creating boolean serializes create/switch/stop; locks set serializes mount per surfaceId with XPRA_VIEW_BUSY; per-mount Symbol epoch plus active() revokes stale async work after close/switch/dispose; setInterval every 100ms prunes dead program profiles and closes revoked watches.

Human mounts allocate trace file via createHumanTraceFile with shared traceBudget and pruneHumanTraces retention; failures log METAVIEWER_TRACE_RETENTION_REFUSED. Agent mounts use dummyTrace no-op recorder. Trace closed on mount failure, tile failure, session close.

Configured from env MV_SRF_PROFILES JSON, MV_SRF_STATE_DIR, MV_SRF_BIN_DIR, MV_SESSION_ID, MV_XPRA_JQUERY override, MV_IDENTITY_TOOL; browser template must be Kind browser 1280x900 with RAMRoot under /dev/shm and non-foreign identity; identity names come from trusted listIdentities, never renderer.

Depends on identityProtection isForeignIdentity, keyboardLayout/xpraKeyboard, openingMode stageOpeningMode, identityMarkers, xpraClientQuery, recordingDestination, xpraHumanSession/Bridge/Tile factories, humanTrace, profilePicker configuredProfiles/summarizeSurfaces, operatorBridge for program identity provisioning.

Stale bridge token or binding run_id change must not persist: openBridge re-reads binding and refuses XPRA_BINDING_CHANGED, tile recovery reloads via fresh bridge origin; dispose clears timer, removes CHANNEL handler, unregisters preload, closes all sessions to revoke watch on capsule loss or takeover.
rolePreload.cjs is the additive v0.3 capability bridge: exposes frozen window.metaviewerRoles facade over metaviewer:roles.v0.3 without touching frozen preload.js.

smoke.js is a dedicated shell integration probe launched only via test/smoke.mjs after renderer build; it boots a window, checks wall settlement and domain facade, prints METAVIEWER_SMOKE_OK, makes no production writes.

Preload entry invoke(op,body) sends {schema:metaviewer.roles/v0.3,op,...body} via ipcRenderer.invoke; only installed when process.isMainFrame and location is app://metaviewer, using contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld.

Smoke entry runSmoke() runs immediately at ESM evaluation before app ready; requires Electron version pin, app.whenReady, host UID, resolves shell root from electron/ parent, serves bundled renderer, attaches window policy.

Renderer calls choices/surfaces/create/createProgram/open/switchMode/stop/confirmLogin/status/mount/resize/visibility/raise/close/onFocus map to invoke with matching op and payload; onFocus subscribes to metaviewer:role-focus.v0.3 and returns unsubscribe.

Smoke builds smokeApp shim mapping getAppPath to shell root while keeping real getPath, resolves main paths from XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/uid, serves bundled root with style nonce, creates 1280x720 window, installs authority wire with stub core admitting only smoke proposal.
Channel constant is metaviewer:roles.v0.3; focus event channel is metaviewer:role-focus.v0.3 with string id payload; facade is Object.freeze with fixed method set, no raw IPC handle leaked.

Smoke sequence: registerPrivilegedScheme -> runSmoke -> whenReady -> open window -> load PRIVILEGED_ORIGIN/index.html -> poll up to 100x100ms for .metaviewer[data-wall-settled=true] plus .mv-terminal plus load function and no window.require -> run facade checks -> METAVIEWER_SMOKE_OK and exit 0.

Renderer must settle with isolated preload: wall-settled marker present, typeof metaviewer.load function, typeof require undefined; authority.propose must refuse {} payload and admit well-formed smoke proposal with proposal_id smoke.

Version mismatch, missing UID, unsettled wall after 10s, or facade check failure throws and exits 1; render-process-gone forces exit 1; 15s deadline timer forces exit 1; preload errors logged via console-message/preload-error handlers.
Smoke load handler admits only zero-arg observeSender-admitted calls and returns null; save handler always throws Smoke storage is read-only; authority wire disposed on will-quit.
Global 15s deadline timer guards hung smoke; cleared only on success path before exit 0, otherwise app.exit(1).

Uses XDG_RUNTIME_DIR as XDG_CONFIG_HOME and uid from process.getuid; window 1280x720 with preloadPath from resolved paths; loadSettings/recordingDestination/nestedDepth/selfCapsuleId must all return null in smoke env.

Depends on main.js createWindowOptions/attachWindowPolicy/registerPrivilegedScheme/resolveMainPaths/serveBundled/observeSender/CHANNELS/ELECTRON_PIN/PRIVILEGED_ORIGIN and authorityWire installAuthorityWire; no production core or persistent writes.

Main-only bounded terminal broker host: owns whitelisted shell/provider profiles, spawns via node-pty through ptyBroker runBroker, reaps recorded PTY process groups; only owned profile references enter the engine.
launchTerminalUtility forks ptyUtility with validated SpawnSpec, transfers one MessagePortMain after spawn; session id must match ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$ or INVALID_SESSION.
Entries on host: setEnabled, open, attach, resize, close, listProviders, copyText, dispose; every mutating entry first throws DISPLAY_ONLY in nested display (--nested-depth=1).

Open validates {cols,rows,command[,args|provider]}, resolves targetId to owned profile, creates uuid session with token buckets and attach deadline, sends op open to broker. Attach binds MessagePort, replays pre-attach queue, routes resize/input/ack messages to broker as base64 write ops.

Session lifecycle: pending open -> opened on broker ev open -> attached when port set -> data frames forwarded -> exit sets exited and resolves exitPromise. Pre-attach frames queue bounded; overflow drops queue and closes session. Detached port close triggers closeSessionInternal.

All IPC payloads require closed data-only keys (e.g. open allows exactly cols,command,rows plus optional args/provider variants); session ids match ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,128}$; copy text must match capsule id regex; sender binding checked on every call when first seen.

Open contract: cols 2-500, rows 2-300, command shell or owned provider id, args must exactly equal providerMeta args after validateProviderArgv; returns TERMINAL_UNAVAILABLE object when node-pty missing, TERMINAL_DISABLED when disabled/disposed, COMMAND_NOT_ALLOWED for unknown.

Rate contract: resize burst 16/s 16, write bytes 262144 burst/s, write ops 64 burst/s, attach deadline 10s, pre-attach max 64 frames/64KiB. Port input requires sequential seq=inputSeq+1 and bytes<=64KiB; ack requires positive ack and non-negative bytes.

Rate or disabled input gets retryable TERMINAL_IO_REFUSED with expectedSeq=inputSeq+1 without consuming tokens; 64 consecutive retryable refusals without admitted input escalates to non-retryable TERMINAL_IO_REFUSED.

Malformed port message posts non-retryable TERMINAL_IO_REFUSED then closes session; resize out of range, unknown session, sender mismatch, or TERMINAL_IO_REFUSED:SENDER thrown; broker ev error before open rejects open promise, after open forwards error frame.

User sees terminal tile stuck connecting then closing, typed input echoed as error frame, or open failing with TERMINAL_DISABLED/DISPLAY_ONLY/COMMAND_NOT_ALLOWED; nested windows show DISPLAY_ONLY side-terminal is disabled in nested display.

Attach is single-shot per session; second attach throws. Token buckets refill per second via now hook; input seq strictly ordered, gaps rejected. Dispose disables host, rejects pending opens, closes broker, then reaps pids and ports.

Owned pids tracked in set; reapOwnedPid refuses UNOWNED_PID, collects tree via /proc stat matching ppid/pgrp/sid/root, SIGKILLs process group then each member; dispose iterates copy of pids and clears sessions. Queue bytes bounded to stop memory growth.

Limits configurable via limits object or individual overrides, defaults frozen in DEFAULT_TERMINAL_LIMITS; shell/cwd from userInfo with /bin/sh and /tmp fallbacks; provider env filtered via validateProviderEnv to allowlisted keys.

Depends on ptyBroker resolveNodePtyDir/runBroker/validateProviderArgv/validateProviderEnv, ptySession validateSpawnSpec, node-pty loaded via createRequire on resolved dir requiring spawn function; clipboard.writeText optional for copyText.

Cross-sender hijack prevented by senderKey pinning from explicit sender or embedded sender field; mismatch throws SENDER refusal. Profiles built only from host Map with executable absolute paths; renderer args cannot invent commands.

Host-owned HTML5 Xpra client contract plus authenticated loopback bridge: tile document renders capsule socket over HTTP/WebSocket on 127.0.0.1 with per-bridge token, never exposing bridge capability to renderer IPC.
Tile document is fixed 1280x900 iframe with transform-scale fit, Connecting overlay, no credentials; CSS transform changes presentation only, page zoom stays 1.

Readiness requires client.connected, server_ok, server_readonly==!writable, optional metaviewer_raw_keyboard, inner 1280x900, desktop 1280x900, at least one window and one non-empty canvas; waitForXpraClient polls every 50ms with timeout default 30s.

Every HTTP and upgrade request must be GET to authority host 127.0.0.1, matching origin, no transfer-encoding, content-length absent or 0, path starting single /, and header x-metaviewer-xpra-session timingSafeEqual to token; failures get 403.
Readiness timeout throws XPRA_CLIENT_READY_TIMEOUT after timeoutMs; lease loss throws XPRA_HUMAN_LEASE_LOST when isActive false; hung evaluation also hits deadline via Promise.race with probe loop.

Binding refusal XPRA_BINDING_REFUSED, missing getuid XPRA_HOST_UID_ABSENT, path XPRA_PATH_REFUSED, perms XPRA_PERMISSIONS_REFUSED, bind XPRA_LOOPBACK_BIND_UNPROVEN; upstream 3xx redirects mapped to 502, encoded Client.js to 502, proxy errors to 502, handler exceptions to 403.
User sees tile stuck on Connecting/Reconnecting overlay on dark #182330 background, never reaching desktop pixels; writable tile stays read-only or keyboard layout rejected before listener opens.
Tracks every HTTP upstream socket and TCP connection in set; close sets closed, destroys connections, closes server. Timeouts: upstream 10s, request 15s, headers 10s, maxHeaders 64.
Keyboard patch optional: {layout,keycodes} validated via rawKeyboardPatch before listen; jquery asset host-supplied for Debian missing symlink, served only at /js/lib/jquery.js when defined.

Depends on xpraClient xpraTileDocument, xpraKeyboard rawKeyboardPatch, node http/net/crypto/path/fs promises; cookie/authorization/proxy-authorization/session header stripped from upstream, set-cookie stripped from response, cache no-store.

Token never crosses renderer IPC: injected via main-process requestHeaders hook; upstream redirect blocked to avoid privileged child navigation; WebSocket requires Upgrade header and re-admission with fresh inspect check.
Immutable role lifetime for one human/agent view: sequences setReadonly->openBridge->showView with revocation, single-flight open/recover/close, and aggregated cleanup of tile, bridge and trace.

Native role view: separate sandboxed WebContentsView hosting authenticated Xpra tile, enforcing lease/geometry, recording trace, recovering bridge, and revoking view on crash, unresponsiveness or trace fatal.

Entry createXpraHumanSession({role,setReadonly,openBridge,showView,closeTrace}) requires role human|agent and four functions or XPRA_CAPABILITIES_ABSENT; returns frozen {role,active,open,resize,bringToFront,setVisible,close}.

Entry attachXpraHumanTile({electron,window,bridge,bounds,trace,isActive,capsuleSize,...}) requires isActive() true at call, capsuleSize function and onFailure or XPRA_HUMAN_LEASE_ABSENT; creates isolated partition xpra-human-uuid with xpraTracePreload.

Session open: check lease -> setReadonly(role==agent) must return true -> openBridge -> showView(bridge,recoverBridge) -> tile. Tile: addChildView -> loadURL origin/metaviewer-tile.html+query -> waitForXpraClient -> publish ready -> focus if writable; recovery reloads via fresh bridge origin.

Flags revoked/opening/recovering/cleaning/closing/traceClosed; check throws XPRA_SESSION_CLOSED when revoked. Recover reuses healthy bridge else closes and opens replacement, closing replacement if revoked mid-flight. Cleanup closes tile, bridge, trace once, AggregateError as XPRA_CLOSE_FAILED.

Tile states connecting->ready->reconnecting->lost via onState; overlay hidden only when ready. Fail latches failed, stops recovery, deactivates trace, closes view then calls onFailure; live() false after detached/failed/lease lost.

Geometry fixed: capsuleSize must return 1280x900 or XPRA_FIXED_SIZE_REQUIRED; resize rect must be safe-int x,y,width,height with positive size or XPRA_BOUNDS_REFUSED; zoom forced to 1; clientQuery must match ^?[A-Za-z0-9_=&.-]+$ or XPRA_QUERY_REFUSED.

Sandbox contract: sandbox/contextIsolation/no node, webSecurity, deny window.open/webview, will-navigate and will-redirect blocked outside origin, all_urls requests cancelled unless active and localURL, auth headers injected, permissions denied, downloads prevented, shortcuts passed to guest via interceptDesktopShortcut.

render-process-gone gives XPRA_VIEW_CRASHED, unresponsive gives XPRA_VIEW_UNRESPONSIVE, recorder throw gives XPRA_TRACE_FAILED; each calls fail(), removes failed contents so parent typed error and Reopen show, host closes bridge, never quits app.

Open, recover and close are single-flight via cached promises reset on settle; parallel roleHost timer and tile recovery probe (2s bounded evaluation race) both gate on isActive/live so stale epochs cannot publish state or trace.

Close is idempotent: stops recovery, deactivates trace, removes human-trace listener, removes child view, closes contents, clears request hooks and storage data; readonly views additionally preventDefault all input and mouse events.

Depends on xpraClient query/ready/wait, xpraRecovery createXpraRecovery, desktopShortcuts interceptDesktopShortcut, humanTrace recorder with record/setActive, isolated session partition per tile with cache false.

Trace IPC accepted only from tile wc mainFrame with URL under current origin; stale origin after bridge replacement would fail localURL and cancel requests; writable false enforces OS plus DOM defense in depth for readonly watch.
xpraRecovery.js provides one host-owned retry/monitor flight per tile that probes health every 250ms and reconnects with backoff while the role lease stays authorized.
xpraTracePreload.cjs is a capability-less Electron preload observing key/mouse/wheel in the xpra view and forwarding redacted human-trace events over ipcRenderer.

positions is positional, never character mapping: Digit/Key/F/Numpad rows are synthesized; physicalXkbKeycodes keeps only entries present in xkbcomp and requires KeyA, Digit2, Quote, IntlBackslash, AltRight, ShiftLeft in 8..255.
physicalXkbKeycodes(source) parses xkbcomp text with /<NAME> = NUMBER;/ and returns Record<code,number>; throws XPRA_KEYMAP_UNAVAILABLE when required sentinels are missing or out of range.
rawKeyboardPatch({layout,keycodes}) validates layout /^[a-z0-9_-]{1,32}$/ and each code/name range, then returns JS source that must run after Client.js and before its hello.
Control flows DISPLAY env -> xkbcomp stdout -> physicalXkbKeycodes -> keycodes record -> JSON-embedded into patched script -> XpraClient.prototype._make_hello sends xkbmap_layout/xkbmap_raw.
Condition: no DISPLAY, xkbcomp error/timeout, or missing sentinel. Next: promise rejects XPRA_KEYMAP_UNAVAILABLE. Receiver: main-process caller; no keycodes returned.
Condition: bad layout, bad code name, or keycode outside 8..255 throws XPRA_KEYMAP_INVALID; missing _make_hello/_keyb_process in client throws XPRA_KEYMAP_UNSUPPORTED at runtime.

User sees wrong symbols, dead keys doubled, or AltGr doing nothing. Happens here because patch bypasses browser IME and sends raw key-action with capsule keycode; bad table sends wrong code or drops the key.
Mousemove events are throttled to one per 16ms via lastMove and performance.now; key/mouse/wheel listeners are passive capture on window and iframe document, never blocking.
Redact before IPC: only navigation set members keep their key name, all other keys send null; main recorder must redact again against capsule AX state.
DOM KeyboardEvent/MouseEvent/WheelEvent -> {width,height,kind,key|phase|x,y,button|dx,deltaMode} -> ipcRenderer.send metaviewer:human-trace.v0.3. Same-origin child frame only.
States: monitoring (250ms probe) -> reconnecting -> ready. Healthy probe reschedules monitor; failed probe emits reconnecting then retries; successful reconnect emits ready and resumes monitor.
One flight per tile: stopped flag plus isActive gate every callback; later() only schedules when active; stop() freezes object, sets stopped, clears timer.
Condition: probe throws or returns false, or reconnect rejects. Next: onState reconnecting, then later(retry, xpraRetryDelay(attempt++)). Attempt resets to 0 only on success.
xkbcomp child limited to 3s and 262144 bytes; recovery backoff is 500/1000/2000/4000 then 5000ms, plus fixed 250ms monitor cadence; preload holds only a Set and a timestamp.
Only config is env.DISPLAY selecting the app display whose public XKB metadata is read; absent DISPLAY means unavailable, never a fallback display.
Depends on node:child_process execFile, system xkbcomp binary, Electron ipcRenderer, shipped XpraClient globals, and DOM frame with id metaviewer-xpra-client.
Patch monkey-patches XpraClient.prototype and installs capture input listener calling stopImmediatePropagation, which silences browser IME for dead keys; failure leaves keyboard unusable.

App.vue is the MetaViewer shell: merges authoritative projection plus native role surfaces into rows, owns wall/multislot/terminal/creative/settings screens, and routes every intent through dispatch or dispatchMultislot.

dispatch(intent) routes op-bearing intents to authorityHost.intent via submitHost and proposals to authorityHost.propose; onWallIntent funnels take_control/release_control through applyWallControl, else dispatch.
dispatchMultislot(intent,capsuleId) handles move/tab/float/hide/show and fold/unfold for the selected slot only; local toggles and unknown bodies never reach the host.
onCreateCapsule(intent,settle) gates program/browser/identity creates, forbids renderer profile choice, and opens revealed surfaces; program path delegates to metaviewerRoles.createProgram.

baseFeed is runtime.projectionView or a null unavailable stub; native human role surfaces merge in mergedRows; feed.subscribe drives snapshot; rows filters destroyed, stopped, and non-admitted lost rows.
submitHost(action) awaits host, maps true to INTENT_ACKNOWLEDGED success and objects to hostOutcome rows, records activityFeed entries, and normalizes thrown codes to refusal toasts.

Per-capsule wall input arms: take_control arms human rows at once else pends; feed reconcile promotes pending on human and drops non-human/departed; Escape pauses to Click the tile to type; Release disarms.

Committed placement echoes keyed by surface with pending flag; lifetime epoch captured before await distinguishes same-lifetime frame advance from destroy/recreate; departed ids bump epoch and close pane.
canvasStateFor maps lost lifecycle to frozen lost, else live only when attachmentState is live; input needs human control, WRITE or wall arm, never lost, never nested display-only.
validPlacement enforces closed boundary: exact keys op/params/request_id/schema, op in hide/show/move/tab/float, slot ids matching id pattern, integers within 0..16383 and 1..16384 for sizes.
assertLiveProposal requires matching row by surface_id, active/standby/ceded lifecycle, live attachment, generation>=1 equal to based_on_frame.generation, else throws NO_BROWSER_CAPSULE.
Condition: wrong capsule, invalid body, pending echo, agent control, or READ mode. Next: LAYOUT_ILLEGAL_TRANSITION, ERR_PLACEMENT_PENDING, or LAYOUT_INPUT_MODE_READ refusal; no host call.

Condition: host throws NO_BROWSER_CAPSULE, CAPSULE_LIMIT_REACHED, NO_FREE_PROFILE, SURFACE_PROFILE_BOUND, RAM_ADMISSION_REFUSED and others. Next: mapped message plus activity row; true becomes success toast.
User sees Core not connected with no runtime, Waiting for capsule frames with runtime but no envelope, Core connected when envelope arrives; refusals appear as This request is unavailable toast.
User sees Taking control, Interactive, Input unavailable in this window, or Input refused: CODE chip; refusal bursts coalesce into one activity row with count instead of spam.
Every ack/refusal toast auto-dismisses after 4000ms via one re-armed timer cleared on unmount; watcher writes no reactive state so dismissal never moves the activity count.
Same-code refusals within 1000ms coalesce without resetting chip; chip clears after 2500ms; disconnect of inputPort never breaks shell and teardown clears all timers.
Tile scheduler budget caps 4 draws, 16777216 upload bytes, 8ms present, 1 warm resource per surface, 4 drain steps; presentationRevision drives witness reads of last presented handle and size.
Bounds: activityFeed keeps last 8 rows; lifetime epochs cap 64 entries with oldest eviction failing fence closed; pre-ready echo retries cap 8 entries retried once on wall ready.
Entry resolves stored scheme/density before mount; defaults are mv-light and compact; density mirrors to documentElement.themeDensity and settings panel only persists it.
Failed storage read supplies in-memory default layout once and session-locks writes; any later write throws LAYOUT_SAVE_REFUSED and banner shows Layout unavailable read-only.
Live boot polls metaviewerRoles.surfaces every 250ms, admits only metavier.role_surface/v0.3 human active surfaces, merges by id, and marks capsules human; fixtures keep diagnostic-only lost rows.
Nested display-only walls render nested grid and block dispatch, wall control, and capsule creation with DISPLAY_ONLY; missed gate would let an embedded wall mutate outer state.
Creative service operations have no authoritative wire schema: any type starting creative/ emits locally and always surfaces CREATIVE_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE refusal, closing creative on close.
wallView selects nested/creative/workspace/empty; workspace plus desktopWallReady sets settled; revealRows splits admitted rows once; failed layout echoes replay once on ready.
Native poll interval unrefs and guards hostActive plus generation counters; terminal toggle uses terminalGeneration so stale broker enables and late resolves never flip state.

Renders the docked authority-activity strip: compact bar with toggle plus scrollable log of latest propose-verdict and intent-acknowledgement receipts as typed rows. Props in, nothing out; host adapters own outcomes.
Entry is the entries prop (ActivityFeedItem[] {seq,code,count?}). Non-array input is coerced to an empty feed; nothing is fetched or emitted by this component.
entries.slice(-MV_ACTIVITY_LIMIT) keeps the newest N, each passed through normalizeActivityEntry; nulls are dropped. Result drives v-for rows with entry.seq, entry.type, entry.tone, entry.text.
total is mvActivityFeedTotal over the raw entries (max valid seq), so it keeps counting the full history even when rows shows only the windowed tail.
Two states: expanded=true shows the ol outcomes list; expanded=false hides it. toggle() flips the boolean. Bar with count stays visible in both states.
Rendered row count never exceeds MV_ACTIVITY_LIMIT (8). Order follows feed order after tail-slicing, so oldest of the window is first and newest is last.
countText is mvActivityCountText(rows.length, total): plain count while history fits, latest-window label once total exceeds visible rows.
When no renderable row exists the list shows one row reading No authority activity yet. User sees an empty log rather than a blank panel.
Count label shows plain N while history fits, else latest S of N once windowed. A stuck or jumping count means feed seq values are not contiguous from 1.
Strip section carries stable id mv-activity-strip, anchor activity/strip, accessible name Authority activity. Toggle and list expose matching DomId/Anchor helpers.
Outcomes list is ol role=log tabindex 0 with stable id and anchor; accessible name is Latest authority outcomes, N shown or latest S of N when windowed.
Toggle is capsule-ui-kit UiButton labelled Activity with aria-expanded bound to state; click calls toggle(). Styling comes from activity.css; all copy/ids come from activityModel.js.
rows, total, countText, listName are computed refs; they recompute only when entries changes and allocate a fresh normalized array per change.
Turns reported authority outcomes ({seq,code,count?}) into closed frozen strip entries. Pure JS, zero imports; visible text comes only from closed maps, never from raw prop messages.
Entry is normalizeActivityEntry(input). Non-object, array, null, or seq not a safe integer >=1 returns null and renders nothing.

Branch order: human-input refusal codes first, then NO_IDENTITY variants with missing id, then trusted rawReason pass-through, then ACTIVITY_ROWS lookup, then generic CODE-prefixed refusal, else fallback refusal.
Output is a frozen {seq,type,tone,text} with type in intent-ack, verdict-admitted, verdict-refused, request-refused and tone success or refusal. Unknown codes fall back to generic refusal text.
MV_ACTIVITY_LIMIT is 8: the strip shows at most the newest 8 rows. App.vue enforces the same bound inline; the activity app test pins both literals.
Empty-strip copy is the neutral fixed string No authority activity yet, never a placeholder or a raw code.

Human-input refusal codes (NOT_IN_CONTROL, INPUT_MODE_READ, SURFACE_UNKNOWN, STALE_STREAM, LIMIT, NESTED_DISPLAY_ONLY, SCHEMA, CORE_UNAVAILABLE) render Input refused: reason (CODE) with xN suffix when count>1.
NO_IDENTITY, NO_IDENTITY:profile-id, and NO_IDENTITY__PROFILE forms render a request-refused row naming the missing profile id and telling the operator to create a matching identity.
A well-formed rawReason (1-256 chars, no control chars) with a CODE-shaped code not starting ERR_ or LAYOUT_ renders CODE: reason verbatim, prefixing the code when absent.

Known ACTIVITY_ROWS codes (INTENT_ACKNOWLEDGED, ACTION_ADMITTED, STALE_FRAME, POLICY, CAPSULE_LIMIT_REACHED and others) render their closed human sentence; unknown CODE-shaped codes render CODE plus generic refusal.

Operator sees closed sentences like Request sent, Action admitted, The surface changed. Try again, or Input refused: read-only mode (INPUT_MODE_READ). Raw codes appear only for human-input and capsule identity rows.
count/burst suffix applies only to human-input refusal rows; malformed count reads as 1. Authority rows keep exact historical shape regardless of count.
mvActivityFeedTotal(feed) returns the max valid seq, which equals the true total because recordActivity assigns seq contiguously from 1. Non-array returns 0; malformed rows are ignored.
mvActivityCountText(shown,total) returns String(shown) while total fits, else latest S of N. Unsafe inputs coerce to 0.
Stable strip identity: id mv-activity-strip, anchor activity/strip, accessible name Authority activity. Toggle, list, and row helpers give matching stable ids and anchors.
List accessible name is Latest authority outcomes, N shown, or latest S of N when total exceeds shown. Unsafe counts coerce to 0.
Human-sentence copy mirrors closed literals in core/hostAdapters.js REASONS plus two success messages, kept as a local copy so the strip never trusts a prop message.
CODE-shaped pass-through branches exclude ERR_ and LAYOUT_ prefixes, which fall to the generic refusal instead; a new refusal family with an excluded prefix would lose its code visibly.
Zero-DOM installer for the __agentLane host key: mounts the agent_lane/v1 snapshot producer once per renderer and uninstalls on unmount. No visual output, styles, controls, or host calls.
Entries are props screen (default wall), fixtureKey (default empty), enabled (default true). Mount calls apply(); enabled/fixtureKey changes re-apply via watch; unmount uninstalls.
apply() removes any existing install, then when enabled calls installAgentLane(globalThis,{root:document,screen:()=>props.screen,fixture:fixtureKey||null}) and keeps the returned uninstall callback.
Two install states: uninstalled (uninstall null) and installed (uninstall callable). Every apply() passes through uninstalled first, so re-install never double-mounts.
screen is read lazily through a closure so snapshots track the current prop; fixture is the fixtureKey string or null when empty. enabled=false means no host key is installed.
If installAgentLane throws (key already mounted, bad root), the throw propagates from onMounted/watch with no catch or log here; the lane key stays absent.
Watch tracks only enabled and fixtureKey. A screen-prop change alone does not re-apply, but snapshots still see it because the screen reader closes over live props.
apply() is synchronous and idempotent: uninstall-then-install serializes mount churn from rapid prop changes; no async window exists.
Lifetime is the component lifetime: exactly one install at a time, released on unmount. Forgetting the host (e.g. mounting twice) surfaces as a typed already-installed error.
Only dependency is installAgentLane from agentLane.js plus Vue onMounted, watch, onBeforeUnmount. Root is always document; target is always globalThis.
uninstall is module-closure state reset to null after every uninstall, so a stale callback can never run twice or delete a newer install.
Because root is fixed to document, mounting two hosts (e.g. nested renderers) races on the same global key; the second mount throws ERR_AGENT_LANE_MOUNTED.
Builds a closed frozen agent_lane/v1 DOM snapshot from [data-semantic-anchor] elements in document order. Renderer-only: no host calls, Node/Electron APIs, or network.
Entry is collectAgentControls(root) needing querySelectorAll, or createAgentLane({root,screen,fixture}).snapshot(). Non-queryable root throws ERR_AGENT_LANE_NO_ROOT.

querySelectorAll(ANCHORED_SELECTOR) in document order; each node yields trimmed anchor/id, inferRole, readName, isEnabled, isVisible(rect), roundRect box. Empty anchor or missing id goes to skipped, never controls.
Snapshot is frozen {schema:agent_lane/v1,controls,screen,state:{source:dom,fixture,collected,skipped}}. screen resolves from string or reader fn; throwing reader falls back to wall.
Role is explicit role attr first, else BUTTON/button, A/link, SELECT/combobox, TEXTAREA/textbox, INPUT by type (checkbox, radio, slider, spinbutton, searchbox, textbox), else generic.
Accessible name prefers aria-label, then textContent, then value/placeholder/title, then value property; whitespace collapsed and cut to MAX_ACCESSIBLE_NAME_CHARS (140). May be empty.
enabled=false when disabled attr/property or aria-disabled true. visible=false when rect null, hidden attr, aria-hidden true, or sizeless box.
roundRect accepts x/y or left/top plus width/height, requires finite numbers, rounds to ints, rejects non-positive size with null. readRect wraps getBoundingClientRect and never throws.
Whitespace-only anchor yields skipped reason empty-anchor; whitespace-only id yields missing-id. Collection itself never throws on node data.
Double install throws ERR_AGENT_LANE_MOUNTED; fixture install with existing __benchCaptureFrame throws ERR_BENCH_FRAME_MOUNTED; bad target throws ERR_AGENT_LANE_NO_TARGET.
Host key lifecycle: absent, installed (__agentLane frozen, plus __benchCaptureFrame only for non-empty fixture), uninstalled by returned callback which deletes only its own snapshot binding.
Fixture installs wrap snapshot with a 1-based sequence counter; bindBenchFrame(frame) binds the latest snapshot id fixture:fixture:seq. Zero snapshots throws ERR_BENCH_FRAME_NO_SNAPSHOT.
Bench frame must be exactly {raw_sha256} or {raw_sha256,source_pin}: 64 lowercase hex digest, pin 1-256 chars. Total function returning ok/error, never throwing.

Snapshot validator is total: checks schema, non-empty screen, control closed keys anchor,enabled,id,name,rect,role,visible with non-empty id/anchor and null-or-positive rect. Failures return ERR_AGENT_LANE_SHAPE.
findAnchorOffenders reports interactive elements missing id or anchor; assertAnchoredControls throws ERR_AGENT_LANE_ANCHOR listing TAG#id:reason. Query with INTERACTIVE_SELECTOR.
auditAnchors checks collected controls against the kit controlRegistry inventory via matchControlFamily; snapshot itself never filters on admission. Returns anchor, admitted, family, roleAdmitted.
Automation sees missing controls when ids or anchors are blank, or visible:false when an element is hidden or has zero size; names over 140 chars appear truncated.
Agents calling window.__agentLane.snapshot() get a typed error when the key is absent (host not mounted) or stale after unmount; bench binding is fixture-only, never live.
Bounds: names cut at 140 chars, bench source_pin at 256 chars, rects rounded to ints. Snapshot and rows are Object.freeze deep enough to prevent mutation.
Only external import is matchControlFamily from capsule-ui-kit controlRegistry for admission audit. All DOM reads go through defensive readAttr/hasAttr helpers supporting test doubles.
Snapshot covers only [data-semantic-anchor] nodes while the anchor gate covers interactive elements; an interactive control with id but no anchor is gated but invisible to snapshots.
In-memory fake of window.metaviewer.capture honouring the exact host contract for tests and fixtures. Six methods only: screenshot, recordStart, recordStop, export, list, subscribe.
Mutating calls validate {schema:capture_request/v1, request_id 1-64 printable ASCII, required non-empty string fields}. Malformed shapes throw TypeError synchronously.
screenshot validates surface_id, checks nested/unavailable/surface gates, then seals a shot-N row (1280x720, zero sha, wall-clock created_ms) and resolves {ok:true,shot}.
recordStart (mode must be ai, optional max_fps int 1-60) creates rec-N and emits capture.state recording; recordStop seals it with duration_ms and emits sealed. One active recording per surface.
export validates capture_id and destination (null or recording:configured only), then applies refusal vocabulary before resolving deterministic receipt {id,bytes:2048,sha256}.
Captures move active recording to sealed history; list returns sealed rows plus live active rows with computed duration. Exported ids are remembered to refuse DESTINATION_EXISTS.

recordStart refuses NESTED_DISPLAY_ONLY when nested, configured refuseStart code, CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE when unavailable, SURFACE_UNKNOWN for unknown ids, ALREADY_RECORDING per surface, LIMIT at options.limit.
recordStop refuses NESTED_DISPLAY_ONLY, CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE, or NOT_RECORDING for unknown ids. No success path fabricates frames; frames stay 0.

export refuses NESTED_DISPLAY_ONLY, CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE, DESTINATION_UNSET (null or noDestination), NOT_SEALED for active ids, CAPTURE_UNKNOWN, LIMIT past exportLimit, DESTINATION_UNAVAILABLE, DESTINATION_EXISTS.
list with unavailable resolves {ok:false,code:CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE} with no rows; otherwise {ok:true,rows}. subscribe with non-function throws TypeError.

Test sees closed-code refusals {ok:false,code,request_id} mirroring the host, or synchronous TypeError for bad schema, request_id, mode, max_fps, destination, or listener. Ids are shot-1, rec-1 counters.
Request guard requires plain records and CAPTURE_SCHEMA; request_id alphabet is printable ASCII. subscribe returns an unsubscribe closure removing the listener.
Events are frozen {type:capture.state,recording_id,surface_id,phase,frames,elapsed_ms} broadcast to a snapshot of listeners at emit time.
All methods are synchronous; no locks or timers. Wall clock (Date.now) is used for created/started/duration exactly like a live host, so durations vary per run.
Behaviour switches: nested, unavailable, surfaces closed world (omit for open), limit, noDestination, destinationUnavailable, exportLimit, reportDropped (adds dropped_frames:0), refuseStart code.
Only import is CAPTURE_SCHEMA from capturePort.js; the double must stay in step with that schema tag or every call throws unknown schema.
Export keeps no bytes: receipt sha is zeros for shots and f*64 for recordings with fixed 2048 bytes, so content checks must not treat it as real media.
Renderer-side adapter over window.metaviewer.capture. Components reach the host only through here; every host reply is shape-checked and malformed replies resolve to CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE, never throw.
Entry is createCapturePort(facade) with screenshot, recordStart, recordStop, list, subscribe all callable. Missing facade yields available:false and every call resolves unavailable.
Requests carry schema capture_request/v1 plus deterministic per-port ids mv-capture-N, surface_id or recording_id, and mode ai with optional max_fps. Throwing hosts resolve unavailable.
exportCapture sends capture_id with opaque destination recording:configured and requires bound.export; list takes no args. Replies pass checkExportReply/checkListReply or become unavailable.
Store toggleRecord starts when idle (starting phase, pendingStarts slot) or stops the active recording (stopping phase). Success clears lastCode; failure stores the refusal code.
Validated capture.state events update bySurface entry phase/frames/elapsedMs/recordingId; sealed phase triggers a coalesced auto-refresh so the manifest shows the new row.
storeRows dedupes by id (first wins), caps at CAPTURE_ROWS_CAP (64), O(cap). Unfiltered runs replace all rows; filtered runs merge that surface ahead of kept rows with unseen-surface fill rules.
Per-surface entry phases from MV_RECORDING_PHASES: idle, starting, recording, stopping, plus sealed and error. starting/stopping block new toggles; error sets lastCode to MV_RECORDING_FAILED_CODE.
Refresh coalescing: at most one list in flight plus one queued follow-up sharing one promise. A different-surface or unfiltered waiter widens the queued filter to full list.

Record refusals admit SURFACE_UNKNOWN, ALREADY_RECORDING, NOT_RECORDING, CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE, NESTED_DISPLAY_ONLY, LIMIT plus BUDGET_EXCEEDED and POLICY; unknown codes collapse to CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE.
Export refusals admit DESTINATION_UNSET, CAPTURE_UNKNOWN, NOT_SEALED, DESTINATION_UNAVAILABLE, DESTINATION_EXISTS, LIMIT, NESTED_DISPLAY_ONLY, CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE plus policy codes.
maxFps must be int 1-60 or the call resolves unavailable without touching the host; absent means host default. Export destination is always the opaque token recording:configured, never a path.
Shot, start, stop validators freeze well-formed results and map ok:false to closed refusals; malformed shapes return null and become CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE. Stop requires sealed:true.
List rows need id, surface_id, kind shot/recording, phase in MV_RECORDING_PHASES, count/ms fields, sealed bool. State events need type capture.state plus ids, phase, frames, elapsed_ms.
Manifest cap is 64 rows mirroring the host seam; oversized replies are truncated during store, never stored whole.
screenshot stores lastShot and clears lastCode on success plus auto-refresh; on refusal it stores the code. Disposed stores resolve unavailable without touching the facade.
One export per capture id in flight; duplicates resolve CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE without a host call. Result passes through; disposed resolves unavailable.
User sees disabled tile chrome or a stored lastCode refusal when the facade is missing, the host throws, replies are malformed, or codes are unknown; no exception reaches components.
Refusals keep previous rows; a filtered refresh that meets only other-surface rows fills unseen surfaces instead of wiping to empty.
Auto-refresh after screenshot, stop, or sealed event is fire-and-forget and coalesced; a throwing custom port settles quietly. dispose() resolves queued waiters promptly to unavailable.
Store subscribes exactly once at creation; dispose() unsubscribes, clears pendingStarts/exporting, and poisons later actions to unavailable. bySurface and rows are Vue-reactive.
Phases come from MV_RECORDING_PHASES and failure code from MV_RECORDING_FAILED_CODE in recordingModel.js; Vue reactive powers the store. Port itself needs only that plus the injected facade.
Refresh filter rejects empty and __proto__/constructor/prototype strings to avoid prototype pollution; anything else becomes a surface filter, non-strings list everything.

New Capsule launcher wrapper over kit NewCapsuleDialog: renders known kinds as kit cards, unknown or malformed entries as typed error rows in the empty slot, and translates a kit choice into a create intent with role or program follow-ups.
s: ui/src/catalog/CatalogLauncher.vue::{props, emit, api, choosingRole, profileChoice, roleChoice, roleError, choosingProgram, programBinary, programBusy, programError, pendingIntent, profileChoices, matchingProfiles, confirmRole, confirmProgram, cancelProgram, normalized, dialogTypes, catalogErrors, invokerFocus, forwardVisible, onCreate, pendingIntent.value, onClose}

t: Inputs are visible, kinds, title, subtitle, emptyText props plus kit events create, update:visible, close. onCreate receives {type.id, placement, binary}; forwardVisible and onClose handle dialog visibility and close.

props.kinds flows through normalizeCatalogEntries into normalized, then dialogTypes to kit types and catalogErrors to the empty-slot list. onCreate builds an intent with buildCreateIntent and emits create, or branches to role or program dialogs.

Three views are exclusive: kit dialog, role dialog when choosingRole, program dialog when choosingProgram. Closing the launcher resets both flags and bumps choiceGeneration to invalidate in-flight identity loads.

Error rows render only while catalogErrors is non-empty so clean catalogs keep exact kit behaviour. While choosingProgram is true, forwardVisible and onClose return early and never forward visibility or close.

confirmRole emits create as pendingIntent plus {choice:{role, profileId}} and closes. confirmProgram emits create with intent plus a settle callback, awaits promise outcomes, and only closes on outcome.ok true.
If the chosen profile is busy confirmRole returns silently. If it is unavailable or missing, roleError becomes PROFILE_ALREADY_BOUND or NO_IDENTITY and the dialog stays open with a role alert.
Invalid program input sets programError from the builder error. Unhandled host, rejected outcome, or exception sets Program could not be started or the host reason, and programBusy resets in finally.
Unknown or malformed kit choice makes buildCreateIntent return not-ok and onCreate returns without emitting. Identity list failure clears profileChoices and sets IDENTITY_LIST_UNAVAILABLE.

User sees Capsule role and identity or Program dialogs, alert text such as PROFILE_ALREADY_BOUND, NO_IDENTITY, IDENTITY_LIST_UNAVAILABLE, or Program could not be started, and rows reading This capsule kind is unavailable.

Identity loading is guarded by choiceGeneration: stale api.choices results after close or a newer choice are discarded. confirmProgram disables Start via programBusy and tracks sync settle with settledByListener.
Identity profiles come from globalThis.metaviewerRoles. Focus capture stores document.activeElement on open and restores it after close via invokerFocus, with a document-exists guard.
Defaults are kinds from CATALOG_KIND_IDS, title Add capsule, subtitle about opening a kind in the wall, and emptyText for no search matches. Callers override kinds to subset the launcher.
Depends on catalogModel.js for CATALOG_KIND_IDS, normalizeCatalogEntries, buildCreateIntent, createInvokerFocus, and on kit NewCapsuleDialog for search, grid arrows, Enter and Escape behaviour.

Pure closed catalog model: kind set, typed error rows, and create-intent builder for the launcher. No DOM, framework, or host calls; unknown or malformed entries resolve to frozen error rows and nothing here throws.

t: Renders one host outcome row as a status or refusal paragraph, mapping the code through hostOutcomeFor and exposing code plus tone in DOM attributes.
Entries enter via normalizeCatalogEntries raw host catalog, choices via buildCreateIntent {kind, placement, binary}, and focus handling via createInvokerFocus capture and restore.
Input is the row prop, an OutcomeRow or null. The outcome computed property calls hostOutcomeFor and drives conditional rendering, role, and data-outcome-code.
Each entry becomes a candidate string via direct string or {kind} carrier, resolves with resolveCatalogKind, then splits into frozen types or deduplicated frozen errors with slug collision suffixes.
buildCreateIntent validates kind against BY_KIND, normalizes placement with resolveCatalogPlacement, trims program binary, and returns a frozen ok intent or frozen typed error.
Invoker focus has captured versus cleared states: capture stores the node, restore focuses it when still connected and clears it, returning whether focus happened.
Results are deeply frozen. Valid kinds deduplicate by kind id with first winning; errors deduplicate by raw kind. Malformed entries collapse to one shared invalid-entry row by design.

Error codes are stable: ERR_CATALOG_UNKNOWN_KIND with raw kind, ERR_CATALOG_INVALID_ENTRY with null kind, ERR_CATALOG_INVALID_INTENT with null kind. Messages are plain one-line text with stable kebab keys.
Rendered text is closed renderer copy from hostOutcomeFor, never raw row text. NO_BROWSER_CAPSULE and the generic fallback render as code plus message; other rows render the mapped message.
Non-string kind yields invalid-entry row; unknown string yields unknown-kind row with slugified key. Non-array normalize input yields empty types and errors without throwing.
Non-object input, non-string kind, unknown kind, or empty program binary yields a frozen not-ok result. Placement outside split or floating silently falls back to tab.
User sees one line at the wall bottom such as Action admitted, Request sent, or a refusal like This slot is no longer available, rendered as status or alert by tone.
No locks or async work. Last capture wins; restore is one-shot because it clears the stored invoker before focusing.
Kind set is fixed at module load: identity-browser and program, both opening as tab. No allocation beyond frozen arrays, maps, and per-call result objects.
HostOutcome depends only on hostAdapters.js hostOutcomeFor for copy mapping; catalogModel has no imports and no host surface.
Renderer boundary to host authority, terminal, and frame-wall feeds: strict verdict and session validation, copy mapping for outcomes, and a metadata-only frame subscription into the projection path.

t: Capabilities enter as AuthorityPort and TerminalPort objects with optional methods. Missing methods yield null paths instead of throwing; only main.js reads the preload global, this module receives ports.
intent bodies are stringified through buildAuthorityIntent and require literal true. propose bodies pass assertProposalFrame then decode through verdictRow into an OutcomeRow code, message, and tone.
Frame notices flow through an injected decode into createWallProjection admission as schema metaviewer.frame-wall/v1 query authority.frames. Frame bytes and ports never enter projection or Vue state.

Runtime tracks rows by surface_id, monotonic revision, disposed flag, and initial flag. First notice uses admitInitialResponse, later notices use admitPush; stale generations keep the admitted row without snapshot error.
Acknowledgements are literal true, never truthy coercion. Proposals require schema action_proposal/v0.2, non-empty surface_id, valid generation and sha256, and a budget, else NO_BROWSER_CAPSULE.

Verdicts require schema action_verdict/v0.2, non-empty proposal_id, core_seq safe integer at least 1. Admitted maps to ACTION_ADMITTED; refused requires a known reason code from the closed REASONS table.

Terminal open accepts exactly command, args, cols, rows, validates refusal codes against uppercase pattern and session ids against 1..128 safe characters, and maps TERMINAL_UNAVAILABLE to bundled-support copy.
Non-ok surface reply throws the reply code or SURFACE_CREATE_FAILED. Non-true intent or setEnabled reply throws Host acknowledgement unavailable. Invalid verdict throws Invalid verdict.
Non-function subscribeFrames returns null. Non-function stop throws Invalid frame subscription after disposing the controller. Decoder refusal preserves last-good snapshot as visibly stale.
Unknown codes fall back to This request is unavailable. Raw reason strings over 256 chars or with control chars are ignored. NO_IDENTITY variants map to profile guidance with the missing id.
User sees admitted or sent confirmations, or refusal lines such as capsule limits, no free profile, quarantined profile, insufficient RAM, start busy or timed out, each prefixed by its code.
Out-of-order older generations are treated as routine duplicates: admitted state is kept and only the kit revision advances, so one duplicate never flips tiles to error.
Row map caps at 256 surfaces; beyond that decode refuses with ERR_FRAME_NOTICE. dispose stops the subscription, disposes the controller, and clears rows.

Depends on projection.js createWallProjection for admission and intents.js buildAuthorityIntent and createWallIntentBuilders for encoding and builders; controlRegistry and scheduler are empty frozen objects.
Proposal validation failure raises NO_BROWSER_CAPSULE even when the real cause is a malformed proposal body, which can misdirect debugging toward capsule availability.
Closed frozen intent builders for the capsule wall: protocol visibility and control intents plus local presentation intents, with all wire encoding delegated to injected host encoders.
