Badge copy: Recording MM:SS, Starting, Stopping, Sealed, else Idle. Variants are recording, busy, sealed, idle for the data-variant hook. Error deliberately maps to idle variant.

Null for non-object store, empty surfaceId, missing key, or non-record candidate. Plain-object path uses direct tracked read then hasOwnProperty, so reactive additions re-render while __proto__ and toString still refuse.
User sees Idle on tiles with unknown phases or error entries, with no error text. A tile stuck on Starting or Stopping means the host transition never resolved to recording, sealed or idle.
User sees --:-- instead of a timer when elapsedMs is missing, negative or non-finite. That mirrors the kit convention and signals the host has not projected a time, not zero elapsed.
Busy is derived synchronously from the latest phase each render: starting or stopping true, all else false. No timers here; the chrome component owns the transient screenshot flag.
Capsule-id and copy control share the tile-<segment>-capsule-id and tile-<segment>-copy-id DOM id and anchor derivation, stable per surfaceId for agent selectors and tests.
Pure dependency-free module: no framework, host or external loads. Re-exports the capsuleId copy helpers so the chrome keeps a single pure-module import.

Reserved encoded- prefix is itself encoded, so a crafted host id cannot collide with an encoded value. Encoding covers every UTF-16 unit with padded hex plus end suffix for deterministic safe segments.
Derives one frozen tile decision tile, status, controlVerb and keepsCapturing from the authoritative snapshot plus row and last admitted row, with typed refusal and transport precedence.

Decision entry is deriveTileState(snapshot, row, lastRow): checks refusal/error, unavailable, departed row, terminal lifecycles, unknown lifecycle, stale, non-live transport, attaching binding, then fold/control axis.
Refusal entry is refusalCodeFor(snapshot, row): reads row.refusal else snapshot.error, returns non-empty code string or null. Consumers use it instead of parsing status text.

Live-row axis: folded wins, then controlOwner human/agent falling back to surface control, then busy AI session to agent-acting, else live. Folded keeps capturing; ownership decides human-control versus agent-acting.
Seven frozen states only: connecting, live, folded, human-control, agent-acting, lost, error. Never extended locally; invalid states surface as ERR_TILE_INVALID_STATE for callers.
Capture continues for active, standby and ceded lifecycles, including folded tiles and refused control requests. Terminal or unknown lifecycles stop it; keepsCapturing mirrors that in every decision.
Typed refusal outranks everything: any row or snapshot code, or error status, forces error tile with Refused: <code> or safe display status. Raw refusal detail never renders beyond the code.

Agent chip claims motion only with evidence: busy aiSessionActivity or admitting/accepted/executing dispatchOutcome. Idle ownership, waiting, exited, failed, or settled proposals read ready, not acting.

Display-safe error status is Surface update unavailable. Status labels match the sibling panel derivation for every shared case; coded Refused form exists for parity but render uses the display constant.
Freshness contract: safe-integer generation 1 or above renders Frame <generation> from the authority notice, never a rendered-frame count. Unadmitted rows render empty; callers decide display.

Presented-frame witness: empty string when scheduler affirmatively reports nothing presented or terminal flags; null when unknowable through missing API, malformed instrumentation or refused read; else the opaque handle string.

Unavailable transport gives connecting Waiting without capturing. Departed row with resident live/stale feed gives lost Lost. destroyed gives lost Destroyed, lost lifecycle gives lost Lost, unknown lifecycle or missing row gives connecting Waiting.

Null scheduler, missing getInstrumentation, thrown read, or non-object info give null or empty per case. Generation or epoch mismatch and missing lastPresentedHandle give empty so the Frame badge hides with the placeholder.

User sees Connecting, Waiting, Stale, Live, Lost, Destroyed or the safe error text. A tile stuck on Waiting means unknown lifecycle or no live envelope; Stale means transport stale flag with capture still running.

User sees Agent acting chip only during busy session or in-flight proposal. An agent-owned but idle tile reads plain live/ready; the old ownership fallback that marked every idle agent tile acting is removed.
Decisions are frozen objects, safe to share across snapshot updates. lastRow covers only the current binding, so a departed row cannot pin a later binding to lost.
Scheduler instrumentation read is guarded in try/catch and shape-checked; destroyed or contextLost short-circuits to empty without reading handles, avoiding use of dead surfaces.

Pure dependency-free module shared with SurfacePanel setup: no framework, host or external loads. Constants for lifecycles, attachments, acting activities, outcomes and verbs are frozen and imported by reference.
Error status keeps the coded Refused form for panel parity, so renderers must use the display constant and refusalCodeFor rather than parsing status text, or raw codes leak into the UI.
Compile-time compatibility overlay for the pinned kit: rewrites DockWorkspace.vue source so quarantineReason defaults to quarantined instead of empty, without editing materialized kit source.
kitQuarantineReason(source) takes a source string, applies two string replacements in order, throws on anchor drift, returns the patched source string.
kitQuarantineReasonPlugin() returns a Vite-style plugin object with name metaviewer-kit-quarantine-reason, enforce pre, and transform(source,id) called by the bundler per module.

transform receives source and id, normalizes id backslashes to slashes, checks endsWith /.kit/capsule-ui-kit/src/workspace/DockWorkspace.vue; match forwards source to kitQuarantineReason, mismatch returns undefined and leaves source unchanged.

Input source string flows through replacements loop: before/after pair one patches ref('') to ref('LAYOUT_RESTORE_PENDING'); pair two replaces st.quarantineReason assignment with quarantineCode plus restorePhase fallback joined with quarantineReason.
Each before anchor must occur exactly once: source.split(before).length must equal 2, else throw Error KIT_QUARANTINE_OVERLAY_DRIFT. Guarantees fail-closed behavior when the pinned kit changes.
transform only rewrites the single DockWorkspace.vue path; every other module id must be ignored by returning undefined. Caller must treat undefined as no transform.
States: unpatched -> first anchor verified/replaced -> second anchor verified/replaced -> patched; any verification failure transitions to drift-error and aborts without partial return.
After patch, quarantineReason initial value is LAYOUT_RESTORE_PENDING, so the workspace starts quarantined until layout restore resolves, rather than starting as empty unquarantined.

Patched assignment builds quarantineReason.value from [quarantineCode or restorePhase default, st.quarantineReason] filtered to non-empty trimmed strings and joined with ': ', so no leading/trailing separator when one side is missing.

Fallback is st.quarantineCode, else LAYOUT_RESTORE_PENDING when st.restorePhase is uninitialized or restoring, else LAYOUT_READ_ONLY; that code is then combined with st.quarantineReason detail string.

If either before string is missing or duplicated after a kit upgrade, split length check fails and the build throws KIT_QUARANTINE_OVERLAY_DRIFT; no patched source is returned and the build stops at the pre transform.
User-visible build break after kit upgrade: bundler fails with error text KIT_QUARANTINE_OVERLAY_DRIFT instead of producing the app, pointing at the quarantine overlay anchors.
When patched, testers see quarantine reason strings beginning with LAYOUT_RESTORE_PENDING or LAYOUT_READ_ONLY, optionally followed by ': ' plus detail; when unpatched, the reason starts empty.
Depends on pinned kit file .kit/capsule-ui-kit/src/workspace/DockWorkspace.vue anchors, Vue ref, and store fields st.quarantineReason, st.quarantineCode, st.restorePhase.
Plugin config is name metaviewer-kit-quarantine-reason with enforce pre, so the string replacement runs before other transforms compiling DockWorkspace.vue.
Exact-literal matching is brittle to whitespace, quoting, or formatting changes in the kit; any such change triggers fail-closed drift error by design and requires overlay update.
Synchronous pure string operation with no locks, retries, timers, or shared state; safe to run per module transform, with ordering guaranteed only by enforce pre relative to other plugins.
Allocates intermediate split arrays and replaced source strings per call; no retained handles or lifetimes beyond the returned source. Cost scales with DockWorkspace.vue file size.

Deterministic Linux Electron packager: stage host modules, verify imports, set modes, seal renderer digests into main, enforce ASAR-only plus fuses, write sha256 manifest, tar bundle, atomic publish, then install/smoke verify.

Delivered packaged entry template: owns fresh private runtime and real core session, supervises bundled mv-daemon-adapter when MV_SRF_BIN_DIR set, else core-only; publishes attach pointer and disposes on all exit paths.

Packaged boot entry: preparePackagedAdmission, mkdtemp mv-pkg- runtime 0700, write config.json 0600, spawn bin/metaviewer-core, poll metavier/core.sock under shared budget, then mainDirectEntry with SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP/will-quit/exit disposal.
Shared boot-budget helper: polls checkSocket every pollMs until deadline, then races startMain/runEntry against remaining budget timer; injectable now/sleep/checkSocket/isFailed for tests.

Verify flow: read app.asar electron/main.js seal JSON, check nesting seal equality, walk ASAR namespace excluding aliases/unpacked, recompute normalized digests for dist/renderer, dist/preload, electron, .kit and require exact inventory match.

Attach handoff: build record of paths and ids only from session plus operator env, publish owner-only host <XDG_RUNTIME_DIR>/metaviewer/attach/current.json plus current.env via temp rename 0600, print METAVIEWER_ATTACH env path, retract on stop/exit.

Boot states: init admission failure before children, runtime created, core spawned, socket ready, main entry resolved to boot, live session with attach published, stopping idempotent via stopPromise, core SIGTERM then SIGKILL after 1500ms, runtime removed.

Install invariant: no symlinks/special entries, dirs 0755, files 0755 if any exec bit else 0644, manifest lines sorted sha256 plus mode marker, walk must match digest and mode exactly, count must equal manifest size.

Fuse invariant: ASAR must be true for OnlyLoadAppFromAsar, config keys and values must equal buildFuseConfig exactly else Fuse configuration drift; binary bytes at sentinel offset must equal expected 0/1 per FUSE_TABLE.

Attach contract schema metaviewer.attach/v1 closed keys schema/session_id/pid/core_socket/boot_profile/env; session pkg-hex UUID, pid safe int>1, absolute paths no NUL/CR/LF, core_socket must be XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/metaviewer/core.sock.
Path contract: XDG_CONFIG_HOME candidate must be absolute without NUL/CR/LF and outside runtimeDir and appRootDir else fallback runtime/config; MV_PKG_OUT must be absolute and not overlap repository.

Binary/font contract: ELF 64-bit LSB magic 7f454c46 class 2 data 1 machine 183 arm64 or 62 x64 plus exec bit; any font extension or magic wOFF/wOF2/OTTO/ttcf/true/typ1 or 00 01 00 00 throws PKG_FONT_FORBIDDEN.

Fuse fail: sentinel missing/duplicate throws Fuse sentinel missing or ambiguous; version byte !=1 or length mismatch throws wire version/length mismatch; non 48/49 byte throws unavailable; post-write verify throws Fuse mismatch name.

Security fail: missing app.asar or present app/app.asar.unpacked throws ASAR-only layout required; alias/unpacked entry throws refused; seal missing/invalid, asset mismatch key, inventory mismatch, entry mismatch, required entry absent all throw.

Admission fail before children: missing/non-absolute XDG_RUNTIME_DIR throws PKG_HOST_RUNTIME_REQUIRED; non-dir/symlink/foreign uid/mode!=0700/non-canonical throws UNSAFE; absent/non-dir/non-canonical RAM root returns METAVIEWER_BOOT_REFUSED line.

Electron fail closed: version/electron binary/pin mismatch throws PKG_ELECTRON_PIN; unanchored dist without verified wrapper/pinned tree/zip throws PKG_ELECTRON_CHECKSUM with expected versus actual tree/zip detail on stderr.

Publish fail: existing finalDir or manifest throws EEXIST Package destination already exists; lost directory race throws same; crash recovery removes half-published dir/manifest/marker only when no in-flight commit, loser repairs winner manifest not delete.

Smoke fail: launch exception maps to PKG_SMOKE_CHILD_FAILED; nonzero code/null code/signal throws same; missing METAVIEWER_MAIN_SMOKE_OK plus METAVIEWER_RENDERER_READY lines throws PKG_SMOKE_MARKER_MISSING with bounded tails.

User sees app quit at once with no window. Terminal shows PKG_CORE_START_FAILED, PKG_SEAL_MISMATCH key, PKG_HOST_RUNTIME_UNSAFE, SINGLE_INSTANCE already running, or METAVIEWER_BOOT_REFUSED RAM_ROOT_ABSENT with mkdir -p -m 700 fix.

Tester sees smoke error naming PKG_SMOKE_CHILD_FAILED or PKG_SMOKE_MARKER_MISSING plus JSON code/signal and last 3000 chars of stdout/stderr; missing METAVIEWER_RENDERER_READY or METAVIEWER_MAIN_SMOKE_OK means renderer or boot never completed.

Installer sees PKG_MANIFEST_MISMATCH name, PKG_ALIAS_FORBIDDEN, PKG_FONT_FORBIDDEN, PKG_BINARY_MISSING name, PKG_ARCH_MISMATCH name, PKG_ELECTRON_CHECKSUM context expected versus actual; tar/launch refused rather than running tampered bytes.

Concurrent publish uses activePublishCommits count per commit marker, wx marker create, rename manifest then dir, inode match ownership, parent fsync; rollback deletes only owned inodes and repairs winner manifest on lost race.

Stop is single-flight via stopPromise; will-quit prevents default then stop finally exit 0; live check requires same child object plus exitCode/signalCode null plus validateKillTarget; exit path SIGKILLs live core and sync-removes runtime.
Boot budget default PKG_BOOT_BUDGET_MS 10000, overridable by MV_PKG_BOOT_BUDGET_MS>0, poll 25ms; same deadline covers socket wait and mainDirectEntry race with timer cleared in finally.

Diagnostics keep last SMOKE_DIAGNOSTIC_TAIL_CHARS 3000 chars of stdout/stderr; adapter refusal requires nonzero exit, no signal, no success marker, plus completed write(2, configuration: profile map... , length) in per-thread strace.

node-pty outside ASAR at resources/build-native/pty-runtime/node-pty; build inputs and node-addon-api headers pinned by sha256, ELF arch checked, npm rebuild --offline stages package.json/lib/pty.node/spawn-helper then verifies.

Depends on local Electron zip/dist cache, node_modules/electron wrapper plus package-lock integrity, capsule-ui-kit via sync_kit/checkInstalled, unzip, xvfb-run for operator smoke; packager download branch unused, archives mandatory.

Electron may exit before forwarding stderr so use writeFdSync fd 1/2 with EINTR/EAGAIN retry and sync write; override console.error to fd 2, swallow stdio EIO/EPIPE errors, ignore SIGHUP terminal hangup during disposal.

Attach pointer holds paths/ids never secrets; current.env must be sourced in subshell because it overrides XDG_RUNTIME_DIR; retract is sync never-throw and deletes only when current.json still names this session_id, stale pid must not be used.

Fake adapter only for clean-install smoke: deterministic node shebang, real core socket hello/v0.2 handshake, receipt pid/handshake/env/reaped checks plus ESRCH liveness; operator smoke warns empty/fake SRF binaries do not prove native capsule.

ui/tools/package.js builds the reproducible MetaViewer Linux package: vite renderer, staged Electron modules, sealed assets, native core/adapter, Electron packager, fuses, manifest bundle. It also verifies install/security and runs clean-install smoke legs.
CLI dispatch when argv[1] equals this module: --verify, --verify-install, --smoke, --smoke-operator, else packageShell(). Failures print error.message and set exitCode 1. --smoke logs JSON result.

packageShell(env=process.env) requires Node>=24, resolves repo realpath, validates MV_PKG_OUT through nearest existing ancestor, creates destination, then runs builder/app/work staging, vite build, native builds, packager, and publish/bundle.

cleanInstallSmoke(artifact path) extracts/installs to an isolated clean HOME, runs fake-adapter leg, real-adapter /dev/shm leg, no-profiles negative control, and retail-flag refusal leg, returning smoke marker on success.

First smoke leg sets XDG_RUNTIME_DIR, PATH, HOME=clean, LANG=C.UTF-8, MV_PACKAGE_SMOKE=1, MV_SRF_BIN_DIR and runs xvfb-run strace -f -e trace=file -o trace metaviewer --user-data-dir=clean/profile with 30s timeout and 1MB buffer.

Second leg builds realEnv with MV_SRF_BIN_DIR/STATE_DIR, SRF_IDENTITY_STORE_ROOT, MV_SRF_PROFILES JSON (smoke-browser, RAMRoot=shmRoot, :100, 1280x900), MV_PACKAGE_SMOKE_HOLD=1, and runs 60s strace file trace under xvfb-run.

Negative config leg uses noProfilesEnv identical to realEnv but omits MV_SRF_PROFILES, runs strace -ff -e trace=write -s 256, collects config-refusal.trace.* files, and calls assertAdapterConfigRefusal(result,traces).

Build data flows builder(app src/index/vite/electron/tools/kitQuarantineReason/package.json/node_modules symlink/kit sync) -> vite build -> stageElectronModules -> rename nesting.js, append mainDirectEntry export, write productionEntry and package-pin.json -> seal -> packager -> copy native/contracts/deps/operator resources.

MV_PKG_OUT is validated via ancestor walk: realpath up until existing dir, lstat rejects dangling symlink with MV_PKG_OUT ancestor cannot be resolved, then join+validate, mkdir -p, realpath+validate. Refuses if destination already contains arch name or sha256.

Success contract returns {marker:METAVIEWER_MAIN_SMOKE_OK, source_access:false, negative_controls:PASS}. Caller asserts marker via assertSmokeOutput, adapter receipt via verifySmokeAdapterReceipt, and no repo source access via trace scan.
Installed tree must never open repo sources: strace file trace is scanned for repo path and its realpath; match throws PKG_SOURCE_ACCESS. Covers fake-adapter and real-adapter legs.
Isolation requires 0700 shmRoot under /dev/shm/mv-pkg-* plus 0700 realSrfBin/State/Identity dirs, 0700 host XDG_RUNTIME_DIR, and empty host ram-admission ledger after run; any reservation leaks.

States: clean temp -> fake-adapter smoke -> verifyInstall -> real-adapter smoke+admission-leak check+source check -> no-profiles config-refusal check -> retail refusal check -> return marker. shmRoot removed in finally; clean removed in outer finally on all paths.

If file trace contains repo path then throw PKG_SOURCE_ACCESS. Missing host runtime dir throws PKG_HOST_RUNTIME_REQUIRED. Nonempty hostRuntime/metaviewer/ram-admission (ENOENT treated as empty) throws PKG_ADMISSION_RESERVATION_LEAK.

Without MV_SRF_PROFILES the child must exit nonzero without smoke marker and its strace write trace must show completed adapter config diagnostic; assertAdapterConfigRefusal throws PKG_ADAPTER_CONFIG_REFUSAL_MISSING otherwise.

Retail launch with --remote-debugging-port=9222 must exit nonzero with RETAIL_FLAG on stdout/stderr; otherwise throw PKG_RETAIL_REFUSAL_MISSING with 3000-char refusalDetail. Catches only numeric code errors.

Early fail-closed errors: Node<24, CAPSULE_UI_KIT_REPO missing, neither MV_ELECTRON_ZIP_DIR nor ELECTRON_OVERRIDE_DIST_PATH, PKG_CARGO_TARGET_REQUIRED when CARGO_TARGET_DIR not absolute, PKG_REVISION_INVALID when git HEAD not 40 hex, packager built.length!=1.

Tester sees smoke fail with PKG_SOURCE_ACCESS, PKG_ADMISSION_RESERVATION_LEAK, PKG_HOST_RUNTIME_REQUIRED, or PKG_SMOKE_CHILD_FAILED/marker missing; delivered tarball is rejected and no marker JSON is printed.

Lifetimes: /dev/shm/mv-pkg-* RAMRoot chmod 0700 removed with rm recursive force in finally; clean HOME removed in outer finally; builder work .pkg-* removed in finally. Leaked shm dirs signal failed cleanup.

Config inputs: MV_PKG_OUT, CAPSULE_UI_KIT_REPO, MV_ELECTRON_ZIP_DIR or ELECTRON_OVERRIDE_DIST_PATH, CARGO/CARGO_TARGET_DIR (must be absolute), GO, MV_OPERATOR_REPO implied by INSTALL.md. Offline locked builds: cargo --offline --locked, go GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local.

Depends on vite build, @electron/packager with ELECTRON_PIN, zip for dist staging, cargo metaviewer-core, Go mv-daemon-adapter, kit sync via kit.lock.json, verify helpers (verifyElectronZip/Dist, verifyBinary, buildFuseConfig, sealRendererAssets).
Test suite guards packaged install, seal, Electron binding, smoke diagnostics and clean-install smoke with fixtures outside the checkout and no source mutation; it runs with node --test on this file.

fixture builds a temp MetaViewer linux directory with synthetic ELF binaries, applies fuses, stages electron main plus renderer and preload stubs, seals, packs asar, writes manifest, verifies install, creates a 0700 host runtime, invokes the callback, then removes temp.

Tampered adapter bytes, an added extra file, or a removed binary fail verifyInstall with PKG_MANIFEST_MISMATCH or PKG_BINARY_MISSING naming mv-daemon-adapter; the manifest is rewritten after each mutation in the test.
A planted font file or disguised font bytes inside asar fail verifyInstall with PKG_FONT_FORBIDDEN even after manifest regeneration, proving content scanning rather than manifest comparison.

Flipping the ELF machine field fails verifyInstall with PKG_ARCH_MISMATCH; packageArchitecture maps arm64 to machine 183 and x64 to 62 with pinned Electron zip names, rejecting riscv64 with PKG_ARCH_UNSUPPORTED.
Tampered renderer in a rebuilt asar fails with ASAR asset mismatch; a manifest line with a parent escape fails with PKG_MANIFEST_INVALID, blocking path traversal in manifest entries.
assertSmokeOutput accepts only exact METAVIEWER_MAIN_SMOKE_OK plus METAVIEWER_RENDERER_READY lines; READY alone or a prefixed marker throws PKG_SMOKE_MARKER_MISSING.

bundlePackage ignores mtimes and preserves pinned bytes: two bundles of the same root after touching mtime share artifact sha and size; smoke tests also assert byte-identical rebuilds across temp dirs.

Fake-adapter test starts a unix socket core, writes config with session and core daemon hellos, launches the adapter with createAdapterLauncher, asserts live availability and hello seen on both ends, disposes, then checks receipt handshake and reaped flags.

Receipt checks fail closed: missing file yields PKG_SMOKE_ADAPTER_RECEIPT_MISSING, wrong srf dir yields ENV_MISMATCH, pid 1 yields PID_INVALID, false handshake yields HANDSHAKE_MISSING, and false reaped yields NOT_REAPED.

Extended seal test asserts productionEntry is a string, an intact staged nesting entry boots to BOOT_MAIN_DIRECT_ENTRY_OK, while tampered coreLauncher or preload refuses boot before entry with PKG_SEAL_MISMATCH and fails packaged security verification.

writeManifest emits stock sha256sum check grammar with star for executables and space otherwise; the external check passes, while mode-only drift on the adapter or asar fails with PKG_MANIFEST_MISMATCH naming the file.
Suite asserts package ELECTRON_PIN equals main ELECTRON_PIN and archive names embed that pin per arch, while package.js imports the pin from electron main and contains no literal version string.

runPackagedBootWait enforces one total budget across socket wait and hello: a virtual 10000 ms budget with socket at 9900 ms leaves 100 ms for hello, a real 220 ms budget bounds a slow hello, and the fast path succeeds.
sealRendererAssets sorts directory entries and is deterministic: sealing twice and sealing under reversed readdir yield byte-identical main.js with sorted digest keys.

runSmokeCommand decorates PKG_SMOKE_MARKER_MISSING and PKG_SMOKE_CHILD_FAILED with code, signal and the last 3000 chars of stdout and stderr, dropping the head prefix; zero exit with both markers succeeds.

productionEntry uses synchronous fd writes so METAVIEWER_MAIN_SMOKE_OK and PKG_ADAPTER_START_FAILED or RETAIL_FLAG reach non-TTY pipes despite corked streams and immediate exit; an async-write mutant loses the marker and fails.

Source asserts cleanInstallSmoke calls assertSmokeOutput and verifySmokeAdapterReceipt and throws PKG_SOURCE_ACCESS; a determinism check copies the root to two dirs, retouches mtime, and requires equal artifact sha and bytes.

checkCleanCiReproPrerequisites fails closed with PKG_CLEAN_CI_PREREQ_ELECTRON_MISSING when no cached zip or dist exists, and PKG_CLEAN_CI_PREREQ_NPM_CACHE_MISSING with a missing package list; the hosted repro does offline npm ci in temp, verifies dist, and checks tamper negative controls.

Config-refusal test proves strace write traces witness a diagnostic lost in forwarded output and rejects noise, partial and failed writes; the large smoke test builds the real Go adapter plus C launchers, mutates renderer and host to require renderer-ready and surface-create failures, and asserts no shm leak on pass or fail.

Tester sees node test failure naming PKG_MANIFEST_MISMATCH, PKG_FONT_FORBIDDEN, PKG_ARCH_MISMATCH, PKG_SMOKE_MARKER_MISSING, PKG_ELECTRON_CHECKSUM or admission reservation leak instead of pass, indicating a tampered, misbuilt or leaking package rather than a flaky harness.

Vite build config for ui: sets relative base, renderer outDir, Vue plus quarantine plugins, exact capsule-ui-kit aliases from .kit copy, and copies electron preload to sibling preload dir as preload.cjs.
Entry is Vite loading this config via defineConfig; top-level code runs at config load, while sandbox-preload plugin writeBundle runs after renderer bundle emit with Rollup output object.
kit path derives from import.meta.url plus ./.kit/capsule-ui-kit/ via fileURLToPath; pkg reads kit package.json; alias maps pkg.exports keys to absolute kit file paths for Vite resolve.alias.

Preload flow: readFileSync electron/preload.js to string, validate import/export shape, strip declaration exports, mkdir ../preload beside output.dir, write preload.cjs. No bundling of preload imports.

Preload must stay single import-free JS source; only export const/class/function declarations allowed. Regex /^import\s|^export\s+(?!const |class |function )/m enforces it, else throws Preload bundling contract changed.
Alias find uses anchored exact-match RegExp per export key, escaping regex chars; root . maps to bare capsule-ui-kit, others to capsule-ui-kit/subpath. Prevents root alias capturing subpaths.
Alias replacement handles string or object export values via typeof value check and value.default, stripping leading ./ and joining onto kit dir.

Renderer output directory must exist in writeBundle: if output.dir is falsy throw Renderer output directory is required. Preload destination always resolves as resolve(output.dir, ../preload), honoring packager --outDir.
base ./ makes built asset URLs relative; build.outDir dist/renderer places renderer bundle one level below preload output sibling.
resolve.dedupe forces single copies of vue, dockview-core, dockview-vue across aliased kit and app code.
Depends on vite defineConfig, @vitejs/plugin-vue vue(), local kitQuarantineReasonPlugin from ./tools/kitQuarantineReason.js, and node:fs/node:path/node:url primitives.
Requires pre-synced .kit/capsule-ui-kit/package.json with exports map; comment states kit must first pass tools/sync_kit.mjs against kit.lock.json.
If .kit not synced or package.json missing/invalid, readFileSync or JSON.parse throws at config load; Vite fails before build with ENOENT or SyntaxError, no renderer output.
If preload.js gains import or non-declaration export, writeBundle throws Preload bundling contract changed; renderer bundle already emitted but preload.cjs not written, build fails.
If output.dir undefined (in-memory or custom writer), throws Renderer output directory is required; caller is Vite/Rollup writeBundle pipeline.
Synchronous file I/O at config load (package.json read) and at writeBundle (preload read, mkdirSync recursive, writeFileSync). No async, locks, retries, or timers.
Stale .kit copy silently aliases to old kit files if sync_kit.mjs not rerun; build succeeds but UI uses outdated kit. Exact regex avoids accidental subpath capture.
User sees PASS <component>: <detail> or FAIL <component>: <detail> lines, plus FAIL deps.lock: ... on lock errors. Planner SKIP prints literal SKIP (planner not pinned yet).
User sees one JSON summary with passed/failed/skipped/source plus result/receipt or error. Live probe failures name probe child rc, missing binary, or orphan evidence blocking the gate.
User sees ERROR: ... lines on stderr for each violation, dry-run assembled changelog on stdout, silent success otherwise. Pending fragments block check mode.
Visible symptom: tester sees ERROR lines for failing schema or example and nonzero exit; passing run prints Contracts check OK message listing audited schemas and accepted and rejected examples.
Visible symptom: user sees ERROR lines naming revision and rule on stderr with nonzero exit; clean tree prints Laws check OK.
Visible symptom: designer sees PASS with measured pair count or single error line describing failing pair, token, selector or font path.

User sees one line per leg PASS <leg> or FAIL <leg> or BLOCKED <leg> plus final PASS/FAIL aggregate. Failures add diagnostics on stderr: metadata drift, pin drift, stale lock, frozen offline resolution failed, child rc, missing tool/target, marker=False, SKIPPED reason.

User sees no DONE receipt: stdout is a BLOCKED receipt with rc 5 and error code such as assertion_failed, negative_control_accepted, wender_subprocess_failed, vision_subprocess_failed, no_actionable_target, or cleanup proof missing, plus detail text.

Operator sees DEMO_REFUSED on stdout with ok false and exit 6 when ids, paths, leases, recordings, digests, site bounds or the MemoryWeb build gate fail. No native output, event text, paths or exceptions escape; only that fixed error string is printed.

Operator sees stderr hints for PROFILE_MISSING, PROFILE_NOT_PROVISIONED with sudo install -d -m 0700 -o 10001 -g 10001, RESERVED_ID, LOGIN_IN_PROGRESS or LOGIN_TERMINATED, plus stdout JSON ok false with codes such as IDENTITY_PROTECTED, IDENTITY_BOUND or NATIVE_REFUSED.

Operator sees one JSON line per reservation with action keep/would_remove/removed and reason owner_alive_or_unknown, native_capsule_present, native_inventory_unknown, or owner_dead_and_matching_native_absent. Unsafe names never disappear; dry-run changes nothing.

User sees JSON summary with rows and focused element; on drift the summary adds code MW_AX_ANCHOR_DRIFT with exit 3 and candidate names for each missing anchor. Config or native failures print a refused marker with code and detail and exit 6.

User sees one-line JSON such as ok false code MW_HOME_TRACKED, MW_HOME_NOT_IGNORED, MW_HOME_GIT, MW_WORKFLOW_ABSENT or MW_PROVENANCE. With provenance failure, faults lists one actionable line per bad site.json or workflow file naming the expected inside-sites file and hash fix.
Run stops for a human when AX shows CAPTCHA cue or sign-in dialog; observation carries observed_wall kind captcha_wall or login_wall. Nothing is clicked or solved.
Tester sees synthetic page title change to P18-TYPED plus typed value, then P18-SAVED after Persist click. Missing change means typing or persistence failed.

Observer sees Switching to target progress text, then new mode surface; missing progress raises SWITCH_PROGRESS_UNPROVEN, no flip raises SWITCH_UI_UNPROVEN, retained pane raises ENDED_LIFETIME_PANE_RETAINED.
User sees human menu Switch to agent mode, I logged in, Stop capsule above native video; agent menu adds Watch read-only and emergency take control. Missing overlay means z-order failure.
Vision drives VCorePerceptionAdapter on synthetic 320x200 frames with two white rectangles; timeout, probe rc, bad JSON, or changed_regions != two expected boxes yields FAIL with detail.

Any ValueError/TypeError/KeyError returns ok False with failure string: bad schema/workload/orphans/duration, short cohort, clock regression, missing role, tree<sum(parts), late first/final sample, >10s gap, or cap exceedance.

Validate failure path: type, const, enum, oneOf exactly-one-branch rule, missing required, unexpected properties, item count, string length, pattern and number bounds each raise path-prefixed ValidationError.

Fragment failure path: bad fragment path, symlink or non-regular file, invalid encoding, empty file, non-bullet line, overlong line, forbidden word, or missing fragment on product change each emit path-prefixed errors.

If a required target file/dir is absent, leaf() prints missing target: <name> and returns 2 (BLOCKED) for manifests/laws/contracts/unit/js/rust/go/ui-smoke/ui/perf, except agents absence returns 1 (FAIL). Child nonzero prints <leg>: child rc=<rc>.

Post-action path requires after sha256 differs from before, tick in [frame.tick+1, frame.tick+100], post state sha256 differs from pre_state_sha256, and post battery differs from pre battery. Violations raise post-action pixels/state did not change or tick outside window.

validate_events requires 1-501 newline rows each at most 4096 bytes, exact seq order, nondecreasing mono_ns, known kind, window wN or empty, modifier set, text_len rules, keysym allowlist, before/after frame names, int coords, dir set, and a final stop row with operator/limit/recorder_exited reason.

delete refuses protected or live ids with IDENTITY_PROTECTED, shows identity, holds the guard flock, requires lease absent or inactive else IDENTITY_BOUND, rejects symlink/non-file metadata or non-dir profiles, keeps the entry until privileged removal succeeds, then unlinks metadata and lock record but never the guard.

Pixel race MW_REBIND_PIXELS retries without submit up to 3 attempts; STALE_FRAME core refusal retries with fresh AX up to 3; other refusals raise. Exhaustion raises MW_STALE_FRAME_EXHAUSTED. Only post-receipt slot readback gets extended window.

CLI: --lock, --deps-root, --timeout, --strict-head, --require-planner, --print-pins, --github-output. Print-pins validates and dumps JSON; github-output appends repo/commit/dir vars; else run_all_smokes.
Mutually exclusive --self-test|--receipt PATH|--probe, optional --electron and --exclude-pid-file. Loads tests/perf/budgets.json, writes GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY when set, exit 0/1/2 by result.

Bash parses argv into selector: no args=skeleton, --self-test, or --leg <leg>; any other arity/value prints Usage to stderr and exits 2. Valid legs are skeleton|laws|contracts|unit|agents|manifests|js|rust|go|ui|ui-smoke|perf|self-test.

Entry is main(argv) with --surface mv-live-1 (only choice) and optional --receipt-out. It builds a receipt schema metaviewer.g-ai-receipt/v1 with assertions A1-A8 false and empty negative_controls, then runs preflight and run_gate.

Entry is main(argv) with --store-root, --memoryweb-home and verbs create/list/show/status/delete/login/release. create needs --id --label plus --domains/--browser; release needs --holder. Success prints schema metaviewer.identity/v1 ok true; Refused and OS/subprocess errors print ok false error with exit 6.
Run one admitted MemoryWeb owner workflow against the running packaged MetaViewer core via HostBackend, writing memoryweb-run.json report and receipt; never starts or reconfigures capsules.

Probe launches electron rss_probe.mjs with MV_RSS_OUTPUT/PROFILE/EXCLUDES env in temp dir via bounded 180s helper from gate.sh, reads receipt, maps sample process roles, audits /proc identities, attaches argv and sandbox env.

observe merges tools.observe frame_ref with native ax tree plus url and observed_wall; perceive retains frame pixels, builds vqa.element-table from AX boxes, returns frame, table, ax, window; state_for runs wender shim subprocess for Wender IDs.

deps.lock must be object with only components/schema_version, schema metaviewer.deps.lock/v1, non-empty components list, unique names, owner/name repo in allowlist, non-empty version, 40 lowercase hex commit, all three required components.
Contrast contract: every matrix pair plus explicit CSS and Vue color and background pairs must reach threshold ratio 4.5 to one using relative luminance formula.

Frozen resolution is verified only in disposable manifest-only trees: cargo metadata --offline --locked --filter-platform <rustc host> and npm ci --offline --ignore-scripts --dry-run; no installs, scripts, network, or repo writes are admitted.

tools/ holds isolated dev launchers, live verification harnesses, router coverage tooling, kit vendoring and xpra witnesses for mv. p18c_dev.cjs and p18c_r2_dev.cjs launch the owned MetaViewer on :97 with RPC file-loop ops; R2 suppresses first surface create. p18c_smoke.py, p18f_exercise.py, p18f_meter.py, p18g_run.py and p18f_cleanup.py exercise drag/resize/desktop moves, prove bridge-port stability and restart retention, meter memory and audit cleanup. router_index.py compiles/checks catalogue nodes/routes coverage. sync_kit.mjs vendors capsule-ui-kit, xpra_lock_probe.cjs probes single-instance lock, xpra_tile_r3_client.py and xpra_tile_r3_contracts.py drive native/remote witnesses and validate role contracts. Offers isolated launch, live gates and coverage proofs; needs P18_ROOT isolation, DISPLAY :97, Electron, ss/proc, xdotool, docker, git and contract trees.
Operator sees only own dev window on :97; tile-status shows connected and readonly flags, visibility shows which tiles visible. No renderer capability or operator session reused.
Tester sees human and agent desktop buttons toggle pressed state and native tile appear or disappear; unexpected retained role or visible desktop means view leak.
Evidence shows floating native window before, moved-resized, and desktop-2 screenshots; user would see native video move, grow, hide behind menu, reappear on desktop 2.

Tester sees METAVIEWER_ROUTER_COVERAGE 100% N files when healthy; stale shows Stale or incomplete router with coverage mismatch N vs M and digest diffs or missing source <path>. Kit/mount faults show Router error: kit builder failed/timeout, corpus mismatch, mount ids != nodes ids, SHA256SUMS mismatch, or broken doc link file:line.

A user sees JSON {version,contentHash,direction} on sync success or ERROR: reason on failure; probe prints SINGLE_INSTANCE with exit 1 when locked else SPIKE_LOCK_ISOLATED with exit 0; R3 prints JSON rows baseline, bridge-cut, reconnecting-overlay-pixel, reconnected, blur-refocus, ctrl-t/w/q, final-paint to stdout and r3-live.json.

A user sees one line per example such as role_request.basic.json accepted or role_request.bad.invalid.json rejected. Success prints all lines and exits cleanly; failure prints lines up to the mismatch then an AssertionError naming the offending example file.
Bad isolation throws ISOLATION_REQUIRED; lock contention logs SINGLE_INSTANCE exits 7; unknown op throws OP_REFUSED; missing tile throws VIEW_ABSENT; boot error logs and exits 1.

Missing readiness raises LIVE_GATE_UNPROVEN; absent bridge raises OWN_BRIDGE_CONNECTION_ABSENT; restart refusal on SINGLE_INSTANCE or BOOT_REFUSED; missing ready raises RESTART_NOT_READY; reopened session fails SESSION_REOPENED.
Missing element or disabled button fails click assertion; unsettled bounds raises NATIVE_BOUNDS_NOT_SETTLED; ctrl+alt+Right/Left intercepted before xpra must widen then restore width within 2 px.

Git manifest timeout/OSError/nonzero rc, non-UTF8, non-canonical, duplicate or empty universe raise RouterError printed to stderr return 1. Router error: covers malformed input/kit/protocol/symlink/prohibited path; Stale or incomplete router: covers missing source, stale bytes, doc link, mount/SHA mismatch; unknown option returns 2.

check_doc_links fails on non-UTF8 markdown, empty paren, undefined [ref], ambiguous scheme, .. escape beyond root or missing target after stripping fences/comments/code spans, citing file:line. Kit failures: missing/symlink input, bad schema, unimportable validator, builder timeout/nonzero rc/OSError raise Router error: kit builder failed.

Sync fails with kit absent when dest is not materialised, Kit metadata/pin/hash mismatch, Invalid kit lock, Kit repository/commit mismatch on HEAD or origin, symlink ancestor rejection, source-destination overlap, or activation failure with preserved backup path. All CLI failures print ERROR: message and set exitCode 1.

R3 fails with ROOT_REFUSED, CAPSULE_REFUSED, REMOTE_WITNESS_FAILED when REMOTE_PID missing or early exit, BASELINE_PAINT_ABSENT or RECOVERED_PAINT_ABSENT when cadence changed<1, RECOVERY_TIMEOUT after 20s without ready state advance, and REMOTE_KEY_MISSING when ctrl+t/w/q is not observed in r3-remote.log. Finally always kills remote and logs commands.jsonl.

Failure paths raise instead of returning codes: missing schema or example files raise OSError, malformed JSON raises json decode error, bad meta-schema raises check_schema error, and expectation mismatch raises AssertionError with the example name. Any exception stops later contracts and examples.

main(argv) accepts only --check else Router error: unknown option return 2; resolves root, checks corpus, loads schema/validator, reads git manifest, derives ids, compiles, verifies kit, then checks or writes nodes/routes with METAVIEWER_ROUTER_COVERAGE. tracked_paths runs git ls-files -z --cached with 60s timeout, rejects non-canonical/duplicate/empty manifests; no recursion.

CLI entry parses node tools/sync_kit.mjs [kit-repo] [--check], with fallback MV_KIT_CHECKOUT or CAPSULE_UI_KIT_REPO. More than one --check, extra positionals, dash options, or missing repo in sync mode prints usage ERROR and sets exitCode 1. Otherwise it calls checkInstalled or syncKit and prints JSON result.

Entry is top-level script execution with no function or CLI flags. Running python3 tools/xpra_tile_r3_contracts.py walks the fixed name list role_request then role_view_state, loading each schema and iterating its sorted example glob.
50 ms file loop maps eval to main window JS, tile-status to xpra connected/readonly/layout/remoteWindows, visibility to tile visibles, shortcut to ctrl+key, pixel to 1px bitmap, quit to close.

connections parses ss -tnp endpoints and ss -ltnp listeners, asserts loopback only else NONLOCAL_LISTENER, returns ports/pairs to prove bridge persistence; rss sums statm resident pages of pid plus /proc children recursively tracking peak_ui_kib, tolerating exited as zero.
ports reads ss -ltnpH for live-app pid and asserts loopback only. snapshot raises own window, grabs :97 via ImageGrab, crops to outer geometry, saves native-label.png.

compile_material reads each source, hashes SHA256, derives title, builds search, validates, emits canonical JSON lines plus id-path routes. _derive_ids maps each source to deterministic id: semantic trailing-segment join when fitting MAX_COMPOSITE and ID_PATTERN and unused, else stem[:7]-digest[:12]; collisions/overflows raise.

_build_search emits triggers<=12, keywords<=24, problem_names<=5, tasks<=8, questions<=12 from filename/dir tokens, suffix hints, symbols and doc tokens with test-centric handling. check_mount_freshness verifies SHA digests cover nodes plus catalogue/router/docs shards, mount id set equals node id set, and every mount id resolves in routes lookup.

kitDigest hashes kit tree with sha256-length-framed-tree over sorted entries, skipping KIT_SOURCE.json/node_modules/.git, rejecting symlinks. readPin enforces exact keys commit/contentHash/repo/version with 40-hex commit and 64-hex hash; verifyKit recomputes digest and requires schema capsule-ui-kit-source/v1, algorithm match, and version/hashes equal pin.

syncKit resolves kitRepo to repo top level, requires local to equal repo or packages/capsule-ui-kit, rejects symlink ancestors and source-destination overlap, verifies source, copies to .kit-sync-* staging excluding metadata, writes vendor KIT_SOURCE.json, re-verifies staging and source, then renames dest aside and activates staging.

Data flows root/contracts/v0.3/<name>.schema.json text into json.loads, through Draft202012Validator.check_schema, into a Draft202012Validator instance, then each root/contracts/examples/v0.3/<name>.*.json example is parsed and passed to validator.iter_errors to collect an error list.
Reads OUT/live.json seen pid:start keys, classifies live vs zombie via /proc stat, unions docker-started.jsonl containers, runs docker ps, writes remainingOwnCapsules/Pids/Zombies, asserts all empty.

current_view requires viewport rect to match single visible view-bounds within 2 px in 10 s else NATIVE_BOUNDS_NOT_SETTLED. drag converts client coords with screenX/frame offset, performs xdotool mousedown/move/mouseup with sleeps, then records descendants.

Each node must satisfy ctx.node.v2 schema with active status and source_sha256; validator must return list else fail closed. routes.tsv needs id-path header with canonical unique rows; protocol.json needs exactly one metaviewer mount at catalogue/router; check_targets require lookup: rule plus regular target file.

KitPin contract is {repo,commit,version,contentHash} with exact key set. Record contract is schema capsule-ui-kit-source/v1, algorithm sha256-length-framed-tree, direction vendor for installed trees, plus verified version and contentHash. checkInstalled returns version, contentHash, direction after verifying both pin and tree.

Schemas role_request and role_view_state must pass Draft 2020-12 check_schema; per-example bool(errors)==expected with filename on mismatch. Schemas live at contracts/v0.3/<name>.schema.json, examples at contracts/examples/v0.3/<name>.*.json; .invalid. in name means errors required, else zero errors required.

Ports before/after switches, moves, resizes and keyboard/header sizing must stay equal with overlapping established endpoint and unchanged CLIENT_CONNECTED/CLOSED counts else BRIDGE_LISTENER_CHANGED or PERSISTENT_BRIDGE_CONNECTION_CHANGED; any new listener fails.

Composite len(corpus)+1+len(id) <=32; corpus matches [a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,15}, id matches [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,31}; compile re-enforces width, patterns, uniqueness and canonical paths. Every manifest/SHA/routes/protocol path must be canonical with no symlinks, requiring regular readable files via lstat of ancestors.

Additive-contract invariant: valid examples must stay valid as contracts grow. Filename invariant encodes expectation: containing .invalid. means errors are required, otherwise zero errors are required. Sorted glob order makes the check sequence deterministic.

ui/electron is the Electron main-process host layer that binds privileged renderer IPC to the owner-only Rust core and local devices. authorityWire validates propose, intent, surface-input, settings, terminal, clipboard and capsule IPC and forwards only closed JSON or trusted reader and port capabilities; hostBindings attaches the core unix socket, multiplexes surfaces, input queues, capture, cadence and frame publish; coreLauncher supervises the pinned Rust child and optional adapter with single-flight start and degraded core-only fallback. Frame path uses frameReader for verified rgb24 reads, framePort for brokered MessageChannel delivery, displayReader for 20-30fps DISPLAY rings, captureBridge for metadata-only screenshot, record, export and state, and frameDiag for env-gated diagnostics. bytePlane gives lossless terminal byte accounting with flow control; buttonBridge runs one host-owned demo child; desktopLayout and desktopShortcuts hold presentation-only walls and chord grammar; humanTrace, identityMarkers, identityProtection and keyboardLayout handle redacted traces, login markers, deletion guards and XKB layout. Offers validated surfaces, frames, input, capture, cadence and terminal/display channels. Needs ipcMain, privileged origin, MV_CORE_CONFIG, XDG runtime and config dirs, recording and display grants, and profile stores.

When surface input fails the user sees clicks, keys, typed text or scrolls do nothing. Host logs METAVIEWER_INPUT_REFUSED surface=<id> code=<CODE> count=<n> and renderer gets {ok:false,code}. Stale sequence, rate excess, unknown surface or core refusal all present this way.

When capsule creation fails the renderer gets {ok:false,code,reason,message,tone:refusal} on metaviewer:authority.createSurface plus console error for create refused. User sees closed text such as at most 4 capsules or no free profile, never CLI detail.

When the settings file is missing, oversized or invalid the UI silently keeps mv-light compact defaults. Host warns MetaViewer settings with code and using defaults, and notifies cadence subscribers with defaults so wall and recording cadence stay safe.

User sees demo.start return DEMO_BUSY when a run is active, demo.stop return DEMO_NOT_RECORDING when idle, demo.prompt return DEMO_REFUSED when the demo does not match the sealed demo, or BUTTON_UNAVAILABLE on unexpected failure. CLI detail never reaches the renderer.

During record the first stdout line must be a single-key {url} row with a valid viewer URL; otherwise the run fails and no URL is announced. During prompt the output must contain exactly one text fence or clipboard is untouched. Check and record validate a closing demo schema row.

When the wire violates contiguity, base64, size or lifetime the caller gets PlaneError with a stable code and counter-only message, never payload bytes. The session is closed and onFault fires once with a context copy and code.

Producer sees pause advice once when buffered bytes reach the high watermark and resume advice once when drained to the low watermark or below. Counters never lose bytes; pause and resume callbacks carry no payload.

User sees capture buttons do nothing with {ok:false,code} where code is SURFACE_UNKNOWN, ALREADY_RECORDING, NOT_RECORDING, CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE, NESTED_DISPLAY_ONLY, LIMIT, DESTINATION_UNSET, CAPTURE_UNKNOWN, NOT_SEALED, DESTINATION_UNAVAILABLE, DESTINATION_EXISTS, BUDGET_EXCEEDED or POLICY.

When the core transport throws, the renderer gets {ok:false,code:CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE} instead of an exception. When export has no configured destination it gets DESTINATION_UNSET. Nested walls get NESTED_DISPLAY_ONLY for capture calls.
User sees Degraded mode (CODE): adapter absent or crashed, capsules unavailable, running core-only; detail appends redacted stderr tail with secrets/tokens and control chars stripped.
Refusals surface as CoreLauncherError CODE: message with codes OPTIONS/SPAWN/COMMAND/ARGS/ENV_PATH/SETTINGS_DESTINATION/VERSION_MISMATCH/NOT_LIVE/QUEUE_FULL/REQUEST_TIMEOUT.
User sees frozen tile marked stale after 2s without new capture, or VERIFIED-only static rendering when ring absent; no crash, polling continues.

Tester sees no frame-diag.json when disabled, packaged, or nested, or stale file when throttled to one write per second per session. Disposed report calls fail visibly with FRAME_DIAG_DISPOSED instead of updating snapshot.

User sees frozen or missing tile after TIMEOUT, PORT_REVOKED, or ENDPOINT_RESTART revocation. Superseded frames never paint; only newest is consumed. Refused postings return ok false with reason and detail and send nothing.

User sees frozen or skipped frames: stale replays return STALE_FRAME_GENERATION, overloaded readers return TIMEOUT no-read-slot, closed readers return CLOSED. No pixels are delivered; caller gets {ok:false, reason, detail} and dropped leases fire onReleaseLease.

Corrupt or forged frames produce no image: SIZE_MISMATCH, DIGEST_MISMATCH, LEASE_INVALID or INVALID_CONTRACT. Log or reply carries only frozen reason and short detail like snapshot-length-mismatch, never paths or bytes.

User sees tile that never opens, frozen video, or ignored clicks and typing. Logs show only METAVIEWER_SURFACE_CREATE_SENT or WIRE_REPLY markers and closed codes like CORE_SEAMS_ABSENT, SURFACE_CREATE_BUSY, STALE_STREAM or CORE_UNAVAILABLE. Frames coalesce so older out-of-order arrivals never overwrite newer pending generation.

User sees paused or missing trace: write returns false when paused or over budget, record throws TRACE_LIMIT at cap, prune silently keeps fresh files. Marker misuse surfaces as IDENTITY_MARKER_REFUSED; keyboard failure surfaces as XPRA_KEYMAP_UNAVAILABLE with no layout.

Intent path: non-string arg goes to surface-input handler. String arg must pass wire cap 256 KB JSON parsing and validateIntentBody exact op and params keys plus ID pattern, else INTENT or PAYLOAD is thrown. Core must return true or OUTCOME is thrown.

Surface-input path: validateSurfaceInputBatch returns SCHEMA for bad keys, schema, IDs, coords or key chords, or LIMIT for over 32 events or over 16 KB encoded batch; overlong type text is SCHEMA. Refusal is logged at most once per second per surface and code burst.

Bad channel, wrong arity, wrong key set, wrong schema, bad request_id, bad surface, capture or recording id, bad destination, non-ai mode, or max_fps outside 1 to 60 throws PAYLOAD or ARGS or CHANNEL before the core is touched.

Spawn null, unsafe pid, malformed handle, listener refusal, connect/handshake timeout, bad epoch, EOF/error/exit/close all move to unavailable with reasons like core spawn failed, HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT, bad authority epoch.
Returns RING_ABSENT on ENOENT/ENOTDIR, OPEN_SYMLINK on symlink/ino-dev mismatch, STAT_UID/STAT_MODE on owner/mode, STAT_NOT_FILE on non-file, NOT_TMPFS on statfs miss or non-tmpfs, OPEN_IO otherwise.

Pre-acquire path refuses without touching producer: unknown keys, bad schema, bad path root or pattern, bad surface id, bad generation, bad witnesses or dimensions, bad format or sha256, surface mismatch, null digest, stale generation, over-budget dimensions or bytes.

Input admissibility returns CORE_UNAVAILABLE, SURFACE_UNKNOWN, STALE_STREAM, NOT_IN_CONTROL, SCHEMA for out-of-bounds clicks or unknown kinds, or LIMIT. Each refused batch resolves {ok:false, code} without disposing wire or channels; send timeouts also report CORE_UNAVAILABLE per batch.

Record refuses with TRACE_BINDING_REFUSED on bad ids or write, TRACE_EVENT_REFUSED on unknown kind, TRACE_LIMIT on event cap, TRACE_CLOCK_REFUSED on backward or huge clock, TRACE_GEOMETRY_REFUSED, TRACE_COORDINATE_REFUSED, TRACE_BUTTON_REFUSED, TRACE_KEY_PHASE_REFUSED or TRACE_SCROLL_REFUSED.
addDesktop when 16 desktops or id overflow throws DESKTOP_LIMIT; else appends blank desktop, bumps next, makes it active.

Child output over 65536 bytes fails the run and triggers disposal with the short budget. Non-zero exit, failed flag, bad viewer URL, bad demo schema row, or site, validated or source mismatch also yields public DEMO_REFUSED with no CLI text exposed.

Marker paths require lowercase profile pattern else IDENTITY_MARKER_REFUSED. Read returns null on ENOENT and rethrows other errors. Confirm validates directory owner and 0700 with realpath equality, uses O_EXCL 0600 temp plus rename, and always cleans temp.

installAuthorityWire takes ipcMain, contents, core, env, argv, terminal, clipboard, profiles, capsuleStates, listIdentities, frames, frameDiag and clock, installs handlers for wire plus side-terminal plus clipboard channels, and returns wall and recording fps getters, rate maps, notifyCreateRefusal and dispose.

createMainBindings({env, createMessageChannel, getPeerCredentials, inputDeadlineMs}) validates config, authenticates peer, completes hello, checks socket identity, starts keepalive, and returns {core, wire}. Any acquisition failure throws a closed cause via acquireFail.

createCoreLauncher validates exact option keys, absolute bounded command, NUL-free args, scrubbed env, pid/pgid, killFn/handshake/transport/limits/ownership/callbacks before any spawn; bad options throw CoreLauncherError.
Ctrl+Alt+arrows without Meta/Shift maps to resize narrower/wider/shorter/taller; Ctrl+Tab toggles, Ctrl+1..9 selects desktop N; Ctrl+Alt alone or other combos return null.

Frames flow main-side only. frames.subscribe stages entries by surface_id, drainPendingEntries serializes delivery through deliverAuthorityFrame which reads via reader, posts via port, and emits metaviewer:authority.frames with frame_ref plus projected surface and optional transfer ports.

Frames flow via publish: validate frame_ref, coalesce per surface to max published generation, store frozen latestFrames, then drainSurface per surface to listeners. buildFrameEntry creates a channel, binding, readerOptions with acquirePublishedLease, and portOptions.

Ingest validates context, generation and ledger, checks seq equals lastSeq plus 1, decodes base64 to owned bytes, enforces pending, frame-count and lifetime caps, records cumulative sent offset per seq, appends to the replay tail and may emit pause. Returns a fresh byte copy.

Sender postFrame sends first unacked frame via postMessage frame_delivery/v0.2 with correlation, queues later frames as pending. Receiver admits newest into held slot, consumes via onFrame, posts frame_ack/v0.2, releases lease. Sender ACK clears inFlight and promotes pending.

Intent uses schema ui_intent/v0.2 with ops take_control, release_control, fold, unfold, hide, show, move, tab and float and strict param keys. Proposal uses action_proposal/v0.2 with click, key, type, scroll, wait and lane_submit. Verdict uses action_verdict/v0.2.

RecordStart takes mode ai plus surface_id with optional max_fps; recordStop takes recording_id; export takes capture_id plus destination recording:configured or null plus optional max_fps; screenshot takes surface_id. Core inherits MV_RECORDING_DESTINATION; renderer never supplies a path.

Only closed objects are accepted: exact key sets, plain prototypes, data descriptors and no symbols. Well-formed strings reject lone surrogates. Bounded ID and key token patterns apply. A JSON reviver preserves float versus integer spelling until field validation.

ui/electron is the Electron main-process shell for MetaViewer: window lifecycle, privileged bundle serving, and host-only bridges to Rust core, adapter, PTYs and Xpra capsules. main.js validates retail launch, pins Electron, enforces default-deny navigation/permission, serves app://metaviewer via pinned fd with strict CSP, supervises core/adapter and first-surface create with unwind/dispose. nesting.js is display-only nested viewer depth 1 with read-only layout and settle-gated show; openingMode.js stages exclusive opening-mode records. preload.js and rolePreload.cjs expose frozen metaviewer/metaviewerRoles facades with byte caps and reply validation; main re-admits via observeSender. operatorBridge.js runs mv_identity.py, handoff ack, egress publishing and buttons. roleHost.js manages human/agent surfaces, bindings, Xpra tiles via xpraClient/xpraHumanBridge loopback token bridge. terminalHost.js, ptyBroker.js, ptySession.js and ptyUtility.js implement supervised PTYs with profiles, spawn brake, credit and reaping. profilePicker.js picks Add-capsule profile capped at 4. qaAnchors.js atomically writes qa-anchors.json. smoke.js probes wall settlement. Needs pinned Electron, core/adapter binaries, mv_identity.py, node-pty, Xpra sockets, state/run dirs.

User sees app exit immediately or no window: wrong Electron version logs ELECTRON_PIN, second instance quits with SINGLE_INSTANCE, core not live throws CORE_UNAVAILABLE, adapter not live refuses with dialog text to check MV_SRF_LIVE_PROFILE/RAM_ROOT or unset MV_SRF_BIN_DIR. Renderer sees 403 forbidden or 404 not found in bundle loads.

User sees empty main wall with capsule still creating: first-surface timeout or refusal logs METAVIEWER_SURFACE_CREATE_PENDING then METAVIEWER_SURFACE_CREATE_DEGRADED {code,reason} with SURFACE_CREATE_TIMEOUT/REFUSED/FAILED and keeps window. Renderer ready never logs METAVIEWER_RENDERER_READY if index blocked or ping sender refused with RENDERER_READY.

User sees a second viewer window never appear or vanish immediately; console shows DISPLAY_ONLY startup/wall/sender errors or SINGLE_INSTANCE. Save, settings save, authority and side-terminal actions always fail with persistence/privileged disabled text.

User sees identity list/create/login/delete fail with IDENTITY_PROTECTED, IDENTITY_REFUSED, IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE, IDENTITY_TIMEOUT, or PROFILE_NOT_PROVISIONED; login view never opens or reports LOGIN_URL/LOGIN_VIEW.

User sees handoff list empty or acknowledge fail with HANDOFF_UNAVAILABLE, egress change rejected with NET_OPEN_PREREQ, NET_PROXIED_UNSUPPORTED, or NET_EGRESS_IO; renderer receives {ok:false,code} rather than an exception.

User sees copy/demo buttons do nothing, demo viewer never opens, screenshot/record/export/list report unavailable/busy/not-recording, typed input dropped, identity/egress/handoff actions rejected. Code surfaces typed {ok:false,code} such as DEMO_BUSY, ALREADY_RECORDING, SURFACE_UNKNOWN, LIMIT, IDENTITY_REFUSED.

User sees layout/settings save or load silently fail or promise reject with PAYLOAD/OUTCOME. Happens when text is not a string, multibyte text exceeds 256KiB even with few chars, or main returns non-true/non-string. Renderer keeps old layout; no partial write occurs.

User presses Add capsule and nothing opens; renderer shows At most 4 capsules run at once... or Every configured profile is already in use... or No free profile has an identity yet... or identity list could not be read... Operator sees matching sentence including mv-live-2 hint. No ids/paths leak in copy.

User-visible: new terminal refuses to open with SESSION_LIMIT or CLASS_LIMIT remedy to close a session; rapid retries get SPAWN_BRAKE to wait and retry. Stalled output that never resumes points to missed ack below low-water; truncated replay after reattach reflects plane attach suffix with truncated flag.

User-visible: terminal goes dead and closes after a burst of output with OUTPUT_OVERFLOW error; typing does nothing after close with no error; window resize beyond 500x300 is ignored because receive throws. Empty utility with TERMINAL_UNAVAILABLE message means node-pty failed to load.

Tester sees live run produce no qa-anchors.json or stale anchors: invoke rejected for sender refused, QA_ARGS, QA_PAYLOAD, QA_DISPOSED, or run-dir identity changed during write; log carries MainError code and fixed message, never renderer path.

User sees capsule list missing identities, create button spinning then error code, or black tile that never becomes ready: mount logs METAVIEWER_XPRA_STAGE stage TIMEOUT/ERROR/LOST, tile overlay stays Connecting/Reconnecting, typed code surfaced for Reopen.

User sees terminal tile stuck connecting then closing, typed input echoed as error frame, or open failing with TERMINAL_DISABLED/DISPLAY_ONLY/COMMAND_NOT_ALLOWED; nested windows show DISPLAY_ONLY side-terminal is disabled in nested display.
User sees tile stuck on Connecting/Reconnecting overlay on dark #182330 background, never reaching desktop pixels; writable tile stays read-only or keyboard layout rejected before listener opens.

Retail refusal returns frozen {ok:false,code}: ARGV_SHAPE, RETAIL_FLAG on forbidden inspect/require/no-sandbox flags, RETAIL_ENV on forbidden env or packaged MV_E2E_LIVE/MV_FRAME_DIAG, NESTED_DEPTH on bad/duplicate nesting, UNKNOWN_SWITCH. Condition: dash-led token not in known runtime switches. bootProductionMain throws MainError(code).

Bundle serve never throws: canonicalize failure, pinned root/dev/ino mismatch, asar archive mismatch, bad URL/host/credentials, escape segment, symlink/dir, oversize >8MiB, digest mismatch or HTML without insertion point returns 403 with base CSP; missing file returns 404. Catch-all returns 403.

When MV_SRF_BIN_DIR set and adapter start error, non-live, or handshakeSeen false, boot logs METAVIEWER_BOOT_REFUSED <ADAPTER_* code> with redacted detail and throws ADAPTER_UNAVAILABLE/DEGRADED/START_FAILED before window construction, then unwinds core. Without MV_SRF_BIN_DIR core-only boot continues despite adapter failure.

If process.versions.electron is not ELECTRON_PIN throw 'Electron must be <pin>'. If requestSingleInstanceLock fails throw 'SINGLE_INSTANCE: profile already in use'. If 15000ms race expires throw 'DISPLAY_ONLY: startup deadline exceeded'.

Refusals: foreign id or protected delete rejects IDENTITY_PROTECTED before spawn. Byte cap yields IDENTITY_LIMIT, bad login URL yields LOGIN_URL/VIEW, timeout yields IDENTITY_TIMEOUT, bad shape yields IDENTITY_REPLY, nonzero exit yields refused code or IDENTITY_EXIT.

Condition: wrong channel/arity/type/oversize/invalid reply. Next: sync throw or rejected promise ContractError CHANNEL/ARGS/PAYLOAD/OUTCOME/LIMIT. Logged nowhere here; returned to renderer caller. Main never invoked on ingress failure; renderer must surface the rejection.

Open refusal path: SESSION_LIMIT/CLASS_LIMIT/SPAWN_BRAKE tombstone the id, emit error with fixed remedy from BROKER_REFUSAL_REMEDIES, and commit refused outcome. Bridge open mirrors with UNKNOWN_PROVIDER, DIMS_RANGE, PROFILE_REFUSED, TRANSPORT_FAILED, PLANE_FAILED outcomes carrying version+generation.

Pre-write lstat, O_NOFOLLOW directory open, (dev,ino) pin, realpath outside-root check, target leaf symlink/non-file check, temp device check, and post-write 0600 same-device check can throw QA_RUN_DIR/QA_SYMLINK/QA_WRITE; temp file is unlinked via /proc/self/fd path when safe.

Create guards: SURFACE_CREATE_BUSY single-flight, PROFILE_ALREADY_BOUND, CAPSULE_LIMIT_REACHED via MAX_CAPSULES, NO_IDENTITY when unavailable, IDENTITY_PROTECTED for foreign or mv-/reserved names, PROGRAM_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN when renderer picks profile; on mode-unproven surface it compensates via stopSurface and requires destroyed ack or CAPSULE_STOP_UNPROVEN.

Version mismatch, missing UID, unsettled wall after 10s, or facade check failure throws and exits 1; render-process-gone forces exit 1; 15s deadline timer forces exit 1; preload errors logged via console-message/preload-error handlers.

bootProductionMain(handles) is the production entry on injected handles app, BrowserWindow, ipcMain, protocol, session, core, adapter, bridge, geometry, env, argv, runtime, wire. Validates exact keys, single-instance lock, retail verdict, Electron pin, then registers scheme, resolves paths, starts core/adapter, builds window and bridges.

enterNested(argv,env,display) is the gate: it calls validateRetailLaunch(argv,env), throws on !verdict.ok or !verdict.nested, otherwise runs display(). The packaged bottom block calls it with process.argv/env before app ready.

installOperatorBridge({ipcMain,contents,env,tool,buttonRoot,demoRoot,clipboard,admit,openLogin,...}) installs one ipcMain.handle per OPERATOR_METHODS as metaviewer:<method>, admits senders via admit(event), replies via assertOperatorReply, and starts a 1s refresh timer.

Bundled CJS entry requires electron, snapshots contextBridge/ipcRenderer as data properties, detects nested via --nested-depth=1 and qa/frameDiag flags, then calls createPreloadFacade. ESM import does nothing. After load it sends metaviewer:renderer-ready once unless nested.

Main IPC bridge registerTerminalIpc binds fixed metaviewer:terminal.* channels for open/attach/close/write/resize/ack/capabilities. Each call re-authenticates principal, enforces {owner,value} envelope, refuses exe/cwd/env/argv/path/PATH/channel keys, admits per-op via authority.admit, then dispatches once to child.

Entry is installRoleHost({electron,window,core,env,capsuleStates,admit,...}) registering ipcMain.handle(CHANNEL,handler); handler requires admit(event) and schema metaviewer.roles/v0.3, dispatches choices/surfaces/create/create-program/open/switch/stop/mount/resize/visibility/close/raise/status/confirm-login.

Renderer bytes flow protocol.handle(app)->handleAppRequest(canonicalRoot,request): canonicalize root, check pinned dev/ino/fd, parse raw URL, scan raw segments with decodeSafeSegment, resolve/join, lstat, realpath containment, open descriptor identity, size/digest checks, then Response with Content-Type and CSP, optional per-response style nonce.

Layout IPC flows renderer->ipcMain.handle(load/save)->observeSender admit->arity check->decodeLayoutLoad/Save->entry.decode->entry.invoke reading/writing presentation/layout.json outside source tree. admitBridge enforces exactly two entries mirroring CHANNELS.load/save with {channel,decode,invoke} shape.

Open validates {cols,rows,command[,args|provider]}, resolves targetId to owned profile, creates uuid session with token buckets and attach deadline, sends op open to broker. Attach binds MessagePort, replays pre-attach queue, routes resize/input/ack messages to broker as base64 write ops.

Response CSP is exactly default-src none, script/style/img/font self, connect/frame/object/base none. buildCsp(null) returns base; with 24-byte base64 nonce it extends only style-src with nonce. Malformed nonce throws CSP_NONCE. HTML nonce path requires <head> and rewrites meta policy plus injects metaviewer-style-nonce.

Load accepts only undefined payload returning null; save accepts only bounded UTF8 string <=256KiB that parses as JSON, else LAYOUT_BOUNDS. Storage validates via kit decodeAndMigrateLayoutProfile with scope metaviewer/default/main-wall or desktop validator, refuses inside source tree, enforces owner-only 0700 dir and 0600 temp+rename.

Wire contract: channel metaviewer:qa.anchors carries one qa_anchors/v1 snapshot; seq positive safe integer; rows max 512; rect x,y safe ints with w,h positive ints in CSS px; role matches ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$; whole JSON max 64 KiB.

stageOpeningMode(stateDir,profileId,mode,hostBinary?) requires profileId ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$ and mode human|agent else CAPSULE_MODE_INVALID; hostBinary allowed only for agent, absolute, length<=256. Foreign profileId throws IDENTITY_PROTECTED.
Channel constant is metaviewer:roles.v0.3; focus event channel is metaviewer:role-focus.v0.3 with string id payload; facade is Object.freeze with fixed method set, no raw IPC handle leaked.

User sees wrong symbols, dead keys doubled, or AltGr doing nothing. Happens here because patch bypasses browser IME and sends raw key-action with capsule keycode; bad table sends wrong code or drops the key.

render-process-gone gives XPRA_VIEW_CRASHED, unresponsive gives XPRA_VIEW_UNRESPONSIVE, recorder throw gives XPRA_TRACE_FAILED; each calls fail(), removes failed contents so parent typed error and Reopen show, host closes bridge, never quits app.
Condition: no DISPLAY, xkbcomp error/timeout, or missing sentinel. Next: promise rejects XPRA_KEYMAP_UNAVAILABLE. Receiver: main-process caller; no keycodes returned.
Condition: bad layout, bad code name, or keycode outside 8..255 throws XPRA_KEYMAP_INVALID; missing _make_hello/_keyb_process in client throws XPRA_KEYMAP_UNSUPPORTED at runtime.
Condition: probe throws or returns false, or reconnect rejects. Next: onState reconnecting, then later(retry, xpraRetryDelay(attempt++)). Attempt resets to 0 only on success.

Entry createXpraHumanSession({role,setReadonly,openBridge,showView,closeTrace}) requires role human|agent and four functions or XPRA_CAPABILITIES_ABSENT; returns frozen {role,active,open,resize,bringToFront,setVisible,close}.

Entry attachXpraHumanTile({electron,window,bridge,bounds,trace,isActive,capsuleSize,...}) requires isActive() true at call, capsuleSize function and onFailure or XPRA_HUMAN_LEASE_ABSENT; creates isolated partition xpra-human-uuid with xpraTracePreload.
physicalXkbKeycodes(source) parses xkbcomp text with /<NAME> = NUMBER;/ and returns Record<code,number>; throws XPRA_KEYMAP_UNAVAILABLE when required sentinels are missing or out of range.
rawKeyboardPatch({layout,keycodes}) validates layout /^[a-z0-9_-]{1,32}$/ and each code/name range, then returns JS source that must run after Client.js and before its hello.

Session open: check lease -> setReadonly(role==agent) must return true -> openBridge -> showView(bridge,recoverBridge) -> tile. Tile: addChildView -> loadURL origin/metaviewer-tile.html+query -> waitForXpraClient -> publish ready -> focus if writable; recovery reloads via fresh bridge origin.
Control flows DISPLAY env -> xkbcomp stdout -> physicalXkbKeycodes -> keycodes record -> JSON-embedded into patched script -> XpraClient.prototype._make_hello sends xkbmap_layout/xkbmap_raw.
DOM KeyboardEvent/MouseEvent/WheelEvent -> {width,height,kind,key|phase|x,y,button|dx,deltaMode} -> ipcRenderer.send metaviewer:human-trace.v0.3. Same-origin child frame only.

Sandbox contract: sandbox/contextIsolation/no node, webSecurity, deny window.open/webview, will-navigate and will-redirect blocked outside origin, all_urls requests cancelled unless active and localURL, auth headers injected, permissions denied, downloads prevented, shortcuts passed to guest via interceptDesktopShortcut.

positions is positional, never character mapping: Digit/Key/F/Numpad rows are synthesized; physicalXkbKeycodes keeps only entries present in xkbcomp and requires KeyA, Digit2, Quote, IntlBackslash, AltRight, ShiftLeft in 8..255.

Geometry fixed: capsuleSize must return 1280x900 or XPRA_FIXED_SIZE_REQUIRED; resize rect must be safe-int x,y,width,height with positive size or XPRA_BOUNDS_REFUSED; zoom forced to 1; clientQuery must match ^?[A-Za-z0-9_=&.-]+$ or XPRA_QUERY_REFUSED.
Redact before IPC: only navigation set members keep their key name, all other keys send null; main recorder must redact again against capsule AX state.
One flight per tile: stopped flag plus isActive gate every callback; later() only schedules when active; stop() freezes object, sets stopped, clears timer.
Immutable role lifetime for one human/agent view: sequences setReadonly->openBridge->showView with revocation, single-flight open/recover/close, and aggregated cleanup of tile, bridge and trace.

Native role view: separate sandboxed WebContentsView hosting authenticated Xpra tile, enforcing lease/geometry, recording trace, recovering bridge, and revoking view on crash, unresponsiveness or trace fatal.
xpraRecovery.js provides one host-owned retry/monitor flight per tile that probes health every 250ms and reconnects with backoff while the role lease stays authorized.
xpraTracePreload.cjs is a capability-less Electron preload observing key/mouse/wheel in the xpra view and forwarding redacted human-trace events over ipcRenderer.

Flags revoked/opening/recovering/cleaning/closing/traceClosed; check throws XPRA_SESSION_CLOSED when revoked. Recover reuses healthy bridge else closes and opens replacement, closing replacement if revoked mid-flight. Cleanup closes tile, bridge, trace once, AggregateError as XPRA_CLOSE_FAILED.

Tile states connecting->ready->reconnecting->lost via onState; overlay hidden only when ready. Fail latches failed, stops recovery, deactivates trace, closes view then calls onFailure; live() false after detached/failed/lease lost.
States: monitoring (250ms probe) -> reconnecting -> ready. Healthy probe reschedules monitor; failed probe emits reconnecting then retries; successful reconnect emits ready and resumes monitor.

Open, recover and close are single-flight via cached promises reset on settle; parallel roleHost timer and tile recovery probe (2s bounded evaluation race) both gate on isActive/live so stale epochs cannot publish state or trace.
Mousemove events are throttled to one per 16ms via lastMove and performance.now; key/mouse/wheel listeners are passive capture on window and iframe document, never blocking.

Close is idempotent: stops recovery, deactivates trace, removes human-trace listener, removes child view, closes contents, clears request hooks and storage data; readonly views additionally preventDefault all input and mouse events.
xkbcomp child limited to 3s and 262144 bytes; recovery backoff is 500/1000/2000/4000 then 5000ms, plus fixed 250ms monitor cadence; preload holds only a Set and a timestamp.

Depends on xpraClient query/ready/wait, xpraRecovery createXpraRecovery, desktopShortcuts interceptDesktopShortcut, humanTrace recorder with record/setActive, isolated session partition per tile with cache false.
Depends on node:child_process execFile, system xkbcomp binary, Electron ipcRenderer, shipped XpraClient globals, and DOM frame with id metaviewer-xpra-client.

Trace IPC accepted only from tile wc mainFrame with URL under current origin; stale origin after bridge replacement would fail localURL and cancel requests; writable false enforces OS plus DOM defense in depth for readonly watch.
Patch monkey-patches XpraClient.prototype and installs capture input listener calling stopImmediatePropagation, which silences browser IME for dead keys; failure leaves keyboard unusable.
Only config is env.DISPLAY selecting the app display whose public XKB metadata is read; absent DISPLAY means unavailable, never a fallback display.

.github/workflows provides hermetic CI primitives and fail-closed policy gates for mv packaging. install_electron.cjs pins Electron 44.9.2 via checksums and installs/verifies it; laws_range.py selects base..tip diff range for pull_request/push using merge-base with origin/main and fails closed on ZERO/empty; offline.sh executes commands with no network via unshare with only loopback plus offline tool flags; workflow_pins.py enforces pinned owner/repo@40-hex uses and safe local actions; test_laws_range.py covers range selection and negative mutation controls; test_package_regressions.py guards admission matrix, gate order, receipts, and token sanitizers by parsing YAML and executing extracted shell. Interaction: regression suite calls workflow_pins.pin_errors and runs extracted gate/sanitize functions; laws_range output feeds law checks; offline.sh wraps npm ci; install gates package. Offers deterministic install, range, isolation, and admission checks. Needs node, xvfb-run, electron artifacts, git, unshare/ip, PyYAML/bash, and repo root.
Tester sees CI fail at Prime verified Electron with AssertionError: pinned archive checksum absent or installed Electron version differs, so no package artifact is built.
User sees offline: command required, offline: non-root caller required, or namespace setup error and the build/test command does not run at all.
Tester sees unittest AssertionError naming the dropped prerequisite, conditional gate, wrong runner, or missing env var when a workflow edit weakens admission or handoff.
If redaction regresses, test shows raw token bytes instead of [REDACTED]; if over-redaction occurs, benign log diff shows ghosts_of_tokens prose altered.
User sees workflow admission fail with messages like unpinned action: ..., duplicate key: ..., or missing local action metadata, blocking the run instead of executing an unpinned step.
If any pin assert fails (version drift, missing integrity, absent checksum), assert throws and install aborts before exec. Caller sees AssertionError naming the mismatched field.

If binary ui/node_modules/electron/dist/electron is not executable, accessSync throws. If version lines differ, deepEqual throws installed Electron version differs. Install exec timeouts are 240s and 30s.
With no args prints offline: command required exit 2; if run as root prints offline: non-root caller required exit 2; if unshare or ip link set lo up fails, the wrapped command never executes.
Missing main causes merge-base CalledProcessError to propagate, so CI does not scan all history. __main__ catches ValueError and CalledProcessError, prints laws range: <exc> on stderr, exits 1.

Empty base or tip raises ValueError instead of returning ..tip or base... Test also executes an in-memory mutated copy weakening the guard and asserts it returns degenerate ranges, proving the guard is load-bearing.
