Each mutant (gated always, conditional prime step, fork check true, single runner, dropped CARGO_TARGET_DIR, go-version literal, removed fetch, true build, arm64-only verify, true smoke) must raise AssertionError.
Handoff mutants (single runner, true instead of identity --build, needs.package.result, duplicate receipt key, single arch, hardcoded check success) must raise AssertionError.

Gate stub replaces build block with exit rc; for each arch and rc 0/7 it asserts process rc equals stub rc and receipt schema gate_receipt/v1, argv bootstrap/package/verification, rc, PASS/FAIL, scope.platform.
Shim replaces offline.sh and records calls; valid run must call bootstrap, --verify-install, --smoke in order with rc 0 and PASS. Five bad modes must exit nonzero with FAIL or BLOCKED.
Unsupported arch yields BLOCKED, rc None, counts.source unexecuted; missing or relative CARGO_TARGET_DIR skips calls entirely; failed setup and missing smoke marker yield FAIL.
On YAML parse error returns [invalid YAML: ...]; on None document returns [empty workflow]. Callers treat nonempty list as fail-closed admission failure.
Bad refs append unpinned action, missing/ambiguous/unsafe/cyclic/invalid local action metadata, non-string key, duplicate key, merge-key, or uses-must-be-string errors; walk continues to collect all.
Entry install(ui, exec=execFileSync); direct run calls install(path ui directory). Caller supplies ui root; exec injectable for tests. Exports install and validatePins.
Entry select_range(event, before, head, pr_base, pr_head) plus __main__ reading EVENT_NAME, BEFORE, HEAD, PR_BASE, PR_HEAD from environment and printing revision or empty string.
Entry bash offline.sh <command> [args...]; requires at least one arg and non-root caller (id -u != 0). Exec replaces shell with unshare plus inner bash.
Entry pin_errors(text, root) composes YAML with SafeLoader and walks nodes; __main__ reads stdin text plus argv root and prints JSON error list.

validatePins reads ui/package.json dependencies.electron, ui/package-lock.json packages node_modules/electron version and integrity, installed package.json version, and checksums.json archive entry electron-v44.9.2-linux-arch.zip.

install scrubs electron_ and npm_config_electron/platform/arch env keys, runs node install.js with clean env, then xvfb-run electron --version; select_range maps event inputs to base and tip strings joined as base..tip.
sanitize extracts sanitize() shell function via regex, writes payload to temp raw file, runs bash sanitize raw sane in ROOT, and returns sane bytes; returncode must be 0.
Input workflow text plus repo root path; output list of strings. Local ./ refs resolve against root and recurse into action.yml/yaml; remote refs checked against PIN regex and path-part rules.

PIN is 44.9.2. package.json dep, lock version, and installed version must equal it; lock integrity must exist; checksums[archive] must match 64 lowercase hex; version output must deep-equal exactly [v44.9.2].

ZERO is 40 zeros. push with empty or ZERO before resolves base via git merge-base origin/main tip. pull_request uses pr_base/pr_head. Other events return None. Empty or ZERO endpoints raise ValueError.
Admission contract: workflow_pins.pin_errors empty; linux-package matrix exactly x64 on ubuntu-24.04 plus arm64 on ubuntu-24.04-arm; >=11 steps; no if on prerequisites; gate last with if always().

Header contract: job condition excludes fork PRs, fail-fast false, runs-on matrix.runner, timeout 25, pinned go file, rustup 1.97.0, cargo fetch --locked, npm ci, offline.sh npm ci, install_electron.cjs, and fixed env vars.

Gate order contract: PLATFORM must be arm64 or x64; offline bootstrap, then --verify-install MetaViewer-linux-$PLATFORM, then --smoke .tar, with METAVIEWER_MAIN_SMOKE_OK present and build<verify<smoke ordering.

Local handoff contract: ci.yml package and ci-required jobs carry matrix runner/platform, go file, cargo fetch, CARGO_TARGET_DIR, CAPSULE_UI_KIT_REPO, install_electron, and test_package_identity.py --build; no upload/download-artifact.

Receipt handoff: package writes receipt_<arch> via output.write receipt_ + PLATFORM, required consumes needs.package.outputs.receipt_<arch>; ci-required orders --build before --distribution and checks job.status.
Sanitizer contract: every sanitize() in ci.yml maps ghp/ghs/gho/ghu/ghr/github_pat plus _, %5F, %5f spellings to [REDACTED], while ghosts_of_tokens prose with short fragments stays unchanged.

For package.yml and build-other.yml, families ghp/ghs/gho/ghu/ghr/github_pat/AKIA/xoxb- in raw, upper, %5F, %5f spellings sanitize to [REDACTED]; benign log with ghosts_of_tokens stays byte-identical.
PIN regex owner/repo@40-hex; ref path before @ split by / must contain no empty, . or .. parts. Fullmatch required; uppercase hex and short SHAs are rejected.
YAML rules: empty workflow errors; non-string keys error except boolean on resolving to on; duplicate keys error; merge key << not admitted; uses value must be a plain string.

Local action contract: target must stay under root, exactly one of action.yml/yaml must exist, resolved metadata must be a file under root, cycles report local action cycle, invalid content reports invalid metadata.

mv root is the offline-first MetaViewer capsule platform: deterministic core authority with hash-chained journals, privileged daemon adapter for native surfaces, agent toolkit for observe-plan-propose-verify loops, desktop frontend, offline build and judging automation, hermetic workflow gates, and release-gate operator tooling. Parts are core source with admission state machine, journal recovery, frame publication and receipt verification, serve and supervisor and transport and wire layers plus daemon and replay binaries; daemon adapter with capsule lifecycle and input and capture handling, frame rings, frozen IPC, bounded recordings and views; agent package with closed contract schemas and envelope framing, core and tool clients, observe and propose and wait-verify verbs, executor and planners, perception adapters, trial loops, bridge and command interfaces, and MemoryWeb home and handoff and replay and export helpers; interface layer with build config, main-process lifecycle and authority wiring and frame plumbing, renderer wall and tiles and input and recording views, and packaging with sealing and smoke checks; scripts for bootstrap and volume runs and judge install and run and stop plus readiness preflight; workflows for install pinning and revision range selection and offline execution and pin admission plus regression suites; tools for gate orchestration and law and contract and theme and changelog and budget checks plus live AI gate and MemoryWeb runners and isolated fixtures and router coverage and kit sync. Interaction flows from frontend and daemon frame publication through core admission to agent proposal and verified receipt, with journals anchoring replay and export, while bootstrap and volume and judge and gate layers enforce pinned dependencies, isolation, and receipts before packaging. Offers validated surfaces and frames and input handling, admitted and refused verdicts with receipts, replay and export bundles, hermetic builds and policy gates, and operator receipts. Needs recent Node and pinned Electron artifacts and Rust and Go toolchains, Linux display and shared memory and owner-only sockets, pinned kit checkouts and asset hashes, container tooling for higher tiers, and strict environment and directory and identity hygiene.
Tester sees CI fail at Prime verified Electron with AssertionError: pinned archive checksum absent or installed Electron version differs, so no package artifact is built.
User sees offline: command required, offline: non-root caller required, or namespace setup error and the build/test command does not run at all.
User sees workflow admission fail with messages like unpinned action: ..., duplicate key: ..., or missing local action metadata, blocking the run instead of executing an unpinned step.

A tester adding a harmless extra field to any request, param, payload, bbox or geometry object sees the whole message rejected with nothing applied: closed objects mean unknown keys fail validation. The rejection surfaces as the mv_tool_result error arm: status error with code PROTOCOL, UNAVAILABLE, NOT_FOUND or VERIFICATION_FAILED plus detail up to 4096 chars.

An agent that calls wait_verify and hits the deadline gets back only schema, request_id, op wait_verify, status timeout, proposal_id and verified false. There is no receipt, no frame hash and no error text, so the caller knows nothing was verified but cannot tell what, if anything, executed.
User sees tool call hang then timeout or immediate connection failed, socket not owner-only, foreign peer, sequence invalid, or uncorrelated tool result; ClientError code names the class.
User sees message dropped or send rejected with frame exceeds cap, blank/multiline, invalid JSON/UTF-8, or body violates contract; no partial effect occurs.
User sees daemon exit 2 with metaviewer-core: message on stderr and no socket. Causes: missing env, unreadable config, version pin mismatch, uid validation failure, bind failure.

User sees the picture never update after publishing: an old or zero generation, zero size, bad hash, or missing witness silently becomes a journalled refusal instead of a new frame. Logs/Outcome show StaleFrame, SurfaceNotAgentControlled, or Policy.

User sees action marked unverified with missing, invalid or unmatched witness though executor claimed success. Caused by absent pixel change, wrong element state, tick/state hash mismatch, or stale frame binding.

User sees Holdings observation rejected: input produces no GroundTruth, downstream proof omitted, caller gets malformed_cli with detail like invalid holdings tick or CLI output is not a bounded closed JSON object.
Operator sees startup error text on stderr and process exit 2 when RuntimeFromEnv fails; otherwise exit code comes from daemon.Run and signal handling just cancels context.
User sees capture/input refused with input must be drained before capture/destroy, fresh frame and unused permit required, or unverified receipt/frame identity time mismatch after native clock skew.
User sees immediate shell error naming the missing variable, or 'Set MV_ELECTRON_ZIP_DIR...' message, or node test failures, with no package produced. No log file is written.
User sees E2E_PREREQ:... on stderr for offline violations, BLOCKED:... for missing harness, or per-iteration volume-e2e i/N PASS on stdout. prepare-only exits 0 after staging.
Tester sees JUDGE_PREFLIGHT_OK tier/phase on success, or stderr JUDGE_<CODE>: ... -- fix: ... lines plus JUDGE_PREFLIGHT_FAIL count, and JUDGE_NOTE/JUDGE_OS warnings that do not fail.

User sees one line per leg PASS <leg> or FAIL <leg> or BLOCKED <leg> plus final PASS/FAIL aggregate. Failures add diagnostics on stderr: metadata drift, pin drift, stale lock, frozen offline resolution failed, child rc, missing tool/target, marker=False, SKIPPED reason.

User sees no DONE receipt: stdout is a BLOCKED receipt with rc 5 and error code such as assertion_failed, negative_control_accepted, wender_subprocess_failed, vision_subprocess_failed, no_actionable_target, or cleanup proof missing, plus detail text.

User sees app exit immediately or no window: wrong Electron version logs ELECTRON_PIN, second instance quits with SINGLE_INSTANCE, core not live throws CORE_UNAVAILABLE, adapter not live refuses with dialog text to check MV_SRF_LIVE_PROFILE/RAM_ROOT or unset MV_SRF_BIN_DIR. Renderer sees 403 forbidden or 404 not found in bundle loads.

When surface input fails the user sees clicks, keys, typed text or scrolls do nothing. Host logs METAVIEWER_INPUT_REFUSED surface=<id> code=<CODE> count=<n> and renderer gets {ok:false,code}. Stale sequence, rate excess, unknown surface or core refusal all present this way.

User sees app quit at once with no window. Terminal shows PKG_CORE_START_FAILED, PKG_SEAL_MISMATCH key, PKG_HOST_RUNTIME_UNSAFE, SINGLE_INSTANCE already running, or METAVIEWER_BOOT_REFUSED RAM_ROOT_ABSENT with mkdir -p -m 700 fix.
Missing main causes merge-base CalledProcessError to propagate, so CI does not scan all history. __main__ catches ValueError and CalledProcessError, prints laws range: <exc> on stderr, exits 1.
Bad refs append unpinned action, missing/ambiguous/unsafe/cyclic/invalid local action metadata, non-string key, duplicate key, merge-key, or uses-must-be-string errors; walk continues to collect all.
Non-700 owner dir, symlink, non-socket node, wrong mode/uid, missing SO_PEERCRED, or foreign uid raises socket error before connect or first write; fails closed.

Scroll dx/dy outside i32 returns OutOfBounds before reservation and at dispatch. Click outside frame, wait/scroll unsupported types, bad bbox, min_tick>max_tick, bad lane verb/nonce/seq, over-budget ms all map to OutOfBounds/Policy/BudgetExceeded as coded.

Any inline/background fsync failure latches poisoned/sync_failed; next append/retain/commit/flush returns Poisoned, clears surface caches, aborts batches, persists worker sticky_err; witness sync failure blocks retry and only recovery clears it.
Any peer/framing/ValidateEnvelope/version/Authenticate/Reserve/handler/Wrap/Write failure logs adapter: connection refused and drops that connection without reply.
If MV_PKG_OUT unset/empty, shell exits non-zero with 'Set an external build output directory'. Same pattern for CAPSULE_UI_KIT_REPO with 'Set the pinned kit checkout'.

If a required target file/dir is absent, leaf() prints missing target: <name> and returns 2 (BLOCKED) for manifests/laws/contracts/unit/js/rust/go/ui-smoke/ui/perf, except agents absence returns 1 (FAIL). Child nonzero prints <leg>: child rc=<rc>.

Retail refusal returns frozen {ok:false,code}: ARGV_SHAPE, RETAIL_FLAG on forbidden inspect/require/no-sandbox flags, RETAIL_ENV on forbidden env or packaged MV_E2E_LIVE/MV_FRAME_DIAG, NESTED_DEPTH on bad/duplicate nesting, UNKNOWN_SWITCH. Condition: dash-led token not in known runtime switches. bootProductionMain throws MainError(code).

decode(raw,peer,session,epoch,received_ns) is closed entry for proposals. Decodes envelope, maps OutOfBounds, rejects unless from==peer, session matches, to Core, body ActionProposal. Stores raw for replay re-decode.

run_trials(client_factory,planner,trials,min_verified,timeout_ms,surface_id,perception_adapter,goal,kind) is the main entry; it validates callables and bounds then loops trial 1..trials with proposal_id trial-N without retrying a refused or failed proposal inside a trial.

installAuthorityWire takes ipcMain, contents, core, env, argv, terminal, clipboard, profiles, capsuleStates, listIdentities, frames, frameDiag and clock, installs handlers for wire plus side-terminal plus clipboard channels, and returns wall and recording fps getters, rate maps, notifyCreateRefusal and dispose.
Control: raw str -> size check -> preflight -> serde_json Value -> integer rails -> version probe -> typed Envelope -> schema valid + terminal_lengths. No I/O inside.

PIN is 44.9.2. package.json dep, lock version, and installed version must equal it; lock integrity must exist; checksums[archive] must match 64 lowercase hex; version output must deep-equal exactly [v44.9.2].

Receipt contract: schema action_receipt/v0.2, verified True, empty error string, method in pixel,element,state_sha256; native_evidence when present must correlate surface_id, input_mono_ns, and focus_verified True.
Every object sets additionalProperties False and maxProperties 256; every id/string has minLength/maxLength bounds and id patterns safe-token; hashes must match 64 lowercase hex.

agents/metaviewer_agents is the agent-side MetaViewer v0.2 toolkit: frozen contract schemas, bounded transport, and closed observe-plan-propose-verify loop plus MemoryWeb replay and export. _contracts_v02.py embeds v0.2 JSON schemas; envelope.py validates and encodes NDJSON envelope/v0.2; client.py provides CoreClient bounded mailbox and ToolClient hello/sequence/request; tools.py implements observe/list/propose/wait_verify/record verbs; observe.py/verify.py/vision.py build and check observations and run single-shot loop; executor.py executes admitted actions with custody checks; planner.py and wender_bridge.py plan Holdings and element-table clicks via subprocess; perception/ supplies fake/vcore/meta_muse adapters with deps_lock pinned roots; loop_trials.py runs N trials to canonical report; mcp_server.py bridges stdio MCP; mvctl.py is CLI; export.py builds validated mw.run_bundle.v1 stripping PII; mw_home.py/mw_handoff.py/mw_owner.py/mw_run.py handle home admission, stop latch, custodied replay and wall deadline. Flow is observe-perceive-plan-propose-admit-execute-wait_verify-export, all gated by closed-shape validation, seq/nonce correlation, and verified receipts. Offers validated messaging, planning, perception, replay, export. Needs core socket, sequence file, frame_ref dims/sha, RGB24, transports/credentials, locked checkouts, /dev/shm.

A tester adding a harmless extra field to any request, param, payload, bbox or geometry object sees the whole message rejected with nothing applied: closed objects mean unknown keys fail validation. The rejection surfaces as the mv_tool_result error arm: status error with code PROTOCOL, UNAVAILABLE, NOT_FOUND or VERIFICATION_FAILED plus detail up to 4096 chars.

An agent that calls wait_verify and hits the deadline gets back only schema, request_id, op wait_verify, status timeout, proposal_id and verified false. There is no receipt, no frame hash and no error text, so the caller knows nothing was verified but cannot tell what, if anything, executed.

A recording that drops frames under ring pressure shows dropped events carrying dropped_frames (at least 1) and policy ram_ring_oldest. The final stopped totals for frame_count and byte_count then fall short of the frames the tester saw captured, with the gap explained only by those dropped events.

A capture or record action that visibly does nothing is reported as a refused record_event: reason_code STALE_FRAME, SURFACE_NOT_AGENT_CONTROLLED, LOCKED_BY_OTHER, BUDGET_EXCEEDED, OUT_OF_BOUNDS or POLICY plus free-text detail. The user sees no frame and no file; the reason_code is the only diagnosis.
User sees terminal write stall, resync loop, or layout button doing nothing when sender omits generation/seq or uses illegal id; logs show schema validation refusal.
User sees tool call hang then timeout or immediate connection failed, socket not owner-only, foreign peer, sequence invalid, or uncorrelated tool result; ClientError code names the class.
User sees message dropped or send rejected with frame exceeds cap, blank/multiline, invalid JSON/UTF-8, or body violates contract; no partial effect occurs.
User sees click not performed with refused_focus, generation_control, or POLICY binding message; bad click rectangle shows alignment or custody error.
User sees observation rejected before any copy when hostile nesting, bad UTF-8, wrong keys, out-of-frame box or trusted surface and generation mismatch occurs.

User sees either result JSON on stdout, or refuse verdict on stdout for core refusal and unverified receipt, or one-line refuse record on stderr with empty stdout when local validation, endpoint, transport, or version checks fail.
Operator sees a run stop only on login_wall or captcha_wall markers or detector stop; otherwise the latch stays silent and the run continues with no handoff file written.
User sees run stop with HUMAN_HANDOFF and MW_HANDOFF_REQUIRED when capsule handoff latch inspects true; no further send or target work proceeds.
User sees run exceeded wall deadline message, rc 6, and report.json directing inspection of core and capsule responsiveness before retrying.
Tester using fake provider always sees summary 'fake perception: no change' with no regions or elements, because FakePerceptionAdapter is deterministic stdlib-only and never detects change.

User-visible failure is a ValueError/PerceptionError with text like Frame width and height must be positive, Frame data length N != M, frame_ref width malformed, vision summary malformed, changed_regions malformed.

User sees startup refusal naming the env var or commit: VQA_VE_ROOT is required, dependency root is not a directory, name at <actual> expected <pinned>, or name differs from pinned tree; no private package is imported.

User sees describe-frame failure as PerceptionError like muse transport failed: TimeoutError, muse response exceeds line bound, muse response is not strict JSON, unknown muse response version, or pixels disagree with frame_ref.

User sees no table or stale elements: PerceptionError bad_shape, unknown_version, identity_mismatch, STALE_FRAME, unavailable, BUDGET_EXCEEDED, timeout, commit_mismatch, dirty_tree. Texts include C2 digest disagrees with input frame, vserve closed stdout, queue capacity exhausted, PNG dimensions disagree, ramws bytes disagree.

A request naming an op outside the listed const set matches no oneOf arm and is rejected before anything runs. surface_request accepts exactly create, list, destroy, frame_subscribe, frame_unsubscribe, input, record_start, record_stop, take_control, release_control. record_request accepts ram_start, ram_stop, disk_start, disk_stop, screenshot.
Outbound validate/dumps failure maps unknown_version, length, bad_shape, schema without consuming sequence; socket stays usable for validation failures only.
Oversized line, decode failure, EOF with partial bytes, peer close, or monotonic deadline expiry terminates client with length, schema, socket, or timeout codes.
Non-700 owner dir, symlink, non-socket node, wrong mode/uid, missing SO_PEERCRED, or foreign uid raises socket error before connect or first write; fails closed.
Duplicate object keys, Infinity/NaN literals, trailing values, blank or multiline frames, bad UTF-8, unmatched containers, or nesting over 32 refused as bad_shape.
Custody mismatch raises ValueError target custody; Stop/Detener click raises SurfaceRefused generation_control; out-of-bounds or malformed box raises SurfaceError alignment.

ToolRefusal appends refused with exc.reason_code; VerificationFailed maps receipt status timeout to timeout/TIMEOUT else unverified with receipt code; bare TimeoutError maps to timeout/TIMEOUT; Observation/SurfaceError maps to refused; ToolValidation/ValueError maps to unverified.

Local shape/version/correlation failure raises ToolValidationError and nothing was admitted; message is like invalid proposal or uncorrelated surface_id. Transport failures including TimeoutError propagate unchanged.

check_home with is_tracked predicate raising on indeterminate status refuses tracked homes MW_HOME_TRACKED, .git as MW_HOME_NESTED_REPO, profile names and leveldb-style dirs as MW_HOME_PROFILE, over-capacity, depth, size, sqlite headers, non-regular types.

All control and data enter as schema-tagged dicts: each message carries a schema const such as surface_request/v0.2 or record_event/v0.2 plus a request_id of 1..128 chars matching safe-token pattern. request_id is the correlation key joining a request to its events and its tool result.
Entry via CoreClient.connect for transport-only use or handshake/hello exchange; ToolClient.__enter__ does endpoint check, sequence-file lock, connect, reserve, then hello call.
Entry via validate_envelope for dicts, make_envelope to build, dumps_envelope to encode one LF line, loads_envelope to decode one LF/CRLF line.

run_trials(client_factory,planner,trials,min_verified,timeout_ms,surface_id,perception_adapter,goal,kind) is the main entry; it validates callables and bounds then loops trial 1..trials with proposal_id trial-N without retrying a refused or failed proposal inside a trial.

propose(proposal) locally validates action_proposal/v0.2 then sends op propose; on admitted returns the verdict copy after proposal_id correlation. Admission is not completion; refusals raise ToolRefusal with no retry.

plan_step(observation,element_table,goal) is main entry. Validates observation frame_ref, element_table schema vqa.element-table/v1 and frame match, goal string, then spawns planner, validates response, custody checks target, returns action,expectation,state,target.

envelope wraps any body via oneOf ref to surface, frame_ref, observation, action_proposal, action_verdict, action_receipt, hello, capsule_meta, ui_intent, catalog_entry, terminal_session, record_request, record_event, settings, mv_tool_call, mv_tool_result, session_record with from/to, session_id, seq, nonce.

Journal flow starts from GENESIS_PREV_SHA256 (64 zeros), each session_record links prev_sha256 to prior canonical hash; verifier recomputes canonical_sha256 per record and outputs tail as journal_head_sha256.

action variants are click with x,y,button left/middle/right; key with keys array 1..4096; type with text; scroll with dx,dy; wait with ms 1..3600000; lane_submit with verb and payload nonce/seq/command/args.

Receipt contract: schema action_receipt/v0.2, verified True, empty error string, method in pixel,element,state_sha256; native_evidence when present must correlate surface_id, input_mono_ns, and focus_verified True.

Expectation contract: changed_region bbox ints with w,h 1-16384; element_state role/name/state strings; state_sha256_change before hex digest plus non-inverted min/max_tick; text_present non-empty text.
Every object sets additionalProperties False and maxProperties 256; every id/string has minLength/maxLength bounds and id patterns safe-token; hashes must match 64 lowercase hex.
Envelope seq must equal next_seq, incremented only after successful sendall; sender identity tuple is pinned on first send and any change raises schema error.
Tester using fake provider always sees summary 'fake perception: no change' with no regions or elements, because FakePerceptionAdapter is deterministic stdlib-only and never detects change.

User-visible failure is a ValueError/PerceptionError with text like Frame width and height must be positive, Frame data length N != M, frame_ref width malformed, vision summary malformed, changed_regions malformed.

User sees startup refusal naming the env var or commit: VQA_VE_ROOT is required, dependency root is not a directory, name at <actual> expected <pinned>, or name differs from pinned tree; no private package is imported.

User sees describe-frame failure as PerceptionError like muse transport failed: TimeoutError, muse response exceeds line bound, muse response is not strict JSON, unknown muse response version, or pixels disagree with frame_ref.

User sees no table or stale elements: PerceptionError bad_shape, unknown_version, identity_mismatch, STALE_FRAME, unavailable, BUDGET_EXCEEDED, timeout, commit_mismatch, dirty_tree. Texts include C2 digest disagrees with input frame, vserve closed stdout, queue capacity exhausted, PNG dimensions disagree, ramws bytes disagree.

If vision is not dict, summary not str or >4096 chars, regions/elements not lists or >4096 entries, or element name >65536 chars, check_vision raises bad_shape. Observe failures re-raise as PerceptionError preserving code.
If register name is empty/non-str or factory not callable, raises bad_shape provider name malformed / factory is not callable.
If env var missing/blank or root not a directory, raises unavailable. If git HEAD != locked commit or wheel commit != locked commit, raises commit_mismatch with actual vs expected.

If tracked bytes/modes differ, suppressed index flags (lowercase or S), tracked modifications, symlinked dirs, non-regular files, or unrecorded payloads appear, raises dirty_tree differing from pinned tree/wheel tree.

Git inspection failures (spawn error, non-zero exit) raise unavailable cannot inspect dependency checkout; environment strips GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE, Python settings, credentials, user/global config with 2.0s timeout.
Malformed lock, I/O, duplicate keys, non-unique components, short SHAs, or unknown name raise bad_lockfile invalid dependency lock.
If credential None, raises unavailable muse credential not configured. Transport exceptions collapse to unavailable muse transport failed: <TypeName> so messages never echo credential material.
If bound pixels sha256 != frame_ref sha256, raises identity_mismatch pixels disagree with frame_ref. Frame __post_init__ length and fd size/type checks raise bad_shape first.
If response keys inexact, schema empty/non-str, or schema != muse.vision/v1, raises bad_shape or unknown_version unknown muse response version. Vision then must pass base check_vision.

One-shot failure: nonzero exit decodes stderr capped 1000 chars. rc 2 bad_shape refused, rc 4 STALE_FRAME stale, rc 5 unavailable gate failed, rc 6 BUDGET_EXCEEDED budget, else bad_shape with code. When vserve already failed, fallback error may be chained or vserve error re-raised with fallback detail appended.

Vserve desync path: nonempty rx before request, pipelined bytes after newline, EOF, timeout, oversize, or uncorrelated app error closes and reaps proc. One retry after restart if restarts remain. Four consecutive non-hello successes reset restarts to 0; budget exhausted raises unavailable.
Entry is PerceptionAdapter.perceive(frame_ref, frame, prev). Package __getattr__ is the import entry: _BASE_NAMES go to base, the two provider names go to vcore/meta_muse submodules.

FakePerceptionAdapter.perceive is the offline/test entry: takes frame_ref mapping plus optional Frame/path/None frame and prev, validates dims and args, returns fixed vision with empty regions/elements.

Provider selection entry: register_perception_adapter(name,factory) binds names, available_perception_adapters returns sorted names, create_perception_adapter(name,*args,**kwargs) builds adapter or raises unavailable.
Validation entries: frame_dims(frame_ref)->(width,height) reads only dims; check_vision(vision,width,height) validates closed vision dict against v0.2 caps then observe._check_vision.
Construction entry __init__(transport, credential, max_line=16384): transport must be callable, credential None or nonempty bytes/bytearray copied to bytes, max_line exact-int >=1 or bad_shape.

Perceive entry perceive(frame_ref, frame, prev): validates frame_ref schema/dims, contains frame args, binds RGB24 pixels, checks sha256, calls transport(request,credential), validates one JSON line into vision dict.

perceive(frame_ref, frame, prev) is live-tick entry. Validates timeout, binds width/height/sha256 from frame_ref, checks Frame/path/None args, loads missing frame from ramws_path, verifies pixel digest, tries vserve if vadapt/vserve.py present then falls back to one-shot unless identity_mismatch or fallback disabled.

_perceive_vserve builds describe request with frame_raw or pinned frame path, optional prev_raw/prev, marks_out/ocr_marks. Holds queue slot plus ExitStack SHM pins, starts vserve under lock, sends one request_id-correlated roundtrip with one restart-and-retry on unavailable/desync within budget.

run_vcore(verb, args) covers offline QA verbs selftest/analyze/pack/cite-check/verify-citations/rejudge via python -m visioncore.cli. Validates verb membership and str args without NUL, runs bounded, parses JSON object, checks vqa schema allowlist and rc agreement.

project_element_table(frame_ref, vision_or_c2) projects to vqa.element-table/v1 evidence with frame_sha256/width/height/elements bbox/role/name/score_ppm. Accepts raw C2 dict with schema key or normalized vision dict; raw C2 is re-parsed and digest-checked, normalized vision must retain _BoundVision binding.

Data flow: frame_ref Mapping supplies width/height via frame_dims; frame/prev Frame buffers must match those dims per _check_frame_arg while Path/str stay opaque; perceive emits dict with summary, changed_regions, elements.
Flow: read lock JSON -> expected commit for name -> resolve env root -> if .git exists verify HEAD and tree else verify wheel direct_url.json and RECORD -> return root Path.

Flow: frame_ref width/height/sha256 -> bind bound_frame from Frame, /proc/self/fd dup+pread, or _ramws_frame for None/RAM paths -> sha256 compare -> deep-copied request {schema,frame_ref,frame,prev} -> transport -> strict JSON {schema,vision} -> check_vision -> _BoundVision copy.

Frame inputs flow as Frame bytes, /dev/shm paths, or /proc/self/fd/N. One-shot encodes Frame to PNG via _png_bytes into memfd passed by pass_fds. Vserve writes Frame RGB24 to mkstemp 0600 file as path,w,h or pins existing path by full read plus copy under ExitStack cleanup.

Vserve uses JSON-lines over stdin/stdout: {request_id,op,...} plus newline, UTF-8, control line cap 65536. Reply line buffered in _vserve_rx_buf with selector timeout, validated by _parse_vserve_reply, result unwrapped for hello/ping/status/describe then fed to C2 parser.

C2 bytes parse to frame_sha256/changed/regions/crops/marks/timing_us/mark_cap_reached. _vision_from_c2 maps marks to bbox/role/name/confidence elements, else crops to role crop with 0.5 confidence, builds summary string. check_vision validates, then wrapped in _BoundVision carrying frame_sha256 provenance only in-process.

Contract: perceive returns exactly summary:str, changed_regions:list, elements:list passing check_vision for bound dims; failures raise PerceptionError. Perception populates only closed vision sub-object; admission, freshness, witnesses stay with core.

Error contract: DependencyLockError(ObservationError,RuntimeError) carries code and message. Codes: bad_lockfile, unavailable, commit_mismatch, dirty_tree. Any untracked executable/Python or unrecorded wheel file fails closed as dirty_tree.

Wire contract is unit-owned: request schema muse.vision.request/v1 with exact keys schema/frame_ref/frame/prev; response must be exact keys schema/vision with schema muse.vision/v1, else bad_shape or unknown_version.

C2 contract ve.cu_describe/v1 exact. Width/height ints match input; changed bool present iff prev given; regions max 16 score-descending boxes in frame; crops max 8 with reason changed/salient; marks max 24 sequential id, known kind, unit score, optional ocr_text max 64 UTF-8 bytes; timing_us int; cap flag derived when absent.

Frame invariant: frozen RGB24 row-major buffer with width/height exact ints >0 and len(data)==width*height*3. Violations raise bad_shape: non-int dims, non-positive dims, non-bytes data, length mismatch.

Frame identity must hold end to end: frame_ref sha256 is 64 lowercase hex, Frame bytes sha256 must equal it, C2 frame_sha256 must equal expected input digest and frame_ref sha, normalized vision must be _BoundVision with same frame_sha256 else identity_mismatch.

core/src is the deterministic core library plus daemon and replay binaries for mv sessions. lib.rs reserves authority namespaces for admission, journal, supervisor, verify, control, record and catalog. journal/ is the durable private-archive v1 journal.jsonl with hash-chained SessionRecords, per-sequence sidecars, content-addressed witnesses, genesis/checkpoint recovery, group-commit frames and pure-Rust StreamingSha256 hex digests. admission/ is the pure CoreState machine plus durable Authority serializer gating proposals into admitted/refused verdicts with epoch, lease, frame binding and budget. control/ gates frame publication via publish_frame and verifies journals against an external anchor checkpoint. catalog/ is the frozen pure authority validating surface creation and launch specs. record/ handles offline RAM/disk captures and atomic exports. serve/ serializes authority transitions to UI/agent/daemon peers with witness-verified frames, capture, layout, tools and timings. supervisor/ isolates Daemon/Agent/Vision/Executor lifecycle via bundled reaper. transport/ provides owner-only Unix sockets with handshake and bounded framing. verify/ recomputes receipts against immutable frames. wire/ is closed v0.2 decode with preflight, integer rails and embedded schemas. bins provide daemon starter and offline replay. Offers verdicts, frames, replays, exports, routing and verification; needs journal dir, /dev/shm, Unix sockets, tokio, trusted registration/hello and witness roots.
If this code miscomputes, every frame hash mismatches its pinned witness and captures or journal appends are refused as invalid events.
User sees daemon exit 2 with metaviewer-core: message on stderr and no socket. Causes: missing env, unreadable config, version pin mismatch, uid validation failure, bind failure.

User sees surface create silently replaced by POLICY surface event naming the CatalogError debug. Causes: duplicate entry/profile at startup, unregistered profile, wrong geometry, reused surface id, destroyed surface retry.

User sees the picture never update after publishing: an old or zero generation, zero size, bad hash, or missing witness silently becomes a journalled refusal instead of a new frame. Logs/Outcome show StaleFrame, SurfaceNotAgentControlled, or Policy.

User sees commit or flush_sync fail with Poisoned after disk error, recent frames missing after restart from torn-tail rollback, startup refusal UPGRADE-REQUIRED with expected/found versions, logs journal close failed, background sync failed, join timed out.
User sees recording that stops early or never starts: over-rate frames vanish as decimated with dropped_frames count, oversize frames are refused, and ninth recording shows LIMIT.
Sender sees a refused verdict with STALE_FRAME instead of disconnect; other peers see no bogus frame; next good generation still arrives normally.

User sees service never starts; logs/status show InvalidConfig or InvalidEpoch. Cause is non-canonical/symlinked program, relative cwd, oversize args/env, forbidden env key, or missing -I -S -B recipe.
User sees connection refused/timeout or dropped message. FrameError Io/Timeout/Oversized/Incomplete/InvalidUtf8/Decode/Encode names the stage; handshake failures show Version/Pin/IdentityMismatch.

User sees action marked unverified with missing, invalid or unmatched witness though executor claimed success. Caused by absent pixel change, wrong element state, tick/state hash mismatch, or stale frame binding.
User sees action or message silently rejected or never applied; logs show Oversized, Malformed, UnknownVersion, OutOfBounds or InvalidField from decode. No partial Envelope is returned.
No error return: misuse such as double finalize is prevented by consuming self; wrong digests surface downstream as witness mismatches, not here.

Scroll dx/dy outside i32 returns OutOfBounds before reservation and at dispatch. Click outside frame, wait/scroll unsupported types, bad bbox, min_tick>max_tick, bad lane verb/nonce/seq, over-budget ms all map to OutOfBounds/Policy/BudgetExceeded as coded.
Bad id returns InvalidSurfaceId, reused id SurfaceIdUsed, unknown kind UnknownKind, depth>1 NestedDepth, depth mismatch NestedDepth, unknown profile UnregisteredProfile, size mismatch Geometry.
Stale generation (0, or <= previous.generation) yields Refusal::StaleFrame via Input::Refuse. A resumed surface therefore needs a newer frame to advance.

Any inline/background fsync failure latches poisoned/sync_failed; next append/retain/commit/flush returns Poisoned, clears surface caches, aborts batches, persists worker sticky_err; witness sync failure blocks retry and only recovery clears it.

Torn/unsealed tail: scan error Empty/Blank/Utf8Bom/MissingLf/Oversize/Corrupt triggers rollback removing torn sidecar/journal bytes, deleting orphans, syncing events/artifacts/journal/checkpoint.next in order, truncating journal, syncing dirs.
Oversize, empty, or sha-mismatched bytes return Error::Event and never enter RAM; projected total over MEMORY returns Error::Overflow with state unchanged.

Missing shm file maps to NotFound. precheck_frame_on_not_found then validates generation, size, sha256 shape and surface liveness. If the surface is destroyed or non-live it returns Ok without retiring the daemon; stale generation or unknown surface becomes StaleFrame or invalid instead.
Bad epoch returns InvalidEpoch; bad path/args/env or recipe/cwd violation returns InvalidConfig; caller Supervisor.start aborts before Entry insert, no loss recorded.

Zero deadline or missing filename gives ProbeInconclusive; non-socket/wrong uid gives NotSocket; live connect gives LiveSocket; refused proceeds; inconclusive probe or changed inode gives IdentityChanged.
Any gate failure returns InvalidData: bad length, non-/dev/shm or symlink, mode with group/other bits, uid mismatch, size change, double-open dev/ino drift, hash mismatch.
Callers create StreamingSha256::new or default, feed bytes via update, and consume with finalize_hex; sha256_hex is the one-shot helper.

decode(raw,peer,session,epoch,received_ns) is closed entry for proposals. Decodes envelope, maps OutOfBounds, rejects unless from==peer, session matches, to Core, body ActionProposal. Stores raw for replay re-decode.

admit(request,witnesses) applies Propose with witnesses and returns action_verdict/v0.2 admitted/refused with proposal_id, reason_code, core_seq. apply/apply_with_witnesses journal every Input before swapping state.
main builds current-thread tokio runtime, blocks on run, prints metaviewer-core: error to stderr and exits 2 on any failure. No args; all config via env files.
new(entries) builds registry, rejecting DuplicateEntry on repeated entry_id and DuplicateProfile on repeated (kind,profile_id). Projections returns cloned entries; state queries Live/Destroyed/Lost.

Entry is publish_frame(authority: &mut Authority, surface_id: &str, frame: Frame, witnesses: Vec<Witness>). Callers supply a mutable Authority plus surface id, frame, and retained witnesses; returns Result<Outcome, JournalError>.

Journal::create(state_dir,state) is fresh-session entry: validates session_id via safe_component and core_seq 0, builds state_dir/sessions/<id>/{events,artifacts} with 0700, writes genesis.json and journal.jsonl header, stages first checkpoint.json, syncs dirs to ancestors.

Journal::recover(path,root) is restart entry: takes exclusive WriterFile lock, scans journal, on scan error rolls back uncommitted tail, cleans uncommitted artifacts, replays from genesis, promotes checkpoint.next only after full-closure replay, evicts surface caches.
decode_envelope(raw) decodes with default limits; decode_envelope_with_limits(raw, limits) is the checked entry used by transports.
Bytes accumulate in 64-byte buf with total_len counter; full blocks compress immediately and remainder buffers; finalize appends 0x80, zero pad, big-endian bit length, then hex-encodes state.

apply clones state, runs reduce(input) to Outcome{core_seq,reason,dispatch,cancelled,cancellation_reason,control_ready}, then commits. core_seq increments once per input via checked_add; overflow returns Overflow.
Control: raw str -> size check -> preflight -> serde_json Value -> integer rails -> version probe -> typed Envelope -> schema valid + terminal_lengths. No I/O inside.
Digest format is fixed 64-char lowercase hex via 0123456789abcdef table; initial state uses standard SHA-256 IVs and 64 round constants.

Frame needs 64 lowercase-hex sha256, generation/width/height nonzero. Surface needs non-empty display, owner Endpoint, agent_controlled/live flags, optional frame and refresh_after fence, allowed_verbs list.

Entry requires schema catalog_entry/v0.2, valid ids/text, memory 1..1073741824, cpu 1..20000, sizes 1..16384 with window<=display, depth<=1. Nested/metaviewer-nested rows must match exact pinned image, geometry 1280x720x1280x900, display_only, None network, seccomp.
total_len counts all updated bytes; buf_len stays below 64; finalize emits one or two blocks depending on whether buf_len exceeds 56 after 0x80.
Surface states Live->Destroyed or Live->Lost only. Once terminal, id remains in map so validate_create returns SurfaceIdUsed and finish returns SurfaceNotLive; no reuse or resurrection.

Scroll dx/dy outside i32 returns OutOfBounds before reservation and at dispatch. Click outside frame, wait/scroll unsupported types, bad bbox, min_tick>max_tick, bad lane verb/nonce/seq, over-budget ms all map to OutOfBounds/Policy/BudgetExceeded as coded.

Duplicate proposal_id, msg_id, nonce, or seq<=stored returns Policy without budget charge. HumanInput on human_roles surface, destroyed, epoch 0, or existing pending/draining returns Policy. Unknown proposal Dispatch/Receipt/Drain returns Policy.

SurfaceRequest op must be create/destroy/list/frame_subscribe/frame_unsubscribe with catalog-valid create policy; targeting destroyed or non-live id returns Policy. Zero budget returns BudgetExceeded, else decrements budget.

decode(raw,peer,session,epoch,received_ns) is closed entry for proposals. Decodes envelope, maps OutOfBounds, rejects unless from==peer, session matches, to Core, body ActionProposal. Stores raw for replay re-decode.

admit(request,witnesses) applies Propose with witnesses and returns action_verdict/v0.2 admitted/refused with proposal_id, reason_code, core_seq. apply/apply_with_witnesses journal every Input before swapping state.

apply clones state, runs reduce(input) to Outcome{core_seq,reason,dispatch,cancelled,cancellation_reason,control_ready}, then commits. core_seq increments once per input via checked_add; overflow returns Overflow.

Input is tagged journaled ABI: SurfaceRequest, SurfaceNotice, Lifecycle, Refuse, Connect, Surface, Frame, Propose, Dispatch, DispatchFailed, Receipt, TakeControl, ReleaseControl, Drain, HumanInput. Unknown fields denied.

Frame needs 64 lowercase-hex sha256, generation/width/height nonzero. Surface needs non-empty display, owner Endpoint, agent_controlled/live flags, optional frame and refresh_after fence, allowed_verbs list.
proposal() extracts ActionProposal from envelope body; non-proposal returns InvalidInput. Propose path re-decodes raw and requires envelope equality, catching deserialization-built request tampering.

Admission requires live agent_controlled surface, owner equals proposer, epoch matches nonzero, frame present and generation/sha match proposal, no refresh fence, lease/display conflict free, budget and deadline valid, Agent component.

Destroyed ids stay in destroyed set; Lifecycle/Frame/TakeControl/ReleaseControl on destroyed returns Policy. Metadata Updated cannot resurrect non-live; live only ORs true, agent_controlled only ANDs. Human-owned creation pins human_roles immutably.
Own deterministic admission state machine for surfaces, leases, pending proposals, budget, nonces/sequences. Pure reduce/apply; persistence only after journal fsync by Authority.

Durable serializer around CoreState plus journal. Success follows dependency publication and journal fsync, never merely a state plan. Exposes retain witnesses, flush_sync, admit, apply_with_witnesses.

Surface lifecycle: Created inserts fresh id with no frame; Updated mutates display/live/agent_controlled with refresh fence; Lost sets live false; Destroyed sets live false and adds to destroyed tombstone set. Lost/Destroyed are terminal.

Losing liveness or agent control cancels all pending for that surface. Dispatched/unknown move to draining map; undispatched removed with lease cleanup. Returns cancelled ids with SurfaceNotAgentControlled reason.

Callers serialize Authority access. Each proposal dispatched at most once below retry ceiling; Dispatch sets dispatched true and dispatch flag. Failed recheck removes pending so retry needs new frame-bound admission.

Connect increments epoch and marks all pending unknown, forcing re-admission. DispatchFailed/Receipt/Drain require epoch match; unknown or undispatched receipts are Policy and never refund admitted-attempt budget.

Budget counts admitted attempts via remaining_budget, default 10000. Propose and HumanInput decrement on success; unknown dispatched work never refunded; DispatchFailed releases unqueued work without refund.

Deadline is received_ns plus budget.max_ms*1e6 with overflow check. Expired (now>=deadline) or now<received_ns yields BudgetExceeded. Lane key is JSON of (from,surface_id) for wait-lane nonce/sequence dedup.
Depends on journal canonical_bytes, Journal create/recover/append, Witness retain/verified/frame, wire decode_envelope/payload, catalog CreateRequest for create policy validation.

core/src/bin holds the executable entry points for metaviewer-core: metaviewer-core.rs daemon starter and mv-replay.rs offline journal replay tool. metaviewer-core reads JSON Config from MV_CORE_CONFIG, pins component_version to CARGO_PKG_VERSION, validates uid, binds XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/metaviewer/core.sock, opens state dir, and serves with shared Mutex on a current-thread tokio runtime. mv-replay scans a journal with witness root and optional anchor, prints sha256 snapshot hash unless --verify-only, mapping journal errors to exits 2/3/4. Both depend on catalog decode/launch (preflight bounds, CatalogEntry validation, Registration kind-target gating, launch_spec and surface create payloads) and core serve/journal plus wire MAX_ENVELOPE_BYTES/DecodeError/SurfaceRequest types. It offers daemon socket service and offline verify/replay; it needs MV_CORE_CONFIG, XDG_RUNTIME_DIR, --journal/--witness-root/--anchor args, and tokio runtime.
User sees daemon exit 2 with metaviewer-core: message on stderr and no socket. Causes: missing env, unreadable config, version pin mismatch, uid validation failure, bind failure.
Operator sees catalog registration rejected as InvalidTarget when pairing wrong binary/program, non-absolute game path, out-of-range slots, or mismatched nested geometry.
Missing --journal/--witness-root, duplicated flags, unknown arg, or scan failure returns JournalError Invalid/Corrupt etc. verify-only suppresses snapshot hash print but still validates.

Oversized maps to Oversized, depth>32 DepthExceeded, long string StringLimitExceeded, duplicate key DuplicateField, >256 keys KeyLimitExceeded, >=4096 array items ArrayLimitExceeded, bad syntax Malformed.
main builds current-thread tokio runtime, blocks on run, prints metaviewer-core: error to stderr and exits 2 on any failure. No args; all config via env files.
main calls run, prints error to stderr, exits 3 on Duplicate, 4 on Witness, 2 otherwise. Args are --journal, --witness-root, optional --anchor, --verify-only; any other shape is Invalid.

new(entry,target) gates kind-target pairs: Browser->Browser, Program notepad/metaviewer-nested, Vm notepad-vm, Game absolute app_dir slots 1-4 with 1280x900x1280x900, Desktop valid class slot>0. Else InvalidTarget.

preflight scans raw bytes without allocation: depth max 32, string values max 65536 decoded length, max 256 unique keys per object with duplicate detection, array commas max 4096. Oversize beyond MAX_ENVELOPE_BYTES rejected first.

launch_spec maps Browser/Program/Vm to srf-identity-surface start --kind --identity --windows 1 [--program], Game to srf-holdings-capsule start --slots --app, Desktop to srf-capsula-desktop iniciar --clase --slot --json. Nested entry adds fixed inner_argv.

Wire row needs schema plus entry_id,kind,profile_id,label,image,window/display sizes,display_only,network,seccomp_identity,nested_depth,limits{memory_bytes,cpu_milli}. Unknown fields denied; serde checks shape after preflight.
Program kind always emits CreateNested desktop_capsule with geometry w/h and profile_id,nested_depth; other kinds emit Case0 Browser/DesktopCapsule/GameCapsule/Vm with geometry and profile_id.
Refuses foreign registration before sockets/session: config.core.hello.component_version must equal compiled CARGO_PKG_VERSION, else error core component version pin mismatch.

Start metaviewer-core daemon: read JSON Config from MV_CORE_CONFIG file, pin component_version to CARGO_PKG_VERSION, validate uid, bind XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/metaviewer/core.sock, open state dir server, serve with shared Mutex.
Offline journal replay tool. Scans journal with witness root, optionally with anchor file, prints sha256 of state snapshot unless --verify-only. Maps journal errors to exit codes 2/3/4.
Decode one catalog entry line into validated CatalogEntry. Runs preflight bounds checks then serde shape check then TryFrom policy. Input excludes framing LF but budget reserves it.
Bind a validated CatalogEntry to a LaunchTarget and derive launch_spec binary+args plus inner_argv, and build surface_request/v0.2 create payload for admission.
Requires MV_CORE_CONFIG path to JSON config file and XDG_RUNTIME_DIR for socket dir. Uses serve::effective_uid, config.validate(uid), serve::bind, serve::state_dir for state.
Hard caps prevent allocation blowup: envelope bytes, 32 nesting, 64KB strings, 256 keys/object, 4096 array elements. Checked before typed allocation.
Decode/launch depend on crate::wire MAX_ENVELOPE_BYTES/DecodeError and wire payload SurfaceRequest types. Binaries depend on metaviewer_core serve/journal modules and tokio runtime.

core/src/catalog is the pure frozen catalog authority for surface creation (single file mod.rs with decode/launch submodules, no processes or filesystem). It stores CatalogEntry rows by entry_id and (kind,profile) index plus a surface-id to SurfaceState map where terminal ids stay reserved forever. CatalogRegistry::new rejects DuplicateEntry/DuplicateProfile; projections returns cloned entries with Live/Destroyed/Lost queries. CreateRequest::from_surface_request (depth 0) and from_nested_surface_request convert admitted DTOs with geometry, identity and kind checks. validate_create enforces valid unused id, known Kind, depth<=1 and equality, registered profile and exact window geometry match, returning Registration. create emits LaunchSpec and marks Live; destroy/mark_lost move Live->Destroyed/Lost via finish with no reuse or resurrection. CatalogEntry::try_from enforces schema catalog_entry/v0.2, id/text rules, resource bounds and pinned nested image/geometry. Kind::parse allows only five kinds; CatalogError maps to POLICY SurfaceEvent. Offers validated Registration/LaunchSpec and state views; needs decode/launch types and SurfaceRequest DTOs; allocates nothing — launch is caller's job.

User sees surface create silently replaced by POLICY surface event naming the CatalogError debug. Causes: duplicate entry/profile at startup, unregistered profile, wrong geometry, reused surface id, destroyed surface retry.
Bad id returns InvalidSurfaceId, reused id SurfaceIdUsed, unknown kind UnknownKind, depth>1 NestedDepth, depth mismatch NestedDepth, unknown profile UnregisteredProfile, size mismatch Geometry.
Schema/id/label/image/limits failures return InvalidEntry, bad profile InvalidProfile, oversized depth NestedDepth, nested mismatch NestedPolicy, bad geometry Geometry.
new(entries) builds registry, rejecting DuplicateEntry on repeated entry_id and DuplicateProfile on repeated (kind,profile_id). Projections returns cloned entries; state queries Live/Destroyed/Lost.
create(request) validates then emits LaunchSpec and marks surface Live. destroy/mark_lost move Live to Destroyed/Lost via finish; non-Live finish returns SurfaceNotLive.

from_surface_request converts admitted Case0 DTO with explicit nested_depth 0 only; from_nested_surface_request converts CreateNested DTO with i64 depth. Both check geometry range, identity, kind mapping.
validate_create checks valid surface id, unused id, Kind::parse, depth<=1, profile lookup UnregisteredProfile, stored depth equality, exact window geometry match. Returns Registration on success.

Entry requires schema catalog_entry/v0.2, valid ids/text, memory 1..1073741824, cpu 1..20000, sizes 1..16384 with window<=display, depth<=1. Nested/metaviewer-nested rows must match exact pinned image, geometry 1280x720x1280x900, display_only, None network, seccomp.

Kind parses browser/program/vm/game_capsule/desktop_capsule only, else UnknownKind. Network is none/proxy. CatalogError maps to POLICY SurfaceEvent via surface_event with code POLICY and debug detail.

Nested create requires DesktopCapsule kind else NestedPolicy, depth 0-1 else NestedDepth, geometry 1..16384, valid identity, and depth1 must be exactly 1280x720 else NestedPolicy. Kind fixed to program.

valid_id 1-128 chars, alnum start, alnum/._:- rest. valid_identity 2-48 lowercase alnum start, lowercase/digit/- rest. valid_text <=256 non-blank after trim. Browser/Program/Vm profiles must also satisfy valid_identity.
Pure frozen catalog authority with no processes or filesystem. Stores entries by entry_id, (kind,profile) index, and surface states. Terminal surface ids stay reserved forever.
Surface states Live->Destroyed or Live->Lost only. Once terminal, id remains in map so validate_create returns SurfaceIdUsed and finish returns SurfaceNotLive; no reuse or resurrection.
No runtime resource allocation; limits field only validated. Registry is in-memory BTreeMaps; create reserves surface id entry without spawning anything—launch is caller's job from LaunchSpec.
Depends on decode::decode_entry/CatalogEntryWire/Limits and launch::Registration/LaunchSpec/LaunchTarget submodules, plus wire payload SurfaceRequest and DecodeError for admission bridging.
Exact geometry match required: requested w/h must equal frozen window size, not merely fit display. Stale catalog entries cause Geometry refusals even when display could fit the request.

core/src/control is the frame-publication gate for mv. mod.rs offers publish_frame(&mut Authority, surface_id, frame, witnesses): surface lookup, liveness check, strictly-increasing generation with generation 0 always stale, and content-identity checks (nonzero dimensions, 64-char lowercase-hex sha256, matching witness). Every refusal is journalled via authority.apply(Input::Refuse); valid frames use apply_with_witnesses with a durable Policy-refusal fallback on store failure, propagating storage errors as Err. tests.rs locks genesis semantics (generation 0 refused without committing, generation 1 admitted and committed) with Authority recovery equality and isolated temp dirs. The bundled anchor reader verifies a journal against an externally protected metaviewer.checkpoint/v1 head, requiring an outside-archive anchor and exact checkpoint JSON equality. It needs a mutable Authority, live agent-controlled surfaces, retained witnesses, and an independently administered anchor path.

User sees the picture never update after publishing: an old or zero generation, zero size, bad hash, or missing witness silently becomes a journalled refusal instead of a new frame. Logs/Outcome show StaleFrame, SurfaceNotAgentControlled, or Policy.
Unknown surface_id (surfaces.get returns None) yields Refusal::Policy via authority.apply(Input::Refuse). No frame is stored; Outcome.reason carries the refusal.
Known but !surface.live yields Refusal::SurfaceNotAgentControlled via Input::Refuse. Distinguishes a non-agent-controlled surface from generic policy refusal.
Stale generation (0, or <= previous.generation) yields Refusal::StaleFrame via Input::Refuse. A resumed surface therefore needs a newer frame to advance.
Bad dimensions, non-64 or non-lowercase-hex sha256, or no matching witness yields Refusal::Policy via Input::Refuse. Same path covers all content-identity failures.

If apply_with_witnesses for Input::Frame fails, publish_frame attempts a durable Input::Refuse Policy entry and returns its outcome. Storage failure or poisoning propagates as Err rather than fake success.

Missing, unreadable, overlong, symlink-containing, noncanonical, unparseable, or archive-local anchor maps to JournalError::Corrupt. Scan failure or checkpoint JSON mismatch also returns Corrupt with no Replay.

Entry is publish_frame(authority: &mut Authority, surface_id: &str, frame: Frame, witnesses: Vec<Witness>). Callers supply a mutable Authority plus surface id, frame, and retained witnesses; returns Result<Outcome, JournalError>.

Entries are verify_with_anchor(root, anchor_path) for the conventional root/journal.jsonl and scan_with_anchor(path, root, anchor_path) for an explicit journal plus archive root. Both return Result<Replay, JournalError>.

Data flows surface lookup -> refusal branch -> authority.apply(Input::Refuse) or authority.apply_with_witnesses(Input::Frame, witnesses). On frame-store error it attempts authority.apply(Input::Refuse { reason: Refusal::Policy }) and returns that result.

Flow: read_file(anchor_path, MAX_LINE) -> canonicalize anchor and root -> reject archive-local anchor -> parse Checkpoint -> scan(path, root) -> compare json(expected) vs json(replay.checkpoint). Mismatch returns Corrupt.

Publication requires a strictly newer generation across a control refresh fence: generation 0 always refused; otherwise frame.generation must exceed previous frame.generation when a previous frame exists.
Frame validity requires width != 0, height != 0, sha256 length 64 of lowercase hex digits, and at least one witness with w.sha256 == frame.sha256. Any violation maps to Refusal::Policy.

Anchor must live outside the session archive with storage permissions the archive writer cannot rewrite. Path separation is checked (anchor.starts_with(archive) rejected) but cannot prove independent administration; that is a caller precondition.
Anchor pins the exact head: json(expected) must equal json(replay.checkpoint). Legitimate later appends need a new trusted anchor. Unanchored scan proves local consistency only.
core/src/control/mod.rs exists only for frame publication via publish_frame. Operator control transitions, cancellation notices and daemon forwarding belong to serve, not here.
core/src/control/tests.rs proves genesis-frame behavior: generation 0 is refused as stale without committing, generation 1 is admitted and committed, with journal recovery checked.
core/src/journal/anchor.rs only reads an externally protected metaviewer.checkpoint/v1 head and verifies a journal against it. It never creates, refreshes, or falls back from a required anchor.

Refusal is journalled but commits no frame: expected state is before.clone() with core_seq += 1 only; on success the surface frame is additionally set to Some(frame). Recovered Authority state must equal expected.

Depends on admission Authority, Frame, Input, Outcome, journal Witness and JournalError, and Refusal. Reuses authority.apply and authority.apply_with_witnesses; no direct storage access in this module.

Control transitions must use serve authenticated routing; this module must not gain a transition function (compile_fail example uses control::transition). Refusals are journal entries, so retrying a stale frame without bumping generation never advances.
Tests isolate parallel runs with static NEXT AtomicU64 temp-dir suffixes and TempRoot Drop removing the dir. publish_frame itself takes &mut Authority, so callers serialize admission updates.
TempRoot deletes its temp dir on drop; test Authority dirs use mode 0o700. Anchor reads are bounded by MAX_LINE via read_file, limiting memory from an oversized anchor file.

Test session uses CoreState::session(frame-genesis), Input::Connect, and a live agent-controlled surface with frame None, then journal path sessions/frame-genesis/journal.jsonl for Authority::recover verification.

User sees commit or flush_sync fail with Poisoned after disk error, recent frames missing after restart from torn-tail rollback, startup refusal UPGRADE-REQUIRED with expected/found versions, logs journal close failed, background sync failed, join timed out.

Tester sees fail-closed Corrupt(empty), Corrupt(blank), Corrupt(utf8_bom), Corrupt(missing_lf) for torn line without LF, Corrupt(oversize) over 64 MiB, frame digest mismatch on tampered pixels, Locked when another writer holds flock.

Visible failure is a rejected write or a scan error naming Poisoned, Invalid, Witness, Io, MissingLf, Unsealed, Corrupt, Duplicate, or UpgradeRequired; after a torn append the journal holds an extra sidecar and truncated line, and recover rolls back to the last committed prefix so later appends resume cleanly.
User sees unchanged frames still verified slowly or refused: every repeat frame costs a full hash after lifecycle, epoch, geometry, permission, or poison change instead of instant hit.
Tampered pixels are rejected rather than recorded: spoofed or truncated shm yields InvalidData/Witness errors and no new journal record, so the frame never commits.

Any inline/background fsync failure latches poisoned/sync_failed; next append/retain/commit/flush returns Poisoned, clears surface caches, aborts batches, persists worker sticky_err; witness sync failure blocks retry and only recovery clears it.

Torn/unsealed tail: scan error Empty/Blank/Utf8Bom/MissingLf/Oversize/Corrupt triggers rollback removing torn sidecar/journal bytes, deleting orphans, syncing events/artifacts/journal/checkpoint.next in order, truncating journal, syncing dirs.

try_rollback_uncommitted_tail never rolls back UpgradeRequired, Invalid, Locked or Poisoned scan errors; otherwise it loads checkpoint.json and checkpoint.next candidates, verifies each prefix, highest count first, and returns the original scan error if none verifies.

Line readers enforce exact framing: UTF BOM is rejected as Utf8Bom, missing trailing newline as MissingLf, empty or whitespace-only line as Blank, overlong read as Oversize, corrupt parse as Corrupt or Duplicate, leaving torn tail detectable on next scan.

Digest/ownership path: read_verified_inner returns frame digest mismatch on length/trailing/hash mismatch; verify maps to Witness; retain rejects empty/>64MiB/non-hex/mismatch; is_verified_artifact checks dev/ino/uid/mode/mtime/ctime.
Stale generation, geometry change, wrong epoch, other surface, other root, bad mode 0o644, or poison all fall back to full hash or return Invalid/Poisoned without appending records.

Single-byte flip, truncation/extension by one byte, or corrupted artifacts/<sha> fails read_verified_for_surface with InvalidData and verify/retain/recover with Witness; spoofed digest forces full hash; journal count/lines unchanged, poison clears cache and never blesses unhashed bytes.

Journal::create(state_dir,state) is fresh-session entry: validates session_id via safe_component and core_seq 0, builds state_dir/sessions/<id>/{events,artifacts} with 0700, writes genesis.json and journal.jsonl header, stages first checkpoint.json, syncs dirs to ancestors.

Journal::recover(path,root) is restart entry: takes exclusive WriterFile lock, scans journal, on scan error rolls back uncommitted tail, cleans uncommitted artifacts, replays from genesis, promotes checkpoint.next only after full-closure replay, evicts surface caches.

Live entries are retain_witness sync-now, retain_verified_pixels/retain_verified_witness/retain_frame_witness grouped, verify_surface_frame[_with_geometry], flush_sync/close/shutdown; close/shutdown flush group-commit, close channel, join worker.

Journal.append is the sole write entry: caller supplies Input, Outcome, CoreState and witnesses. It reconciles worker progress, rejects poisoned handles, validates sequence linkage and state transition, verifies witnesses, then follows frame or non-frame durability path before updating in-memory state.

scan and verify_chain are read-only validators: they confine the path, enforce private archive, check header schema and core version, bind genesis by header hash and session, replay each record with sidecar and witness checks, reject extra event files as Unsealed, and require a matching checkpoint.
Tests enter via Journal::create, CoreState::apply, retain_verified_pixels, verify_surface_frame and VerifiedPixels::read_verified_for_surface with shm files and digests.

Non-frame write: caller bytes sha256-checked into artifacts/<sha> via publish, event sidecar unsynced, journal.jsonl append via WriterFile, fsync dirty witness/event files and artifact/event dirs and journal, write/fsync checkpoint.next then atomic rename to checkpoint.json plus root sync; frame path stages SyncCmd::Flush batches.

Frame appends publish the event sidecar unsynced, append the journal line, stage checkpoint via checkpoint_unsynced without immediate promotion, track dirty files with pending checkpoint, and either dispatch or stage a background sync batch based on batch size and time window.

Read flow: read_file checks symlink, size, ino/dev, exact length; parse enforces canonical_bytes sorted keys and deny_unknown_fields; scan replays Genesis/Event lines, recomputes archive_next chain and tail; verify_witness rereads artifacts and rehashes.

Crash-safe rollback forces committed witnesses, genesis, and committed events durable, ensures checkpoint.json durably holds the chosen checkpoint, removes uncommitted events and orphan artifacts and syncs those directories, truncates journal to prefix offset and syncs it, then removes stale checkpoint.next and syncs root.
Control flows Input::Frame into CoreState then Journal::append with frame witnesses; verification reads shm bytes and returns VerifiedPixels carrying sha256, hash_skipped, hash_ns and timing fields.

Checkpoint schema metaviewer.checkpoint/v1 with count/tail/archive/genesis; closure snapshots live values; matching_checkpoint accepts json/next only if all four equal replay; Header metaviewer.journal/v1, Genesis metaviewer.archive/v1.

Witness is sha256+byte_len; VerifiedPixels guarantees bytes hash to sha256 except fast-path memcmp hit; Event holds SessionRecord+Envelope+Input+Outcome+state+witnesses; event_kind maps Refused/Admitted/Executed/SurfaceChanged; audit_envelope wraps record.

Append and replay require strict linkage: expected sequence is count plus one, outcome and state sequence must match it, reduced state from apply must equal supplied outcome and snapshot, record uses msg_id event linkage and prev_sha256 equal to tail, else Invalid is returned.

Witnesses are content verified by digest and byte length via verify_witness and verified cache, recorded in committed set, tracked in dirty files if unsynced; required witness derived from input and outcome must be present or append fails with Witness.
VerifiedPixels reports hash_skipped true with hash_ns 0 and skipped_hash_ns>0 on hit; false with hash_ns>0 on full streaming SHA-256. shm_read_ns plus skipped_hash_ns stays within elapsed nanos.
Fast versus full journal runs must be bit-identical: journal.jsonl, checkpoint.json, replayed state, boundaries, count, tail, archive and genesis match across static and changed generations.

Canonical identity: json uses canonical_bytes with sorted keys and rejects non-u64/i64 numbers; parse rejects duplicate keys/alternate spellings by comparing bytes; hex requires 64 lowercase hex; Witness byte_len in 1..=MAX_BYTES.

Confinement: confined rejects ParentDir and any symlink prefix; private_directory_for_uid requires dir uid==current_uid and mode 0700; artifact/frame files require uid match and mode &077==0; current_uid reads /proc/self/status Uid and caches.

Steady-state recover with checkpoint.json matching the journal performs no historical fsync; when checkpoint.next holds the proven checkpoint while checkpoint.json is stale, recover forces witnesses, genesis, events, journal and directories durable before promoting next and syncing root.
Fast path requires same session root, same surface_id, same epoch, advancing generation, same width/height, same length and digest, mode 0o600, unpoisoned journal.

Journal tracks poisoned latch, unsynced_frames/first_unsynced_at, dirty_files/staged_dirty_len, pending_checkpoint/staged counts, completed counts and sync_failed; poisoned/sync_failed forces Poisoned and clears caches. WorkerState tracks queue, staged StagedBatch with deadline, in_flight, closed/finished, sticky_err and completed counts; loop pops Flush, waits for deadline/closed, executes batch and Barrier returns sticky result to flush_sync.

verify_prefix_and_classify_tail replays genesis through checkpoint count checking header, genesis binding, hash chain, envelope, witness, state apply, kind, snapshot and archive, then walks beyond prefix to separate torn bytes from valid uncommitted tail with frame ordering; witness cache is unprimed/committed/evicted/poisoned, evicted on Update/TakeControl/ReleaseControl/Lost/Destroyed/Connect/epoch change, poison clears bytes to Poisoned.

Frame group-commit waits FRAME_SYNC_WINDOW 50ms or FRAME_SYNC_MAX_BATCH 8, stages deadline batches, queues Flush up to MAX_PENDING_SYNC_BATCHES 4 then coalesces by rel path; non-frame Barrier rendezvous uses join timeout, error propagates and timeout aborts to Io; close/drop flush group commits, promote checkpoint.next, join worker to quiescence with 5s timeout, on timeout poison and retain worker for later join.

Bounded growth: MAX_BYTES 64MiB, MAX_RECORDS 100000, MAX_LINE with Policy/Oversize on overflow and seq overflow rejected; MAX_UNCOMMITTED_ARTIFACTS 32, MAX_DIRTY_FILES 32, MAX_VERIFIED_WITNESS_CACHE 256 LRU, surface/retained/per-surface 64MiB caps evicting oldest; dirty files, unsynced witnesses/frames and in-flight batches tracked until durable.

Durability order: witness file sync, artifacts dir sync, events dir sync, journal.jsonl sync, checkpoint.next sync, rename to checkpoint.json, root sync; execute_sync_batch validates existing checkpoint count/schema if rename races.

Layout from state_dir/sessions/<session_id> with safe_component 128 chars alnum/._-, CARGO_PKG_VERSION and uid/0700 enforcement; default_state_dir uses absolute XDG_STATE_HOME or HOME, Invalid on empty/relative; on-disk journal.jsonl/events/artifacts/genesis/checkpoint.json/next plus dirs; needs Authority/CoreState/Input/Outcome/Envelope, sha256, unix modes/dev/ino; 1280x900 bench gated by MV_RUN_HASH_BENCH.

Symlink/ParentDir escape blocked by confined plus ino/dev recheck, fork flock needs explicit WriterFile unlock, torn sidecar/journal/next on crash with sidecar cleanup before truncate and stale next replaced only under lock after replay, each step idempotent; private mode plus owner required, retained dup fd keeps Locked; never cache disk bytes without SHA-256.

core/src/record is the offline recording authority for RAM and disk captures. mod.rs Coordinator admits surfaces, validates ram_start/ram_stop/disk_start/disk_stop/screenshot, reserves ring bytes against memory_bytes, journals Started/Refused/Stopped/Exported with hash-chained SessionRecords via JournalSink, and validates frame_captured/exported metadata without touching pixels. capture.rs Host holds live pixels: frame/frame_verified ingest with empty/ring/sha checks, decimation by max_fps, latest map plus per-recording rings with FIFO eviction and 64MiB/8MiB/64-row/8-recording caps, prepare seals on recordStop/screenshot and exports sealed rows. capture/export builds deterministic private atomic exports: RGB24 PNG encoding, zero-metadata ustar, receipt {id,bytes,sha256}, exclusive 0600 temp then hard-link with no-clobber, pin_directory and recover. guard_tests.rs/tests.rs prove budget, admission, atomic rejects and lifecycle/eviction/chain. Offers validated start/stop/screenshot, RAM capture, atomic export. Needs admitted surfaces, memory/ring/fps limits, durable JournalSink, /dev/shm paths, lowercase hex digests, exact disk grant on export, and separate RAM reclamation on release.
User sees recording that stops early or never starts: over-rate frames vanish as decimated with dropped_frames count, oversize frames are refused, and ninth recording shows LIMIT.
Stopped recording shows frame count, duration_ms and concatenated-bytes sha256; decimated runs report fewer frames plus dropped_frames, e.g. 3 kept and 3 dropped.

User sees recording stop reporting retained frame and byte counts after eviction, or an export that only succeeds after disk stop with the exact authorized destination; wrong destination never changes state.

User sees export refused with DESTINATION_EXISTS when file already present, or DESTINATION_UNAVAILABLE when destination missing, read-only, replaced, or a symlink alias; aborted journal leaves no file because Drop cleans up.
A tester sees no leftover temp or partial tar after a crash before commit, and no clobber of an existing export; symlink attacks do not delete outside files.
Oversize, empty, or sha-mismatched bytes return Error::Event and never enter RAM; projected total over MEMORY returns Error::Overflow with state unchanged.
recordStart with unknown surface, no latest, duplicate active recording, over row or recording cap, or over MEMORY preflight returns ok false without allocating IDs or events.
Coordinator refusal Case5 maps BUDGETEXCEEDED to BUDGET_EXCEEDED else POLICY; recordStop on missing or non-recording id returns NOT_RECORDING.
Starting on unknown surface with two actives held returns POLICY surface is not admitted, creates nothing, journals Refused; pressure does not bypass admission.
ram_path /dev/shm/ and /dev/shm/subdir/ are rejected as directory paths even under /dev/shm, atomically with no state or journal change.

Unadmitted surface, inactive stop, bad fps/ring, over-limit fps/ring, over-memory reservation, reused or released identity, or unauthorized disk grant each journal a refused event and leave next state uncommitted on sink error.
disk_start with null or mismatched capability or path journals POLICY refusal, leaves recordings empty, records Refused kind with unchanged prev chain 0-repeat-64.
Screenshot frame with /dev/shm/../disk path errors atomically; valid 8-byte frame seals with stopped event; second frame on sealed screenshot errors.

Zero, oversize, zero-fps, high-fps, over-ring, over-max-fps and unknown-surface starts each journal POLICY without creating recordings; sink failure returns Journal with state unchanged; bad limits fail Configuration.

Unknown or malformed id returns CAPTURE_UNKNOWN; unsealed returns NOT_SEALED; missing or empty pixels or width*height*3 mismatch returns CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE; over 4096 frames, bad dimensions, or tar over limit returns LIMIT.

Pin failure, read-only mode, temp create/write/sync failure, grant replacement, inode substitution, temp unlink or directory sync failure return DESTINATION_UNAVAILABLE; existing final returns DESTINATION_EXISTS.
Inputs arrive via frame/frame_verified with FrameRef plus bytes and now_ms, drop_frame on loss, and prepare for recordStart, recordStop, screenshot and list.
observe accepts frame_captured metadata and exported receipts from the authenticated recorder, deriving ring evictions locally; pixels never cross the journal boundary.
Host.export_plan(id) validates id, sealed flag, pixel store presence and frame count, then encodes every retained frame with png() before any disk access.
frame checks empty, over-RING and sha256_hex mismatch then delegates to frame_verified; verified frames update latest map and fan out append_frame per active recording with journal events.
png() prepends filter byte 0 per row, wraps rows in zlib stored blocks with Adler32, then emits PNG signature plus IHDR bit depth 8 color type 2, IDAT, IEND chunks with CRC32 via chunk().
Refusal codes are exact: SURFACE_UNKNOWN, CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE, ALREADY_RECORDING, NOT_RECORDING, LIMIT, BUDGET_EXCEEDED for fps 61, POLICY otherwise; replies carry ok, code and request_id.
recordStop seals row, stamps duration_ms from created_ms, concatenates ring bytes in order and returns sealed true with sha256; list returns rows; screenshot reply has no ram_path or pixels.
Third 16-byte start over 32-byte memory fails BUDGETEXCEEDED; ram_stop alone does not free budget; detail names held a=16 b=16; only release(a) lets c start.
Two unreleased screenshots block third with BUDGETEXCEEDED naming shot1=16 shot2=16; releasing shot1 admits shot3, proving sealed screenshots hold reservations.
New requires ring nonzero and within 1GiB and memory, max_fps 1..120, surface ids valid, and disk grant with valid capability id plus absolute path; else Error::Configuration.
