Run admits only srf-identity-surface/srf-holdings-capsule under root plus admin show with valid id; identity surface appends owned --state-dir and rejects caller --state-dir flags; runs with timeout, group kill, capped buffers.
Egress schema must be metaviewer.capsule_egress/v1; Mode open requires zero domains, allowlisted requires 1..256 domains. Domains must be unique normalized exact ASCII hostnames.

WriteEgressPolicy only for allowlisted egress with valid profile identity and container match; writes identity.policy.json with browserid.proxy-policy/v1 approved map then re-reads egress and fails with NET_EGRESS_CHANGED on drift.
NewManager requires runner/clock, OriginNS nonzero, absolute BinDir, MaxSurfaces>=1, MaxOutputBytes 1..1048576, Timeout 0..3min, valid profiles, NetModes subset, bounded liveness values.

Opening file must live under stateDir/opening-modes/<profile>.json with dir 0700, file 0600 owned by uid, size at most 1024, schema metaviewer.opening_mode/v0.3, matching profile and human/agent mode.
exactHostname requires dot, length at most 253, lowercase, not IP, no localhost/local/internal/lan/home.arpa suffix, valid labels, and at least one letter to reject numeric address forms.

Only proven absence counts: deadlines (probeCtx.Err != nil), session cancellation, cli_failed, malformed_cli, and setup/usage faults never increment misses and break consecutive sequence; unknown output never proves loss.
User sees adapter refuses to start or input receipt says verified false; logs name private state directory required, invalid profiles, monotonic completion refused, or post-input proof missing.
User sees create refused with host MemAvailable below floor plus incumbent reserves, or adapter exits 2 with unsupported arguments on bad CLI use.
User sees stream drop or frames stop: logs show registered core route refused, core surface request required, dispatch error, or peer credentials refused.
Capture, remarshal, or publish failure runs compensate which issues destroy under WithoutCancel with 30s timeout and returns CreationError with surface id, cause, rollback.
Preserves committed identity when initial capture fails, including when verified compensation cannot complete; Unwrap joins Cause and Rollback.
Returns invalid list snapshot when JSON is malformed, schema is not surface_event/v0.2, event is not created, unknown fields exist, or surface id is empty.
Fails closed with configuration fault on bad env, non-private state dir, wrong owner, bad profiles, unavailable CLOCK_MONOTONIC, or invalid startup hello envelope.
Returns last frame when deadline nears or context expires without change; capture errors propagate unless a prior frame exists and only the bounded context expired.
Maps errors through capsule WireCode into surface_event error with surface id, code, detail; falls back to MsgID when surface id is absent.
Post-check failure destroys only the new surface under a 30s detached context; unverified removal or rollback error returns CreationError with cause and rollback.
Augments refusal with counted records and foreign share, directing operators to dry-run reclaim only after proving native containers absent.
Prints adapter unsupported arguments, startup cancelled, one runtime required, or policy and handler required to stderr; connect or serve errors also map to exit 2.
Abnormal read, framing, validation, route, schema, auth, dispatch, or write failure records first session error, cancels session, joins workers, and returns it.
Bind, publisher, subscribe, or unsubscribe errors map through wireFailure to surface_event error; successful unsubscribe returns no replies.
Requires non-nil capsule Manager and frames Publisher; returns an ipc.Handler taking ctx and envelope and returning JSON replies or error.
Takes ctx, empty args, stderr writer, and optional single Runtime; returns process exit code 0 on success or 2 on usage and startup errors.
Requires validated IPC config, non-nil policy and handler, and registration from core to daemon with session id; registration body is the local daemon hello.
Intercepts frame_subscribe and frame_unsubscribe requests; all other operations pass to the next handler unchanged.
Decodes envelope body header, short-circuits hello/v0.2, decodes capsule.Request, calls manager.Handle, rewrites list via listSnapshots or runs create capture-publish path.

Create resolves profile, delegates to dispatch handler, registers recorder surface, records frame_ready refs, and marks agent surfaces owned. Input carries checked native evidence directly, never from cache.
Reconciles own reservation records, counts directory entries, pre-checks RAM, persists reservation before spawn, runs create under grace context, then post-checks RAM.
Reader validates framing, route, schema, authentication, and replay reservation, then routes keepalive, hello, policy refusal, frame refusal, control, or data queue.
Session carries ctx, work mutex, surface locks, and synchronous bounded emit used by subscriptions, recorder polling, and liveness monitor.
Create must return exactly one created event with a surface id; human-role openings return immediately with no agent frame consumer or capture.
Rewrites each created snapshot to state_changed after strict validation; error events pass through unchanged.
Anchors replay creation to a canonical no-symlink walk: absolute clean path, O_NOFOLLOW per component, only final component may be mkdir 0700.
Failed inputs settle verified false with last wire frame as diagnostic context only; human input without baseline emits diagnostic frame_ref and error instead of proof.
Only drained agent type and key inputs settle up to 1500ms at 50ms intervals waiting for SHA change; clicks and human input keep existing capture policy.
Rejects second hello with handshake fault and requires session emission; MV_RING_FPS defaults to 60 and MV_CAPTURE_RING selects ring source.
Refuses with RAM_ADMISSION_REFUSED when memory unreadable, total zero, available above total, live negative, reserve multiplication overflows, or available below floor plus reserves.
Uses MV_RAM_ADMISSION_DIR or XDG runtime metaviewer ram-admission; requires uid-owned 0700 directory opened via canonical walk before flock.
Writes one fsynced 0600 file per reserved profile named owner hash plus profile; removes only own stale names and never reclaims other owners on PID death.
Requires absolute clean existing canonical RAM roots with no symlinks and pairwise disjoint paths; nested roots are rejected.
Refuses non-Unix peers, unadmitted UIDs, and envelopes whose schema, From, To, SessionID, Seq, or Nonce break the registered core route.
Core liveness probe is answered in the reader before any queue and never reaches the handler or capsule state, protecting the core idle deadline.
Parses surface_id with bounded ParseLine; unsubscribe drains before manager mutex because in-flight CLI capture holds that mutex until subscription cancels.
Floor is min of 20 GiB and MemTotal divided by 4; each incumbent reservation costs 512 MiB matching the frame budget.
Human-role openings never start a frame poll; agent subscriptions require the publisher for the binding profile RAM root.

daemon-adapter/internal/frames captures native surfaces into verified RGB24 frame_refs and optional DISPLAY taps. Subscriptions runs the per-surface 2-stage poll/publishLoop pipeline with TryLock capture, dedup, stage p50/p95 summaries and capture_failed/lost handling. Publisher verifies PNG sources via no-follow traversal, opaque-alpha and SHA checks, then atomic link into a tmpfs ring with time/byte eviction. RingSource/SelectRingSource optionally replaces legacy CLI capture with shared-memory ring.rgb24 resident reads. DisplayTaps independently consumes W8U/XWD from docker srf-fbread into per-surface tmpfs displayRing mmap with seqlock. displayRing and frames define the ring file and frame_ref/v0.2 plus an unsupported Backend stub. diag_limiter aggregates skipped_polls and stage_summary cadence (30s, 5s verbose). Offers frame_ready events, DISPLAY rings and diagnostics; needs RAM tmpfs roots, capsule bindings, vqa-ring group and DISPLAY config.

User sees one adapter: surface <id> skipped_polls=N line every 30s instead of per miss; with MV_ADAPTER_DIAG=verbose they see a line per miss. Absence of lines does not mean no misses, only window not yet expired.

User sees no DISPLAY image but VERIFIED capture continues; Diagnostics shows adapter: DISPLAY tap <id>: session ended: <err> or resolve error. Stderr tail is appended as (sender stderr: ...) when present.
Viewer sees frozen or missing DISPLAY image when ring open fails; Diagnostics/log shows DISPLAY requires private tmpfs directory ... or unsafe stale DISPLAY ring instead of frame content.
Viewer sees stale or missing frame with no crash; downstream gets capture_failed event; logs show only generic refusal, so geometry/hash/capacity causes are indistinguishable to user.
User sees capture_mode=legacy reason=<detail> line at startup when ring refused; after ring selected, stale/torn frames appear as capture_failed events with no silent fallback to legacy capture.

User sees adapter: surface <id> skipped_polls=N total_skipped_polls=M and periodic stage_summary samples with p50/p95 ms lines every 30s (5s verbose); missing lines mean window not expired, not zero misses.

If Admit fails, records error, logs adapter: DISPLAY tap refused by RAM admission once and returns without retry. If Resolve or validDisplayTarget fails, records typed refusal, emits adapter: DISPLAY tap <id>: resolve error, and returns.

Control header mismatch, END length error, unexpected HELLO, framing without hello, frame header/dimension/stride/digest mismatch, leg length error, or XWD geometry error each returns DISPLAY control/HELLO/framing/header/geometry error and retires session.

Invalid target, unsafe dir/file, or mmap/truncate/chmod failure returns error and closes partial state; never follows links or reclaims special files; caller surfaces error via DisplayTaps session diag.
RGB length mismatch returns DISPLAY RGB length; target change after open returns DISPLAY ring geometry changed; nil file lazily reopens with new target.
Any Subscribe/Unsubscribe call fails with unsupported fault; callers must use Subscriptions/Publisher path instead of this Backend.
Path escape, symlink, non-regular, wrong uid/group bits, nlink!=1, size out of range, short read, or mtime/content change between stats returns frameError or IO error and disables skip gate.
Bad PNG magic/IHDR dims, decode error, bounds mismatch, non-opaque alpha, or sha mismatch returns frameError; caller treats as publish failure without writing lease.
Over per-surface slots/bytes or global total after oldest-first eviction down to 2-generation floor returns frameError without writing; unlink failure mid-commit returns frame lease release error.

Non-absolute/unclean path, openat failure, non-tmpfs, missing nosuid/nodev/noexec flags, mode!=02770, uid/gid mismatch, or bad run/window component yields ring_root/ring_wire/ring_missing/ring_hostile.

Zero/multiple entries, non ring.rgb24 name, mode!=0640, bad uid/gid/nlink, short header, size mismatch, torn double-read, digest mismatch, or all-stale yields ring_length/hostile/geometry/stale/torn; final header/stat recheck can still fail hostile.
Invalid id, duplicate subscription, capacity reached, closed session, or cancelled parent returns inactive session/invalid identity, already subscribed, or capacity error without starting goroutine.
Publish error triggers adapter: surface <id> error line plus capture_failed event with skipped_polls; emit error joins publish+delivery errors, sends one bounded failure notice, then terminates task.
capture_failed event built via capsule.NewErrorEvent code capture_failed detail capture, publication or delivery refused (skipped_polls=N); marshal failure itself becomes terminal task error.

Subscriptions calls initSurface on poll start, recordSkippedPolls on missed deadlines, allowErrorOrWarning before error/warning lines; writeSessionCloseSkippedPolls emits final total at session close.

NewDisplayTaps binds ctx/cfg; Start launches per-surface goroutine if MV_DISPLAY_TAP != off and id matches ringComponent; StartReplies starts taps on frame_ready with Generation>0 or created events with SurfaceID.
Stop cancels one task and waits for done or caller ctx; Close marks closed, cancels all tasks then Stops each joining errors; Err returns last tap refusal/termination error per surface.
DisplayRingPath builds <runtime>/metaviewer/display/<id>.ring; open creates/mmaps file; publish copies RGB into alternating slot with seqlock; close unmaps, closes and removes path.

NewPublisher validates config and creates private output dir under RAMRoot; Publish/PublishForced write unconditionally, PublishIfChanged/PublishWithTimings deduplicate when enabled; all funnel to internal publish.

SelectRingSource wraps legacy Source with RingSource and RingPollInterval; NewRingSource checks vqa-ring group and validates root; Capture resolves binding then reads ring and retains max two payloads per surface.
UseRingSource binds handoff before subscriptions; PublishRGB24 publishes retained raw by seq/path match; Forget clears pinned geometry and payloads after subscriptions drain or hostile root.

NewSubscriptions validates bounded deps and spawns cancellable scope; Subscribe starts poll+publishLoop goroutines; Unsubscribe cancels, drains with ShutdownTimeout and clears failure; Close cancels all and unsubscribes each.
Input missed count accumulates into surfaceSkipWindow.windowSkipped; on window expiry returns summed count with true signalling caller to emit one aggregated line, else returns 0,false to suppress.

ResolveDisplayTarget derives target from capsule.Binding native state file <stateDir>/<container>.json, parsing XID, geometry, display; validDisplayTarget enforces display ^:[0-9]+$, container/run shape, XID!=0, 1..4096 dimensions.
publish validates RGB length W*H*3, bumps seq odd during copy then even after, selects slot (next/2)%2, copies RGB, stores mono timestamp, publishes generation/width/stride in header at open.

readSource opens PNG via dir-fd traversal with no-follow, checks owner/mode/nlink/size/immutability, then decodeAndVerifyPNG checks IHDR dims, decodes PNG, enforces opaque alpha, hashes RGB24 and compares to f.SHA256RGB24 before atomic write-link.

read validates dir/file, header, geometry, scans slots with double-read torn check, digest match and mono age, keeps best seq payload; take matches by path/seq/generation/sha and dequeues for Publisher rawMode.

poll captures under per-surface lock with CaptureTimeout into pipeCh; publishLoop publishes via Publisher, marshals frame_ready surface_event/v0.2, emits with CaptureTimeout; delivery failure terminates subscription with retained error.
Ref schema frame_ref/v0.2 carries surface_id, generation, tick, ts_ns, width/height, format rgb24, ramws_path, sha256, capture_us; produced by Publisher.publish per accepted frame.

All bound violations return generic frame identity, allocation or pixels refused without detail; RAMRoot must be cleaned absolute under /dev/shm/; MaxRetained !=1, retention <=60s, surface<=256MiB, total<=1024MiB.
Source.Capture supplies binding/frame; optional LossMarker stages/rolls back lost event and coordinates delivery; Emit must honor context; delivery failure terminates instead of queueing.
User sees daemon never connects or drops immediately: wrong SessionID/endpoints, peer UID mismatch, or core hello missing causes instant Connect return with registration/credential/route error.
User sees valid-looking request rejected: closed v0.2 envelope/body refused appears when an extra field, wrong const, second oneOf match, or b64/byte_count mismatch occurs.
Operator sees daemon refuses all traffic at startup: malformed contract schema means deployed schema files are broken, not client data; needs schema redeploy.
User sees connections silently dropped and log line adapter: connection refused; caused by wrong UID peer, non-hello first frame, bad seq/nonce, or failed reserve.
Operator sees daemon will not start listening: unsafe runtime/socket directory, symlink parent, already-served socket, or unproven stale socket error.
Dial non-UnixConn gives unix peer required; PeerCred/PeerAdmitted failure gives core peer credentials refused; hello handler error aborts before first write.
Route mismatch (schema/from/to/session/Seq==0/empty Nonce) gives registered core route refused; wrong body gives core surface request required; both fail session then exitLoop.
Abnormal read/framing/validation/route/schema/auth failures cancel session before worker join; clean EOF drains lanes without sessionErr; sessionErr checked on exit.
Violations surface as string/depth/key/array limit, invalid or duplicate key, unclosed container, extra JSON value, invalid encoding, lone surrogate escape.
NewPolicy fails on bad Config, nil source/authority, missing/undecodable envelope.schema.json, nonlocal ref, bad fragment/pointer, open/empty/cyclic schema.
ValidateEnvelope fails with frame limit, JSON bound error, or closed v0.2 envelope/body refused when accept or terminal length check rejects.
PeerCred fails on SyscallConn/Control/GetsockoptUcred errors; PeerAdmitted false when cred.UID != cfg.UID, causing credential refusal upstream.
Any peer/framing/ValidateEnvelope/version/Authenticate/Reserve/handler/Wrap/Write failure logs adapter: connection refused and drops that connection without reply.
Post-handler ctx.Err checks prevent late Wrap/write after cancellation; defer conn.Close reclaims fd when ctx-ignoring handler eventually returns.
If ctx-ignoring handler exceeds ShutdownTimeout, Serve returns handler shutdown deadline exceeded joined with accept error rather than hanging.
Dial probe success means socket already served; non-ECONNREFUSED means staleness unproven; SameFile change means changed during probe; all refuse bind.
Connect(ctx,cfg,policy,registration,handler) requires cfg.Validate, non-nil policy/handler, registration core->daemon with SessionID; else complete client registration required.
NewPolicy(c,source,authority) validates Config, requires schema FS and authority, resolves envelope.schema.json, demands closed v0.2 envelope with body choices.
ValidateEnvelope(raw) enforces frame size, ValidateJSON, schema accept, terminal length check, then unmarshals to Envelope; unconfigured policy errors.
Policy callers must run ValidateEnvelope on complete closed body before Reserve; Reserve must survive reconnect/restart; Wrap allocates adapter seq/identity.
Serve(ctx,listener,cfg,policy,handler,log) validates cfg, requires listener/policy/handler/log; cancels per-connection context on shutdown.
Listen(ctx,cfg) requires live ctx, valid cfg, absolute SocketPath whose parent is a 0700 UID-owned non-symlink dir.
RuntimeSocketPath(runtimeDir,uid) demands absolute 0700 UID-owned non-symlink dir, creates metaviewer subdir 0700, returns surfaces.sock path.
Outbound path: handler replies -> policy.Wrap under authority mutex -> json.Marshal -> ValidateEnvelope outbound contract -> Framer.Write under outbound mutex.
Inbound path: Framer.Read -> ValidateEnvelope -> body schema/component check -> Authenticate+Reserve under authority lock -> dataIn or ctrlCh dispatch.
Read uses bufio ReadSlice loop handling ErrBufferFull; Write validates then writes LF-terminated frame with write deadline from arm().
Schemas load lazily from fs.FS via ReadFile+UseNumber decode, cached by file#fragment; JSON pointer fragments unescape ~1/~0; compile builds schemaNode tree.
Raw bytes -> length check -> ValidateJSON -> generic decode -> envelope.accept -> terminalLengthsOK -> typed Envelope unmarshal and return.
Per connection: PeerCred admit -> NewFramer -> Read (hello timeout on first) -> ValidateEnvelope -> hello/version check -> Authenticate -> Reserve -> handler -> Wrap/Marshal/Write.
Handler(ctx,Envelope) returns reply bodies; Serve wraps each via policy.Wrap, marshals, Framer.Write synchronously to retain backpressure, no send queue.
Registration Body is locally configured daemon hello, never peer data; first admitted frame must be hello/v0.2 from core, later only surface_request/v0.2.
Write refuses len>=MaxFrameBytes or embedded CR/LF as invalid outbound frame, validates JSON, appends LF and loops short writes; zero write is ErrShortWrite.
Read strips trailing LF, rejects overflow beyond MaxFrameBytes as frame limit exceeded, maps bare-EOF-with-bytes to UnexpectedEOF, then ValidateJSON.
Envelope requires schema/msg_id/ts_ns/from/to/session_id/seq/nonce/body; SenderKey is session+component+instance for replay reservation.
Only closed schemas: additionalProperties must be false; open type unions, unknown types/keywords, empty oneOf, nonlocal refs are refused at compile.
Every frame must be envelope/v0.2 with Seq!=0, Nonce!="", core->daemon; first body must be hello/v0.2; no version fallback, successor union hello only in v0.2.
RAMWS paths must match ^/dev/shm(/[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}){1,8}$, len 10-255; segment regex checked per part, no network resolution.
Rendezvous dirs must be Lstat dir, perm exactly 0700, owned by uid; any deviation is unsafe runtime directory.
CloseListener removes only the inode stored at Listen; if path now differs (SameFile false) it reports socket replaced before cleanup and keeps new file.

Manages bounded RAM screen recordings and authorized tar exports. record.go owns Manager lifecycle: NewManager/NewFromEnvironment validate Runner/Clock, RingBytes, MaxFPS, BinDir and Destination; Handle parses record_request/v0.2 and admits ram_start/disk_start/stop/screenshot under identity/surface/budget checks; Poll delegates to capture; stop seals (disk exports first); Release reclaims owned copies with tombstones; Close/UnregisterSurface/Abort seal and wipe RAM. capture.go implements frame capture: runs surface helper, validates frameReply metadata/window/generation/mono/rate/geometry/RAM-root, verifies PNG and per-pixel hash, stores owned copy in ring with eviction; plus export/exportDir/exportFile with pre-hashed tar, byte bounds, O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW and dev/ino pinning. Offers Handle/Poll/Release/Close/Abort; needs capsule Runner, Clock/originNS, absolute BinDir, /dev/shm tmpfs, Destination capability.
User sees recording stops or gaps: stale or over-rate frame, PNG geometry mismatch, RGB witness mismatch, frame exceeds ring/memory, or outside RAM root.
User sees stop/export refused: destination already exists, destination cannot be opened, grant was replaced, export exceeds byte bound, digest mismatch.
User sees start rejected as recording identity was already used after any prior use including released tombstones; must use fresh recording id.
User sees disk stop with empty tar plus refused/export error: destination unset, not authorized, already exists, unavailable, or over byte bound.
export without Destination returns DESTINATION_UNSET refusal; suffix .tar or grantIsDir selects exportDir else exportFile.
exportDir fails with DESTINATION_UNAVAILABLE on bad path, over-bound archive, missing frame, header/payload/seek/close errors, grant replaced, open failure.
exportFile same bounds plus invalid file path for / or non-clean path; open uses O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW so existing file yields DESTINATION_EXISTS.
safeErrDetail unwraps Path/Link/Syscall errors to inner cause, returns fallback when empty or containing / to avoid leaking paths.
Handle refuses POLICY for bad bounds, unadmitted surface, already-used identity, inactive stop; BUDGET_EXCEEDED for over-limit ring/fps or session memory exceeded.
Sealed ram/screenshot disk_start with same surface retries export; export Refusal mapped to refused event, other errors to DESTINATION_UNAVAILABLE with safe detail.
Release returns unknown recording when absent, recording is active when unsealed, raw remove error on owned-copy failure; Close seals all and nils frames.
capture(ctx,requestID,id,r) looks up Surfaces[r.surface], builds BinDir/Family frame --container (+--window for identity), refuses protected containers.
NewManager validates Runner/Clock, RingBytes 1..1GiB and <=MemoryBytes, MaxFPS 1..120, BinDir absolute, Destination/capability, surface bindings.
NewFromEnvironment(originNS,clock) requires nonzero origin and clock, allowlists 7 env keys, builds 1MiB/90s runner, optional MV_RECORDING_DESTINATION.
Handle(ctx,raw) parses closed record_request/v0.2, enforces identities/ceiling/surface, routes ram/disk_stop, disk export-retry, start or screenshot.
Poll(ctx,requestID,id) requires live recorder, identity requestID, unsealed recording; delegates to capture under manager lock.
Runner.Run -> ParseLine frameReply -> seq/geom/mono checks -> window/generation checks -> ramFile read (ring+1 cap) -> PNG decode -> per-pixel hash -> temp copy.
parse uses ParseLine 1MiB for request then params, demands record_request/v0.2 + identity RequestID, per-op closed param set, exact field count, no null/missing.
Handle: base event with capped mono -> surface admitted -> stop vs sealed-disk-export vs new reservation (budget/memory checks) -> started or screenshot chain.
frameReply needs Seq>0, Width/Height>0, MonoNS>=OriginNS and <=2^53-1; generation from Seq or Generation numeric/string; window/state optional.
Holdings capsule must carry no Window; identity surfaces need window ID==Surface.Window and W/H equal Width/Height, else invalid frame window binding.
Frame path must satisfy under(/dev/shm,FramesRoot) and under(FramesRoot,Path); file must be regular tmpfs via ramFile, else outside RAM/not-regular/not-tmpfs.
Allowed params: ram_start surface+recording+ring+max_fps; disk_start surface+recording+capability+path+max_fps; stops none extra; screenshot surface+capture only.
Disk destination must exactly equal configured CapabilityID+Path and be clean absolute; else DESTINATION_UNSET not-authorized refusal.
Hard ceiling capBytes 1GiB bounds ring, memory and tar block sum; per-request ring/fps must also fit configured RingBytes/MaxFPS and session MemoryBytes.
Mono timestamps are session-relative (MonoNS-OriginNS) and capped at 2^53-1 for wire safety; larger values rejected as invalid frame metadata.
Monotonicity + rate: generation must increase, mono>=lastNS, gap>=1e9/fps; else stale or over-rate frame. Geometry checked before decode/alloc.
IDs match ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,127}$; identity surfaces need window ^w[0-9]+$; families only srf-identity-surface/srf-holdings-capsule; FramesRoot under /dev/shm.
Paths must be absolute <=4096 Clean==self no NUL/CR/LF; under() requires Rel not . .. hidden or absolute, enforcing RAM-root containment.
Clock mono capped at 2^53-1; exceeding sets withinCeiling false and Handle refuses with monotonic clock exceeded wire ceiling.
Ring states: compute evicted/dropped to fit size+new<=ring; remove oldest files; on remove error truncate kept prefix and abort new copy; emit dropped then frame_captured.
Recording: created unsealed ram/disk/screenshot -> Poll appends frames -> sealed by stop/screenshot/Close/UnregisterSurface; sealed frames counted retained after eviction.
Release only sealed captures: removes owned RAM copies, keeps reservation on failure for retry, then tombstones id in released and deletes record; no release event on wire.
Single mu guards records/released/config/closed/hooks; Handle/Poll/stop/Register/Unregister/Release serialize; PollInterval/CanStop/Default* read under lock.
Close RemoveAll private RAM root only, never producer frames; ramFile enforces /dev/shm prefix, O_NOFOLLOW open, regular file, tmpfs magic or rejected.
Destination traversal uses pinned descriptors from / with O_NOFOLLOW|O_DIRECTORY; symlink races fail closed; grant dev/ino pin detects replacement.
Refusals carry POLICY codes (UNSET/EXISTS/UNAVAILABLE) distinct from raw errors; export fallthrough converts non-Refusal failures to DESTINATION_UNAVAILABLE.
Abort silently drops active recording and owned copies for failed initial poll; Release tombstone means aborted id can never be reused.
MemoryBytes/RingBytes/MaxFPS bound all admissions; defaults from env are 64MiB/8MiB/30; BinDir from MV_SRF_BIN_DIR; Destination only from MV_RECORDING_DESTINATION.

daemon-adapter/internal/view isolates foreground capsule view lifecycle. process.go ProcessRunner launches srf-identity-surface view/login helper in its own process group, enforces strict private state-dir checks, and separates the one-line readiness announcement from completion with 30s deadline. view.go Manager multiplexes one active view per capsule with busy/closed guards, login-gated paste, and validated stop/paste receipts. Open starts helper, parses ViewInfo announcement, registers Process and reaps via Done watcher; Stop/Paste delegate to bounded short runner view-stop/paste-text. Offers Open/Stop/Paste/Close; needs trusted host env (PATH/HOME/XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/MV_SRF_STATE_DIR plus SRF_* keys, MV_SRF_BIN_DIR), absolute 0700 state dir owned by euid, valid capsule ids.
Operator sees view unavailable or already registered when reopening same capsule, operating while busy, or after manager closed.
Agent sees paste refused as login view required when targeting a non-login view, or usage error for empty/oversize/non-UTF8 text.
Operator sees view launch failed, private state directory required/owner mismatch, exited before announcement, or readiness deadline after 30s hang.
Start fails on protected container, usage/invalid command, cancelled ctx, bad state dir/owner, launch error, fast exit without line, 30s readiness deadline.
Fast helper may announce then exit before scheduler resumes: selects done branch yet still drains ready; missing line maps ExitError via ExitFault.
check fails on protected container, cancelled ctx, bad capsule id, nil runner; Open/Stop/Paste surface those as usage/configuration/refused faults.
Start only accepts [srf-identity-surface view|login --container ID]; validates state dir before exec, waits 30s for first announcement line.
Run only allows srf-identity-surface view-stop|paste-text; rewrites argv[0] to BinDir join and delegates to bounded short runner.
Open(ctx,id,login) checks capsule, refuses when closed/views/busy, starts helper, parses announcement, registers view, reaps via Done watcher.
Stop runs view-stop and validates receipt; Paste demands 1..16384 valid UTF-8, login view, runs paste-text --file - and checks rune receipt.
Open: busy mark -> runner.Start -> parseInfo -> store active -> background Done deletes entry; finish clears busy and idle channel.
Announcement must parse ViewInfo with http URL host 127.0.0.1 valid port 1..65535 no user/fragment, Native non-empty, Socket absolute; else malformed_cli.
Stop receipt needs stopped_view==id, PID>1, seconds 0..60; Paste receipt needs container==id and pasted_runes==RuneCount(text); else malformed_cli.
Capsule ids match ^srf-(id|pg|vm)-[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,39}$; protected containers refused before any runner or state check.
State dir must be absolute Clean==self, IsDir, no symlink, mode exactly 0700, uid==euid; whole path walked with O_NOFOLLOW from / so swap fails closed.
process.go ProcessRunner launches the foreground view helper in its own process group and separates the one-line readiness announcement from completion.
view.go Manager bridges operator views without agent admission: one active view per capsule, busy guard, login-gated paste, validated stop receipts.
Lifecycle: absent -> busy(opening) -> views[id] active -> busy(op) -> deleted on Stop/child-Done/Close; double open or op-while-busy refused.
announcementWriter captures only first newline line up to 65536 bytes; overflow sends nil; later output drained without retention; sent flag one-shot.
Helper owns dedicated process group; Cancel sends SIGINT, WaitDelay 15s lets read-only restore finish; waiter always follows with SIGKILL then cancel/reap.
Close marks closed, cancels manager ctx (cancels starts), closes each child, waits for busy idle up to 5s; Done watcher cleans exited views under lock.
Never derive PIDs from stdout; killGroup validates pid>1 and !=self/pgrp, maps ESRCH to ErrProcessDone; parent pid reuse cannot signal wrong group.
One Process per capsule held in views map with Close func; child stdout/stderr not retained; Close reaps all; idle channel tracks busy drain.
Trusted host env only: PATH/HOME/XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/MV_SRF_STATE_DIR plus 3 SRF_* keys; BinDir from MV_SRF_BIN_DIR; state dir split out of child env.
Short commands share capsule.NewProcessRunner(root,env,64K,1min); long Start uses exec directly; faults via cli.Fault/ExitFault/ParseLine 64K.
WithoutCancel detaches child lifetime from caller cancel except explicit paths; manager AfterFunc ties startCtx to manager Close to avoid orphan helpers.

scripts/ provides offline-first automation for building, verifying, and judging MetaViewer. bootstrap.sh is the local build bootstrap: validates MV_PKG_OUT, CAPSULE_UI_KIT_REPO and Electron location, runs ui/test/nesting.test.js then execs ui/tools/package.js. volume_e2e.py is the offline volume entry: checks volume.yml, prepares staged kit offline (sync_kit, Node>=24, npm ci --offline, pinned electron 44.9.2, local zip staging, xvfb check), then runs tests/e2e/run.py N times. scripts/judge/ installs, checks, launches and stops the judge host: metaviewer-judge.sh doctor|install|run|stop with confirmations, sanitized env, pid tracking and leak audits; preflight.sh is the read-only readiness checker with static/all phases and --facts/--sysdep-packages outputs. Install flow is static preflight, sysdeps, Node 24, app extract, AppArmor, smoke, optional T2 capsule assets/profile/firewall/images/net, final preflight and judge_receipt.json pinning tier/arch/versions/hashes to drive run tier. Offers typed JUDGE_*/E2E_PREREQ/BLOCKED errors, receipts, and stop-clean guarantees. Needs Ubuntu 24.04, x86_64/aarch64, Node 24, pinned kit assets with SHA256, local Electron files, npm cache, Docker for T2, X11 display, XDG runtime, tmpfs SHM, RAM/CPU/disk headroom and capsule network ranges.
User sees immediate shell error naming the missing variable, or 'Set MV_ELECTRON_ZIP_DIR...' message, or node test failures, with no package produced. No log file is written.
User sees E2E_PREREQ:... on stderr for offline violations, BLOCKED:... for missing harness, or per-iteration volume-e2e i/N PASS on stdout. prepare-only exits 0 after staging.

User sees confirmation prompts for downloads and each administrator step, JUDGE_NOTE lines for firewall fallback/decline, JUDGE_INSTALL_OK, JUDGE_DOCTOR_OK, METAVIEWER_MAIN_SMOKE_OK, JUDGE_STOP_CLEAN, or typed JUDGE_* fix lines.
Tester sees JUDGE_PREFLIGHT_OK tier/phase on success, or stderr JUDGE_<CODE>: ... -- fix: ... lines plus JUDGE_PREFLIGHT_FAIL count, and JUDGE_NOTE/JUDGE_OS warnings that do not fail.
If MV_PKG_OUT unset/empty, shell exits non-zero with 'Set an external build output directory'. Same pattern for CAPSULE_UI_KIT_REPO with 'Set the pinned kit checkout'.
If both MV_ELECTRON_ZIP_DIR and ELECTRON_OVERRIDE_DIST_PATH empty/unset, prints 'Set MV_ELECTRON_ZIP_DIR or ELECTRON_OVERRIDE_DIST_PATH to local Electron files' to stderr and exits 1.
If node --test nesting.test.js fails, set -e stops run so package.js never executes. If package.js fails, exec exit status propagates as script exit status.
Absent run.py raises BLOCKED:... which main maps to exit 2; all other OSError/ValueError/RuntimeError/CalledProcessError print to stderr and exit 1.
Node version unparsable or major<24 raises E2E_PREREQ Node >=24. Electron package version !=44.9.2 raises pin mismatch; binary version output !=v44.9.2 raises binary mismatch.
Electron staging needs MV_ELECTRON_ZIP_DIR plus known arch else local archive required; checksum mismatch vs checksums.json, or existing dist present, raises E2E_PREREQ and aborts.
All refusals print JUDGE_<CODE>: <problem> -- fix: <command> to stderr and exit 2. Usage errors print JUDGE_USAGE and exit 64. Identity store contents are never read.
Node path: reuse JUDGE_HOME/node or PATH node if major>=24, else unpack only */bin/node from node-linux tarball. Wrong major fails JUDGE_NODE requiring Node 24 asset.
Smoke requires PKG_TOOL present, --verify-install passes, then 600s timeout --smoke passes and prints METAVIEWER_MAIN_SMOKE_OK. Else JUDGE_SMOKE with last 3 log lines.
Run fails JUDGE_NOT_INSTALLED when APP_BIN not executable or receipt absent; fails JUDGE_RUNNING when running_pid finds live metaviewer pid. Stop-then-run is the fix.
Stop waits STOP_WAIT seconds after SIGTERM polling every 0.2s; overtime fails JUDGE_STOP_TIMEOUT. Any leftover container/socket/RAM/admission item prints JUDGE_STOP_LEAK and exits 2.
Unknown uname -m fails JUDGE_ARCH directing to x86_64/aarch64 64-bit Linux only.
Missing node or major<24 fails JUDGE_NODE pointing at judge install for Node 24 from kit.
Any missing tool in SYSDEP_BASE (plus docker for T2) fails JUDGE_SYSDEP with sudo apt-get install -y <pkgs> fix.
When apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=1 and profile differs from kit apparmor/metaviewer, fails JUDGE_USERNS; fix is judge install, never --no-sandbox.
With xdpyinfo present: empty DISPLAY fails JUDGE_DISPLAY (Wayland-only vs no session distinguished); unreachable DISPLAY fails too with XWayland/xvfb-run fix.
SHM must be tmpfs with 512MiB free (T1) or 2.5GiB (T2); wrong fstype or low space fails JUDGE_SHM with mount/remount fix. MUT:JUDGE_SHM is deciding predicate.
Needs floor(total/4 capped at 20GiB)+4GiB available; shortfall fails JUDGE_RAM with close-apps/RAM/.wslconfig fix. Unreadable meminfo fails asking to mount /proc.
DOCKER_HOST/CONTEXT set fails JUDGE_DOCKER_HOST. docker info failure, rootless engine, or non-unix endpoint fails JUDGE_DOCKER; Docker Desktop fails JUDGE_DOCKER_DESKTOP.
Home and Docker-root free space each need 30GB else JUDGE_DISK with free-space/docker prune fix, reporting measured GB values.
Invoked as bash script with no arguments. Control enters via environment: MV_PKG_OUT, CAPSULE_UI_KIT_REPO required; MV_ELECTRON_ZIP_DIR or ELECTRON_OVERRIDE_DIST_PATH required; MV_NODE_BIN optional.
CLI argparse: --iterations 20|300 default 20, --prepare-only, --check-workflow. Reads .github/workflows/volume.yml for check mode, else prepare then loop subprocess run of tests/e2e/run.py.
Entry is metaviewer-judge.sh doctor|install|run|stop [--capsules] [--yes] [--no-firewall]. Invalid subcommand or flag calls usage which prints JUDGE_USAGE and exits 64.
Derives root from BASH_SOURCE parent, resolves node_bin from MV_NODE_BIN or node, runs nesting test file under root, then exec replaces process with package.js. No output file written here.

prepare resolves kit, runs node tools/sync_kit.mjs, asserts node --version major>=24, npm ci --offline when vite missing, verifies electron 44.9.2 pin plus binary, stages dist from local zip when not executable, xvfb-runs electron --version.
Assets come from KIT/assets or MV_JUDGE_ASSET_DIR; missing names are listed with RELEASE_BASE URL, confirmed, fetched with curl --proto =https, then every named asset is hash-checked before use.

Receipt judge_receipt.json records schema, version, tier, arch, network_mode, node_version, docker version, smoke marker, profile_id, measured nproc/mem/shm facts, asset name-to-sha256 map; no timestamp, pid or host path.
Facts path reads meminfo, /dev/shm availability, node --version, arch, nproc, and open_ready to emit arch/nproc/mem_total_kib/mem_available_kib/shm_avail_bytes/node_version/network lines.
Sysdep path maps required tools to apt packages (base plus docker.io for T2) and lists missing package names once each for the installer to consume.
