Every asset must match kit SHA256SUMS entry from sums_digest. Mismatch fails JUDGE_ASSET; files this run downloaded are deleted. SHA256SUMS itself ships in kit and is never downloaded.
Tarballs must have no absolute paths, no .. members, match expected name regex, and contain only regular files/dirs (no links). App tarball must yield executable MetaViewer-linux-<arch>/metaviewer.
Kit must contain metaviewer-linux-<host-arch>.tar.gz; only-other-arch kit fails JUDGE_BUNDLE_ARCH. Installed ELF e_machine must equal 62 (x64) or 183 (arm64) else counted and refused.
sudo only via sudo_step which prints description and exact quoted command, then confirm asks; --yes is the only non-interactive consent. Returns 0 ok, 99 declined, 98 sudo missing, else command rc.
refuse increments FAILS and prints JUDGE_CODE: problem -- fix: command. Final FAILS>0 prints JUDGE_PREFLIGHT_FAIL tier/phase/count exit 2, else JUDGE_PREFLIGHT_OK.
Judge installer/runner for MetaViewer: doctor checks only, install provisions app plus optional browser capsule (T2), run launches app, stop terminates app and removes leftover capsule state.
Launch path builds a sanitized env -i allowlist, prepares recordings/state/RAM dirs, then starts MetaViewer-linux binary with --ozone-platform=x11 and tracks child via run/metaviewer.pid.
Read-only host readiness checker emitting typed JUDGE_<CODE> refusals (exit 2) or JUDGE_PREFLIGHT_OK. Never installs, writes, or escalates; sudo is never called.
User sees PASS <component>: <detail> or FAIL <component>: <detail> lines, plus FAIL deps.lock: ... on lock errors. Planner SKIP prints literal SKIP (planner not pinned yet).
User sees one JSON summary with passed/failed/skipped/source plus result/receipt or error. Live probe failures name probe child rc, missing binary, or orphan evidence blocking the gate.
User sees ERROR: ... lines on stderr for each violation, dry-run assembled changelog on stdout, silent success otherwise. Pending fragments block check mode.
Visible symptom: tester sees ERROR lines for failing schema or example and nonzero exit; passing run prints Contracts check OK message listing audited schemas and accepted and rejected examples.
Visible symptom: user sees ERROR lines naming revision and rule on stderr with nonzero exit; clean tree prints Laws check OK.
Visible symptom: designer sees PASS with measured pair count or single error line describing failing pair, token, selector or font path.

User sees one line per leg PASS <leg> or FAIL <leg> or BLOCKED <leg> plus final PASS/FAIL aggregate. Failures add diagnostics on stderr: metadata drift, pin drift, stale lock, frozen offline resolution failed, child rc, missing tool/target, marker=False, SKIPPED reason.

User sees no DONE receipt: stdout is a BLOCKED receipt with rc 5 and error code such as assertion_failed, negative_control_accepted, wender_subprocess_failed, vision_subprocess_failed, no_actionable_target, or cleanup proof missing, plus detail text.

Operator sees DEMO_REFUSED on stdout with ok false and exit 6 when ids, paths, leases, recordings, digests, site bounds or the MemoryWeb build gate fail. No native output, event text, paths or exceptions escape; only that fixed error string is printed.

Operator sees stderr hints for PROFILE_MISSING, PROFILE_NOT_PROVISIONED with sudo install -d -m 0700 -o 10001 -g 10001, RESERVED_ID, LOGIN_IN_PROGRESS or LOGIN_TERMINATED, plus stdout JSON ok false with codes such as IDENTITY_PROTECTED, IDENTITY_BOUND or NATIVE_REFUSED.

Operator sees one JSON line per reservation with action keep/would_remove/removed and reason owner_alive_or_unknown, native_capsule_present, native_inventory_unknown, or owner_dead_and_matching_native_absent. Unsafe names never disappear; dry-run changes nothing.

User sees JSON summary with rows and focused element; on drift the summary adds code MW_AX_ANCHOR_DRIFT with exit 3 and candidate names for each missing anchor. Config or native failures print a refused marker with code and detail and exit 6.

User sees one-line JSON such as ok false code MW_HOME_TRACKED, MW_HOME_NOT_IGNORED, MW_HOME_GIT, MW_WORKFLOW_ABSENT or MW_PROVENANCE. With provenance failure, faults lists one actionable line per bad site.json or workflow file naming the expected inside-sites file and hash fix.
Run stops for a human when AX shows CAPTCHA cue or sign-in dialog; observation carries observed_wall kind captcha_wall or login_wall. Nothing is clicked or solved.
Tester sees synthetic page title change to P18-TYPED plus typed value, then P18-SAVED after Persist click. Missing change means typing or persistence failed.

Observer sees Switching to target progress text, then new mode surface; missing progress raises SWITCH_PROGRESS_UNPROVEN, no flip raises SWITCH_UI_UNPROVEN, retained pane raises ENDED_LIFETIME_PANE_RETAINED.
User sees human menu Switch to agent mode, I logged in, Stop capsule above native video; agent menu adds Watch read-only and emergency take control. Missing overlay means z-order failure.
Operator sees only own dev window on :97; tile-status shows connected and readonly flags, visibility shows which tiles visible. No renderer capability or operator session reused.
Tester sees human and agent desktop buttons toggle pressed state and native tile appear or disappear; unexpected retained role or visible desktop means view leak.
Evidence shows floating native window before, moved-resized, and desktop-2 screenshots; user would see native video move, grow, hide behind menu, reappear on desktop 2.

Tester sees METAVIEWER_ROUTER_COVERAGE 100% N files when healthy; stale shows Stale or incomplete router with coverage mismatch N vs M and digest diffs or missing source <path>. Kit/mount faults show Router error: kit builder failed/timeout, corpus mismatch, mount ids != nodes ids, SHA256SUMS mismatch, or broken doc link file:line.

A user sees JSON {version,contentHash,direction} on sync success or ERROR: reason on failure; probe prints SINGLE_INSTANCE with exit 1 when locked else SPIKE_LOCK_ISOLATED with exit 0; R3 prints JSON rows baseline, bridge-cut, reconnecting-overlay-pixel, reconnected, blur-refocus, ctrl-t/w/q, final-paint to stdout and r3-live.json.

A user sees one line per example such as role_request.basic.json accepted or role_request.bad.invalid.json rejected. Success prints all lines and exits cleanly; failure prints lines up to the mismatch then an AssertionError naming the offending example file.
Vision drives VCorePerceptionAdapter on synthetic 320x200 frames with two white rectangles; timeout, probe rc, bad JSON, or changed_regions != two expected boxes yields FAIL with detail.

Any ValueError/TypeError/KeyError returns ok False with failure string: bad schema/workload/orphans/duration, short cohort, clock regression, missing role, tree<sum(parts), late first/final sample, >10s gap, or cap exceedance.

Validate failure path: type, const, enum, oneOf exactly-one-branch rule, missing required, unexpected properties, item count, string length, pattern and number bounds each raise path-prefixed ValidationError.

Fragment failure path: bad fragment path, symlink or non-regular file, invalid encoding, empty file, non-bullet line, overlong line, forbidden word, or missing fragment on product change each emit path-prefixed errors.

If a required target file/dir is absent, leaf() prints missing target: <name> and returns 2 (BLOCKED) for manifests/laws/contracts/unit/js/rust/go/ui-smoke/ui/perf, except agents absence returns 1 (FAIL). Child nonzero prints <leg>: child rc=<rc>.

Post-action path requires after sha256 differs from before, tick in [frame.tick+1, frame.tick+100], post state sha256 differs from pre_state_sha256, and post battery differs from pre battery. Violations raise post-action pixels/state did not change or tick outside window.

validate_events requires 1-501 newline rows each at most 4096 bytes, exact seq order, nondecreasing mono_ns, known kind, window wN or empty, modifier set, text_len rules, keysym allowlist, before/after frame names, int coords, dir set, and a final stop row with operator/limit/recorder_exited reason.

delete refuses protected or live ids with IDENTITY_PROTECTED, shows identity, holds the guard flock, requires lease absent or inactive else IDENTITY_BOUND, rejects symlink/non-file metadata or non-dir profiles, keeps the entry until privileged removal succeeds, then unlinks metadata and lock record but never the guard.

Pixel race MW_REBIND_PIXELS retries without submit up to 3 attempts; STALE_FRAME core refusal retries with fresh AX up to 3; other refusals raise. Exhaustion raises MW_STALE_FRAME_EXHAUSTED. Only post-receipt slot readback gets extended window.
Bad isolation throws ISOLATION_REQUIRED; lock contention logs SINGLE_INSTANCE exits 7; unknown op throws OP_REFUSED; missing tile throws VIEW_ABSENT; boot error logs and exits 1.

Missing readiness raises LIVE_GATE_UNPROVEN; absent bridge raises OWN_BRIDGE_CONNECTION_ABSENT; restart refusal on SINGLE_INSTANCE or BOOT_REFUSED; missing ready raises RESTART_NOT_READY; reopened session fails SESSION_REOPENED.
Missing element or disabled button fails click assertion; unsettled bounds raises NATIVE_BOUNDS_NOT_SETTLED; ctrl+alt+Right/Left intercepted before xpra must widen then restore width within 2 px.

Git manifest timeout/OSError/nonzero rc, non-UTF8, non-canonical, duplicate or empty universe raise RouterError printed to stderr return 1. Router error: covers malformed input/kit/protocol/symlink/prohibited path; Stale or incomplete router: covers missing source, stale bytes, doc link, mount/SHA mismatch; unknown option returns 2.

check_doc_links fails on non-UTF8 markdown, empty paren, undefined [ref], ambiguous scheme, .. escape beyond root or missing target after stripping fences/comments/code spans, citing file:line. Kit failures: missing/symlink input, bad schema, unimportable validator, builder timeout/nonzero rc/OSError raise Router error: kit builder failed.

Sync fails with kit absent when dest is not materialised, Kit metadata/pin/hash mismatch, Invalid kit lock, Kit repository/commit mismatch on HEAD or origin, symlink ancestor rejection, source-destination overlap, or activation failure with preserved backup path. All CLI failures print ERROR: message and set exitCode 1.

R3 fails with ROOT_REFUSED, CAPSULE_REFUSED, REMOTE_WITNESS_FAILED when REMOTE_PID missing or early exit, BASELINE_PAINT_ABSENT or RECOVERED_PAINT_ABSENT when cadence changed<1, RECOVERY_TIMEOUT after 20s without ready state advance, and REMOTE_KEY_MISSING when ctrl+t/w/q is not observed in r3-remote.log. Finally always kills remote and logs commands.jsonl.

Failure paths raise instead of returning codes: missing schema or example files raise OSError, malformed JSON raises json decode error, bad meta-schema raises check_schema error, and expectation mismatch raises AssertionError with the example name. Any exception stops later contracts and examples.

ui is MetaViewer desktop frontend: Vite build config, Electron main-process host, renderer app, and packaging tools. vite.config.js sets relative base, dist/renderer outDir, Vue plus kitQuarantineReason plugins, exact capsule-ui-kit aliases from .kit copy, and copies electron/preload.js to sibling preload.cjs. electron owns window lifecycle, app://metaviewer serving with strict CSP, retail/nesting validation, authorityWire IPC validation, hostBindings core socket multiplexing, coreLauncher/adapter supervision, frame/display/capture/terminal/role/Xpra/operator bridges and frozen preload facades. src boots via main.js and App.vue merging projectionView with role surfaces into wall/workspace/tiles, with scheduler/frame/display/input routers, capture/recording, multislot/terminal, catalog/demo, handoff/identities/network/nested, activity/settings/qa/agent/creative. tools builds reproducible Linux Electron app via package.js sealing and kitQuarantineReason overlay plus clean-install smoke. Offers validated surfaces, frames, input, capture, cadence, terminals and role tiles with closed copy. Needs Node>=24, pinned Electron, core/adapter binaries, MV_CORE_CONFIG, XDG runtime/config, synced .kit, storage/clipboard/DOM/clock, node-pty and display/Xpra grants.

User sees app exit immediately or no window: wrong Electron version logs ELECTRON_PIN, second instance quits with SINGLE_INSTANCE, core not live throws CORE_UNAVAILABLE, adapter not live refuses with dialog text to check MV_SRF_LIVE_PROFILE/RAM_ROOT or unset MV_SRF_BIN_DIR. Renderer sees 403 forbidden or 404 not found in bundle loads.

When surface input fails the user sees clicks, keys, typed text or scrolls do nothing. Host logs METAVIEWER_INPUT_REFUSED surface=<id> code=<CODE> count=<n> and renderer gets {ok:false,code}. Stale sequence, rate excess, unknown surface or core refusal all present this way.

When capsule creation fails the renderer gets {ok:false,code,reason,message,tone:refusal} on metaviewer:authority.createSurface plus console error for create refused. User sees closed text such as at most 4 capsules or no free profile, never CLI detail.

User presses Add capsule and nothing opens; renderer shows At most 4 capsules run at once... or Every configured profile is already in use... or No free profile has an identity yet... or identity list could not be read... Operator sees matching sentence including mv-live-2 hint. No ids/paths leak in copy.

User sees frozen or skipped frames: stale replays return STALE_FRAME_GENERATION, overloaded readers return TIMEOUT no-read-slot, closed readers return CLOSED. No pixels are delivered; caller gets {ok:false, reason, detail} and dropped leases fire onReleaseLease.

User types, clicks or scrolls and nothing moves, with refusal surfaced via onRefusal as NOT_IN_CONTROL, INPUT_MODE_READ, SURFACE_UNKNOWN, STALE_STREAM, LIMIT, NESTED_DISPLAY_ONLY, SCHEMA or CORE_UNAVAILABLE. Cause is gate closure, rate cap, oversize batch or host refusal.

User sees Connecting... before mount or when connecting, Reconnecting... when reconnecting after a prior connect, Human capsule or Read-only watch when live, Recording paused (size limit) badge, or error text with a Reopen button that clears error and retries sync().
User sees A clear view of your work with Add a capsule to bring your surfaces together in one wall and an Add capsule button when the wall has no capsules.

User sees tile freeze then visible stale badge after 2s without frames, or blank tile when binding hidden/unbound. No exception surfaces; failures appear only as HIDDEN/REFUSED acks and capped display-diagnostic posts.
Operator sees Idle, Starting, Stopping, Sealed, or ticking Recording mm:ss, with refusal or failure reason appended after a dash when a capture action was refused or failed.
User-visible build break after kit upgrade: bundler fails with error text KIT_QUARANTINE_OVERLAY_DRIFT instead of producing the app, pointing at the quarantine overlay anchors.

User sees app quit at once with no window. Terminal shows PKG_CORE_START_FAILED, PKG_SEAL_MISMATCH key, PKG_HOST_RUNTIME_UNSAFE, SINGLE_INSTANCE already running, or METAVIEWER_BOOT_REFUSED RAM_ROOT_ABSENT with mkdir -p -m 700 fix.

Installer sees PKG_MANIFEST_MISMATCH name, PKG_ALIAS_FORBIDDEN, PKG_FONT_FORBIDDEN, PKG_BINARY_MISSING name, PKG_ARCH_MISMATCH name, PKG_ELECTRON_CHECKSUM context expected versus actual; tar/launch refused rather than running tampered bytes.
If .kit not synced or package.json missing/invalid, readFileSync or JSON.parse throws at config load; Vite fails before build with ENOENT or SyntaxError, no renderer output.
If preload.js gains import or non-declaration export, writeBundle throws Preload bundling contract changed; renderer bundle already emitted but preload.cjs not written, build fails.

Retail refusal returns frozen {ok:false,code}: ARGV_SHAPE, RETAIL_FLAG on forbidden inspect/require/no-sandbox flags, RETAIL_ENV on forbidden env or packaged MV_E2E_LIVE/MV_FRAME_DIAG, NESTED_DEPTH on bad/duplicate nesting, UNKNOWN_SWITCH. Condition: dash-led token not in known runtime switches. bootProductionMain throws MainError(code).

Surface-input path: validateSurfaceInputBatch returns SCHEMA for bad keys, schema, IDs, coords or key chords, or LIMIT for over 32 events or over 16 KB encoded batch; overlong type text is SCHEMA. Refusal is logged at most once per second per surface and code burst.

Spawn null, unsafe pid, malformed handle, listener refusal, connect/handshake timeout, bad epoch, EOF/error/exit/close all move to unavailable with reasons like core spawn failed, HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT, bad authority epoch.

send returns SCHEMA for bad surface, stream or event shape or count outside 1-32, LIMIT over 16 KiB or over 60 batches per 1000 ms, CORE_UNAVAILABLE when facade missing or reply malformed, never rejecting.

Newest-only: enqueue marks in-flight superseded and settles all queued as SUPERSEDED; pump keeps only head. Older-than-current/queued/expiring arrivals refuse pre-hash so older frames never paint after newer ones.
Non-ok surface reply throws the reply code or SURFACE_CREATE_FAILED. Non-true intent or setEnabled reply throws Host acknowledgement unavailable. Invalid verdict throws Invalid verdict.

If either before string is missing or duplicated after a kit upgrade, split length check fails and the build throws KIT_QUARANTINE_OVERLAY_DRIFT; no patched source is returned and the build stops at the pre transform.

Security fail: missing app.asar or present app/app.asar.unpacked throws ASAR-only layout required; alias/unpacked entry throws refused; seal missing/invalid, asset mismatch key, inventory mismatch, entry mismatch, required entry absent all throw.

If file trace contains repo path then throw PKG_SOURCE_ACCESS. Missing host runtime dir throws PKG_HOST_RUNTIME_REQUIRED. Nonempty hostRuntime/metaviewer/ram-admission (ENOENT treated as empty) throws PKG_ADMISSION_RESERVATION_LEAK.
Entry is Vite loading this config via defineConfig; top-level code runs at config load, while sandbox-preload plugin writeBundle runs after renderer bundle emit with Rollup output object.

installAuthorityWire takes ipcMain, contents, core, env, argv, terminal, clipboard, profiles, capsuleStates, listIdentities, frames, frameDiag and clock, installs handlers for wire plus side-terminal plus clipboard channels, and returns wall and recording fps getters, rate maps, notifyCreateRefusal and dispose.

createMainBindings({env, createMessageChannel, getPeerCredentials, inputDeadlineMs}) validates config, authenticates peer, completes hello, checks socket identity, starts keepalive, and returns {core, wire}. Any acquisition failure throws a closed cause via acquireFail.

dispatch(intent) routes op-bearing intents to authorityHost.intent via submitHost and proposals to authorityHost.propose; onWallIntent funnels take_control/release_control through applyWallControl, else dispatch.

cleanInstallSmoke(artifact path) extracts/installs to an isolated clean HOME, runs fake-adapter leg, real-adapter /dev/shm leg, no-profiles negative control, and retail-flag refusal leg, returning smoke marker on success.

Preload flow: readFileSync electron/preload.js to string, validate import/export shape, strip declaration exports, mkdir ../preload beside output.dir, write preload.cjs. No bundling of preload imports.

Frames flow via publish: validate frame_ref, coalesce per surface to max published generation, store frozen latestFrames, then drainSurface per surface to listeners. buildFrameEntry creates a channel, binding, readerOptions with acquirePublishedLease, and portOptions.

baseFeed is runtime.projectionView or a null unavailable stub; native human role surfaces merge in mergedRows; feed.subscribe drives snapshot; rows filters destroyed, stopped, and non-admitted lost rows.

Preload must stay single import-free JS source; only export const/class/function declarations allowed. Regex /^import\s|^export\s+(?!const |class |function )/m enforces it, else throws Preload bundling contract changed.

Intent uses schema ui_intent/v0.2 with ops take_control, release_control, fold, unfold, hide, show, move, tab and float and strict param keys. Proposal uses action_proposal/v0.2 with click, key, type, scroll, wait and lane_submit. Verdict uses action_verdict/v0.2.
validPlacement enforces closed boundary: exact keys op/params/request_id/schema, op in hide/show/move/tab/float, slot ids matching id pattern, integers within 0..16383 and 1..16384 for sizes.

Renderer output directory must exist in writeBundle: if output.dir is falsy throw Renderer output directory is required. Preload destination always resolves as resolve(output.dir, ../preload), honoring packager --outDir.

Only closed objects are accepted: exact key sets, plain prototypes, data descriptors and no symbols. Well-formed strings reject lone surrogates. Bounded ID and key token patterns apply. A JSON reviver preserves float versus integer spelling until field validation.

ui/electron is the Electron main-process host layer for MetaViewer: window lifecycle, privileged bundle serving, and owner-only bindings from renderer IPC to Rust core and local devices. authorityWire validates propose/intent/surface-input/settings/terminal/clipboard/capsule IPC and forwards closed JSON or trusted reader/port capabilities; hostBindings attaches the core unix socket and multiplexes surfaces, input, capture, cadence and frame publish; coreLauncher supervises the pinned Rust child and optional adapter with single-flight start and degraded core-only fallback. Frames use frameReader verified rgb24 reads, framePort brokered MessageChannel delivery, displayReader 20-30fps DISPLAY rings, captureBridge metadata-only screenshot/record/export/state, and frameDiag env-gated diagnostics. main.js validates retail launch, pins Electron, serves app://metaviewer with strict CSP, supervises core/adapter and first-surface create; preload/rolePreload expose frozen facades with byte caps; operatorBridge runs identity/handoff/egress/buttons; roleHost plus xpraHumanSession/Tile/Recovery/Keyboard/TracePreload own sandboxed Xpra role views with lease/geometry, raw XKB patch and redacted traces; terminalHost/ptyBroker/ptySession supervise PTYs with profiles, spawn brake and credits; profilePicker caps at 4, nesting is display-only depth 1, openingMode stages exclusive records, qaAnchors writes snapshots, smoke probes settlement. Offers validated surfaces, frames, input, capture, cadence, terminal/display channels and role tiles. Needs ipcMain, privileged origin, pinned Electron, core/adapter binaries, MV_CORE_CONFIG, XDG runtime/config dirs, recording/display grants, Xpra sockets, node-pty and profile stores.

When surface input fails the user sees clicks, keys, typed text or scrolls do nothing. Host logs METAVIEWER_INPUT_REFUSED surface=<id> code=<CODE> count=<n> and renderer gets {ok:false,code}. Stale sequence, rate excess, unknown surface or core refusal all present this way.

When capsule creation fails the renderer gets {ok:false,code,reason,message,tone:refusal} on metaviewer:authority.createSurface plus console error for create refused. User sees closed text such as at most 4 capsules or no free profile, never CLI detail.

When the settings file is missing, oversized or invalid the UI silently keeps mv-light compact defaults. Host warns MetaViewer settings with code and using defaults, and notifies cadence subscribers with defaults so wall and recording cadence stay safe.

User sees demo.start return DEMO_BUSY when a run is active, demo.stop return DEMO_NOT_RECORDING when idle, demo.prompt return DEMO_REFUSED when the demo does not match the sealed demo, or BUTTON_UNAVAILABLE on unexpected failure. CLI detail never reaches the renderer.

User sees capture buttons do nothing with {ok:false,code} where code is SURFACE_UNKNOWN, ALREADY_RECORDING, NOT_RECORDING, CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE, NESTED_DISPLAY_ONLY, LIMIT, DESTINATION_UNSET, CAPTURE_UNKNOWN, NOT_SEALED, DESTINATION_UNAVAILABLE, DESTINATION_EXISTS, BUDGET_EXCEEDED or POLICY.
User sees Degraded mode (CODE): adapter absent or crashed, capsules unavailable, running core-only; detail appends redacted stderr tail with secrets/tokens and control chars stripped.
User sees frozen tile marked stale after 2s without new capture, or VERIFIED-only static rendering when ring absent; no crash, polling continues.

User sees frozen or missing tile after TIMEOUT, PORT_REVOKED, or ENDPOINT_RESTART revocation. Superseded frames never paint; only newest is consumed. Refused postings return ok false with reason and detail and send nothing.

User sees frozen or skipped frames: stale replays return STALE_FRAME_GENERATION, overloaded readers return TIMEOUT no-read-slot, closed readers return CLOSED. No pixels are delivered; caller gets {ok:false, reason, detail} and dropped leases fire onReleaseLease.

User sees tile that never opens, frozen video, or ignored clicks and typing. Logs show only METAVIEWER_SURFACE_CREATE_SENT or WIRE_REPLY markers and closed codes like CORE_SEAMS_ABSENT, SURFACE_CREATE_BUSY, STALE_STREAM or CORE_UNAVAILABLE. Frames coalesce so older out-of-order arrivals never overwrite newer pending generation.

User sees app exit immediately or no window: wrong Electron version logs ELECTRON_PIN, second instance quits with SINGLE_INSTANCE, core not live throws CORE_UNAVAILABLE, adapter not live refuses with dialog text to check MV_SRF_LIVE_PROFILE/RAM_ROOT or unset MV_SRF_BIN_DIR. Renderer sees 403 forbidden or 404 not found in bundle loads.

User sees empty main wall with capsule still creating: first-surface timeout or refusal logs METAVIEWER_SURFACE_CREATE_PENDING then METAVIEWER_SURFACE_CREATE_DEGRADED {code,reason} with SURFACE_CREATE_TIMEOUT/REFUSED/FAILED and keeps window. Renderer ready never logs METAVIEWER_RENDERER_READY if index blocked or ping sender refused with RENDERER_READY.

User sees a second viewer window never appear or vanish immediately; console shows DISPLAY_ONLY startup/wall/sender errors or SINGLE_INSTANCE. Save, settings save, authority and side-terminal actions always fail with persistence/privileged disabled text.

User sees identity list/create/login/delete fail with IDENTITY_PROTECTED, IDENTITY_REFUSED, IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE, IDENTITY_TIMEOUT, or PROFILE_NOT_PROVISIONED; login view never opens or reports LOGIN_URL/LOGIN_VIEW.

User sees layout/settings save or load silently fail or promise reject with PAYLOAD/OUTCOME. Happens when text is not a string, multibyte text exceeds 256KiB even with few chars, or main returns non-true/non-string. Renderer keeps old layout; no partial write occurs.

User presses Add capsule and nothing opens; renderer shows At most 4 capsules run at once... or Every configured profile is already in use... or No free profile has an identity yet... or identity list could not be read... Operator sees matching sentence including mv-live-2 hint. No ids/paths leak in copy.

User-visible: new terminal refuses to open with SESSION_LIMIT or CLASS_LIMIT remedy to close a session; rapid retries get SPAWN_BRAKE to wait and retry. Stalled output that never resumes points to missed ack below low-water; truncated replay after reattach reflects plane attach suffix with truncated flag.

User-visible: terminal goes dead and closes after a burst of output with OUTPUT_OVERFLOW error; typing does nothing after close with no error; window resize beyond 500x300 is ignored because receive throws. Empty utility with TERMINAL_UNAVAILABLE message means node-pty failed to load.

Tester sees live run produce no qa-anchors.json or stale anchors: invoke rejected for sender refused, QA_ARGS, QA_PAYLOAD, QA_DISPOSED, or run-dir identity changed during write; log carries MainError code and fixed message, never renderer path.

User sees capsule list missing identities, create button spinning then error code, or black tile that never becomes ready: mount logs METAVIEWER_XPRA_STAGE stage TIMEOUT/ERROR/LOST, tile overlay stays Connecting/Reconnecting, typed code surfaced for Reopen.

User sees terminal tile stuck connecting then closing, typed input echoed as error frame, or open failing with TERMINAL_DISABLED/DISPLAY_ONLY/COMMAND_NOT_ALLOWED; nested windows show DISPLAY_ONLY side-terminal is disabled in nested display.
User sees tile stuck on Connecting/Reconnecting overlay on dark #182330 background, never reaching desktop pixels; writable tile stays read-only or keyboard layout rejected before listener opens.

User sees wrong symbols, dead keys doubled, or AltGr doing nothing. Happens here because patch bypasses browser IME and sends raw key-action with capsule keycode; bad table sends wrong code or drops the key.

Surface-input path: validateSurfaceInputBatch returns SCHEMA for bad keys, schema, IDs, coords or key chords, or LIMIT for over 32 events or over 16 KB encoded batch; overlong type text is SCHEMA. Refusal is logged at most once per second per surface and code burst.

Intent path: non-string arg goes to surface-input handler. String arg must pass wire cap 256 KB JSON parsing and validateIntentBody exact op and params keys plus ID pattern, else INTENT or PAYLOAD is thrown. Core must return true or OUTCOME is thrown.

Bad channel, wrong arity, wrong key set, wrong schema, bad request_id, bad surface, capture or recording id, bad destination, non-ai mode, or max_fps outside 1 to 60 throws PAYLOAD or ARGS or CHANNEL before the core is touched.

Spawn null, unsafe pid, malformed handle, listener refusal, connect/handshake timeout, bad epoch, EOF/error/exit/close all move to unavailable with reasons like core spawn failed, HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT, bad authority epoch.

Pre-acquire path refuses without touching producer: unknown keys, bad schema, bad path root or pattern, bad surface id, bad generation, bad witnesses or dimensions, bad format or sha256, surface mismatch, null digest, stale generation, over-budget dimensions or bytes.

Input admissibility returns CORE_UNAVAILABLE, SURFACE_UNKNOWN, STALE_STREAM, NOT_IN_CONTROL, SCHEMA for out-of-bounds clicks or unknown kinds, or LIMIT. Each refused batch resolves {ok:false, code} without disposing wire or channels; send timeouts also report CORE_UNAVAILABLE per batch.

Retail refusal returns frozen {ok:false,code}: ARGV_SHAPE, RETAIL_FLAG on forbidden inspect/require/no-sandbox flags, RETAIL_ENV on forbidden env or packaged MV_E2E_LIVE/MV_FRAME_DIAG, NESTED_DEPTH on bad/duplicate nesting, UNKNOWN_SWITCH. Condition: dash-led token not in known runtime switches. bootProductionMain throws MainError(code).

render-process-gone gives XPRA_VIEW_CRASHED, unresponsive gives XPRA_VIEW_UNRESPONSIVE, recorder throw gives XPRA_TRACE_FAILED; each calls fail(), removes failed contents so parent typed error and Reopen show, host closes bridge, never quits app.

installAuthorityWire takes ipcMain, contents, core, env, argv, terminal, clipboard, profiles, capsuleStates, listIdentities, frames, frameDiag and clock, installs handlers for wire plus side-terminal plus clipboard channels, and returns wall and recording fps getters, rate maps, notifyCreateRefusal and dispose.

createMainBindings({env, createMessageChannel, getPeerCredentials, inputDeadlineMs}) validates config, authenticates peer, completes hello, checks socket identity, starts keepalive, and returns {core, wire}. Any acquisition failure throws a closed cause via acquireFail.

Entry createXpraHumanSession({role,setReadonly,openBridge,showView,closeTrace}) requires role human|agent and four functions or XPRA_CAPABILITIES_ABSENT; returns frozen {role,active,open,resize,bringToFront,setVisible,close}.

Frames flow via publish: validate frame_ref, coalesce per surface to max published generation, store frozen latestFrames, then drainSurface per surface to listeners. buildFrameEntry creates a channel, binding, readerOptions with acquirePublishedLease, and portOptions.

Ingest validates context, generation and ledger, checks seq equals lastSeq plus 1, decodes base64 to owned bytes, enforces pending, frame-count and lifetime caps, records cumulative sent offset per seq, appends to the replay tail and may emit pause. Returns a fresh byte copy.

Session open: check lease -> setReadonly(role==agent) must return true -> openBridge -> showView(bridge,recoverBridge) -> tile. Tile: addChildView -> loadURL origin/metaviewer-tile.html+query -> waitForXpraClient -> publish ready -> focus if writable; recovery reloads via fresh bridge origin.

Intent uses schema ui_intent/v0.2 with ops take_control, release_control, fold, unfold, hide, show, move, tab and float and strict param keys. Proposal uses action_proposal/v0.2 with click, key, type, scroll, wait and lane_submit. Verdict uses action_verdict/v0.2.

Only closed objects are accepted: exact key sets, plain prototypes, data descriptors and no symbols. Well-formed strings reject lone surrogates. Bounded ID and key token patterns apply. A JSON reviver preserves float versus integer spelling until field validation.

ui/src is MetaViewer renderer root. App.vue shell merges authoritative projectionView with native role surfaces into rows/feed/snapshot and routes dispatch/dispatchMultislot with placement/control gates to authorityHost; main.js boots from location query through fixture/live wiring, theme-before-paint, layout facade/storage and refuseBoot closed copy. Core builds frozen ui intents, host adapters, verdict/outcome copy and stale-preserving projection; wall owns multi-desktop state, WallWorkspace composition, SurfacePanel tiles, capture rail and empty state; surfaces paint live tiles via scheduler/frame/display/input routers with frozen/lost/connecting states; frames ack every delivery with stale/HIDDEN/REFUSED/SUPERSEDED rules; input validates surface_input/v1 with gating/coalescing/rate limits plus test double; capture/recording provide screenshot/record/export, RAM panel/badge/clock and manifest; multislot/terminal host live surface plus shell sessions, broker launch, deck, overlay and providers; catalog/demo drive capsule create and record-then-automate demos; handoff/identities/network/nested handle interrupts, session CRUD, egress allowlists and display-only depth; activity/settings/qa/agent/creative/types supply receipt strip, persisted scheme/density/fps, anchor snapshots, agent_lane snapshots, storyboard intents and kit prop boundaries. Offers closed copy, frozen builders/views, validated gates and stable ids/anchors; needs host facades, kit components, storage, clipboard, DOM/scheduler/clock and doubles.
When no renderable row exists the list shows one row reading No authority activity yet. User sees an empty log rather than a blank panel.
User sees disabled tile chrome or a stored lastCode refusal when the facade is missing, the host throws, replies are malformed, or codes are unknown; no exception reaches components.
User sees admitted or sent confirmations, or refusal lines such as capsule limits, no free profile, quarantined profile, insufficient RAM, start busy or timed out, each prefixed by its code.

User sees tile freeze then visible stale badge after 2s without frames, or blank tile when binding hidden/unbound. No exception surfaces; failures appear only as HIDDEN/REFUSED acks and capped display-diagnostic posts.

User sees a persistent CAPTCHA or bot-check notice with Take control and Acknowledge, or Handoff notifications unavailable, or Acknowledgement could not be saved. The notice stays visible. Cause is failed list, failed subscribe, or refused ack.

User types, clicks or scrolls and nothing moves, with refusal surfaced via onRefusal as NOT_IN_CONTROL, INPUT_MODE_READ, SURFACE_UNKNOWN, STALE_STREAM, LIMIT, NESTED_DISPLAY_ONLY, SCHEMA or CORE_UNAVAILABLE. Cause is gate closure, rate cap, oversize batch or host refusal.

What the operator sees is disabled buttons with reasons, typed refusal or outcome rows with dismiss controls, a starting-session pending row, state chip labels, and placement reason text; raw broker text never appears.
Operator sees Idle, Starting, Stopping, Sealed, or ticking Recording mm:ss, with refusal or failure reason appended after a dash when a capture action was refused or failed.

User sees Connecting... before mount or when connecting, Reconnecting... when reconnecting after a prior connect, Human capsule or Read-only watch when live, Recording paused (size limit) badge, or error text with a Reopen button that clears error and retries sync().
User sees greyed Enable and provider buttons while starting, a Starting session status line, then Terminal session opened, Terminal access is unavailable, or This terminal launch is unavailable.
User sees A clear view of your work with Add a capsule to bring your surfaces together in one wall and an Add capsule button when the wall has no capsules.
Condition: wrong capsule, invalid body, pending echo, agent control, or READ mode. Next: LAYOUT_ILLEGAL_TRANSITION, ERR_PLACEMENT_PENDING, or LAYOUT_INPUT_MODE_READ refusal; no host call.

Maps typed preview error codes to This preview is unavailable and all other failures to a generic unavailable line prefixed with the refusal prefix; sets mount text plus dataset error code and never renders host text.

Human-input refusal codes (NOT_IN_CONTROL, INPUT_MODE_READ, SURFACE_UNKNOWN, STALE_STREAM, LIMIT, NESTED_DISPLAY_ONLY, SCHEMA, CORE_UNAVAILABLE) render Input refused: reason (CODE) with xN suffix when count>1.

recordStart refuses NESTED_DISPLAY_ONLY when nested, configured refuseStart code, CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE when unavailable, SURFACE_UNKNOWN for unknown ids, ALREADY_RECORDING per surface, LIMIT at options.limit.
Non-ok surface reply throws the reply code or SURFACE_CREATE_FAILED. Non-true intent or setEnabled reply throws Host acknowledgement unavailable. Invalid verdict throws Invalid verdict.

Frame refused paths: surface mismatch -> REFUSED; no binding or invisible binding -> HIDDEN with REFUSED diagnostic NO_BINDING/HIDDEN; paint/onFrame false/throw -> HIDDEN with PAINT_FAILED. refusedCount increments; host is still acked.

Newest-only: enqueue marks in-flight superseded and settles all queued as SUPERSEDED; pump keeps only head. Older-than-current/queued/expiring arrivals refuse pre-hash so older frames never paint after newer ones.

send returns SCHEMA for bad surface, stream or event shape or count outside 1-32, LIMIT over 16 KiB or over 60 batches per 1000 ms, CORE_UNAVAILABLE when facade missing or reply malformed, never rejecting.

Session limit, unavailable command, rejected arguments, missing broker, and attach failures project typed refusal rows with dismiss and emit launch-refused; cleanup closes the opened broker session best-effort.
If the chosen profile is busy confirmRole returns silently. If it is unavailable or missing, roleError becomes PROFILE_ALREADY_BOUND or NO_IDENTITY and the dialog stays open with a role alert.

dispatch(intent) routes op-bearing intents to authorityHost.intent via submitHost and proposals to authorityHost.propose; onWallIntent funnels take_control/release_control through applyWallControl, else dispatch.
dispatchMultislot(intent,capsuleId) handles move/tab/float/hide/show and fold/unfold for the selected slot only; local toggles and unknown bodies never reach the host.
Runs at module import via void bootstrap; reads location search, builds layout and hosts, mounts on the single mount selector, and routes rejections to refuseBoot.
Reads globalThis.metaviewer.operator and returns null when absent; callers must handle the null host path.
Splits the single-line field on whitespace, comma or semicolon, lowercases, trims, drops empties and de-duplicates while preserving first-seen order.
Entry is collectAgentControls(root) needing querySelectorAll, or createAgentLane({root,screen,fixture}).snapshot(). Non-queryable root throws ERR_AGENT_LANE_NO_ROOT.

Inputs are visible, kinds, title, subtitle, emptyText props plus kit events create, update:visible, close. onCreate receives {type.id, placement, binary}; forwardVisible and onClose handle dialog visibility and close.

baseFeed is runtime.projectionView or a null unavailable stub; native human role surfaces merge in mergedRows; feed.subscribe drives snapshot; rows filters destroyed, stopped, and non-admitted lost rows.
submitHost(action) awaits host, maps true to INTENT_ACKNOWLEDGED success and objects to hostOutcome rows, records activityFeed entries, and normalizes thrown codes to refusal toasts.
entries.slice(-MV_ACTIVITY_LIMIT) keeps the newest N, each passed through normalizeActivityEntry; nulls are dropped. Result drives v-for rows with entry.seq, entry.type, entry.tone, entry.text.
capsuleId validates to idResult and frames to board; admittedFrames is non-null only when both pass, driving rendering, anchor ids, and whether dispatchIntent emits.
Removes rows whose id or surfaceId equals the self capsule id; non-array input yields empty list and missing self id returns a copy unchanged, preserving non-object rows.
validPlacement enforces closed boundary: exact keys op/params/request_id/schema, op in hide/show/move/tab/float, slot ids matching id pattern, integers within 0..16383 and 1..16384 for sizes.
assertLiveProposal requires matching row by surface_id, active/standby/ceded lifecycle, live attachment, generation>=1 equal to based_on_frame.generation, else throws NO_BROWSER_CAPSULE.
Exact hostname needs a dot, a letter, length at most 253 chars, valid labels, no wildcard, address, hex-like label or local suffix such as localhost, local, internal, lan or home.arpa.

Image sources admit only PNG data URLs within 2800000 chars and 2 MiB decoded with PNG magic, or relative self paths ending in .png. Remote schemes and protocol-relative URLs refuse without a request.
canvasStateFor maps lost lifecycle to frozen lost, else live only when attachmentState is live; input needs human control, WRITE or wall arm, never lost, never nested display-only.
selectedSessionId must name one entry of sessions; surfaceHidden/terminalHidden/folded/floating are independent booleans so a capsule can be folded yet surface-visible.
When no renderable row exists the list shows one row reading No authority activity yet. User sees an empty log rather than a blank panel.
Count label shows plain N while history fits, else latest S of N once windowed. A stuck or jumping count means feed seq values are not contiguous from 1.

Operator sees closed sentences like Request sent, Action admitted, The surface changed. Try again, or Input refused: read-only mode (INPUT_MODE_READ). Raw codes appear only for human-input and capsule identity rows.

Human-input refusal codes (NOT_IN_CONTROL, INPUT_MODE_READ, SURFACE_UNKNOWN, STALE_STREAM, LIMIT, NESTED_DISPLAY_ONLY, SCHEMA, CORE_UNAVAILABLE) render Input refused: reason (CODE) with xN suffix when count>1.
NO_IDENTITY, NO_IDENTITY:profile-id, and NO_IDENTITY__PROFILE forms render a request-refused row naming the missing profile id and telling the operator to create a matching identity.
A well-formed rawReason (1-256 chars, no control chars) with a CODE-shaped code not starting ERR_ or LAYOUT_ renders CODE: reason verbatim, prefixing the code when absent.

Known ACTIVITY_ROWS codes (INTENT_ACKNOWLEDGED, ACTION_ADMITTED, STALE_FRAME, POLICY, CAPSULE_LIMIT_REACHED and others) render their closed human sentence; unknown CODE-shaped codes render CODE plus generic refusal.
Entry is the entries prop (ActivityFeedItem[] {seq,code,count?}). Non-array input is coerced to an empty feed; nothing is fetched or emitted by this component.
Entry is normalizeActivityEntry(input). Non-object, array, null, or seq not a safe integer >=1 returns null and renders nothing.
entries.slice(-MV_ACTIVITY_LIMIT) keeps the newest N, each passed through normalizeActivityEntry; nulls are dropped. Result drives v-for rows with entry.seq, entry.type, entry.tone, entry.text.
total is mvActivityFeedTotal over the raw entries (max valid seq), so it keeps counting the full history even when rows shows only the windowed tail.

Branch order: human-input refusal codes first, then NO_IDENTITY variants with missing id, then trusted rawReason pass-through, then ACTIVITY_ROWS lookup, then generic CODE-prefixed refusal, else fallback refusal.
countText is mvActivityCountText(rows.length, total): plain count while history fits, latest-window label once total exceeds visible rows.
Strip section carries stable id mv-activity-strip, anchor activity/strip, accessible name Authority activity. Toggle and list expose matching DomId/Anchor helpers.
Outcomes list is ol role=log tabindex 0 with stable id and anchor; accessible name is Latest authority outcomes, N shown or latest S of N when windowed.
Output is a frozen {seq,type,tone,text} with type in intent-ack, verdict-admitted, verdict-refused, request-refused and tone success or refusal. Unknown codes fall back to generic refusal text.
MV_ACTIVITY_LIMIT is 8: the strip shows at most the newest 8 rows. App.vue enforces the same bound inline; the activity app test pins both literals.
Empty-strip copy is the neutral fixed string No authority activity yet, never a placeholder or a raw code.
mvActivityFeedTotal(feed) returns the max valid seq, which equals the true total because recordActivity assigns seq contiguously from 1. Non-array returns 0; malformed rows are ignored.
mvActivityCountText(shown,total) returns String(shown) while total fits, else latest S of N. Unsafe inputs coerce to 0.
Stable strip identity: id mv-activity-strip, anchor activity/strip, accessible name Authority activity. Toggle, list, and row helpers give matching stable ids and anchors.
List accessible name is Latest authority outcomes, N shown, or latest S of N when total exceeds shown. Unsafe counts coerce to 0.
Rendered row count never exceeds MV_ACTIVITY_LIMIT (8). Order follows feed order after tail-slicing, so oldest of the window is first and newest is last.
count/burst suffix applies only to human-input refusal rows; malformed count reads as 1. Authority rows keep exact historical shape regardless of count.

Renders the docked authority-activity strip: compact bar with toggle plus scrollable log of latest propose-verdict and intent-acknowledgement receipts as typed rows. Props in, nothing out; host adapters own outcomes.
Turns reported authority outcomes ({seq,code,count?}) into closed frozen strip entries. Pure JS, zero imports; visible text comes only from closed maps, never from raw prop messages.
Two states: expanded=true shows the ol outcomes list; expanded=false hides it. toggle() flips the boolean. Bar with count stays visible in both states.
Toggle is capsule-ui-kit UiButton labelled Activity with aria-expanded bound to state; click calls toggle(). Styling comes from activity.css; all copy/ids come from activityModel.js.
Human-sentence copy mirrors closed literals in core/hostAdapters.js REASONS plus two success messages, kept as a local copy so the strip never trusts a prop message.
CODE-shaped pass-through branches exclude ERR_ and LAYOUT_ prefixes, which fall to the generic refusal instead; a new refusal family with an excluded prefix would lose its code visibly.
rows, total, countText, listName are computed refs; they recompute only when entries changes and allocate a fresh normalized array per change.

ui/src/agent provides the renderer-only agent_lane/v1 snapshot lane. agentLane.js builds closed frozen snapshots from [data-semantic-anchor] elements in document order with role, name, enabled, visible and rect inference, plus host-key install/uninstall on globalThis, fixture-only bench frame binding with sequence ids, snapshot and bench validators, and anchor audit/gating. AgentLaneHost.vue is a zero-DOM Vue installer that mounts the lane once per renderer via installAgentLane(globalThis,{root:document,screen:()=>props.screen,fixture}) and releases it on unmount. Interaction: Host apply() does uninstall-then-install on mount and on enabled/fixtureKey changes; lane collectAgentControls() queries the document and createAgentLane().snapshot() freezes {schema,screen,controls,state}. Offers window.__agentLane.snapshot(), bench frame, validators, auditAnchors. Needs document root, globalThis target, Vue lifecycle, and matchControlFamily from capsule-ui-kit for audit only.
Automation sees missing controls when ids or anchors are blank, or visible:false when an element is hidden or has zero size; names over 140 chars appear truncated.
Agents calling window.__agentLane.snapshot() get a typed error when the key is absent (host not mounted) or stale after unmount; bench binding is fixture-only, never live.
If installAgentLane throws (key already mounted, bad root), the throw propagates from onMounted/watch with no catch or log here; the lane key stays absent.
Watch tracks only enabled and fixtureKey. A screen-prop change alone does not re-apply, but snapshots still see it because the screen reader closes over live props.
Whitespace-only anchor yields skipped reason empty-anchor; whitespace-only id yields missing-id. Collection itself never throws on node data.
Double install throws ERR_AGENT_LANE_MOUNTED; fixture install with existing __benchCaptureFrame throws ERR_BENCH_FRAME_MOUNTED; bad target throws ERR_AGENT_LANE_NO_TARGET.
findAnchorOffenders reports interactive elements missing id or anchor; assertAnchoredControls throws ERR_AGENT_LANE_ANCHOR listing TAG#id:reason. Query with INTERACTIVE_SELECTOR.
Entries are props screen (default wall), fixtureKey (default empty), enabled (default true). Mount calls apply(); enabled/fixtureKey changes re-apply via watch; unmount uninstalls.
Entry is collectAgentControls(root) needing querySelectorAll, or createAgentLane({root,screen,fixture}).snapshot(). Non-queryable root throws ERR_AGENT_LANE_NO_ROOT.
apply() removes any existing install, then when enabled calls installAgentLane(globalThis,{root:document,screen:()=>props.screen,fixture:fixtureKey||null}) and keeps the returned uninstall callback.

querySelectorAll(ANCHORED_SELECTOR) in document order; each node yields trimmed anchor/id, inferRole, readName, isEnabled, isVisible(rect), roundRect box. Empty anchor or missing id goes to skipped, never controls.
screen is read lazily through a closure so snapshots track the current prop; fixture is the fixtureKey string or null when empty. enabled=false means no host key is installed.
Snapshot is frozen {schema:agent_lane/v1,controls,screen,state:{source:dom,fixture,collected,skipped}}. screen resolves from string or reader fn; throwing reader falls back to wall.
Role is explicit role attr first, else BUTTON/button, A/link, SELECT/combobox, TEXTAREA/textbox, INPUT by type (checkbox, radio, slider, spinbutton, searchbox, textbox), else generic.
Accessible name prefers aria-label, then textContent, then value/placeholder/title, then value property; whitespace collapsed and cut to MAX_ACCESSIBLE_NAME_CHARS (140). May be empty.
enabled=false when disabled attr/property or aria-disabled true. visible=false when rect null, hidden attr, aria-hidden true, or sizeless box.
roundRect accepts x/y or left/top plus width/height, requires finite numbers, rounds to ints, rejects non-positive size with null. readRect wraps getBoundingClientRect and never throws.
Fixture installs wrap snapshot with a 1-based sequence counter; bindBenchFrame(frame) binds the latest snapshot id fixture:fixture:seq. Zero snapshots throws ERR_BENCH_FRAME_NO_SNAPSHOT.
Bench frame must be exactly {raw_sha256} or {raw_sha256,source_pin}: 64 lowercase hex digest, pin 1-256 chars. Total function returning ok/error, never throwing.

Snapshot validator is total: checks schema, non-empty screen, control closed keys anchor,enabled,id,name,rect,role,visible with non-empty id/anchor and null-or-positive rect. Failures return ERR_AGENT_LANE_SHAPE.
auditAnchors checks collected controls against the kit controlRegistry inventory via matchControlFamily; snapshot itself never filters on admission. Returns anchor, admitted, family, roleAdmitted.
uninstall is module-closure state reset to null after every uninstall, so a stale callback can never run twice or delete a newer install.
Zero-DOM installer for the __agentLane host key: mounts the agent_lane/v1 snapshot producer once per renderer and uninstalls on unmount. No visual output, styles, controls, or host calls.
Builds a closed frozen agent_lane/v1 DOM snapshot from [data-semantic-anchor] elements in document order. Renderer-only: no host calls, Node/Electron APIs, or network.
Two install states: uninstalled (uninstall null) and installed (uninstall callable). Every apply() passes through uninstalled first, so re-install never double-mounts.
Host key lifecycle: absent, installed (__agentLane frozen, plus __benchCaptureFrame only for non-empty fixture), uninstalled by returned callback which deletes only its own snapshot binding.
apply() is synchronous and idempotent: uninstall-then-install serializes mount churn from rapid prop changes; no async window exists.
Lifetime is the component lifetime: exactly one install at a time, released on unmount. Forgetting the host (e.g. mounting twice) surfaces as a typed already-installed error.
Bounds: names cut at 140 chars, bench source_pin at 256 chars, rects rounded to ints. Snapshot and rows are Object.freeze deep enough to prevent mutation.
Only dependency is installAgentLane from agentLane.js plus Vue onMounted, watch, onBeforeUnmount. Root is always document; target is always globalThis.
Only external import is matchControlFamily from capsule-ui-kit controlRegistry for admission audit. All DOM reads go through defensive readAttr/hasAttr helpers supporting test doubles.
Because root is fixed to document, mounting two hosts (e.g. nested renderers) races on the same global key; the second mount throws ERR_AGENT_LANE_MOUNTED.
Snapshot covers only [data-semantic-anchor] nodes while the anchor gate covers interactive elements; an interactive control with id but no anchor is gated but invisible to snapshots.

ui/src/capture is the renderer capture seam to window.metaviewer.capture. capturePort.js provides createCapturePort facade adapter plus createCaptureState reactive store; captureDouble.js provides createCaptureDouble in-memory fake for tests and fixtures. Port builds capture_request/v1 requests with mv-capture-N ids, shape-checks every reply and collapses malformed/throwing/unknown to CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE, manages per-surface phases, coalesced refresh, 64-row manifest, single in-flight export per id, and validated capture.state application with auto-refresh. Double validates schema/request_id/fields synchronously, seals shot-N/rec-N rows, and enforces nested/unavailable/surface/limit/export refusal vocabulary with deterministic receipts. Port is the only component path; double mirrors host codes. Offers screenshot/record/export/list/subscribe plus reactive store; needs injected facade, CAPTURE_SCHEMA tag, recordingModel phases, and Vue reactivity.
User sees disabled tile chrome or a stored lastCode refusal when the facade is missing, the host throws, replies are malformed, or codes are unknown; no exception reaches components.

Test sees closed-code refusals {ok:false,code,request_id} mirroring the host, or synchronous TypeError for bad schema, request_id, mode, max_fps, destination, or listener. Ids are shot-1, rec-1 counters.
Refusals keep previous rows; a filtered refresh that meets only other-surface rows fills unseen surfaces instead of wiping to empty.

recordStart refuses NESTED_DISPLAY_ONLY when nested, configured refuseStart code, CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE when unavailable, SURFACE_UNKNOWN for unknown ids, ALREADY_RECORDING per surface, LIMIT at options.limit.
recordStop refuses NESTED_DISPLAY_ONLY, CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE, or NOT_RECORDING for unknown ids. No success path fabricates frames; frames stay 0.

export refuses NESTED_DISPLAY_ONLY, CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE, DESTINATION_UNSET (null or noDestination), NOT_SEALED for active ids, CAPTURE_UNKNOWN, LIMIT past exportLimit, DESTINATION_UNAVAILABLE, DESTINATION_EXISTS.
list with unavailable resolves {ok:false,code:CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE} with no rows; otherwise {ok:true,rows}. subscribe with non-function throws TypeError.
screenshot stores lastShot and clears lastCode on success plus auto-refresh; on refusal it stores the code. Disposed stores resolve unavailable without touching the facade.
One export per capture id in flight; duplicates resolve CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE without a host call. Result passes through; disposed resolves unavailable.
Mutating calls validate {schema:capture_request/v1, request_id 1-64 printable ASCII, required non-empty string fields}. Malformed shapes throw TypeError synchronously.
Entry is createCapturePort(facade) with screenshot, recordStart, recordStop, list, subscribe all callable. Missing facade yields available:false and every call resolves unavailable.
screenshot validates surface_id, checks nested/unavailable/surface gates, then seals a shot-N row (1280x720, zero sha, wall-clock created_ms) and resolves {ok:true,shot}.
recordStart (mode must be ai, optional max_fps int 1-60) creates rec-N and emits capture.state recording; recordStop seals it with duration_ms and emits sealed. One active recording per surface.
export validates capture_id and destination (null or recording:configured only), then applies refusal vocabulary before resolving deterministic receipt {id,bytes:2048,sha256}.
Requests carry schema capture_request/v1 plus deterministic per-port ids mv-capture-N, surface_id or recording_id, and mode ai with optional max_fps. Throwing hosts resolve unavailable.
exportCapture sends capture_id with opaque destination recording:configured and requires bound.export; list takes no args. Replies pass checkExportReply/checkListReply or become unavailable.
Store toggleRecord starts when idle (starting phase, pendingStarts slot) or stops the active recording (stopping phase). Success clears lastCode; failure stores the refusal code.
Validated capture.state events update bySurface entry phase/frames/elapsedMs/recordingId; sealed phase triggers a coalesced auto-refresh so the manifest shows the new row.
storeRows dedupes by id (first wins), caps at CAPTURE_ROWS_CAP (64), O(cap). Unfiltered runs replace all rows; filtered runs merge that surface ahead of kept rows with unseen-surface fill rules.
Request guard requires plain records and CAPTURE_SCHEMA; request_id alphabet is printable ASCII. subscribe returns an unsubscribe closure removing the listener.
Events are frozen {type:capture.state,recording_id,surface_id,phase,frames,elapsed_ms} broadcast to a snapshot of listeners at emit time.

Record refusals admit SURFACE_UNKNOWN, ALREADY_RECORDING, NOT_RECORDING, CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE, NESTED_DISPLAY_ONLY, LIMIT plus BUDGET_EXCEEDED and POLICY; unknown codes collapse to CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE.
Export refusals admit DESTINATION_UNSET, CAPTURE_UNKNOWN, NOT_SEALED, DESTINATION_UNAVAILABLE, DESTINATION_EXISTS, LIMIT, NESTED_DISPLAY_ONLY, CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE plus policy codes.
maxFps must be int 1-60 or the call resolves unavailable without touching the host; absent means host default. Export destination is always the opaque token recording:configured, never a path.
Shot, start, stop validators freeze well-formed results and map ok:false to closed refusals; malformed shapes return null and become CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE. Stop requires sealed:true.
List rows need id, surface_id, kind shot/recording, phase in MV_RECORDING_PHASES, count/ms fields, sealed bool. State events need type capture.state plus ids, phase, frames, elapsed_ms.
Manifest cap is 64 rows mirroring the host seam; oversized replies are truncated during store, never stored whole.

Renderer-side capture seam over window.metaviewer.capture: capturePort.js adapter plus store is the only component path with shape-checked replies mapping malformed to CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE; captureDouble.js is the in-memory fake honouring the exact host contract for tests.
Captures move active recording to sealed history; list returns sealed rows plus live active rows with computed duration. Exported ids are remembered to refuse DESTINATION_EXISTS.
Per-surface entry phases from MV_RECORDING_PHASES: idle, starting, recording, stopping, plus sealed and error. starting/stopping block new toggles; error sets lastCode to MV_RECORDING_FAILED_CODE.
Refresh coalescing: at most one list in flight plus one queued follow-up sharing one promise. A different-surface or unfiltered waiter widens the queued filter to full list.
All methods are synchronous; no locks or timers. Wall clock (Date.now) is used for created/started/duration exactly like a live host, so durations vary per run.
Auto-refresh after screenshot, stop, or sealed event is fire-and-forget and coalesced; a throwing custom port settles quietly. dispose() resolves queued waiters promptly to unavailable.
Store subscribes exactly once at creation; dispose() unsubscribes, clears pendingStarts/exporting, and poisons later actions to unavailable. bySurface and rows are Vue-reactive.
Behaviour switches: nested, unavailable, surfaces closed world (omit for open), limit, noDestination, destinationUnavailable, exportLimit, reportDropped (adds dropped_frames:0), refuseStart code.

Double imports only CAPTURE_SCHEMA from capturePort.js and must stay in step or every call throws unknown schema; port needs injected facade plus MV_RECORDING_PHASES/MV_RECORDING_FAILED_CODE from recordingModel.js with Vue reactive store.
Export keeps no bytes: receipt sha is zeros for shots and f*64 for recordings with fixed 2048 bytes, so content checks must not treat it as real media.
Refresh filter rejects empty and __proto__/constructor/prototype strings to avoid prototype pollution; anything else becomes a surface filter, non-strings list everything.

ui/src/catalog implements the New Capsule launch flow. CatalogLauncher.vue wraps kit NewCapsuleDialog: normalizes props.kinds via catalogModel.js normalizeCatalogEntries into kit dialogTypes plus typed catalogErrors rows, forwards kit create/update:visible/close via onCreate/forwardVisible/onClose, and branches create intents into Capsule role or Program follow-up dialogs. catalogModel.js is a pure closed model with kind set BY_KIND (identity-browser, program), slug/error-row helpers, resolve/normalize, placement and buildCreateIntent intent builder, and createInvokerFocus helper; no DOM or host calls, all results frozen. Interaction: kinds -> normalized -> types/errors -> buildCreateIntent -> emitted create intent with role/profile or program binary plus settle callback. Offers frozen types, errors, intents, stable error codes, and focus capture/restore. Needs kit NewCapsuleDialog behavior, host create/settle handling, globalThis.metaviewerRoles profiles, and CATALOG_KIND_IDS defaults.

User sees Capsule role and identity or Program dialogs, alert text such as PROFILE_ALREADY_BOUND, NO_IDENTITY, IDENTITY_LIST_UNAVAILABLE, or Program could not be started, and rows reading This capsule kind is unavailable.
User sees one line at the wall bottom such as Action admitted, Request sent, or a refusal like This slot is no longer available, rendered as status or alert by tone.
If the chosen profile is busy confirmRole returns silently. If it is unavailable or missing, roleError becomes PROFILE_ALREADY_BOUND or NO_IDENTITY and the dialog stays open with a role alert.
Invalid program input sets programError from the builder error. Unhandled host, rejected outcome, or exception sets Program could not be started or the host reason, and programBusy resets in finally.
Unknown or malformed kit choice makes buildCreateIntent return not-ok and onCreate returns without emitting. Identity list failure clears profileChoices and sets IDENTITY_LIST_UNAVAILABLE.
Non-string kind yields invalid-entry row; unknown string yields unknown-kind row with slugified key. Non-array normalize input yields empty types and errors without throwing.
Non-object input, non-string kind, unknown kind, or empty program binary yields a frozen not-ok result. Placement outside split or floating silently falls back to tab.

Inputs are visible, kinds, title, subtitle, emptyText props plus kit events create, update:visible, close. onCreate receives {type.id, placement, binary}; forwardVisible and onClose handle dialog visibility and close.
Entries enter via normalizeCatalogEntries raw host catalog, choices via buildCreateIntent {kind, placement, binary}, and focus handling via createInvokerFocus capture and restore.
Input is the row prop, an OutcomeRow or null. The outcome computed property calls hostOutcomeFor and drives conditional rendering, role, and data-outcome-code.

props.kinds flows through normalizeCatalogEntries into normalized, then dialogTypes to kit types and catalogErrors to the empty-slot list. onCreate builds an intent with buildCreateIntent and emits create, or branches to role or program dialogs.
Each entry becomes a candidate string via direct string or {kind} carrier, resolves with resolveCatalogKind, then splits into frozen types or deduplicated frozen errors with slug collision suffixes.
buildCreateIntent validates kind against BY_KIND, normalizes placement with resolveCatalogPlacement, trims program binary, and returns a frozen ok intent or frozen typed error.

confirmRole emits create as pendingIntent plus {choice:{role, profileId}} and closes. confirmProgram emits create with intent plus a settle callback, awaits promise outcomes, and only closes on outcome.ok true.

Error codes are stable: ERR_CATALOG_UNKNOWN_KIND with raw kind, ERR_CATALOG_INVALID_ENTRY with null kind, ERR_CATALOG_INVALID_INTENT with null kind. Messages are plain one-line text with stable kebab keys.
Rendered text is closed renderer copy from hostOutcomeFor, never raw row text. NO_BROWSER_CAPSULE and the generic fallback render as code plus message; other rows render the mapped message.

Error rows render only while catalogErrors is non-empty so clean catalogs keep exact kit behaviour. While choosingProgram is true, forwardVisible and onClose return early and never forward visibility or close.
Results are deeply frozen. Valid kinds deduplicate by kind id with first winning; errors deduplicate by raw kind. Malformed entries collapse to one shared invalid-entry row by design.

New Capsule launcher wrapper over kit NewCapsuleDialog: renders known kinds as kit cards, unknown or malformed entries as typed error rows in the empty slot, and translates a kit choice into a create intent with role or program follow-ups.

t: Pure closed catalog model: kind set, typed error rows, and create-intent builder for the launcher. No DOM, framework, or host calls; unknown or malformed entries resolve to frozen error rows and nothing here throws.
s: ui/src/catalog/catalogModel.js::{CATALOG_UNKNOWN_KIND, CATALOG_INVALID_ENTRY, CATALOG_INVALID_INTENT, BY_KIND, isKnownCatalogKind, slugifyCatalogKey, toDialogType, unknownKindRow, invalidEntryRow, invalidIntentRow, resolveCatalogKind, isKindCarrier, normalizeCatalogEntries, resolveCatalogPlacement, buildCreateIntent, createInvokerFocus}

t: Renders one host outcome row as a status or refusal paragraph, mapping the code through hostOutcomeFor and exposing code plus tone in DOM attributes.

Three views are exclusive: kit dialog, role dialog when choosingRole, program dialog when choosingProgram. Closing the launcher resets both flags and bumps choiceGeneration to invalidate in-flight identity loads.
Invoker focus has captured versus cleared states: capture stores the node, restore focuses it when still connected and clears it, returning whether focus happened.

Identity loading is guarded by choiceGeneration: stale api.choices results after close or a newer choice are discarded. confirmProgram disables Start via programBusy and tracks sync settle with settledByListener.
No locks or async work. Last capture wins; restore is one-shot because it clears the stored invoker before focusing.
Identity profiles come from globalThis.metaviewerRoles. Focus capture stores document.activeElement on open and restores it after close via invokerFocus, with a document-exists guard.
Kind set is fixed at module load: identity-browser and program, both opening as tab. No allocation beyond frozen arrays, maps, and per-call result objects.
Defaults are kinds from CATALOG_KIND_IDS, title Add capsule, subtitle about opening a kind in the wall, and emptyText for no search matches. Callers override kinds to subset the launcher.
Depends on catalogModel.js for CATALOG_KIND_IDS, normalizeCatalogEntries, buildCreateIntent, createInvokerFocus, and on kit NewCapsuleDialog for search, grid arrows, Enter and Escape behaviour.
HostOutcome depends only on hostAdapters.js hostOutcomeFor for copy mapping; catalogModel has no imports and no host surface.

ui/src/core is the renderer-side core for the capsule wall between Vue/components and host authority, terminal, and frame feeds. Parts: hostAdapters.js is the host boundary with AuthorityAdapter, TerminalBroker, AuthorityRuntime plus verdictRow, requireAck, assertProposalFrame, and hostOutcomeFor copy; intents.js builds closed frozen wall intents with visibility, control, presentation builders plus buildAuthorityIntent ui_intent/v0.2 and control registry; projection.js admits decoded wall data into a read-only frozen view over the kit projection coordinator with selectWallSurface. Interaction: builders validate then encode via injected encoders, adapters stringify intents and require literal true, proposals validate then decode to OutcomeRow, frame notices decode into createWallProjection admitInitialResponse/admitPush with stale preservation, terminal validates separately. Offers strict validation, frozen builders/views, outcome copy, session and subscription handling. Needs injected AuthorityPort/TerminalPort, encodeUiIntent/encodeControl, frame decode, allowed schemas and limits, and kit coordinator.
User sees admitted or sent confirmations, or refusal lines such as capsule limits, no free profile, quarantined profile, insufficient RAM, start busy or timed out, each prefixed by its code.
User action silently does nothing at the wall while the caller surfaces a coded error such as ERR_INVALID_INTENT_PAYLOAD, ERR_UNKNOWN_INTENT_KEY, or ERR_INTENT_ENCODER_MISSING.
User sees tiles frozen on the last good wall with a stale indicator when new updates refuse to decode, or an empty unavailable wall with an admission error code and message.
Non-ok surface reply throws the reply code or SURFACE_CREATE_FAILED. Non-true intent or setEnabled reply throws Host acknowledgement unavailable. Invalid verdict throws Invalid verdict.
Non-function subscribeFrames returns null. Non-function stop throws Invalid frame subscription after disposing the controller. Decoder refusal preserves last-good snapshot as visibly stale.
Unknown codes fall back to This request is unavailable. Raw reason strings over 256 chars or with control chars are ignored. NO_IDENTITY variants map to profile guidance with the missing id.
Non-plain inputs, bad schema, missing params, or invalid field values throw ERR_INVALID_INTENT_PAYLOAD with the offending key or operation named in the message.
Missing factory throws ERR_REGISTRY_UNAVAILABLE. Bad windowId, epoch, or generation throw ERR_INVALID_REGISTRY_CONFIG or ERR_STALE_GENERATION; missing generation is explicitly refused.
After dispose, admit returns ERR_DISPOSED with the current snapshot. Bad meta throws ERR_INVALID_META; bad decoder shape throws ERR_INVALID_DECODER_RESULT and notifies listeners.

Divergent id versus surfaceId, bad lifecycle, generation, visibility, control, or non-string title, display, profile_id refuses the row. Bad activity, attachment, outcome, refusal, or owner fields also refuse.

Capabilities enter as AuthorityPort and TerminalPort objects with optional methods. Missing methods yield null paths instead of throwing; only main.js reads the preload global, this module receives ports.

Inputs are raw authority payloads, builder inputs {verb, capsuleId, pinned}, and registry config {windowId, epoch, generation}. Encoders encodeUiIntent and encodeControl are injected and both required.

Options carry allowedSchemas, five ingress limits, and a decode function with no defaults. Sessions begin with query, epoch, and optional onUnsubscribe, then markSubscriptionReady before snapshot requests.
intent bodies are stringified through buildAuthorityIntent and require literal true. propose bodies pass assertProposalFrame then decode through verdictRow into an OutcomeRow code, message, and tone.
Frame notices flow through an injected decode into createWallProjection admission as schema metaviewer.frame-wall/v1 query authority.frames. Frame bytes and ports never enter projection or Vue state.

visibility validates fold, unfold, or pin and calls encodeUiIntent; control validates take_control or release_control and calls encodeControl; presentation validates close, hide, show, float, or dock-back locally without encoders.
Authority inputs validate op, closed keys, and per-field shapes, then emit frozen ui_intent/v0.2 with a fresh crypto.randomUUID request_id via structuredClone plus deep freeze.
Every raw ingress runs the injected decoder first, then shared kit admission on both push and initial-response paths. Decoder refusals overlay the error and preserve the last-good snapshot as stale.

Verdicts require schema action_verdict/v0.2, non-empty proposal_id, core_seq safe integer at least 1. Admitted maps to ACTION_ADMITTED; refused requires a known reason code from the closed REASONS table.

Terminal open accepts exactly command, args, cols, rows, validates refusal codes against uppercase pattern and session ids against 1..128 safe characters, and maps TERMINAL_UNAVAILABLE to bundled-support copy.

Authority ops share one wire table: fold, unfold, hide, show, move, tab, float, layout_save, layout_load, take_control, release_control with fixed slot, surface, geometry, index, and coordinate field rules.
Capsule ids must be host-issued non-empty strings with no whitespace, never bare numeric indexes, never display credentials starting with colon or display=. Violations throw coded errors.

Registry accepts only windowId, epoch, generation; exporter keys are forbidden with ERR_REGISTRY_EXPORTER_FORBIDDEN. Retail mode is forced true and no producer contract is forwarded to the kit factory.

selectWallSurface needs a non-empty capsuleId and a snapshot with rows array. Missing data yields ERR_PROJECTION_UNAVAILABLE or ERR_UNKNOWN_SURFACE; shape violations yield ERR_MALFORMED_ROW, never invented defaults.
Acknowledgements are literal true, never truthy coercion. Proposals require schema action_proposal/v0.2, non-empty surface_id, valid generation and sha256, and a budget, else NO_BROWSER_CAPSULE.
All inputs use closed key sets and closed verb lists. Unknown keys throw ERR_UNKNOWN_INTENT_KEY; unknown verbs throw ERR_UNKNOWN_INTENT_TYPE; pin additionally requires pinned as boolean.
Schemas must be a non-empty string array and limits five positive safe integers, else TypeError. Decode must return an ok boolean result with code and message on refusal.
Renderer boundary to host authority, terminal, and frame-wall feeds: strict verdict and session validation, copy mapping for outcomes, and a metadata-only frame subscription into the projection path.

t: Closed frozen intent builders for the capsule wall: protocol visibility and control intents plus local presentation intents, with all wire encoding delegated to injected host encoders.

t: Wall projection admission: strict decode plus read-only frozen view over the kit public projection coordinator. Presentation only; the core owns authority and components receive only the frozen view.

t: Runtime tracks rows by surface_id, monotonic revision, disposed flag, and initial flag. First notice uses admitInitialResponse, later notices use admitPush; stale generations keep the admitted row without snapshot error.
No session state. Each builder call is independent; a missing encoder blocks every effect instead of falling back, and encoder results must be plain cloneable objects.
Snapshots are unavailable, live, or stale with an overlay error. Disposal refuses late admission with ERR_DISPOSED, clears listeners, and invalidates the session.

Depends on projection.js createWallProjection for admission and intents.js buildAuthorityIntent and createWallIntentBuilders for encoding and builders; controlRegistry and scheduler are empty frozen objects.
Kit control registry resolves only through the injected createControlRegistry factory from the host build; this module never imports the kit subpath directly.
Storage and session lifecycle delegate to kit createPublicProjectionCoordinator; this file adds only validation, decoder overlay, and row selection on top.
Proposal validation failure raises NO_BROWSER_CAPSULE even when the real cause is a malformed proposal body, which can misdirect debugging toward capsule availability.
Raw renderer controls may carry surfaceId without params for control verbs only; slot identities must come from the host, never from substituting a surface id.
No default schemas, limits, or decoder. Callers supply the full WallProjectionOptions; hostAdapters supplies frame-wall schema, 256-row caps, and its frame decoder.

ui/src/creative owns the creative storyboard capsule UI. Its sole part is CreativeCapsule.vue: a dependency-free validation and intent script block plus a Vue panel built on capsule-ui-kit UiPage, UiToolbar, and UiButton. It validates capsuleId and the storyboard frame list, gates image sources to PNG data URLs or relative self .png paths, derives Live, Waiting, or Refused status, renders only admitted frames with select, regenerate, and close actions, and builds frozen submit-intent events. It offers admittedFrames and isAdmitted gating plus buildStoryboardIntent builders; it needs capsuleId, frames, title, presentationInstance, and folded props from its parent.
User sees a storyboard grid with prompts and Select frame buttons when Live, an empty waiting panel when no frames arrived, or a stuck panel with no admitted frames when input refuses.
Empty, whitespace-padded, numeric-only, or display-credential capsule ids refuse with ERR_INVENTED_CAPSULE_ID, ERR_INVALID_IDENTITY, ERR_NUMERIC_INDEX_ID, or ERR_DISPLAY_CREDENTIAL_ID.
Empty board refuses ERR_STORYBOARD_EMPTY, over 8 frames ERR_STORYBOARD_TOO_LARGE, and one bad frame refuses everything with its indexed frame message. Malformed data URLs map to source codes.
dispatchIntent returns silently when the capsule id is invalid, so Select frame, Request new frame, and Close storyboard buttons do nothing on a refused identity.
Inputs are capsuleId, frames array, title, presentationInstance, and folded. Outputs are submit-intent events built only through buildStoryboardIntent for select-frame, regenerate, and close.
capsuleId validates to idResult and frames to board; admittedFrames is non-null only when both pass, driving rendering, anchor ids, and whether dispatchIntent emits.

Image sources admit only PNG data URLs within 2800000 chars and 2 MiB decoded with PNG magic, or relative self paths ending in .png. Remote schemes and protocol-relative URLs refuse without a request.
Only creative/select-frame, creative/regenerate, and creative/close are built. Select requires a valid frameId detail; the other two take no detail. Results are frozen with the validated capsuleId.
Frames carry exactly six keys with no extras. frame_id matches 1..128 safe chars, prompt 1..2000 chars, sha256 64 lowercase hex, dimensions integers 1..8192, and duplicate frame ids refuse the board.
Creative storyboard capsule: closed frame validation, image-source CSP gate, status derivation, and frozen intent builders in a dependency-free block plus a Vue panel rendering admitted frames.
