Destroyed ids stay tombstoned and revival refuses SURFACE_DESTROYED; evicted ids leave no tombstone and stay re-registerable. Eviction is only for fully retired canvas-less entries with streamRetired true and canvasAttached not true, else a live stream would strand with no entry.

ui/src/terminal provides terminal UI for mv: opt-in launch controls, right-side overlay, full-wall multi-screen deck, single-session view, plus facades, client, provider menu and deck model. BrokerLaunchControls.vue offers enable checkbox and provider launch buttons through an injected host broker facade with pending and outcome rows. SideTerminalOverlay.vue pairs those controls with kit SideTerminalPanel bound to an injected session port using display contents so tiles never reflow. TerminalDeckView.vue renders screen bar, Bootstrap and New actions, launcher popover, equal-tile xterm grid, context menu and busy-close confirm; terminalDeckModel.js owns its screens, slots, focus, launcher, toasts, errors, broker open and close, session attach, write, resize, persistence and shortcuts. TerminalView.vue mounts one xterm for a session port. sideTerminalFacade.js adapts ports, broker and transport to kit shape with attach, data, exit, ack, write, resize, close and dispose. terminalClient.js bridges one MessagePort to xterm read and write with cumulative ack credits. providers.js normalizes host provider entries to frozen reference-only menu rows. Needs injected broker, session ports, kit panel, xterm with FitAddon, storage and clipboard; offers launch, attach, PTY input and output, copy and paste, and persisted deck state.
User sees greyed Enable and provider buttons while starting, a Starting session status line, then Terminal session opened, Terminal access is unavailable, or This terminal launch is unavailable.
User sees No terminals on Screen N with Open Shell hint, bootstrap toast, terminal/error alert text, exited or restored badges on tiles, and Close busy terminal confirm copy.
User sees a right-click Copy/Paste menu at cursor position; Copy is greyed without selected text. Clicking elsewhere or pressing Escape makes it vanish.
User sees an empty terminal host box when no port is injected, or a Terminal attached status line above the terminal once bound. No host error strings are rendered.
User sees custom-dialog messages Enter an executable, The executable must not start with a dash, Arguments must be text, Too many arguments, or size and null-byte refusals.
User sees Session ended for clean exits or Session ended unexpectedly for failures, with tone info or error. Typed codes travel only in data attributes, never visible text.
User sees terminal output stop and a status line Terminal binding refused, Terminal stream refused, host error text, or Exited (code). No further output or input flows after that.

User pastes nothing and sees toast Paste failed: clipboard read failed or target slot is not running, so pasteClipboard returns pasted false. Failure also records TERMINAL_PASTE_FAILED errorCode/message.
Bootstrap copy shows toast Copied on success or Copy unavailable when neither clipboard.writeText nor operator entry copy succeeds; it returns {ok,text,toast} with the AGENT_ENTRY_PROMPT text.
Copy with no selection silently does nothing and returns copied false without touching the clipboard, because empty explicit text, terminal selection and getSelection fallback are all empty.
If setEnabled throws, outcome becomes TERMINAL_ENABLE_REFUSED with message Terminal access is unavailable. The checkbox is forced back to the authoritative enabled value.

If open throws containing TERMINAL_UNAVAILABLE, outcome is TERMINAL_UNAVAILABLE: terminal support is not bundled in this package. Otherwise outcome is TERMINAL_LAUNCH_REFUSED: This terminal launch is unavailable.
Null binding yields TERMINAL_UNAVAILABLE plus empty facade; constructor throw yields TERMINAL_BINDING_REFUSED plus empty facade. Kit panel then shows designed empty state, not exception text.
launchProfile, launchCustomCli, restartSlot, bootstrap failures are swallowed locally; the message projects via deckState.errorMessage with errorCode in data-error-code and role alert.
Closing a busy slot sets pendingCloseSlotId and shows a confirm dialog stating SIGINT then terminate. Confirm closes, cancel clears. Idle slots close without the dialog path.
Non-object records throw expected an object; byte sizes use TextEncoder so the module stays renderer-importable. Capability rows with bad id, available, or reason throw TypeError.

Present-but-not-callable methods throw TypeError. Bad session shapes throw SESSION_INVALID; non-literal-true resize, close, copyText replies throw REFUSED or UNAVAILABLE; malformed listings throw PROVIDERS_UNAVAILABLE.
Ack with unknown seq or mismatched cumulative bytes throws TERMINAL_CREDIT_REFUSED. resize without host method throws SESSION_UNAVAILABLE; bad cols and rows throw RESIZE_REFUSED.

Frames for another session deactivate with Terminal binding refused. Error or exitCode frames deactivate with the host error or Exited (code). Retryable TERMINAL_IO_REFUSED with exact keys rewinds inputSeq. Malformed shape, non-Uint8Array, gap, oversize chunk, or 256 pending frames deactivate with Terminal stream refused. Duplicate or late parser done callbacks are ignored.

Unknown broker/IPC errors normalize to {code,hint,message} with message CODE: hint. Explicit code/reason wins; otherwise message tokens, phrase matches, or TERMINAL_OPEN_REFUSED fallback. Custom remedy replaces the built-in hint. Broker refusal or invalid/missing session id sets errorCode/errorMessage, closes the launcher, notifies, and rethrows.
Empty, NUL-, CR- or LF-containing custom commands set COMMAND_NOT_ALLOWED with Enter a single-line command and throw before any broker open, so no session is consumed.

Control arrives via props broker, providers, idPrefix, anchorPrefix, visible, showMenu. broker maps through createSideTerminalBrokerFacade to facade; providers map through toKitMenuProviders to entries with empty fallback.

Overlay arrives via terminalBroker, terminalBinding {session,port}, hostProviders, open, deck, storage, topOffset, bottomOffset. rebind converts terminalBinding into facadeRef or an empty-state facade.

Control arrives via open, terminalBroker, terminalBinding session facade, terminalSessionPort, hostProviders, brokerCommands, clipboard, storage, closeGraceMs. Controller is built once from those props.
Input is session id, nullable port, and host element ref. bindTerminal runs on mount and on session or port change; missing port, host, or session leaves an empty section.

Input is {session,port}. Session must match closed id grammar and port must expose postMessage, else TERMINAL_BINDING_REFUSED. Kit calls capabilities then attach. Client input is {session,port,write,onStatus}. Port starts listening immediately via addEventListener plus start. Returns frozen {input,dispose}.

launchProfile opens an admitted broker profile on the active screen or reuseSlotId at 80x24 marking running and busy. launchCustomCli opens an admitted shell then types the trimmed single-line plus newline without widening admission. restartSlot relaunches a restored or exited slot in place preserving identity. handleKeyDown consumes deck shortcuts and Escape with preventDefault and stopPropagation, else returns false so PTY input and Ctrl+C pass through.

launch(entry) calls broker.open with command 80x24 and copied argv, empty for shell. Success sets outcome TERMINAL_OPENED; stale or disabled sessions are closed best-effort. Errors project TERMINAL_UNAVAILABLE or TERMINAL_LAUNCH_REFUSED.
Host provider data flows through toKitMenuProviders in both files. Malformed host data falls back to shell-only menu, so the menu never throws into the view.

syncTerminals reconciles viewportElements against controller screens: destroys unretained terminals, creates MvDeckTerminal plus FitAddon per new session, replays buffered output, resizes, and focuses the focused slot. Tile input flows from xterm onData through controller.writeSessionBytes as encoded bytes, with Ctrl+C mapped to 0x03. Fallback onTileKeyDown forwards single chars and Enter only when no xterm is mounted.

Terminal output flows from port through createTerminalClient write into terminal.write; input flows from onData and onBinary into client.input. ResizeObserver posts {session,cols,rows} on host size change. createProviderMenu takes normalized entries plus host capabilities and returns frozen reference-only rows with id,label,hint,command,disabled. Shell row is always first; provider rows need positive capability.

Terminal bytes flow from createTerminalClient write into data listeners as {session,seq,bytes,byteLength} with cumulative totals. Ack releases contiguous credits via stored done callbacks. Inbound {session,seq,bytes} frames with strict key shape go to write(bytes,done). Contiguous parser completions advance ackSeq and consumed, then post {session,ack,bytes}.

createSessionTransport validates the injected window.metaviewer.sideTerminal fixed API and binds attach, resize, close, listProviders, copyText. Absent methods mean unavailable capability, never exception. Port facade attaches once per session via transport.attach, binds terminalClient, flushes queued inputs, then emits data and exit. Failed attach drops the entry and emits one exit. openBrokerSession enables the broker then opens {command,args,cols,rows}; attachSession binds via sessionFacade or a direct MessagePort facade; writeSessionBytes sends PTY input bytes through the same path.

Provider ids must match closed grammar 1..128 chars and must not be shell or provider. Unknown keys, malformed fields, duplicates, and reserved ids throw instead of filtering. Provider argv must be 1..33 strings, no NUL, each up to 4096 UTF-8 bytes, argv[0] non-empty and not dash-led. Returns a frozen copy; violations throw TypeError or RangeError. Custom dialog splits argument text on whitespace runs only with no quoting or shell evaluation. Empty executable, dash-led head, NUL, oversize, or over 32 items returns null argv plus message.

providerAnchorSegment returns a grammar-valid anchor segment up to 61 chars. Valid ids pass through byte-identical; others map to lead plus sanitized rest plus fnv1a32 suffix. Raw id stays for host resolution. Shell entry keeps empty argv and command shell; host spawns its own login shell. Menu rows never carry argv, exe, cwd, or env across the boundary.

Every ack, write, resize, and close must name the bound session while attached; mismatched id or detached facade throws TERMINAL_BINDING_REFUSED. Empty facade answers capabilities developerMode false and attach with zero sessions, so the kit shows designed empty state. Broker facade separates launch authority from port IO. Absent setEnabled means already authorized; canEnable and canOpen reflect host method presence.

Pump or exit events normalize to exited or failed with typed codes TERMINAL_SESSION_EXITED or FAILED and messages Session ended or Session ended unexpectedly. Unknown shapes fail closed to failed. copyText accepts only lead-alnum plus 0..127 of alnum . _ : -. Off-grammar text throws ERR_CLIPBOARD_INVALID before any host round-trip; host text never reaches visible strings.

serializeDeckState persists schema, activeScreenIndex, sequences and per-slot id/title/kind/profileId/customCommand only; live handles and sessionIds are never stored. deserializeDeckState rejects wrong schema, empty or over-limit envelopes with null. Tile grid maps count to columns: 0-1 to 1, 2-4 to 2, 5-9 to 3, else 4. Non-finite counts clamp to 0. Persistence uses localStorage key metaviewer.terminalDeck/v1 with envelope schema tag of the same value; storage failures fall back or are swallowed so quota never crashes the deck.

Enable checkbox resets to enabled.value in finally; launch stays disabled while busy or opt-in required but not enabled. All screens stay mounted with only active visible via hidden, inert, and aria-hidden and data-grid-cols. Pane records carry broker session id verbatim for stable kit tab ids and anchors. Screens stay numbered 1..N as Screen N; deserialize clamps active index and derives next seqs above observed suffixes.

createStreamRegistry is the entry for building the terminal stream registry consumed as AiMultiSlotProps.streamRegistry; onSendAuthorizedPtyInput carries sessionId, epoch, attachmentId, inputSeq and data.
Attachment and activity flow through attachmentState/activityState strings plus hasControlLease boolean; streamRegistry of MultislotRegistryLike binds live session streams outside Vue props.
AiMultiSlotProps requires capsuleId string; sessions carry sessionId/title/kind/activity and providers carry id/label/hint/argv with optional command. epoch/generation order concurrent slot updates.
AiSlotControlBarProps requires only capsuleId; every display and mode field is optional so the bar renders before surface state arrives.
All SideTerminalPanel props are optional; storage is a minimal getItem/setItem pick or null, and open accepts boolean or null for not-yet-loaded panels.
selectedSessionId must name one entry of sessions; surfaceHidden/terminalHidden/folded/floating are independent booleans so a capsule can be folded yet surface-visible.
Declares the consumer prop boundary for the vendored AiMultiSlot kit SFC: capsule identity, layout flags, session selection, provider/command launch inputs and multislot registry attachment.
Declares the control-bar prop boundary: capsule identity plus input mode, copy state, surface/terminal visibility, folded and floating flags.
Declares the side-terminal panel prop boundary: optional session facade, provider list, storage handle, open flag and top/bottom offsets.
Re-exports the kit TerminalView and declares the local createStreamRegistry factory that wires Terminal/FitAddon classes and authorized PTY input callback to a multislot registry.
Both types depend on ../multislot/multislotAttach.js MultislotRegistryLike for the registry shape; TerminalView.d.ts additionally depends on the vendored .kit capsule-ui-kit TerminalView types.
Provider entries use argv arrays while commands is a separate string list and launching is a single boolean; treating launching per-provider or argv as shell text misroutes terminal launch input.

ui/src/wall implements the multi-view multi-desktop capsule wall UI. DesktopWorkspace.vue owns multi-view multi-desktop state: loads persisted desktops, reconciles assignments from projection rows/modes, renders one WallWorkspace per desktop, persists via cleanLayouts, handles view/desktop switching, add/remove, follow/reveal and cross-desktop moveTile with readOnly latching. WallWorkspace.vue is presentation-only composition over kit DockWorkspace: ready gating, revealSurface admission, presentation verbs, layout echo, presets with grid/floating geometry, orphan pruning and identity slots. SurfacePanel.vue validates panel deps, binds projection snapshots to exact id/surfaceId rows, derives seven-state tiles via tileStates.js, emits fold/control/close/dock-back intents and mirrors folded state to kit. TileCaptureChrome.vue plus tileCapture.js plus capsuleId.js drive the per-tile capture rail: phase/badge/elapsed, record/screenshot/copy actions, DOM ids/anchors, short-id display and Copy ID for AI ready line with clipboard bounds. layout.js creates/migrates Dockview profiles with grid arrangement and quarantine. EmptyWallView.vue renders the empty placeholder with add-capsule seam. Offers switching, reveal, presets, capture copy; needs projectionView, intent builders, storage, kit DockWorkspace/capsule-ui-kit, electron layout helpers, scheduler/registry and clipboard.
User sees an empty desktop even though surfaces are assigned: reveals run only for ready walls and skip already-seen ids, so a wall that never fires ready or a failed reveal leaves tiles unrevealed.
User sees A clear view of your work with Add a capsule to bring your surfaces together in one wall and an Add capsule button when the wall has no capsules.

User sees Folding/Unfolding in the status row after a fold gesture until authority moves; refused folds clear busy and keep authoritative state. Connecting tiles show a placeholder with no frame claim; lost tiles show a typed status row unless a frozen frame keeps canvas identity.

User sees a small badge reading Idle, Starting, Recording MM:SS, Stopping or Sealed with matching variant and Phase title; frozen readout means phase/elapsedMs stopped. Screenshot button reads Screenshot/Capturing/Captured with capsule-aware name; stuck Capturing means the screenshot promise never settled.

User sees Panel unavailable: <id> with retired-type reason for unknown kit components, never a live-looking tile. Picking a tile preset may do nothing or show Tile layout is unavailable when preset unknown, wall not ready, a tile maximized, or kit moveTo missing.

User sees a short id (whole when 14 or fewer chars, else first 8 plus ellipsis plus last 5) with full id on hover and accessible name. Id chip shows only for usable ids; on lost/error tiles Copy disables with Capsule is <tile> and no command is offered.

User sees letterboxed capsule content with footer strip when stripVisible true; wrong aspect or clipped footer means Width/Height aliases were unreadable and 1280x900 defaults applied. An empty wall after upgrade/demo import is deliberate migration on foreign panel identities, not loss of live capsules.

User sees Connecting, Waiting, Stale, Live, Lost, Destroyed or Surface update unavailable; stuck Waiting means unknown lifecycle or no live envelope, Stale means stale transport with capture running. Agent acting chip shows only during busy session or in-flight proposal; idle agent ownership reads live/ready.

Storage write rejection latches readOnly true, emits layout-error and rethrows; later persists reject with LAYOUT_SAVE_REFUSED while moveTile/setPreset refuse with ok false. On load, schema mismatch or failed layout-profile decode/migrate throws LAYOUT_CONTRACT_INVALID, latches readOnly, emits layout-error, runs on defaults without saving.

Missing or malformed capsuleId, presentationInstance, projectionView, intentBuilders, controlRegistry or non-null tileScheduler throws ERR_PANEL_INVALID_PROP with a naming message before any subscription.

When unavailable or phase starting/stopping, record disables with Recording is unavailable or Recording is <phase> and ignores submit-intent. Screenshot disables when unavailable or pending; copy disables when canCopy false, clipboard unreachable, or copying, showing Copied or Copy unavailable only after a run.

Layout echo validates slot_id/group_id grammar and index 0..255 then docks/moves, floats via x/y/width/height ranges, else ERR_INVALID_PLACEMENT. resizeTile wider/narrower/taller/shorter/fit refuses ERR_NOT_READY or LAYOUT_SIZE_INVALID, clamps to 240x200 minima and wall maxima, else LAYOUT_SIZE_FAILED.

Null line gives unavailable ERR_CAPSULE_ID_INVALID; over 4096 UTF-8 bytes gives ERR_CAPSULE_LINE_TOO_LARGE; no clipboard gives ERR_CLIPBOARD_UNAVAILABLE; write rejection gives ERR_CLIPBOARD_WRITE_REFUSED. Thrown copy callbacks map to write-refused; outcomes never throw.

Missing or whitespace-bearing surface id throws Invalid capsule identity; duplicate panel id throws Duplicate capsule identity; absent placements or failed kit decode throw. Corrupt JSON stays raw for kit quarantine; future schemas, wrong scopes, or any contentComponent/capsuleId/panel- mismatch resets the whole wall to empty.

Unavailable transport gives connecting Waiting without capturing; departed row with resident live/stale feed gives lost Lost; destroyed gives lost Destroyed, lost lifecycle gives lost Lost, unknown lifecycle or missing row gives connecting Waiting. Null scheduler, broken instrumentation, or generation/epoch mismatch give null/empty so the Frame badge hides.

Null for non-object store, empty surfaceId, missing key, or non-record candidate. Plain-object path uses direct tracked read then hasOwnProperty so reactive additions re-render while __proto__ and toString still refuse; never throws.

selectView switches the active human/agent view (deferred via requestedView before load); selectDesktop switches the active desktop. addDesktop appends via electron layout helper and surfaces layout-error on limit failure; removeDesktop deletes the active-view desktop and drops ready/adapter/revealed entries.

followSurface optionally reassigns a surface view then activates its home desktop; revealSurface delegates to the home wall or returns ok false when no home. moveTile relocates a surface across desktops (hide visibility, emit close, relocate, prune, reveal target, persist, optionally navigate); read-only or unknown ids return ok false.
The Add capsule UiButton click is the only action; it emits add-capsule so the parent opens capsule creation. No other events or host calls exist.

Fold toggle emits one visibility intent with verb fold/unfold from current visibility, arming folding/unfolding pending-busy on live-axis tiles. Control requests resolve the verb via controlVerbForRow then emit one control intent. Close and dock-back emit presentation intents close/dock-back for the exact capsuleId, silent when no authoritative row exists.

Record enters via kit SaasRecordButton submit-intent calling captureState.toggleRecord; screenshot enters via shot click calling captureState.screenshot with lane-local capturing flag until settle; copy snapshots surfaceId/profileId and runs copyCapsuleReadyLine through feedback. Disabled or missing store returns silently.

Lifecycle starts at handleReady with api/windows/host requiring getPanel/addPanel plus state/show/hide/float/dock else ERR_INVALID_READY, re-emitted via onReady. revealSurface creates/reveals panel- panels with admission checks. Verbs close/hide/show/float/dock-back arrive via applyPresentationIntent; unknown verbs/panels or not-ready refuse, close emits panel-closed. Component methods delegate to the controller.

Copy entry is copyCapsuleReadyLine(ids, clipboard): builds the line, enforces byte bound, picks injected then ambient clipboard, awaits writeText, never throws. Feedback entry is createCapsuleCopyFeedback(onState, options): run emits copying, awaits copy, emits copied/unavailable, then schedules reset to ready; new runs supersede prior timers.

Creation is createWallLayout(scope, surfaces): clones kit default profile, sizes grid from first surface, registers panel-<id> panels, arranges leaves, then decodes/migrates. Restore is migrateWallLayout(raw, scope): null passes through; unparseable JSON returns raw for kit quarantine; failed decode or non-CapsulePanel/identity mismatch returns fresh empty wall.

Store read is readSurfaceEntry(captureState, surfaceId) accepting bySurface Map or plain object, returning the entry or null without throwing. Availability is isCaptureUnavailable true for missing store, explicit available false, or missing toggleRecord/screenshot; hasCaptureActions requires both functions callable.

Decision is deriveTileState(snapshot, row, lastRow): checks refusal/error, unavailable, departed row, terminal lifecycles, unknown lifecycle, stale, non-live transport, attaching binding, then fold/control axis. Refusal entry is refusalCodeFor(snapshot, row) reading row.refusal else snapshot.error, returning non-empty code or null.
adapter(view,id) builds a per-desktop feed/storage/defaultProfile: projection rows filtered by desktopRows, snapshot rows rewritten, layout read/written per desktop layout JSON, then persisted.

Projection snapshots flow from projectionView through bindView into snapshot ref; row selects exact id/surfaceId match, lastRow keeps last admitted row, tile derives the seven-state decision. Kit panel receives a mirrored view whose rows add folded boolean; snapshots without rows or unchanged rows pass through by reference without mutating inputs.

Admission reads projectionView.getProjection rows by surfaceId, demanding row.id equals capsuleId and lifecycle active/standby/ceded; lost with allowLostSurface passes for fixtures, lost/destroyed refuse ERR_SURFACE_GONE. Router resolves capsuleId from panel params and renders SurfacePanel; tabs read params capsuleId then reversible panel- prefix, preferring panel title then capsuleId then Capsule fallback.

Capture flow: captureState plus capsuleId feed readSurfaceEntry into entry, then surfaceEntryPhase into phase driving busy/badge and SaasRecordButton. Chip flow: surfaceId plus profileId plus tile into capsuleIdModel, rendered only when visible. Id flow: surface id into tile-<segment> DOM ids and anchors, canonical pass-through else hex per UTF-16 unit. Clipboard: injected wins else ambient navigator.clipboard.

persist() deep-clones state through cleanLayouts and writes atomically; concurrent calls coalesce via dirty/saving flags. After a write failure it latches readOnly and emits layout-error with LAYOUT_SAVE_REFUSED thereafter.

Semantic anchors are capsule/id/action for the 7 known panel actions; unknown actions throw PANEL_INVALID_ANCHOR, popout always unavailable with denies-new-windows. Control boxes round to integer CSS pixels, hidden/non-finite yields null. Props title/hint default to clear-workspace text, emits exactly add-capsule. All controller results are frozen WallAdmissionResult ok true with value or ok false with code/message; callers match on ok.

captureState contract: bySurface entries carry phase/elapsedMs/lastShot; toggleRecord and screenshot are functions of surfaceId returning promise-like {ok}; clipboard optional with writeText. Elapsed formats finite non-negative ms as MM:SS else --:--, only active recording shows readout. Badge copy Recording MM:SS/Starting/Stopping/Sealed else Idle with recording/busy/sealed/idle variants, error maps to idle. Fixed strings: Copy ID for AI, Copied, Copy unavailable.

Defaults 1280x900 capsule size and 23px footer strip, never hard-coded 16:9, strip omitted when showStrip false. Display-safe error status is Surface update unavailable with Refused: <code> parity. Freshness renders Frame <generation> for safe-integer generation 1+ from authority, empty for unadmitted rows. Presented-frame witness is empty when affirmatively nothing presented/terminal, null when unknowable, else opaque handle.

cleanLayouts prunes every desktop layout to surfaces assigned to that exact view/desktop, collapsing grid-preset orphans before each atomic persist. Capsule ids are never invented: blank/trimmed-different/whitespace refuse ERR_INVALID_CAPSULE_ID. Panel ids are deterministic panel-<capsuleId> and tab ids wall-tab-<capsuleId>. Empty wall always has branch root with one empty wall-empty leaf; activeGroup follows first surface.

A surface row is selected only when row.id and row.surfaceId both equal capsuleId; duplicates/mismatches never bind, missing yields null. Frame host stays mounted except destroyed rows; canvas drawing limited to active/standby/ceded while chrome/diagnostics keep rendering. Empty-wall section keeps aria-labelledby on empty-wall-title, mark aria-hidden, button id empty-wall-add with anchor wall/add-capsule.

Missing store, available false, or missing actions makes unavailable true; controls disable instead of throwing. Surface ids must be 1..128 shell-safe chars and identity lower-case 1..64 chars, else null line/invisible chip and id-only line without guessing. Only six phases known, others normalize to idle; chrome label prefers trimmed capsuleLabel then capsuleId then capsule, group always Tile capture controls. ui/tools builds and guards the shippable Linux Electron app. kitQuarantineReason.js is a Vite pre-transform overlay that rewrites pinned DockWorkspace.vue so quarantineReason starts as LAYOUT_RESTORE_PENDING and combines quarantineCode/restorePhase detail, failing closed with KIT_QUARANTINE_OVERLAY_DRIFT on anchor drift. package.js is the deterministic packager: stages ui/electron plus capsule-ui-kit, verifies imports, runs vite build, seals renderer/preload/electron digests into main/nesting, stages native core/adapter and node-pty, enforces ASAR-only, fuses, modes, ELF/font/arch policy, writes sha256 manifest, tars and atomically publishes, then provides packaged boot lifecycle (admission, private 0700 runtime, core spawn, socket wait, attach pointer, disposal) and clean-install smoke legs (fake/real adapter, no-profiles, retail refusal) with source-access and admission-leak checks. test_package_clean_install.mjs exercises all of this with temp fixtures via node --test: tamper, font, arch, seal, manifest, smoke-marker, boot-budget and receipt checks. Offers reproducible bundle, verified install, and boot/smoke entry points. Needs Node>=24, MV_PKG_OUT, CAPSULE_UI_KIT_REPO, Electron zip/dist pin, cargo/Go toolchains, offline locked deps, XDG runtime/config, xvfb/strace for smoke.
User-visible build break after kit upgrade: bundler fails with error text KIT_QUARANTINE_OVERLAY_DRIFT instead of producing the app, pointing at the quarantine overlay anchors.
When patched, testers see quarantine reason strings beginning with LAYOUT_RESTORE_PENDING or LAYOUT_READ_ONLY, optionally followed by ': ' plus detail; when unpatched, the reason starts empty.

User sees app quit at once with no window. Terminal shows PKG_CORE_START_FAILED, PKG_SEAL_MISMATCH key, PKG_HOST_RUNTIME_UNSAFE, SINGLE_INSTANCE already running, or METAVIEWER_BOOT_REFUSED RAM_ROOT_ABSENT with mkdir -p -m 700 fix.

Tester sees smoke error naming PKG_SMOKE_CHILD_FAILED or PKG_SMOKE_MARKER_MISSING plus JSON code/signal and last 3000 chars of stdout/stderr; missing METAVIEWER_RENDERER_READY or METAVIEWER_MAIN_SMOKE_OK means renderer or boot never completed.

Installer sees PKG_MANIFEST_MISMATCH name, PKG_ALIAS_FORBIDDEN, PKG_FONT_FORBIDDEN, PKG_BINARY_MISSING name, PKG_ARCH_MISMATCH name, PKG_ELECTRON_CHECKSUM context expected versus actual; tar/launch refused rather than running tampered bytes.

Tester sees smoke fail with PKG_SOURCE_ACCESS, PKG_ADMISSION_RESERVATION_LEAK, PKG_HOST_RUNTIME_REQUIRED, or PKG_SMOKE_CHILD_FAILED/marker missing; delivered tarball is rejected and no marker JSON is printed.

Tester sees node test failure naming PKG_MANIFEST_MISMATCH, PKG_FONT_FORBIDDEN, PKG_ARCH_MISMATCH, PKG_SMOKE_MARKER_MISSING, PKG_ELECTRON_CHECKSUM or admission reservation leak instead of pass, indicating a tampered, misbuilt or leaking package rather than a flaky harness.

If either before string is missing or duplicated after a kit upgrade, split length check fails and the build throws KIT_QUARANTINE_OVERLAY_DRIFT; no patched source is returned and the build stops at the pre transform.

Security fail: missing app.asar or present app/app.asar.unpacked throws ASAR-only layout required; alias/unpacked entry throws refused; seal missing/invalid, asset mismatch key, inventory mismatch, entry mismatch, required entry absent all throw.

Admission fail before children: missing/non-absolute XDG_RUNTIME_DIR throws PKG_HOST_RUNTIME_REQUIRED; non-dir/symlink/foreign uid/mode!=0700/non-canonical throws UNSAFE; absent/non-dir/non-canonical RAM root returns METAVIEWER_BOOT_REFUSED line.

Electron fail closed: version/electron binary/pin mismatch throws PKG_ELECTRON_PIN; unanchored dist without verified wrapper/pinned tree/zip throws PKG_ELECTRON_CHECKSUM with expected versus actual tree/zip detail on stderr.

Smoke fail: launch exception maps to PKG_SMOKE_CHILD_FAILED; nonzero code/null code/signal throws same; missing METAVIEWER_MAIN_SMOKE_OK plus METAVIEWER_RENDERER_READY lines throws PKG_SMOKE_MARKER_MISSING with bounded tails.

Fuse fail: sentinel missing/duplicate throws Fuse sentinel missing or ambiguous; version byte !=1 or length mismatch throws wire version/length mismatch; non 48/49 byte throws unavailable; post-write verify throws Fuse mismatch name.

Publish fail: existing finalDir or manifest throws EEXIST Package destination already exists; lost directory race throws same; crash recovery removes half-published dir/manifest/marker only when no in-flight commit, loser repairs winner manifest not delete.

If file trace contains repo path then throw PKG_SOURCE_ACCESS. Missing host runtime dir throws PKG_HOST_RUNTIME_REQUIRED. Nonempty hostRuntime/metaviewer/ram-admission (ENOENT treated as empty) throws PKG_ADMISSION_RESERVATION_LEAK.

Without MV_SRF_PROFILES the child must exit nonzero without smoke marker and its strace write trace must show completed adapter config diagnostic; assertAdapterConfigRefusal throws PKG_ADAPTER_CONFIG_REFUSAL_MISSING otherwise.

Retail launch with --remote-debugging-port=9222 must exit nonzero with RETAIL_FLAG on stdout/stderr; otherwise throw PKG_RETAIL_REFUSAL_MISSING with 3000-char refusalDetail. Catches only numeric code errors.

Early fail-closed errors: Node<24, CAPSULE_UI_KIT_REPO missing, neither MV_ELECTRON_ZIP_DIR nor ELECTRON_OVERRIDE_DIST_PATH, PKG_CARGO_TARGET_REQUIRED when CARGO_TARGET_DIR not absolute, PKG_REVISION_INVALID when git HEAD not 40 hex, packager built.length!=1.
kitQuarantineReason(source) takes a source string, applies two string replacements in order, throws on anchor drift, returns the patched source string.
kitQuarantineReasonPlugin() returns a Vite-style plugin object with name metaviewer-kit-quarantine-reason, enforce pre, and transform(source,id) called by the bundler per module.

Packaged boot entry: preparePackagedAdmission, mkdtemp mv-pkg- runtime 0700, write config.json 0600, spawn bin/metaviewer-core, poll metavier/core.sock under shared budget, then mainDirectEntry with SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP/will-quit/exit disposal.
CLI dispatch when argv[1] equals this module: --verify, --verify-install, --smoke, --smoke-operator, else packageShell(). Failures print error.message and set exitCode 1. --smoke logs JSON result.

cleanInstallSmoke(artifact path) extracts/installs to an isolated clean HOME, runs fake-adapter leg, real-adapter /dev/shm leg, no-profiles negative control, and retail-flag refusal leg, returning smoke marker on success.

transform receives source and id, normalizes id backslashes to slashes, checks endsWith /.kit/capsule-ui-kit/src/workspace/DockWorkspace.vue; match forwards source to kitQuarantineReason, mismatch returns undefined and leaves source unchanged.

Input source string flows through replacements loop: before/after pair one patches ref('') to ref('LAYOUT_RESTORE_PENDING'); pair two replaces st.quarantineReason assignment with quarantineCode plus restorePhase fallback joined with quarantineReason.

Verify flow: read app.asar electron/main.js seal JSON, check nesting seal equality, walk ASAR namespace excluding aliases/unpacked, recompute normalized digests for dist/renderer, dist/preload, electron, .kit and require exact inventory match.

Build data flows builder(app src/index/vite/electron/tools/kitQuarantineReason/package.json/node_modules symlink/kit sync) -> vite build -> stageElectronModules -> rename nesting.js, append mainDirectEntry export, write productionEntry and package-pin.json -> seal -> packager -> copy native/contracts/deps/operator resources.

Fake-adapter test starts a unix socket core, writes config with session and core daemon hellos, launches the adapter with createAdapterLauncher, asserts live availability and hello seen on both ends, disposes, then checks receipt handshake and reaped flags.
Each before anchor must occur exactly once: source.split(before).length must equal 2, else throw Error KIT_QUARANTINE_OVERLAY_DRIFT. Guarantees fail-closed behavior when the pinned kit changes.

Attach contract schema metaviewer.attach/v1 closed keys schema/session_id/pid/core_socket/boot_profile/env; session pkg-hex UUID, pid safe int>1, absolute paths no NUL/CR/LF, core_socket must be XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/metaviewer/core.sock.

Binary/font contract: ELF 64-bit LSB magic 7f454c46 class 2 data 1 machine 183 arm64 or 62 x64 plus exec bit; any font extension or magic wOFF/wOF2/OTTO/ttcf/true/typ1 or 00 01 00 00 throws PKG_FONT_FORBIDDEN.
assertSmokeOutput accepts only exact METAVIEWER_MAIN_SMOKE_OK plus METAVIEWER_RENDERER_READY lines; READY alone or a prefixed marker throws PKG_SMOKE_MARKER_MISSING.
After patch, quarantineReason initial value is LAYOUT_RESTORE_PENDING, so the workspace starts quarantined until layout restore resolves, rather than starting as empty unquarantined.

Install invariant: no symlinks/special entries, dirs 0755, files 0755 if any exec bit else 0644, manifest lines sorted sha256 plus mode marker, walk must match digest and mode exactly, count must equal manifest size.
Installed tree must never open repo sources: strace file trace is scanned for repo path and its realpath; match throws PKG_SOURCE_ACCESS. Covers fake-adapter and real-adapter legs.

ui/tools/package.js builds the reproducible MetaViewer Linux package: vite renderer, staged Electron modules, sealed assets, native core/adapter, Electron packager, fuses, manifest bundle. It also verifies install/security and runs clean-install smoke legs.
